text.id: Pemujaan sudah mapan pada Kerajaan Lama (sekitar 2613-2181 SM) dan berlanjut hampir 2.000 tahun
text.en: Worship already established by the Old Kingdom (c. 2613-2181 BCE) and continued for almost 2,000 years

short_description.id: Ra adalah dewa matahari Mesir kuno, penguasa langit, bumi, dan dunia bawah yang melayari langit dengan bahtera suryanya.
short_description.en: Ra is the ancient Egyptian sun god, ruler of the sky, the Earth, and the underworld, who sails the sky in his solar barque.

long_description.id: Ra (juga ditulis Re) adalah dewa matahari Mesir kuno dan termasuk dewa tertua dalam jajaran dewa Mesir. Namanya berarti matahari dalam bahasa Mesir. Ia kemudian dilebur dengan dewa lain, misalnya Ra-Horakhty (matahari pagi), Amun (matahari siang), dan Atum (matahari petang). Ra ditampilkan hampir selalu sebagai Ra-Horakhty berkepala elang dengan cakram matahari di atas kepala, dan kadang sebagai kumbang scarab.
long_description.en: Ra (also written Re) is the sun god of ancient Egypt and one of the oldest deities in the Egyptian pantheon. His name is the Egyptian word for sun. He was later merged with other gods, such as Ra-Horakhty (the morning sun), Amun (the noonday sun), and Atum (the evening sun). Ra is almost always shown as the falcon-headed Ra-Horakhty with the solar disc above his head, and sometimes as a scarab beetle.

long_description.id: Menurut sumber, Ra berkuasa di langit, bumi, dan Duat (dunia bawah). Pada siang hari ia membawa matahari melintasi langit dengan bahtera suryanya, lalu turun ke dunia bawah saat matahari terbenam. Di sana, pada malam hari, bahteranya menjadi Kapal Sejuta Jiwa yang menjemput orang mati yang telah dibenarkan menuju Field of Reeds, dan Ra melebur dengan Osiris sebagai Ra-Osiris. Ular Apophis menyerangnya setiap malam, dan setiap malam ia dikalahkan oleh para dewa di atas bahtera yang dibantu orang mati yang dibenarkan.
long_description.en: According to the sources, Ra ruled over the sky, the Earth, and the Duat (underworld). By day he carries the sun across the sky in his solar barque and descends into the underworld at sunset. There, at night, his barque becomes the Ship of a Million Souls, which picks up the justified dead and brings them to the Field of Reeds, and Ra merges with Osiris as Ra-Osiris. The serpent Apophis attacks him every night, and every night it is defeated by the gods aboard the barque, helped by the justified dead.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah penciptaan yang paling dikenal, Ra sang Pencipta-Diri berdiri di atas gundukan purba ben-ben yang muncul dari air bergolak, menciptakan Hu dan Sia, lalu melahirkan Shu dan Tefnut. Sumber lain menyebut dewa pencipta Atum menampakkan diri dalam rupa Ra, dan manusia tercipta dari air mata Ra, atau dalam sebagian kisah dari air mata dan keringatnya. Ketika Ra menua dan manusia memberontak, Mata Ra, yang dalam Kitab Sapi Langit adalah Hathor, dilepaskan untuk menghancurkan mereka. Setelah itu Ra yang lelah meminta Nut membawanya ke langit.
long_description.en: In the best-known creation story, Ra the Self-Created stands on the primordial ben-ben mound that rose from swirling water, creates Hu and Sia, and then gives birth to Shu and Tefnut. Another source says that the creator Atum manifested in the form of Ra, and that humans came from Ra's tears, or in some accounts from his tears and sweat. When Ra grew old and humans rebelled, the Eye of Ra, who in the Book of the Heavenly Cow is Hathor, was released to destroy them. Afterwards a weary Ra asked Nut to carry him into the heavens.

long_description.id: Pemujaan Ra sudah mapan pada Kerajaan Lama dan berlanjut hampir 2.000 tahun. Ia pertama kali disebut dalam Teks Piramida, dan pusat pemujaannya adalah Iunu, yang dikenal sebagai Heliopolis. Raja Userkaf dari Dinasti ke-5 mengangkat pemujaan Ra hampir menjadi agama negara dan membangun kuil matahari, dan para penerusnya menyebut diri putra Ra. Menurut Richard H. Wilkinson, Ra boleh dikatakan dewa terpenting Mesir, dan pemujaannya baru surut setelah penaklukan Romawi.
long_description.en: Worship of Ra was established in the Old Kingdom and continued for almost 2,000 years. He is first mentioned in the Pyramid Texts, and his cult center was Iunu, known as Heliopolis. King Userkaf of the 5th Dynasty elevated the cult of Ra almost to a state religion and built a sun temple, and his successors called themselves sons of Ra. According to Richard H. Wilkinson, Ra is arguably Egypt's most important deity, and his cult declined only after the Roman conquest.

cultural_context.id: Menurut sumber, raja Mesir yang diilahikan dianggap putra Dewa Matahari, dan para raja Dinasti ke-5 menyebut diri putra Ra. Ra juga dikaitkan dengan pemberian kehidupan, dan dewa-dewa besar Mesir banyak yang menyatu dengannya.
cultural_context.en: The sources say Egypt's deified king was regarded as the Sun God's son and that 5th Dynasty kings styled themselves sons of Ra. Ra is also tied to the giving of life, and many major Egyptian gods fused with him.

literal_meaning.id: "matahari"
literal_meaning.en: "sun"

who.id: Ra adalah dewa matahari Mesir kuno yang membawa matahari melintasi langit.
who.en: Ra is the ancient Egyptian sun god who carries the sun across the sky.

origin.id: Ia berasal dari agama Mesir kuno dan pertama kali disebut dalam Teks Piramida; pusat pemujaannya Heliopolis.
origin.en: He comes from ancient Egyptian religion and is first mentioned in the Pyramid Texts; his cult center was Heliopolis.

role.id: Ra berkuasa di langit, bumi, dan dunia bawah, serta dalam beberapa kisah menciptakan dunia.
role.en: Ra ruled over the sky, the Earth, and the underworld, and in some stories created the world.

famous_for.id: Ia paling dikenal karena pelayaran suryanya dan pertempuran malamnya melawan ular Apophis.
famous_for.en: He is best known for his solar voyage and his nightly battle against the serpent Apophis.

did_you_know.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam sebagian kisah manusia tercipta dari air mata dan keringat Ra, sehingga orang Mesir menyebut diri "Ternak Ra".
did_you_know.en: Wikipedia notes that some accounts have humans arising from Ra's tears and sweat, which is why Egyptians called themselves the "Cattle of Ra".

name.en: Creation of the world and life

description.id: Semua bentuk kehidupan dipercaya diciptakan oleh Ra, dan dalam kisah penciptaan terbaik dikenal ia sang Pencipta-Diri yang berdiri di gundukan purba, menciptakan Hu dan Sia, lalu melahirkan Shu dan Tefnut.
description.en: All forms of life were believed to have been created by Ra; in the best-known creation story he is the Self-Created who stands on the primordial mound, creates Hu and Sia, and gives birth to Shu and Tefnut.

name.en: Carrying the sun across the sky

description.id: Tugas Ra sebagai dewa matahari adalah membawa matahari melintasi langit dengan bahtera suryanya untuk menerangi hari.
description.en: Ra's duty as the sun god was to carry the sun across the sky on his solar barque to light the day.

description.id: Sebagai dewa pertama, Ra menciptakan heka, sihir ilahi, dan memanfaatkannya, sehingga lahirlah Heka yang kemudian memelihara dan mengendalikannya.
description.en: As the first god, Ra created heka, divine magic, and harnessed it, resulting in the birth of Heka, who then maintained and controlled it.

description.id: Dalam pelayarannya di Dunia Bawah, Ra menerangi orang mati, menghancurkan musuh ciptaan, dan memperbarui dirinya dalam persatuan dengan Osiris.
description.en: During his voyage through the Underworld, Ra illuminates the dead, destroys the enemies of creation, and regenerates himself in union with Osiris.

description.id: Dalam kutipan Wilkinson, Ra dikatakan mengarahkan tiga musim dalam setahun Mesir, sehingga memengaruhi banjir Sungai Nil serta musim tanam dan panen.
description.en: In a passage by Wilkinson, Ra was said to direct the three seasons of the Egyptian year, influencing the Nile inundation and the growing and harvest seasons.

description.id: Dalam Teks Piramida Ra menghimpun jiwa raja dan membawanya ke Field of Reeds dengan bahtera emasnya; pada malam hari bahteranya menjemput orang mati yang telah dibenarkan.
description.en: In the Pyramid Texts Ra gathers the soul of the king and takes him to the Field of Reeds in his golden barge; at night his barque picks up the justified dead.

description.id: Setiap malam ular raksasa Apophis menyerang Ra di dunia bawah dan berusaha mencegah matahari terbit, tetapi selalu dikalahkan.
description.en: Every night the giant serpent Apophis attacks Ra in the underworld, trying to prevent the sun from rising, but is always defeated.

description.id: Dalam mitos, Ra menjadi terlalu tua dan lelah untuk memerintah di bumi dan pergi ke langit.
description.en: In myth, Ra became too old and weary to reign on Earth and went to the skies.

description.id: Wujud Ra yang dilebur dengan Horus, digambarkan sebagai lelaki berkepala elang dengan cakram matahari; ia dikaitkan dengan matahari pagi. Saat fajar Ra juga dapat berbentuk elang Hor-akhty.
description.en: Ra merged with Horus, depicted as a falcon-headed male with the solar disc; he is linked with the morning sun. At dawn Ra can also take the form of the falcon Hor-akhty.

description.id: Ra dapat ditampilkan sebagai kumbang scarab, kheper, "yang menjadi ada".
description.en: Ra could be shown as a scarab beetle, kheper, "the one who comes into being".

description.id: Peleburan Ra dengan dewa-dewa besar lain, misalnya Amon-Ra, Khnum-Ra, dan Sobek-Ra.
description.en: The synthesis of Ra with other great gods, for example Amon-Ra, Khnum-Ra, and Sobek-Ra.

description.id: Pada malam hari Ra melebur dengan Osiris; Osiris dipandang sebagai "jasad" dan Ra sebagai "jiwa" dewa tunggal itu.
description.en: At night Ra merges with Osiris; Osiris is seen as the "corpse" and Ra as the "soul" of the single deity.

description.id: Di Heliopolis Ra dipuja dalam rupa banteng Mnevis, perwujudan hidup Ra.
description.en: At Heliopolis Ra was worshiped in the form of the Mnevis bull, the living embodiment of Ra.

role.id: Pencipta-Diri
role.en: The Self-Created creator

summary.id: Pada awal waktu hanya ada air bergolak sampai gundukan purba ben-ben muncul dan Ra sang Pencipta-Diri berdiri di atasnya. Ia menciptakan Hu dan Sia, lalu melahirkan Shu dan Tefnut yang pergi menata dunia.
summary.en: At the beginning of time there was only swirling water until the primordial ben-ben mound rose and Ra the Self-Created stood upon it. He created Hu and Sia, then gave birth to Shu and Tefnut, who left to establish the world.

title.en: The Book of the Heavenly Cow

role.id: Dewa yang menua dan meninggalkan bumi
role.en: The aging god who leaves the earth

summary.id: Ra memanggil Mata Ra, yang dalam kisah ini adalah Hathor, untuk menghancurkan manusia; ia membunuh ribuan orang sebelum Ra menyesal dan memintanya berhenti. Karena lelah memerintah manusia, Ra meminta Nut membawanya ke langit, dan Nut menjelma sapi langit.
summary.en: Ra summons the Eye of Ra, who in this story is Hathor, to destroy humans; she kills thousands before Ra repents and begs her to stop. Tired of ruling humans, Ra asks Nut to carry him into the heavens, and Nut becomes a celestial cow.

title.en: The night voyage through the underworld

role.id: Pemimpin bahtera yang menghadapi Apophis
role.en: Leader of the barque who faces Apophis

summary.id: Pada malam hari Ra berlayar di dunia bawah, menerangi orang mati dan memperbarui dirinya bersama Osiris. Bahteranya menjemput orang mati yang telah dibenarkan menuju Field of Reeds, dan Apophis yang menyerang setiap malam selalu dikalahkan.
summary.en: At night Ra sails the underworld, illuminating the dead and regenerating himself with Osiris. His barque picks up the justified dead and brings them to the Field of Reeds, and Apophis, who attacks every night, is always defeated.

role.id: Dewa yang memutuskan pemusnahan
role.en: The god who decides on extermination

summary.id: Ketika Ra yang menua menyempurnakan ciptaannya, manusia memberontak. Ra memutuskan memusnahkan mereka dan meminta bantuan matanya.
summary.en: While the aging Ra was fine-tuning his creations, humanity rebelled. Ra decided on extermination and asked his eye for help.

description.id: Kota pusat pemujaan Ra; Iunu, yang lebih dikenal sebagai Heliopolis, "kota dewa matahari".
description.en: The city that was Ra's cult center; Iunu, better known as Heliopolis, "city of the sun god".

description.id: Tempat Teks Piramida, yang pertama kali menyebut Ra, terpahat pada sarkofagus dan dinding makam.
description.en: Where the Pyramid Texts, which first mention Ra, were inscribed on sarcophagi and tomb walls.

description.id: Kuil Matahari Ra yang dibangun Raja Userkaf.
description.en: The Sun Temple of Ra built by King Userkaf.

description.id: Surga tempat Ra membawa jiwa raja dan orang mati yang telah dibenarkan.
description.en: The paradise to which Ra takes the soul of the king and the justified dead.

description.id: Dunia bawah, salah satu bagian dunia ciptaan tempat Ra berkuasa.
description.en: The underworld, one of the parts of the created world where Ra ruled.

description.id: Ra pertama kali disebut dalam Teks Piramida di Saqqara.
description.en: Ra is first mentioned in the Pyramid Texts at Saqqara.

description.id: Pemujaan Ra sudah mapan dan berlanjut hampir 2.000 tahun.
description.en: Worship of Ra was already established and continued for almost 2,000 years.

title.en: Sun temples and sons of Ra

description.id: Userkaf mengangkat pemujaan Ra hampir menjadi agama negara dan membangun Nekhenre; para penerusnya menyebut diri putra Ra.
description.en: Userkaf elevated the cult of Ra almost to a state religion and built Nekhenre; his successors called themselves sons of Ra.

description.id: Saat Akhenaten melarang semua kultus lain, pemujaan Ra tetap dibiarkan.
description.en: While Akhenaten outlawed every other cult, the cult of Ra was allowed to continue.

note.id: Ular raksasa yang menyerang Ra setiap malam di dunia bawah.
note.en: The giant serpent that attacks Ra every night in the underworld.

note.id: Ra menjadi Atum saat matahari terbenam; sumber lain menyebut Atum pada dasarnya adalah Ra dengan nama lain.
note.en: Ra becomes Atum at sunset; another source says Atum was essentially Ra by another name.

note.id: Ra dilebur dengan Horus menjadi Ra-Horakhty.
note.en: Ra was merged with Horus as Ra-Horakhty.

note.id: Amun berkembang dari Ra dan berbagi banyak mitologinya.
note.en: Amun developed from Ra and shares much of his mythology.

note.id: Ra melebur dengan Osiris di dunia bawah sebagai Ra-Osiris.
note.en: Ra merges with Osiris in the underworld as Ra-Osiris.

note.id: Dilahirkan Ra bersama Tefnut dalam kisah penciptaan.
note.en: Born of Ra together with Tefnut in the creation story.

note.id: Dilahirkan Ra bersama Shu dalam kisah penciptaan.
note.en: Born of Ra together with Shu in the creation story.

note.id: Salah satu putri Ra, yang mewujudkan kehadirannya pada penghakiman orang mati.
note.en: One of Ra's daughters, who embodied his presence at the judgment of the dead.

note.id: Dalam Kitab Sapi Langit, Hathor adalah Mata Ra yang dilepaskan untuk menghancurkan manusia.
note.en: In the Book of the Heavenly Cow, Hathor is the Eye of Ra released to destroy humanity.

note.id: Dewi yang membawa Ra ke langit sebagai sapi langit.
note.en: The goddess who carries Ra into the heavens as a celestial cow.

note.id: Heka lahir ketika Ra menciptakan dan memanfaatkan heka.
note.en: Heka was born when Ra created and harnessed heka.

traditional.id: Dalam tradisi Mesir kuno, Ra adalah dewa matahari yang melintasi langit dengan bahtera suryanya dan turun ke dunia bawah saat matahari terbenam.
traditional.en: In ancient Egyptian tradition Ra is the sun god who crosses the sky in his solar barque and descends into the underworld at sunset.

modern.id: Menurut sumber ini, gema Ra masih terdengar dalam cerita rakyat Mesir masa kini dan nama Ra muncul dalam film Hollywood dan gim video.
modern.en: According to this source, echoes of Ra are still heard in folklore in present-day Egypt, and the name Ra appears in Hollywood films and video games.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa Ra digambarkan dalam beberapa wujud berbeda pada pagi, siang, dan petang?
learning_questions.en: Why is Ra shown in different forms at morning, noon, and evening?

learning_questions.id: Apa arti pertempuran nyata setiap malam antara Ra dan Apophis bagi orang Mesir kuno?
learning_questions.en: What did the nightly battle between Ra and Apophis mean for the ancient Egyptians?

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana dewa-dewa lain dapat "melebur" dengan Ra tanpa kehilangan identitasnya?
learning_questions.en: How could other gods merge with Ra without losing their own identity?

sources.title: Ra, The Creator God of Ancient Egypt
sources.author: Fayza Haikal

claims.quote: Ra (also given as Re) is the sun god of ancient Egypt.

statement.id: Ra adalah dewa matahari Mesir kuno.
statement.en: Ra is the ancient Egyptian sun god.

claims.quote: Ra is the Egyptian word for 'sun'.

statement.id: Nama Ra berarti matahari dalam bahasa Mesir.
statement.en: Ra is the Egyptian word for sun.

claims.quote: As a solar deity, Ra embodied the power of the sun but was also thought to be the sun itself, envisioned as the great god riding in his barge across the heavens throughout the day and descending into the underworld at sunset.

statement.id: Ra melintasi langit dengan bahtera pada siang hari dan turun ke dunia bawah saat matahari terbenam.
statement.en: Ra crosses the sky in a barque by day and descends to the underworld at sunset.

claims.quote: As he made his way through the darkness beneath the earth, he was attacked nightly by the giant serpent Apophis (also known as Apep) who tried to prevent the sun from rising and so destroy all life on earth.

statement.id: Ular Apophis menyerang Ra di dunia bawah setiap malam.
statement.en: The serpent Apophis attacks Ra in the underworld each night.

claims.quote: An island emerged from the water to support this divinity, who manifested itself in the form of Ra, the sun god of Egypt.

statement.id: Dalam kisah penciptaan, dewa pencipta menampakkan diri sebagai Ra di pulau yang muncul dari air.
statement.en: In the creation story, the deity manifests as Ra on an island emerging from water.

claims.quote: When Ra appeared at dawn in the Eastern horizon, he took the form of a falcon, known as Hor-akhty, or Horus of the Horizon, the falcon who flies high in the sky (Horus = one who is high up.)

statement.id: Saat fajar Ra dapat berbentuk elang Hor-akhty.
statement.en: At dawn Ra can appear as the falcon Hor-akhty.

claims.quote: At sunset he became Atum, an old man who had completed his life cycle and was ready to disappear to be regenerated for a new day.

statement.id: Saat matahari terbenam Ra menjadi Atum.
statement.en: At sunset Ra becomes Atum.

claims.quote: The word Ra also appears in everything from Hollywood films to video games.

statement.id: Nama Ra juga muncul dalam film Hollywood dan gim video.
statement.en: Ra's name also appears in Hollywood films and video games.

claims.quote: Ra (also given as Re) is the sun god of ancient Egypt. He is one of the oldest deities in the Egyptian pantheon and was later merged with others such as Horus, becoming Ra-Horakhty (the morning sun), Amun (as noonday sun), and Atum (the evening sun) associated with primal life-giving energy.

statement.id: Ra termasuk dewa tertua dalam jajaran dewa Mesir dan kemudian dilebur dengan dewa lain: Ra-Horakhty (matahari pagi), Amun (matahari siang), dan Atum (matahari petang).
statement.en: Ra is one of the oldest deities in the Egyptian pantheon and was later merged with others: Ra-Horakhty (the morning sun), Amun (the noonday sun), and Atum (the evening sun).

claims.quote: Ra is first mentioned in the Pyramid Texts (c. 2400-2300 BCE), the oldest religious works in the world, which were inscribed on the sarcophagi and walls of tombs at Saqqara.

statement.id: Ra pertama kali disebut dalam Teks Piramida (sekitar 2400-2300 SM) yang terpahat pada sarkofagus dan dinding makam di Saqqara.
statement.en: Ra is first mentioned in the Pyramid Texts (c. 2400-2300 BCE), inscribed on sarcophagi and tomb walls at Saqqara.

claims.quote: Worship of Ra was already well established at the time these texts - which are thought to derive from a much earlier oral tradition - were inscribed. His cult center was at the city of Iunu (better known as Heliopolis, the Greek name, which means "city of the sun god").

statement.id: Pusat pemujaan Ra berada di kota Iunu, yang lebih dikenal dengan nama Yunaninya, Heliopolis, "kota dewa matahari".
statement.en: Ra's cult center was the city of Iunu, better known by its Greek name Heliopolis, "city of the sun god".

claims.quote: He is almost always depicted as the falcon-headed male Ra-Horakhty with the solar disc above his head although sometimes also shown as the scarab beetle below the solar disc (in this form he is known as Ra-Khepri.

statement.id: Ra hampir selalu digambarkan sebagai Ra-Horakhty berkepala elang dengan cakram matahari di atas kepalanya, kadang juga sebagai kumbang scarab di bawah cakram matahari.
statement.en: Ra is almost always depicted as the falcon-headed Ra-Horakhty with the solar disc above his head, sometimes also as the scarab beetle below the solar disc.

claims.quote: In the best-known version of the story, there was nothing but swirling waters at the beginning of time when the primordial mound (the ben-ben) rose as the first dry land and Ra the Self-Created stood upon it.

statement.id: Dalam versi yang paling dikenal, pada awal waktu hanya ada air bergolak, lalu gundukan purba (ben-ben) muncul sebagai daratan pertama dan Ra sang Pencipta-Diri berdiri di atasnya.
statement.en: In the best-known version, at the beginning of time there was only swirling water until the primordial mound (the ben-ben) rose as the first dry land and Ra the Self-Created stood upon it.

claims.quote: Ra the Self-Created stood upon it. He cut his penis open and, from the drops of blood, created Hu (authority) and Sia (mind), and then became aware of his solitude and mated with his own shadow to give birth to Shu (god of air) and Tefnut (goddess of moisture) who left to establish the world.

statement.id: Dalam kisah penciptaan itu Ra menciptakan Hu (otoritas) dan Sia (pikiran), lalu melahirkan Shu (dewa udara) dan Tefnut (dewi kelembapan), yang pergi untuk menata dunia.
statement.en: In that creation story Ra creates Hu (authority) and Sia (mind), then gives birth to Shu (god of air) and Tefnut (goddess of moisture), who left to establish the world.

claims.quote: Ra is tired of ruling over humans, however, and asks the goddess Nut to carry him into the heavens. Nut turns herself into a celestial cow and takes Ra skyward on her back.

statement.id: Dalam Kitab Sapi Langit, Ra yang lelah memerintah manusia meminta dewi Nut membawanya ke langit, dan Nut menjelma sapi langit yang membawanya naik di punggungnya.
statement.en: In the Book of the Heavenly Cow, a Ra tired of ruling humans asks the goddess Nut to carry him into the heavens, and Nut becomes a celestial cow and takes him skyward on her back.

claims.quote: Ra summons The Eye of Ra, usually personified as a goddess, which is a powerful force that alternately does Ra's bidding or breaks free of his control to wreak havoc.

statement.id: Ra memanggil Mata Ra, yang biasanya dipersonifikasikan sebagai dewi, kekuatan dahsyat yang bergantian menuruti perintah Ra atau lepas dari kendalinya dan mengamuk.
statement.en: Ra summons the Eye of Ra, usually personified as a goddess, a powerful force that alternately does Ra's bidding or breaks free of his control to wreak havoc.

claims.quote: The sun barge now transformed into the evening barge known as the Ship of a Million Souls which picked up the newly arrived and justified dead to bring them to the paradise of the Field of Reeds.

statement.id: Pada malam hari bahtera matahari berubah menjadi bahtera malam, Kapal Sejuta Jiwa, yang menjemput orang mati yang telah dibenarkan menuju surga Field of Reeds.
statement.en: At night the sun barge becomes the evening barge, the Ship of a Million Souls, which picks up the newly arrived and justified dead and brings them to the paradise of the Field of Reeds.

claims.quote: Ra at this time becomes merged with Osiris, the judge of the dead, and Osiris is seen as the "corpse" and Ra as the "soul" of the single deity Ra-Osiris.

statement.id: Pada saat itu Ra melebur dengan Osiris, hakim orang mati; Osiris dipandang sebagai "jasad" dan Ra sebagai "jiwa" dewa tunggal Ra-Osiris.
statement.en: At that time Ra merges with Osiris, the judge of the dead; Osiris is seen as the "corpse" and Ra as the "soul" of the single deity Ra-Osiris.

claims.quote: The gods onboard fight the serpent off with the help of the justified dead while, on earth, the living encourage the defenders through ritual ceremonies, channeling positive energies to strengthen those on board. Every night Apophis attacks, and every night he is defeated.

statement.id: Para dewa di atas bahtera, dibantu orang mati yang dibenarkan, menangkis ular itu; Apophis menyerang setiap malam dan setiap malam ia dikalahkan.
statement.en: The gods aboard, helped by the justified dead, fight the serpent off; Apophis attacks every night and every night he is defeated.

claims.quote: A specific and important example of Ra's influence on the earth is seen in that the god was said to direct the three seasons of the Egyptian year - thus influencing the annual inundation of the Nile and the subsequent growing and harvest seasons.

statement.id: Menurut kutipan Wilkinson dalam sumber ini, Ra dikatakan mengarahkan tiga musim dalam setahun Mesir, sehingga memengaruhi banjir tahunan Sungai Nil serta musim tanam dan panen.
statement.en: In a passage by Wilkinson quoted in this source, the god was said to direct the three seasons of the Egyptian year, influencing the annual Nile inundation and the growing and harvest seasons.

claims.quote: The founder of the 5th Dynasty of the Old Kingdom, the king Userkaf (r. late 26th century BCE), epitomized this ideal in elevating the Cult of Ra to the position of almost a state religion and encouraging his subjects to adhere to Ra's values.
claims.locator: Ra as King & Father of the King

statement.id: Raja Userkaf, pendiri Dinasti ke-5 Kerajaan Lama, mengangkat pemujaan Ra hampir menjadi agama negara.
statement.en: King Userkaf, founder of the 5th Dynasty of the Old Kingdom, elevated the Cult of Ra to almost a state religion.

claims.quote: According to scholar Richard H. Wilkinson, Ra is "arguably Egypt's most important deity" not only because of his association with the life-giving sun but also through his influence on the development of later gods

statement.id: Menurut sarjana Richard H. Wilkinson, Ra "boleh dikatakan dewa terpenting Mesir", karena kaitannya dengan matahari pemberi kehidupan dan pengaruhnya pada perkembangan dewa-dewa kemudian.
statement.en: According to scholar Richard H. Wilkinson, Ra is "arguably Egypt's most important deity", because of his link to the life-giving sun and his influence on the development of later gods.

claims.quote: Amun, who would become so popular that his cult was almost monotheistic in devotion and the most powerful in ancient Egypt, developed from Ra and shares much of his mythology.

statement.id: Amun, yang kelak sangat populer, berkembang dari Ra dan berbagi banyak mitologinya.
statement.en: Amun, who would become hugely popular, developed from Ra and shares much of his mythology.

claims.quote: Ra, as the first god, created heka and harnessed it, resulting in the birth of Heka who then maintained and controlled the divine magic afterwards.

statement.id: Sebagai dewa pertama, Ra menciptakan heka (sihir ilahi) dan memanfaatkannya, sehingga lahirlah Heka yang kemudian memelihara dan mengendalikannya.
statement.en: As the first god, Ra created heka (divine magic) and harnessed it, resulting in the birth of Heka, who then maintained and controlled it.

claims.quote: Reaching the Western horizon, Ra then left the earth in darkness for 12 hours of night while he sailed the Underworld, illuminating the dead, destroying the enemies of creation, and regenerating himself in a union with Osiris, the god of resurrection.

statement.id: Setelah mencapai cakrawala barat, Ra berlayar di Dunia Bawah selama 12 jam malam, menerangi orang mati, menghancurkan musuh ciptaan, dan memperbarui dirinya dalam persatuan dengan Osiris.
statement.en: Reaching the Western horizon, Ra sails the Underworld for 12 hours of night, illuminating the dead, destroying the enemies of creation, and regenerating himself in union with Osiris.

claims.quote: But Ra had other forms. He also could be represented as a scarab called kheper (the one who comes into being)

statement.id: Ra juga dapat digambarkan sebagai kumbang scarab bernama kheper, "yang menjadi ada".
statement.en: Ra could also be represented as a scarab called kheper, "the one who comes into being".

claims.quote: While the aging Ra was fine-tuning his creations, humanity rebelled against him. The god decided on extermination, asking his tear-giving eye again for help.

statement.id: Ketika Ra yang menua menyempurnakan ciptaannya, umat manusia memberontak; ia memutuskan memusnahkan mereka dan meminta bantuan matanya.
statement.en: While the aging Ra was fine-tuning his creations, humanity rebelled; he decided on extermination and asked his eye for help.

claims.quote: during the reign of the so-called heretic king Akhenaten (1353-1336 BCE), when he closed down and outlawed every other cult, he allowed the cult of Ra to remain and worship to continue.

statement.id: Pada masa Raja Akhenaten (1353-1336 SM), yang menutup dan melarang semua kultus lain, pemujaan Ra tetap dibiarkan berlanjut.
statement.en: During the reign of Akhenaten (1353-1336 BCE), who closed down and outlawed every other cult, the cult of Ra was allowed to continue.

claims.quote: And by the way, humankind happened out of the tears of his eyes.

statement.id: Menurut sumber ini, umat manusia lahir dari air mata mata Ra.
statement.en: According to this source, humankind came into being from the tears of Ra's eyes.

claims.quote: In the Old Kingdom (2800 BCE), when Egypt established its institutions and expressed its royal ideology, the divinized king of Egypt was considered the son of the Sun God.

statement.id: Pada Kerajaan Lama (2800 SM) raja Mesir yang diilahikan dianggap putra Dewa Matahari.
statement.en: In the Old Kingdom (2800 BCE) the divinized king of Egypt was considered the son of the Sun God.

claims.quote: It would take yet more centuries and Roman conquest before the cult of Ra declined.

statement.id: Pemujaan Ra baru surut setelah berabad-abad lagi dan penaklukan Romawi.
statement.en: The cult of Ra declined only after yet more centuries and the Roman conquest.

claims.quote: most of Egypt's great gods synthesized with Ra as Amon-Ra, Khnum-Ra, Sobek-Ra, and so forth.

statement.id: Sebagian besar dewa besar Mesir menyatu dengan Ra, misalnya sebagai Amon-Ra, Khnum-Ra, dan Sobek-Ra.
statement.en: Most of Egypt's great gods synthesized with Ra, as Amon-Ra, Khnum-Ra, Sobek-Ra, and so forth.

claims.quote: All forms of life were believed to have been created by Ra. In some accounts, humans were created from Ra's tears and sweat, hence the Egyptians called themselves the "Cattle of Ra".

statement.id: Semua bentuk kehidupan dipercaya diciptakan oleh Ra; dalam sebagian kisah manusia tercipta dari air mata dan keringat Ra, sehingga orang Mesir menyebut diri "Ternak Ra".
statement.en: All forms of life were believed to have been created by Ra; in some accounts humans were created from Ra's tears and sweat, hence the Egyptians called themselves the "Cattle of Ra".

claims.quote: Ra ruled in all parts of the created world: the sky, the Earth, and the Duat (underworld).

statement.id: Ra berkuasa di seluruh bagian dunia ciptaan: langit, bumi, dan Duat (dunia bawah).
statement.en: Ra ruled in all parts of the created world: the sky, the Earth, and the Duat (underworld).

claims.quote: He was believed to have ruled as the second pharaoh of Ancient Egypt, succeeding Ptah. He was the god of the Sun, order, kings and the sky.

statement.id: Ra dipercaya memerintah sebagai firaun kedua Mesir kuno, menggantikan Ptah, dan ia adalah dewa matahari, ketertiban, raja, dan langit.
statement.en: Ra was believed to have ruled as the second pharaoh of Ancient Egypt, succeeding Ptah, and was the god of the Sun, order, kings and the sky.

claims.quote: According to Egyptian myth, when Ra became too old and weary to reign on Earth, he relinquished and went to the skies.

statement.id: Menurut mitos Mesir, ketika Ra terlalu tua dan lelah untuk memerintah di bumi, ia melepaskan takhta dan pergi ke langit.
statement.en: According to Egyptian myth, when Ra became too old and weary to reign on Earth, he relinquished his rule and went to the skies.

claims.quote: As the Sun god, his duty was to carry the Sun across the sky on his solar barque to light the day.

statement.id: Sebagai dewa matahari, tugas Ra membawa matahari melintasi langit dengan bahtera suryanya untuk menerangi hari.
statement.en: As the Sun god, Ra's duty was to carry the Sun across the sky on his solar barque to light the day.

claims.quote: Worship of Ra was already established by the time of the Old Kingdom of Egypt (c. 2613-2181 BCE) and continued for almost 2,000 years until, like the other Egyptian gods, he was eclipsed by Christianity.

statement.id: Pemujaan Ra sudah mapan pada Kerajaan Lama Mesir (sekitar 2613-2181 SM) dan berlanjut hampir 2.000 tahun hingga ia dikalahkan Kekristenan.
statement.en: Worship of Ra was already established by the Old Kingdom (c. 2613-2181 BCE) and continued for almost 2,000 years until he was eclipsed by Christianity.

claims.quote: Userkaf and his successors referred to themselves as "sons of Ra" and were understood as literally being the children of the god.
claims.locator: Ra as King & Father of the King

statement.id: Userkaf dan penerusnya menyebut diri "putra Ra" dan dipahami benar-benar sebagai anak sang dewa.
statement.en: Userkaf and his successors called themselves "sons of Ra" and were understood as literally being the god's children.

claims.quote: In these, Ra gathers the soul of the king to himself and takes him to the paradise of the Field of Reeds in his golden barge.

statement.id: Dalam Teks Piramida, Ra menghimpun jiwa raja dan membawanya ke surga Field of Reeds dengan bahtera emasnya.
statement.en: In the Pyramid Texts, Ra gathers the soul of the king to himself and takes him to the paradise of the Field of Reeds in his golden barge.

claims.quote: Hathor is the Eye of Ra here and is released to destroy humanity. She kills thousands before Ra realizes what he has done and repents, begging her to stop.

statement.id: Dalam Kitab Sapi Langit, Hathor sebagai Mata Ra dilepaskan untuk menghancurkan manusia dan membunuh ribuan orang sebelum Ra menyesal dan memintanya berhenti.
statement.en: In the Book of the Heavenly Cow, Hathor as the Eye of Ra is released to destroy humanity and kills thousands before Ra repents and begs her to stop.

claims.quote: Userkaf built the Nekhenre - the Sun Temple of Ra - near Abusir and established a tradition venerating Ra which continued throughout the dynasty.
claims.locator: Ra as King & Father of the King

statement.id: Userkaf membangun Nekhenre, Kuil Matahari Ra, di dekat Abusir dan memulai tradisi memuliakan Ra.
statement.en: Userkaf built the Nekhenre, the Sun Temple of Ra, near Abusir and established a tradition of venerating Ra.

claims.quote: Ma'at, one of Ra's daughters, also embodied his presence at the judgment and was among his defenders on board the barge

statement.id: Ma'at, salah satu putri Ra, mewujudkan kehadirannya pada penghakiman dan termasuk pembelanya di atas bahtera.
statement.en: Ma'at, one of Ra's daughters, embodied his presence at the judgment and was among his defenders aboard the barge.

claims.quote: he was worshiped at Heliopolis in the form of the Mnevis bull, the living embodiment of Ra, comparable to the better-known Apis bull.

statement.id: Di Heliopolis Ra dipuja dalam rupa banteng Mnevis, perwujudan hidup Ra.
statement.en: At Heliopolis Ra was worshiped in the form of the Mnevis bull, the living embodiment of Ra.

claims.quote: Ra was the Giver of Life in the form of the sun who became associated with the Breath of Life in his form of Amun.

statement.id: Ra adalah Pemberi Kehidupan dalam rupa matahari, dan dikaitkan dengan Napas Kehidupan dalam rupa Amun.
statement.en: Ra was the Giver of Life in the form of the sun and became associated with the Breath of Life in his form of Amun.

claims.quote: Parents None (most accounts) Khnum and Neith (alternative sources) Hathor (In the cycle of rebirth) Mehet-Weret (some accounts)

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Ra pada sebagian besar kisah tidak punya orang tua; sumber lain menyebut Khnum dan Neith, Hathor (dalam siklus kelahiran kembali), atau Mehet-Weret.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, Ra has no parents in most accounts; alternative sources name Khnum and Neith, Hathor (in the cycle of rebirth), or Mehet-Weret.

claims.quote: In the case of Atum, he was essentially Ra only by another name

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Atum pada dasarnya adalah Ra dengan nama lain.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Atum was essentially Ra by another name.

claims.quote: Ancient Egyptian: 𓂋𓐰𓂝𓇳, romanized: rꜥ

short_description.id: Ganesha adalah dewa Hindu berkepala gajah, putra Shiva dan Parvati, yang dipuja sebagai penyingkir rintangan dan dihormati di awal banyak kegiatan.
short_description.en: Ganesha is an elephant-headed Hindu deity, son of Shiva and Parvati, worshipped as a remover of obstacles and honoured at the start of many undertakings.

long_description.id: Ganesha adalah salah satu dewa terpenting dalam agama Hindu. Ia dikenali dari kepala gajah dan tubuh manusia, dikaitkan dengan penulis, pelancong, pelajar, dan perdagangan, serta dipuja sebagai penyingkir rintangan. Ia juga dikenal sebagai Ganapati, Vinayaka, dan Pillaiyar, dan menurut tradisi ia dipuja lebih dulu sebelum dewa lain. Sebuah deskripsi museum menyebutnya putra Shiva dan Parvati, dan umat percaya ia memberi keberhasilan serta kemakmuran. Para pemuja mempersembahkan manisan seperti modaka dan laddu kepadanya.
long_description.en: Ganesha is one of the most important gods in Hinduism. He is recognized by his elephant head and human body, associated with writers, travellers, students, and commerce, and worshipped as a remover of obstacles. He is also known as Ganapati, Vinayaka, and Pillaiyar, and tradition holds that he is worshipped before other gods. A museum description calls him the son of Shiva and Parvati, and devotees believe he grants success and prosperity. Devotees offer him sweets such as modaka and laddus.

long_description.id: Sebuah patung museum menunjukkan tali jerat, kapak, manisan, dan gading di keempat tangannya. Dalam ikonografi ia sering digambarkan membawa gading patah, kapak atau pengait, jerat, dan mangkuk manisan, dan menunggangi atau ditemani seekor tikus. Beberapa kisah menjelaskan kepala gajahnya: dalam kisah yang paling sering, Parvati menciptakannya dari tanah liat dan Shiva memenggalnya lalu menggantikan kepalanya dengan kepala gajah; kisah lain menyebut ia tercipta dari tawa Shiva. Tentang gadingnya yang patah, sumber menyebut ia melemparkannya kepada Bulan yang menertawakannya, atau mematahkannya untuk menyalin Mahabharata yang didiktekan Vyasa.
long_description.en: A museum sculpture shows a lasso, battle-ax, sweet, and tusk in his four hands. In iconography he is often shown with a broken tusk, an axe or goad, a noose, and a bowl of sweets, and riding or attended by a mouse. Several stories explain his elephant head: in the most recurrent one Parvati created him from clay and Shiva beheaded him and replaced the head with an elephant's; another says he was created from Shiva's laughter. For his broken tusk, sources say he hurled it at the laughing Moon, or snapped it off to transcribe the Mahabharata dictated by Vyasa.

long_description.id: Dalam Mahabharata terjemahan Ganguli, Vyasa memanggil Ganesa untuk menuliskan karyanya dan Ganesa bersedia asalkan penanya tidak berhenti. Ganesha juga dipuja dalam tradisi Jain dan Buddha, dan di Jepang dikenal sebagai Kangiten. Gambar dan sebutan paling awal di wilayah Indonesia masa kini berasal dari abad ke-7 dan ke-8, dan di Indonesia ia dipandang sebagai simbol pengetahuan, kebijaksanaan, dan pendidikan.
long_description.en: In Ganguli's translation of the Mahabharata, Vyasa calls Ganesa to write his work and Ganesa agrees provided his pen does not cease. Ganesha is also worshipped in Jain and Buddhist traditions, and in Japan he is known as Kangiten. The earliest images and mentions in present-day Indonesia date to the 7th and 8th centuries, and in Indonesia he is seen as a symbol of knowledge, wisdom, and education.

long_description.id: Ganesha dihormati pada awal doa dan upacara oleh umat Hindu dari semua aliran, dan ia ditempatkan di pintu banyak kuil. Festival Ganesh Chaturthi berlangsung sepuluh hari dengan arca tanah liat, dan pada 1893 Lokmanya Tilak mengubahnya dari perayaan keluarga menjadi acara publik besar. Teks-teks utama tentang Ganesha mencakup Ganesha Purana, Mudgala Purana, dan Ganapati Atharvasirsha. Teks Hindu menyebut Ganesha antara abad ke-1 SM dan abad ke-2 M, dan wujud klasiknya muncul pada awal abad ke-4 hingga ke-5 M.
long_description.en: Ganesha is honoured at the start of prayers and ceremonies by Hindus of all denominations, and stands at the doorway of many temples. The Ganesh Chaturthi festival lasts ten days with clay idols, and in 1893 Lokmanya Tilak transformed it from family celebrations into a grand public event. Among the main texts about Ganesha are the Ganesha Purana, the Mudgala Purana, and the Ganapati Atharvasirsha. Hindu texts mention Ganesha between the 1st century BCE and 2nd century CE, and his classic form appears in the early 4th to 5th centuries CE.

cultural_context.id: Ganesha dipandang sebagai dewa lintas sekte: umat Hindu dari semua aliran menyerunya pada awal doa, kegiatan penting, dan upacara. Di Indonesia, di kalangan yang mayoritas beragama Islam, ia tidak dipuja tetapi dipandang sebagai simbol pengetahuan, kebijaksanaan, dan pendidikan.
cultural_context.en: Ganesha is not tied to a single sect: Hindus of every denomination call on him when beginning prayers, major undertakings, and ceremonies. Among predominantly Muslim Indonesians he is not worshipped but is seen as a symbol of knowledge, wisdom, and education.

description.id: Ganesha dipuja sebagai penyingkir rintangan, dan umat memulai kegiatan baru dengan memuja atau mempersembahkan sesuatu kepadanya. Menurut tradisi ia juga dapat menaruh rintangan di jalan orang yang perlu dihentikan.
description.en: Ganesha is worshipped as a remover of obstacles, and devotees begin new undertakings by worshipping or making offerings to him. Traditionally he also places obstacles in the path of those who need to be checked.

description.id: Para pemuja percaya bahwa bila Ganesha diambil hatinya, ia memberi keberhasilan, kemakmuran, dan perlindungan dari kesulitan.
description.en: Devotees believe that if Ganesha is propitiated he grants success, prosperity, and protection against adversity.

description.id: Sebagai dewa peralihan, Ganesha ditempatkan di pintu banyak kuil Hindu untuk menolak yang tak layak, selaras dengan perannya sebagai penjaga pintu Parvati.
description.en: As god of transitions, Ganesha is placed at the doorway of many Hindu temples to keep out the unworthy, analogous to his role as Parvati's doorkeeper.

description.id: Bentuk populer Ganesha yang berkepala gajah lima; variasi jumlah kepala lain yang lebih jarang juga dikenal.

description.id: Mudgala Purana menggambarkan delapan inkarnasi Ganesha dengan kendaraan berbeda, misalnya tikus, singa, merak, dan ular Shesha.
description.en: The Mudgala Purana describes eight incarnations of Ganesha with different mounts, such as the mouse, a lion, a peacock, and the serpent Shesha.

description.en: Statues of Ganesha are found throughout the region, often beside Shiva sanctuaries, and his forms in the Hindu art of the Philippines, Java, Bali, and Borneo show specific regional influences.

description.en: In Japan Ganesha is known as Kangiten; the cult was first mentioned in 806.

role.en: Parvati's son who stood guard

summary.id: Dalam salah satu kisah, Parvati membuat Ganesha dari tanah dan menempatkannya sebagai penjaga saat mandi. Shiva pulang dan murka, para bhutagana bertarung dengan sang anak hingga kepalanya terpenggal. Shiva yang menyesal memerintahkan kepala baru dicari dan hewan pertama yang ada adalah gajah. Sebagai ganjaran atas keberaniannya, Shiva menjadikannya pemimpin para bhutagana.
summary.en: In one account, Parvati made Ganesha from earth and set him as guard while she bathed. Shiva returned and was outraged, the bhutaganas fought the boy and his head was cut off. Repentant, Shiva ordered a new head to be found and the first animal available was an elephant. As a reward for his courage Shiva made him leader of the bhutaganas.

role.id: Pemenang karena kecerdikannya
role.en: Winner through cleverness

summary.id: Dalam kisah yang menjelaskan kaitan Ganesha dengan kecerdasan dan kebijaksanaan, ia bersaing dengan Karthikeya untuk menikah lebih dulu. Ia dinyatakan menang dan menikahi Buddhi (Kebijaksanaan) dan Siddhi (Keberhasilan), putri-putri Prajapati.
summary.en: In a story explaining Ganesha's association with intelligence and wisdom, he competes with Karthikeya to marry first. He is declared the winner and marries Buddhi (Wisdom) and Siddhi (Success), daughters of Prajapati.

title.en: The modakas, the rat, the snake, and the Moon

role.id: Tokoh utama yang jatuh lalu membalas Bulan
role.en: Protagonist who falls, then answers the Moon

summary.id: Dalam salah satu kisah, setelah makan terlalu banyak modaka, Ganesha menunggangi tikus raksasanya, Kroncha. Perutnya pecah saat jatuh dan ia melilitkan ular di perutnya agar tertutup. Ketika Bulan menertawakannya, Ganesha mematahkan ujung salah satu gadingnya dan melemparnya ke wajah Bulan hingga menghitam.
summary.en: In another account, after eating too many modakas Ganesha rode his giant rat Kroncha. His belly burst when he fell and he wound the snake around his midriff to close it. When the Moon laughed at him, Ganesha snapped the tip off one tusk and threw it at the Moon's face, which was struck black.

title.en: Ganesa as scribe of the Mahabharata

role.id: Penulis yang menuliskan diktat Vyasa
role.en: Scribe taking down Vyasa's dictation

summary.id: Dalam terjemahan Ganguli, Vyasa mengingat Ganesa untuk menulis karyanya. Ganesa bersedia asalkan penanya tidak berhenti, dan Vyasa meminta ia berhenti menulis bila ada yang tidak dipahaminya. Ganesa menyetujui dengan mengucapkan Om lalu mulai menulis.
summary.en: In Ganguli's translation, Vyasa calls Ganesa to mind to write his work. Ganesa agrees provided his pen does not cease, and Vyasa asks him to stop writing wherever he does not comprehend. Ganesa assents by saying Om and begins to write.

statement.en: Ganesha is patron of writers, travellers, students, and commerce, and removes obstacles.

claims.quote: The potbellied, elephant-headed Hindu god Ganesha, son of Shiva and Parvati, is venerated throughout India. He is believed to bestow success and abundance through his removal of obstacles. Before any important task is begun, an offering is made to Ganesha.

statement.id: Ganesha adalah putra Shiva dan Parvati dan diberi persembahan sebelum tugas penting dimulai.
statement.en: Ganesha is Shiva and Parvati's son and receives offerings before important undertakings.

claims.quote: Repentant, Shiva ordered a new head to be found for the boy and, as the first animal available was an elephant, so Ganesha gained a new elephant head

statement.id: Dalam suatu kisah, Shiva mengganti kepala Ganesha dengan kepala gajah.
statement.en: In one story Shiva had Ganesha's head replaced with an elephant's.

claims.quote: Ganesha is also worshipped as a principal deity in both Jainism and Buddhism.

statement.id: Ganesha juga dipuja dalam tradisi Jain dan Buddha.
statement.en: Ganesha is also worshipped in Jain and Buddhist traditions.

claims.quote: Here, his upper left hand holds a lasso; the upper right, a battle-ax; the lower left, a sweet; and the lower right, one of his own tusks

statement.id: Pada patung museum Ganesha memegang tali, kapak, manisan, dan gadingnya sendiri.
statement.en: In a museum sculpture Ganesha holds a lasso, axe, sweet, and one of his tusks.

claims.quote: Ganesha is mentioned in Hindu texts between the 1st century BCE and 2nd century CE

statement.id: Teks Hindu menyebut Ganesha antara abad pertama sebelum Masehi dan abad kedua Masehi.
statement.en: Hindu texts mention Ganesha between the first century BCE and the second century CE.

claims.quote: Ganesha is the son of Shiva and Parvati and he is the brother of Karthikeya (or Subrahmanya), the god of war. He was created by his mother using earth which she moulded into the shape of a boy.

statement.id: Ganesha adalah putra Shiva dan Parvati serta saudara Karthikeya (Subrahmanya), dewa perang; menurut kisah ini ia dibuat ibunya dari tanah yang dibentuk menjadi seorang anak laki-laki.
statement.en: Ganesha is the son of Shiva and Parvati and brother of Karthikeya (Subrahmanya), the god of war; in this account his mother created him from earth moulded into the shape of a boy.

claims.quote: As Shiva was away on his meditative wanderings, Parvati set her new son as guard while she bathed. Unexpectedly, Shiva returned home and, on finding the boy, and outraged at his impudence in claiming he was Parvati's son, Shiva called for his gang of demons, the bhutaganas, who fought ferociously with the boy.

statement.id: Saat Shiva pergi bertapa, Parvati menempatkan putranya sebagai penjaga ketika ia mandi. Shiva pulang dan murka, lalu memanggil para bhutagana yang bertarung sengit melawan sang anak.
statement.en: While Shiva was away on meditative wanderings, Parvati set her son as guard while she bathed. Shiva returned, was outraged, and called his bhutaganas, who fought ferociously with the boy.

claims.quote: However, the youngster easily held his own against such fearsome adversaries and Vishnu was forced to intervene in the form of Maya and, whilst the boy was distracted by her beauty, the demons, or Shiva himself, lopped off his head.

statement.id: Sang anak mampu menahan lawan-lawannya hingga Vishnu turun tangan dalam wujud Maya; saat anak itu terpikat kecantikannya, para bhutagana atau Shiva sendiri memenggal kepalanya.
statement.en: The boy held his own until Vishnu intervened in the form of Maya; while he was distracted by her beauty, the demons, or Shiva himself, cut off his head.

claims.quote: As a reward for his great courage in fighting the demons, Shiva made Ganesha the leader of the bhutaganas, hence his name.

statement.id: Sebagai ganjaran atas keberaniannya melawan para bhutagana, Shiva menjadikan Ganesha pemimpin mereka, dan dari situlah namanya.
statement.en: As a reward for his courage in fighting the bhutaganas, Shiva made Ganesha their leader, hence his name.

claims.quote: A story which explains the god's association with intelligence and wisdom is his competition with Karthikeya to be the first to marry. ... Declared the winner, Ganesha promptly married not one but two daughters of Prajapati: Buddhi (Wisdom) and Siddhi (Success), with whom he had two sons: Kshema and Laabha.

statement.id: Kisah yang menjelaskan kaitan Ganesha dengan kecerdasan dan kebijaksanaan adalah perlombaannya dengan Karthikeya untuk menikah lebih dulu; ia dinyatakan menang dan menikahi Buddhi dan Siddhi, putri-putri Prajapati.
statement.en: A story explaining Ganesha's association with intelligence and wisdom is his competition with Karthikeya to marry first; declared the winner, he married Buddhi and Siddhi, daughters of Prajapati.

claims.quote: One day, after eating a few too many modakas (sacrificial cakes), Ganesha decided to take a ride on his giant rat, Kroncha, to aid his digestion.

statement.id: Suatu hari, setelah memakan terlalu banyak modaka (kue persembahan), Ganesha menunggangi tikus raksasanya, Kroncha, untuk membantu pencernaannya.
statement.en: One day, after eating too many modakas (sacrificial cakes), Ganesha rode his giant rat Kroncha to aid his digestion.

claims.quote: Ganesha landed on his full belly and it burst on hitting the ground. The cakes from his stomach rolled left, right and centre but Ganesha, unperturbed, carefully gathered them in, stuffed them all back into his belly and wound the snake around his midriff to keep it closed.

statement.id: Dalam kisah ini perut Ganesha pecah saat ia jatuh, lalu ia memasukkan kembali kue-kuenya dan melilitkan ular di perutnya agar tertutup.
statement.en: In this story Ganesha's belly burst when he fell; he stuffed the cakes back in and wound the snake around his midriff to keep it closed.

claims.quote: Outraged, Ganesha broke off the end of one of his tusks and hurled it at the laughing Moon who, hit full in the face, was struck black.

statement.id: Karena murka pada Bulan yang menertawakannya, Ganesha mematahkan ujung salah satu gadingnya dan melemparkannya ke wajah Bulan hingga menghitam.
statement.en: Outraged at the laughing Moon, Ganesha broke off the end of one of his tusks and hurled it at the Moon's face, which was struck black.

claims.quote: Yet another but less picturesque explanation of Ganesha's broken tusk was that he snapped it off in order to transcribe the epic poem Mahabharata, dictated by the sage Vyasa who wished to preserve the story for all time. This version explains Ganesha's association with writers and intellectuals.

statement.id: Penjelasan lain tentang gading Ganesha yang patah adalah bahwa ia mematahkannya untuk menyalin Mahabharata yang didiktekan resi Vyasa; versi ini menjelaskan kaitannya dengan penulis dan kaum intelektual.
statement.en: Another explanation of Ganesha's broken tusk is that he snapped it off to transcribe the Mahabharata dictated by the sage Vyasa; this version explains his association with writers and intellectuals.

claims.quote: In his hands he often carries a broken tusk, an axe, a ladle, a noose, prayer beads and a tray or bowl of sweets. He sometimes also wields an elephant goad in order to master life's obstacles.
claims.locator: How is Ganesha Represented in Art?

statement.id: Di tangannya ia sering membawa gading patah, kapak, sendok sayur, jerat, untaian doa, serta nampan atau mangkuk manisan, dan kadang pengait gajah untuk menguasai rintangan hidup.
statement.en: In his hands he often carries a broken tusk, an axe, a ladle, a noose, prayer beads, and a tray or bowl of sweets, and sometimes an elephant goad to master life's obstacles.

claims.quote: Ganesha is often depicted riding Kroncha, his giant rat, famed for its agility and also symbolic of the god's ability to circumvent obstacles.
claims.locator: How is Ganesha Represented in Art?

statement.id: Ganesha sering digambarkan menunggangi Kroncha, tikus raksasanya yang terkenal lincah dan melambangkan kemampuan sang dewa menghindari rintangan.
statement.en: Ganesha is often depicted riding Kroncha, his giant rat, famed for its agility and symbolic of his ability to circumvent obstacles.

claims.quote: Then Vyasa began to call to mind Ganesa. And Ganesa, obviator of obstacles, ready to fulfil the desires of his votaries, was no sooner thought of, than he repaired to the place where Vyasa was seated.

statement.id: Dalam terjemahan Ganguli, Vyasa mengingat Ganesa, "penyingkir rintangan" yang siap memenuhi keinginan para pemujanya, dan Ganesa segera datang ke tempat Vyasa duduk.
statement.en: In Ganguli's translation Vyasa calls Ganesa to mind, "obviator of obstacles" ready to fulfil the desires of his votaries, and Ganesa promptly comes to where Vyasa sits.

claims.quote: I will become the writer of thy work, provided my pen do not for a moment cease writing. ... Wherever there be anything thou dost not comprehend, cease to continue writing. ... Ganesa having signified his assent, by repeating the word Om! proceeded to write

statement.id: Ganesa bersedia menjadi penulis karya Vyasa dengan syarat penanya tidak berhenti; Vyasa meminta ia berhenti menulis bila ada yang tidak dipahaminya, dan Ganesa menyetujui dengan mengucapkan Om lalu mulai menulis.
statement.en: Ganesa agrees to be the writer of Vyasa's work provided his pen never ceases; Vyasa asks him to stop writing wherever he does not comprehend, and Ganesa assents by saying Om and begins to write.

claims.quote: Even the omniscient Ganesa took a moment to consider; while Vyasa, however, continued to compose other verses in great abundance.

statement.id: Menurut teks ini, bahkan Ganesa yang mahatahu sempat berpikir sejenak, sementara Vyasa terus menggubah banyak bait lain.
statement.en: According to this text even the omniscient Ganesa took a moment to consider, while Vyasa continued to compose many other verses.

claims.quote: The name Ganesha is a Sanskrit compound, joining the words gana (gaṇa), meaning a 'group, multitude, or categorical system' and isha (īśa), meaning 'lord or master'.

statement.id: Nama Ganesha adalah gabungan kata Sanskerta gana, berarti "kelompok, kumpulan, atau sistem kategori", dan isha, berarti "tuan atau penguasa".
statement.en: The name Ganesha is a Sanskrit compound of gana, meaning "group, multitude, or categorical system", and isha, meaning "lord or master".

claims.quote: also known as Ganapati, Vinayaka and Pillaiyar, is one of the best-known and most revered and worshipped deities in the Hindu pantheon and is the Supreme god in the Ganapatya sect.

statement.id: Ganesha juga dikenal sebagai Ganapati, Vinayaka, dan Pillaiyar; ia salah satu dewa Hindu yang paling terkenal dan dipuja, serta Dewa Tertinggi dalam sekte Ganapatya.
statement.en: Ganesha, also known as Ganapati, Vinayaka and Pillaiyar, is one of the best-known and most revered deities in the Hindu pantheon and the Supreme god in the Ganapatya sect.

claims.quote: Ganesha also holds the Title of "Pratham Pujya" (the god to be worshipped initially before the worship of any other Deity).

statement.id: Ganesha juga bergelar "Pratham Pujya", dewa yang dipuja lebih dulu sebelum pemujaan dewa lain.
statement.en: Ganesha also holds the title "Pratham Pujya", the god to be worshipped first before any other deity.

claims.quote: As the god of beginnings, he is honoured at the start of rites and ceremonies. Ganesha is also invoked during writing sessions as a patron of letters and learning.

statement.id: Sebagai dewa permulaan, Ganesha dihormati pada awal upacara dan ritus; ia juga diseru saat menulis sebagai pelindung huruf dan ilmu.
statement.en: As god of beginnings Ganesha is honoured at the start of rites and ceremonies, and invoked during writing sessions as patron of letters and learning.

claims.quote: The principal texts on Ganesha include the Ganesha Purana, the Mudgala Purana, and the Ganapati Atharvasirsha.

statement.id: Teks-teks utama tentang Ganesha mencakup Ganesha Purana, Mudgala Purana, dan Ganapati Atharvasirsha.
statement.en: The principal texts on Ganesha include the Ganesha Purana, the Mudgala Purana, and the Ganapati Atharvasirsha.

claims.quote: The Amarakosha, an early Sanskrit lexicon, lists eight synonyms of Ganesha: Vinayaka, Vighnarāja (equivalent to Vighnesha), Dvaimātura (one who has two mothers), Gaṇādhipa (equivalent to Ganapati and Ganesha), Ekadanta (one who has one tusk)

statement.id: Amarakosha, kamus Sanskerta awal, mencantumkan delapan sinonim Ganesha, di antaranya Vinayaka, Vighnarāja, Dvaimātura (berbunda dua), Gaṇādhipa, dan Ekadanta (bergading satu).
statement.en: The Amarakosha, an early Sanskrit lexicon, lists eight synonyms of Ganesha, including Vinayaka, Vighnarāja, Dvaimātura (one who has two mothers), Gaṇādhipa, and Ekadanta (one who has one tusk).

claims.quote: He is popularly worshipped as a remover of obstacles, though traditionally he also places obstacles in the path of those who need to be checked. Hence, he is often worshipped by the people before they begin anything new.

statement.id: Ganesha dipuja secara populer sebagai penyingkir rintangan, meski menurut tradisi ia juga menaruh rintangan di jalan orang yang perlu dihentikan; karena itu ia sering dipuja sebelum memulai sesuatu yang baru.
statement.en: Ganesha is popularly worshipped as a remover of obstacles, though traditionally he also places obstacles in the path of those who need to be checked; hence he is often worshipped before beginning anything new.

claims.quote: The earliest images and mention lists Ganesha as a major deity in present-day Indonesia, Thailand, Cambodia and Vietnam dating to the 7th and 8th centuries, and these mirror Indian examples of the 5th century or earlier.

statement.id: Gambar dan sebutan paling awal mencatat Ganesha sebagai dewa utama di wilayah Indonesia, Thailand, Kamboja, dan Vietnam masa kini, berasal dari abad ke-7 dan ke-8, dan mencerminkan contoh India abad ke-5 atau lebih awal.
statement.en: The earliest images and mentions list Ganesha as a major deity in present-day Indonesia, Thailand, Cambodia, and Vietnam, dating to the 7th and 8th centuries and mirroring Indian examples of the 5th century or earlier.

claims.quote: While some texts say that Ganesha was born with an elephant head, he acquires the head later in most stories. The most recurrent motif in these stories is that Ganesha was created by Parvati using clay to protect her and Shiva beheaded him when Ganesha came between Shiva and Parvati.

statement.id: Sebagian teks menyebut Ganesha lahir berkepala gajah, tetapi dalam kebanyakan kisah ia memperolehnya kemudian; motif paling sering adalah Parvati menciptakannya dari tanah liat dan Shiva memenggalnya.
statement.en: Some texts say Ganesha was born with an elephant head, but in most stories he acquires it later; the most recurrent motif is that Parvati created him from clay and Shiva beheaded him.

claims.quote: Another story says that Ganesha was created directly by Shiva's laughter. Because Shiva considered Ganesha too alluring, he gave him the head of an elephant and a protruding belly.

statement.id: Kisah lain menyebut Ganesha tercipta langsung dari tawa Shiva; karena Shiva menganggapnya terlalu memikat, ia memberinya kepala gajah dan perut buncit.
statement.en: Another story says Ganesha was created directly by Shiva's laughter; because Shiva considered him too alluring, he gave him an elephant head and a protruding belly.

claims.quote: Ganesha's earliest name was Ekadanta (One Tusked), referring to his single whole tusk, the other being broken. Some of the earliest images of Ganesha show him holding his broken tusk.

statement.id: Nama paling awal Ganesha adalah Ekadanta (Bergading Satu), merujuk pada satu gading utuhnya karena yang lain patah; beberapa arca paling awal memperlihatkannya memegang gading patah itu.
statement.en: Ganesha's earliest name was Ekadanta (One Tusked), referring to his single whole tusk, the other being broken; some of the earliest images show him holding his broken tusk.

claims.quote: In the standard configuration, Ganesha typically holds an axe or a goad in one upper arm and a pasha (noose) in the other upper arm.

statement.id: Dalam wujud baku, Ganesha biasanya memegang kapak atau pengait di satu lengan atas dan pasha (jerat) di lengan atas lainnya.
statement.en: In the standard configuration Ganesha typically holds an axe or a goad in one upper arm and a pasha (noose) in the other.

claims.quote: Ganesha is often shown riding on or attended by a mouse. ... Martin-Dubost says that the rat began to appear as the principal vehicle in sculptures of Ganesha in central and western India during the 7th century; the rat was always placed close to his feet.

statement.id: Ganesha sering digambarkan menunggangi atau ditemani seekor tikus; menurut Martin-Dubost, tikus mulai tampil sebagai kendaraan utama dalam arca Ganesha di India tengah dan barat pada abad ke-7.
statement.en: Ganesha is often shown riding on or attended by a mouse; per Martin-Dubost the rat began to appear as principal vehicle in sculptures in central and western India during the 7th century.

claims.quote: Devotees offer Ganesha sweets such as modaka and small sweet balls called laddus. He is often shown carrying a bowl of sweets, called a modakapātra.

statement.id: Para pemuja mempersembahkan manisan seperti modaka dan bola manis kecil bernama laddu kepada Ganesha; ia sering digambarkan membawa mangkuk manisan yang disebut modakapātra.
statement.en: Devotees offer Ganesha sweets such as modaka and small sweet balls called laddus; he is often shown carrying a bowl of sweets called a modakapātra.

claims.quote: An annual festival honours Ganesha for ten days, starting on Ganesh Chaturthi, which typically falls in late August or early September. The festival begins with people bringing in clay idols of Ganesha, symbolising the god's visit.

statement.id: Festival tahunan menghormati Ganesha selama sepuluh hari, dimulai pada Ganesh Chaturthi yang biasanya jatuh pada akhir Agustus atau awal September, dengan membawa masuk arca tanah liat sebagai lambang kunjungan sang dewa.
statement.en: An annual festival honours Ganesha for ten days, starting on Ganesh Chaturthi in late August or early September, beginning with clay idols brought in to symbolise the god's visit.

claims.quote: In 1893, Lokmanya Tilak transformed this annual Ganesha festival from private family celebrations into a grand public event.

statement.id: Pada 1893, Lokmanya Tilak mengubah festival tahunan Ganesha dari perayaan keluarga yang bersifat pribadi menjadi acara publik yang besar.
statement.en: In 1893 Lokmanya Tilak transformed this annual Ganesha festival from private family celebrations into a grand public event.

claims.quote: As the god of transitions, he is placed at the doorway of many Hindu temples to keep out the unworthy, which is analogous to his role as Parvati's doorkeeper.

statement.id: Sebagai dewa peralihan, Ganesha ditempatkan di pintu banyak kuil Hindu untuk menolak yang tak layak, selaras dengan perannya sebagai penjaga pintu Parvati.
statement.en: As god of transitions Ganesha is placed at the doorway of many Hindu temples to keep out the unworthy, analogous to his role as Parvati's doorkeeper.

claims.quote: Located within a 100-kilometer radius of the city of Pune, each of the eight shrines celebrates a particular form of Ganapati, complete with its own lore. The eight shrines are: Morgaon, Siddhatek, Pali, Mahad, Theur, Lenyadri, Ozar and Ranjangaon.

statement.id: Delapan kuil Ashtavinayak terletak dalam radius 100 kilometer dari kota Pune; masing-masing merayakan satu bentuk Ganapati dengan kisahnya sendiri: Morgaon, Siddhatek, Pali, Mahad, Theur, Lenyadri, Ozar, dan Ranjangaon.
statement.en: The eight Ashtavinayak shrines lie within a 100-kilometre radius of Pune; each celebrates a particular form of Ganapati with its own lore: Morgaon, Siddhatek, Pali, Mahad, Theur, Lenyadri, Ozar, and Ranjangaon.

claims.quote: Ganesha appeared in his classic form as a clearly-recognizable deity with well-defined iconographic attributes in the early 4th to 5th centuries CE.

statement.id: Ganesha tampil dalam wujud klasiknya sebagai dewa yang mudah dikenali dengan atribut ikonografi yang jelas pada awal abad ke-4 hingga ke-5 M.
statement.en: Ganesha appeared in his classic form as a clearly recognizable deity with well-defined iconographic attributes in the early 4th to 5th centuries CE.

claims.quote: An independent cult with Ganesha as the primary deity was well established by about the 10th century.

statement.id: Kultus mandiri dengan Ganesha sebagai dewa utama telah mapan pada sekitar abad ke-10.
statement.en: An independent cult with Ganesha as the primary deity was well established by about the 10th century.

claims.quote: Devotees believe that if Ganesha is propitiated, he grants success, prosperity and protection against adversity.

statement.id: Para pemuja percaya bahwa bila Ganesha diambil hatinya, ia memberi keberhasilan, kemakmuran, dan perlindungan dari kesulitan.
statement.en: Devotees believe that if Ganesha is propitiated he grants success, prosperity, and protection against adversity.

claims.quote: Ganesha is a non-sectarian deity. Hindus of all denominations invoke him at the beginning of prayers, important undertakings, and religious ceremonies. Dancers and musicians, particularly in southern India, begin art performances such as the Bharatanatyam dance with a prayer to Ganesha.

statement.id: Ganesha dipandang sebagai dewa lintas sekte: umat Hindu dari semua aliran menyerunya pada awal doa, kegiatan penting, dan upacara; penari dan pemusik, terutama di India selatan, memulai pertunjukan dengan doa kepadanya.
statement.en: Ganesha is a non-sectarian deity: Hindus of all denominations invoke him at the start of prayers, important undertakings, and ceremonies, and dancers and musicians, particularly in southern India, begin performances with a prayer to him.

claims.quote: Amongst Indonesians who predominantly profess the Islamic faith, Ganesha is not worshipped, but seen as a symbol of knowledge, wisdom and education. Many Indonesian public universities feature Ganesha's likeness in their grounds or logo.

statement.id: Di kalangan orang Indonesia yang mayoritas beragama Islam, Ganesha tidak dipuja tetapi dipandang sebagai simbol pengetahuan, kebijaksanaan, dan pendidikan; banyak universitas negeri Indonesia memuat gambarnya di kampus atau logo.
statement.en: Among predominantly Muslim Indonesians Ganesha is not worshipped but seen as a symbol of knowledge, wisdom, and education, and many Indonesian public universities feature his likeness in their grounds or logo.

claims.quote: Statues of Ganesha are found throughout the region, often beside Shiva sanctuaries. The forms of Ganesha found in the Hindu art of the Philippines, Java, Bali, and Borneo show specific regional influences.

statement.id: Arca Ganesha ditemukan di seluruh kawasan Asia Tenggara maritim, sering di samping tempat suci Shiva; bentuk Ganesha dalam seni Hindu di Filipina, Jawa, Bali, dan Kalimantan menunjukkan pengaruh khas daerah.
statement.en: Statues of Ganesha are found throughout the region of Maritime Southeast Asia, often beside Shiva sanctuaries; his forms in the Hindu art of the Philippines, Java, Bali, and Borneo show specific regional influences.

claims.quote: In Japan, where Ganesha is known as Kangiten, the Ganesha cult was first mentioned in 806.
claims.locator: Beyond India and Hinduism, In Buddhism

statement.id: Di Jepang, tempat Ganesha dikenal sebagai Kangiten, kultus Ganesha pertama kali disebut pada 806.
statement.en: In Japan, where Ganesha is known as Kangiten, the Ganesha cult was first mentioned in 806.

claims.quote: One of his popular forms, Heramba-Ganapati, has five elephant heads, and other less-common variations in the number of heads are known.

statement.id: Salah satu bentuk populernya, Heramba-Ganapati, berkepala gajah lima, dan variasi lain jumlah kepala yang lebih jarang diketahui.
statement.en: One of his popular forms, Heramba-Ganapati, has five elephant heads, and other less common variations in the number of heads are known.

claims.quote: Ganesha, or Ganesh (Sanskrit: गणेश, IAST: Gaṇeśa

statement.id: Nama Ganesha dalam bahasa Sanskerta ditulis गणेश, dengan transliterasi IAST Gaṇeśa.
statement.en: Ganesha's name is written गणेश in Sanskrit, with the IAST transliteration Gaṇeśa.

claims.quote: Ganesha is mentioned in Hindu texts between the 1st century BCE and 2nd century CE, and a few Ganesha images from the 4th and 5th centuries CE have been documented by scholars.

statement.id: Ganesha disebut dalam teks Hindu antara abad ke-1 SM dan abad ke-2 M, dan beberapa arca Ganesha dari abad ke-4 dan ke-5 M telah didokumentasikan para sarjana.
statement.en: Ganesha is mentioned in Hindu texts between the 1st century BCE and 2nd century CE, and a few Ganesha images from the 4th and 5th centuries CE have been documented by scholars.

claims.quote: Of the eight incarnations of Ganesha described in the Mudgala Purana, Ganesha uses a mouse (shrew) named Mushaka in five of them, a lion in his incarnation as Vakratunda, a peacock in his incarnation as Vikata, and Shesha, the divine serpent, in his incarnation as Vighnaraja.

statement.id: Dari delapan inkarnasi Ganesha dalam Mudgala Purana, ia memakai tikus bernama Mushaka pada lima inkarnasi, singa sebagai Vakratunda, merak sebagai Vikata, dan Shesha sang ular ilahi sebagai Vighnaraja.
statement.en: Of the eight incarnations of Ganesha in the Mudgala Purana, he uses a mouse named Mushaka in five, a lion as Vakratunda, a peacock as Vikata, and Shesha, the divine serpent, as Vighnaraja.

topic.en: How Ganesha got his elephant head

summary.id: Sebagian teks menyebut Ganesha lahir berkepala gajah, tetapi dalam kebanyakan kisah ia memperolehnya kemudian setelah dipenggal Shiva.
summary.en: Some texts say Ganesha was born with an elephant head, but in most stories he acquires it later after Shiva beheads him.

summary.id: Kisah lain menyebut ia tercipta langsung dari tawa Shiva, yang lalu memberinya kepala gajah karena menganggapnya terlalu memikat.
summary.en: Another story says he was created directly by Shiva's laughter, who then gave him an elephant head because he found him too alluring.

summary.id: Ia mematahkan gadingnya dan melemparkannya kepada Bulan yang menertawakannya.
summary.en: He broke off his tusk and hurled it at the laughing Moon.

summary.id: Ia mematahkannya untuk menyalin Mahabharata yang didiktekan Vyasa.
summary.en: He snapped it off to transcribe the Mahabharata dictated by Vyasa.
