learning_questions.id: Mengapa para penulis kemudian mungkin menggambarkan Odin sebagai Allfather meskipun kedudukannya di masyarakat Zaman Viking berbeda?
learning_questions.en: Why might later writers have portrayed Odin as Allfather even though his standing in Viking Age societies differed?

learning_questions.id: Pengorbanan apa saja yang dilakukan Odin untuk mendapatkan pengetahuan, dan apa yang diperolehnya?
learning_questions.en: What sacrifices does Odin make to gain knowledge, and what does he obtain?

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana atribut seperti gagak dan tombak membantu kita mengenali Odin dalam kisah dan hiasan?
learning_questions.en: How do attributes such as the ravens and the spear help us recognise Odin in stories and ornaments?

sources.title: Odin, Tor and the other Norse Gods
The Younger Edda; Also called Snorre's Edda, or The Prose Edda
sources.author: Snorri Sturluson (translated by Rasmus B. Anderson)

claims.quote: Odin (Old Norse: Óðinn) is the main god in Norse mythology. Described as an immensely wise, one-eyed old man

statement.id: Odin adalah dewa utama mitologi Nordik yang digambarkan bijak dan bermata satu.
statement.en: Odin is a leading Norse god depicted as wise and one-eyed.

claims.quote: the god of poetry, of the dead, of runes, and of magic.

statement.id: Odin terkait dengan puisi, orang mati, rune, dan sihir.
statement.en: Odin is associated with poetry, the dead, runes, and magic.

claims.quote: Odin's two ravens, Huginn ('thought') and Muninn ('wisdom') are very old mythical elements

statement.id: Dua gagak Odin bernama Huginn dan Muninn.
statement.en: Odin's two ravens are Huginn and Muninn.

claims.quote: In the mythic future, Odin leads the einherjar at Ragnarök, where he is killed by the monstrous wolf Fenrir.

statement.id: Dalam Ragnarök Odin dibunuh oleh Fenrir.
statement.en: Odin is killed by Fenrir at Ragnarök.

claims.quote: From written sources such as Snorri's Edda, other Edda poems and the Icelandic sagas, which was written down in the Middle Ages, we know the stories of Odin, Thor and the other Norse gods.

statement.id: Kisah Odin antara lain dikenal dari Edda dan saga Islandia yang ditulis pada Abad Pertengahan.
statement.en: Odin's tales survive in Edda writings and Icelandic sagas recorded in the Middle Ages.

claims.quote: gathers slain warriors around him in Valhalla ('hall of the slain')

statement.id: Odin mengumpulkan pejuang gugur di Valhalla.
statement.en: Odin gathers fallen warriors in Valhalla.

claims.quote: They fly around the world gathering news, and when they return, they sit on Odin's shoulder and whisper their tidings into his ear.

statement.id: Huginn dan Muninn terbang mencari kabar bagi Odin.
statement.en: The ravens fly to gather news for Odin.

claims.quote: Odin can be recognised by his hat and cloak, long beard, and only one eye

statement.id: Odin dikenali dari topi dan jubahnya, janggut panjang, dan hanya satu mata.
statement.en: Odin is recognised by his hat and cloak, long beard, and only one eye.

claims.quote: His spear Gungnir is one of his main attributes

statement.id: Tombak Gungnir adalah salah satu atribut utama Odin.
statement.en: His spear Gungnir is one of his main attributes.

claims.quote: Some other attributes are the ring Draupnir, which drips to form eight new rings every nine nights, and the horse Sleipnir, which is mentioned early on in Old Norse literature and is set apart by the somehow efficient total of eight legs.

statement.id: Atribut Odin lainnya adalah cincin Draupnir, yang meneteskan delapan cincin baru setiap sembilan malam, dan kuda Sleipnir yang berkaki delapan.
statement.en: Other attributes of Odin are the ring Draupnir, which drips eight new rings every nine nights, and the eight-legged horse Sleipnir.

claims.quote: Odin's immense knowledge is courtesy of Mímir's head (or else due to drinking from Mímir's well).

statement.id: Pengetahuan Odin yang luas disebut berasal dari kepala Mímir, atau dari minum air sumur Mímir.
statement.en: Odin's immense knowledge is said to come from Mímir's head, or else from drinking from Mímir's well.

claims.quote: The owner of the well hight Mimer. He is full of wisdom, for he drinks from the well with the Gjallar-horn. Alfather once came there and asked for a drink from the well, but he did not get it before he left one of his eyes as a pledge.

statement.id: Menurut Edda Prosa, Alfather tidak mendapat minum dari sumur Mimer sebelum meninggalkan salah satu matanya sebagai jaminan.
statement.en: According to the Prose Edda, Alfather received a drink from Mimer's well only after leaving one of his eyes there as a pledge.

claims.quote: nine nights of swinging from a branch of Yggdrasil, the World Tree, with a spear wound that put him close to death, and only then are the runes revealed to him.

statement.id: Odin menggantung sembilan malam di dahan Yggdrasil, pohon dunia, dengan luka tombak yang nyaris membunuhnya, dan baru setelah itu rune terungkap kepadanya.
statement.en: Odin hangs for nine nights from a branch of Yggdrasil, the World Tree, with a spear wound that brings him close to death, and only then are the runes revealed to him.

claims.quote: Snorri explains that Odin's superb poetic skills are due to him stealing the mead of the skalds (i.e. poets) by sleeping with the giantess Gunnlǫð, guardian of the mead, for three nights.

statement.id: Snorri menjelaskan bahwa kemahiran puisi Odin berasal dari pencurian mead para skald (penyair) setelah ia tidur tiga malam dengan raksasa perempuan Gunnlǫð, penjaga mead itu.
statement.en: Snorri explains that Odin's poetic skill comes from stealing the mead of the skalds (poets) after sleeping for three nights with the giantess Gunnlǫð, the mead's guardian.

claims.quote: his son Borr and the giant-daughter Bestla sired Odin and his brothers (usually named Vili and Vé)

statement.id: Borr dan raksasa perempuan Bestla menjadi orang tua Odin dan saudara-saudaranya, yang biasanya bernama Vili dan Vé.
statement.en: Borr and the giantess Bestla sired Odin and his brothers, usually named Vili and Vé.

claims.quote: The brothers then slew the proto-giant Ymir and used his flesh to create the earth, his skull to form the sky, his bones for the mountains, and his blood to make the sea.

statement.id: Odin bersaudara membunuh raksasa purba Ymir dan memakai dagingnya untuk bumi, tengkoraknya untuk langit, tulangnya untuk gunung, dan darahnya untuk laut.
statement.en: Odin and his brothers slew the proto-giant Ymir and made the earth from his flesh, the sky from his skull, the mountains from his bones, and the sea from his blood.

claims.quote: Odin's connection with war flows naturally into a connection with the dead, which is further illustrated by Odin as the leader of the so-called Wild Hunt - a widespread and old Germanic cult centred around a myth of an army of the dead who ride on the storms.

statement.id: Hubungan Odin dengan perang berlanjut ke hubungannya dengan orang mati, antara lain sebagai pemimpin Perburuan Liar (Wild Hunt), pasukan orang mati yang menunggang badai.
statement.en: Odin's link with war extends to a link with the dead, shown in his role as leader of the Wild Hunt, an army of the dead who ride on the storms.

claims.quote: Odin has his Valkyries - supernatural warrior women - bringing the bodies of fighters slain in battle to his special warrior paradise Valhalla; these fighters are known as the Einherjar and become Odin's strike-force against the encroaching powers of the Underworld during the Ragnarök.

statement.id: Para Valkyrie, perempuan prajurit gaib, membawa jasad prajurit yang gugur ke Valhalla; mereka dikenal sebagai Einherjar dan menjadi pasukan Odin melawan kekuatan dunia bawah saat Ragnarök.
statement.en: Odin's Valkyries, supernatural warrior women, bring fighters slain in battle to Valhalla; these fighters, the Einherjar, become Odin's strike-force against the powers of the Underworld at Ragnarök.

claims.quote: In southern and western Germanic sources, it was Odin who decided whether battles or individual warriors would be victorious or end in slightly less fortunate ways.

statement.id: Dalam sumber Jermanik selatan dan barat, Odin yang menentukan kemenangan pertempuran atau prajurit tertentu.
statement.en: In southern and western Germanic sources, Odin decided whether battles or individual warriors would be victorious.

claims.quote: He [Odin] is described as falling into trances, as leaving his body behind and travelling abroad in the spirit-form of an animal, and several times as having visions of wisdom provoked by various kinds of ordeal.

statement.id: Odin digambarkan jatuh ke dalam trans, meninggalkan tubuhnya dan mengembara dalam wujud roh hewan, serta beberapa kali mendapat penglihatan kebijaksanaan lewat berbagai cobaan.
statement.en: Odin is described as falling into trances, leaving his body to travel in the spirit-form of an animal, and several times having visions of wisdom provoked by ordeals.

claims.quote: in the great pagan temple of Old Uppsala in Sweden, too; in 1070 CE Adam of Bremen wrote of his visit to this place that a statue of Thor stood prominently in the centre of the hall, with Odin and Freyr to the side, and that sacrifices were made to Thor in case of famine, to Odin in times of war

statement.id: Pada 1070 M, Adam dari Bremen menulis bahwa di kuil Uppsala kuno patung Thor berdiri di tengah, Odin dan Freyr di sisinya, dan persembahan untuk Odin dibuat pada masa perang.
statement.en: In 1070 CE Adam of Bremen wrote that at the Old Uppsala temple a statue of Thor stood in the centre with Odin and Freyr at the sides, and that sacrifices were made to Odin in times of war.

claims.quote: Several of these stem from the reconstructed Proto-Germanic theonym Wōðanaz, meaning "lord of frenzy" or "leader of the possessed"

statement.id: Beberapa nama dan gelar Odin berasal dari nama dewa Proto-Jermanik hasil rekonstruksi, Wōðanaz, yang berarti "penguasa kegilaan" atau "pemimpin orang yang kerasukan".
statement.en: Several of Odin's names and titles stem from the reconstructed Proto-Germanic theonym Wōðanaz, meaning "lord of frenzy" or "leader of the possessed".

claims.quote: He also exists in Germanic mythology as Woden (in Old English), Wodan (in Old Franconian), and Wutan or Wuotan (in Old High German).

statement.id: Odin juga dikenal dalam mitologi Jermanik sebagai Woden (Inggris Kuno), Wodan (Franka Kuno), serta Wutan atau Wuotan (Jerman Kuno Tinggi).
statement.en: Odin also exists in Germanic mythology as Woden (Old English), Wodan (Old Franconian), and Wutan or Wuotan (Old High German).

claims.quote: Alfather he is called in our tongue, but in Asgard of old he had twelve names.

statement.id: Menurut Edda Prosa, sang dewa tertinggi disebut Alfather, dan di Asgard lama ia memiliki dua belas nama.
statement.en: According to the Prose Edda, the highest god is called Alfather, and in old Asgard he had twelve names.

claims.quote: Odin rides first; with his golden helmet, resplendent byrnie, and his spear Gungner, he advances against the Fenris-wolf.

statement.id: Dalam Edda Prosa, Odin maju paling depan dengan helm emas, baju zirah gemerlap, dan tombak Gungner melawan serigala Fenris.
statement.en: In the Prose Edda, Odin rides first, with golden helmet, resplendent byrnie, and his spear Gungner, and advances against the Fenris-wolf.

claims.quote: He was also adapted in Neil Gaiman's 2001 novel American Gods as Mr. Wednesday, a con artist revealed to be an incarnation of Odin.

statement.id: Odin diadaptasi dalam novel American Gods karya Neil Gaiman (2001) sebagai Mr. Wednesday, penipu yang ternyata adalah inkarnasi Odin.
statement.en: Odin was adapted in Neil Gaiman's 2001 novel American Gods as Mr. Wednesday, a con artist revealed to be an incarnation of Odin.

claims.quote: Odin was adapted as a character by Marvel Comics, first appearing in the Journey into Mystery series in 1962.

statement.id: Odin diadaptasi sebagai tokoh oleh Marvel Comics dan pertama muncul dalam seri Journey into Mystery pada 1962.
statement.en: Odin was adapted as a character by Marvel Comics, first appearing in the Journey into Mystery series in 1962.

claims.quote: The nature of Odin's magic moreover often causes him to be seen as a shaman, an aspect which is further bolstered by his function as a god of healing.

statement.id: Sihir Odin membuatnya sering dipandang sebagai syaman, dan pandangan ini diperkuat oleh fungsinya sebagai dewa penyembuhan.
statement.en: The nature of Odin's magic often leads him to be seen as a shaman, an aspect reinforced by his function as a god of healing.

claims.quote: Wider sources depict Odin as the son of Bestla and Borr; brother to Vili and Vé; and husband to the goddess Frigg, with whom he fathered Baldr. Odin has many other sons, including Thor, whom he sired with the earth-goddess Jörð.

statement.id: Sumber yang lebih luas menggambarkan Odin sebagai putra Bestla dan Borr, saudara Vili dan Vé, serta suami dewi Frigg, yang melahirkan Baldr; ia juga ayah Thor dari dewi bumi Jörð.
statement.en: Wider sources depict Odin as son of Bestla and Borr, brother of Vili and Vé, and husband of the goddess Frigg, with whom he fathered Baldr; he also fathered Thor with the earth-goddess Jörð.

claims.quote: Odin's role of 'Allfather' or father of the gods is more of a literary theme from later sources - seemingly influenced by Christian names for God - than an actual reflection of his status in Viking Age societies.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, peran Odin sebagai Allfather lebih merupakan tema sastra dari sumber yang lebih muda, tampaknya dipengaruhi sebutan Kristen untuk Tuhan, ketimbang cerminan kedudukannya di masyarakat Zaman Viking.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Odin's role as Allfather is more a literary theme from later sources, seemingly influenced by Christian names for God, than a reflection of his status in Viking Age societies.

claims.quote: And for this reason Odin is called Alfather, that he is the father of all gods and men, and of all things that were made by him and by his might.

statement.id: Menurut Edda Prosa, Odin disebut Alfather karena ia bapak semua dewa dan manusia serta segala yang dibuat olehnya.
statement.en: According to the Prose Edda, Odin is called Alfather because he is the father of all gods and men and of all things made by him and his might.

claims.quote: Odin used mainly magic to catch glimpses of the future.

statement.id: Odin terutama memakai sihir untuk melihat sekilas masa depan.
statement.en: Odin mainly used magic to catch glimpses of the future.

claims.quote: Because of this cosying up to her, he is allowed three sips, but he simply chugs and drains the containers, shape-shifts into an eagle and legs it (well, wings it) out of there.

statement.id: Dalam kisah mead puisi, Odin diizinkan tiga tegukan tetapi menghabiskan seluruh wadahnya, lalu berubah wujud menjadi elang dan kabur.
statement.en: In the story of the mead of poetry, Odin is allowed three sips but drains the containers, shape-shifts into an eagle and flees.

claims.quote: resides in Asgard (the stronghold and home of the gods)

statement.id: Odin tinggal di Asgard, benteng dan kediaman para dewa.
statement.en: Odin resides in Asgard, the stronghold and home of the gods.

claims.quote: Already in the Bronze Age do Swedish rock carvings depict figures of a god holding a spear, who with some imagination might be linked to Odin, and by at least 500 CE he clearly shows up on a range of ornaments alongside birds and warriors.

statement.id: Ukiran batu Swedia dari Zaman Perunggu menampilkan sosok dewa bertombak yang mungkin dikaitkan dengan Odin, dan paling lambat sekitar 500 M ia jelas muncul pada berbagai hiasan bersama burung dan prajurit.
statement.en: Bronze Age Swedish rock carvings show figures of a god holding a spear who might be linked to Odin, and by at least 500 CE he clearly appears on ornaments alongside birds and warriors.

claims.quote: Odin's main group of worshippers mostly consisted of the elite - kings, chieftains & poets - but also included warriors.

statement.id: Para pemuja utama Odin sebagian besar adalah kalangan elite, yaitu raja, kepala suku, dan penyair, serta juga prajurit.
statement.en: Odin's main group of worshippers mostly consisted of the elite, namely kings, chieftains and poets, but also included warriors.

claims.quote: Skaldic poetry (Viking Age, pre-Christian poetry mainly heard at courts by kings and their retinues), for instance, names Baldr, Thor, and Vali as Odin's sons, whereas later on the 13th-century CE Icelandic author Snorri Sturluson also adds Heimdall, Týr, Bragi, Vidarr, and Hodr to the list.

statement.id: Puisi skaldik menyebut Baldr, Thor, dan Vali sebagai putra Odin, sedangkan Snorri Sturluson pada abad ke-13 M menambahkan Heimdall, Týr, Bragi, Vidarr, dan Hodr.
statement.en: Skaldic poetry names Baldr, Thor and Vali as Odin's sons, whereas the 13th-century CE author Snorri Sturluson adds Heimdall, Týr, Bragi, Vidarr and Hodr.

claims.quote: in the Vafþrúðnismál Odin initiates a battle of wits with the giant Vafþrúðnir and beats him, while in the Grímnismál a disguised Odin is tortured and ends up revealing his extensive mythical knowledge to King Geirroðr.

statement.id: Dalam Vafþrúðnismál Odin memulai adu kecerdasan dengan raksasa Vafþrúðnir dan mengalahkannya; dalam Grímnismál Odin yang menyamar disiksa dan akhirnya membuka pengetahuannya kepada Raja Geirroðr.
statement.en: In Vafþrúðnismál Odin starts a battle of wits with the giant Vafþrúðnir and beats him; in Grímnismál a disguised Odin is tortured and ends up revealing his mythical knowledge to King Geirroðr.

claims.quote: The modern English weekday name Wednesday traces its origins to "day of Woden", wōdnesdæg in Old English, and is still seen in the Dutch name woensdag.

statement.id: Nama hari Wednesday dalam bahasa Inggris modern berasal dari "hari Woden" (wōdnesdæg dalam bahasa Inggris Kuno), dan masih terlihat pada nama Belanda woensdag.
statement.en: The modern English weekday name Wednesday traces its origin to "day of Woden" (wōdnesdæg in Old English), still seen in the Dutch name woensdag.

short_description.id: Osiris adalah dewa Mesir kuno, penguasa dunia bawah dan hakim orang mati, suami Isis yang dibunuh Set lalu dihidupkan kembali oleh Isis.
short_description.en: Osiris is the ancient Egyptian god who rules the underworld and judges the dead, husband of Isis, murdered by Set and revived by Isis.

long_description.id: Dalam kepercayaan Mesir kuno, Osiris adalah Penguasa Dunia Bawah dan Hakim Orang Mati, suami sekaligus saudara Isis, dan salah satu dewa terpenting. Ia putra sulung Geb (bumi) dan Nut (langit). Namanya, Osiris, adalah bentuk Latin dari Usir yang ditafsirkan sebagai "perkasa", meskipun etimologinya disebut tidak pasti. Ia juga dikenal sebagai Wennefer, "Sang Indah", dan Khentiamenti, "Yang Terdepan di antara Orang Barat".
long_description.en: In ancient Egyptian religion Osiris is the Lord of the Underworld and Judge of the Dead, brother-husband of Isis, and one of the most important gods. He is the firstborn of Geb (earth) and Nut (sky). His name, Osiris, is the Latinized form of Usir, interpreted as "powerful" or "mighty", although its etymology is also described as uncertain. He was also known as Wennefer, "The Beautiful One", and Khentiamenti, "The Foremost of the Westerners".

long_description.id: Menurut mitos utamanya, Osiris sebagai putra sulung memerintah sebagai Penguasa Bumi dengan Isis sebagai ratunya, dan memberi rakyat Mesir hukum, budaya, ajaran agama, dan pertanian. Saudaranya, Set, membuat peti mati seukuran tubuhnya; ketika Osiris berbaring di dalamnya, Set menutup dan menguncinya lalu melemparkannya ke Sungai Nil. Set kemudian mencincang jasadnya, tetapi Isis menghidupkannya kembali dan mengandung Horus. Osiris yang tidak utuh tak lagi dapat memerintah orang hidup dan mundur ke alam baka sebagai Penguasa dan Hakim Orang Mati. Horus kemudian bertempur melawan Set.
long_description.en: In his central myth, Osiris, as firstborn, rules as Lord of the Earth with Isis as his queen and gives the people of Egypt laws, culture, religious instruction, and agriculture. His brother Set has a coffin made to his measure; when Osiris lies down in it, Set shuts and fastens the lid and throws it into the Nile. Set later hacks the body to pieces, but Isis revives him and conceives Horus. Incomplete, Osiris can no longer rule the living and withdraws into the afterlife as Lord and Judge of the Dead. Horus later battles Set.

long_description.id: Osiris sering digambarkan dalam wujud mumi atau dibungkus kain kafan dengan hanya kepala dan tangan terlihat, memegang tongkat gembala dan cambuk, lambang kekuasaan raja; kedua benda itu mula-mula adalah lambang Osiris sebelum identik dengan firaun. Sebagai dewa hidup ia tampil sebagai pria tampan berpakaian kerajaan dengan mahkota atef. Kulitnya sering hitam atau hijau, melambangkan lumpur subur Nil dan pembaruan, dan ia dikaitkan dengan lambang djed serta burung Bennu. Dalam wujud mumi, ia turun ke dunia bawah dan, menurut keterangan museum, bergabung dengan dewa matahari Re setiap malam agar matahari terlahir kembali.
long_description.en: Osiris is often shown as a mummy, wrapped in a shroud from which only the head and hands emerge, holding the crook and flail, symbols of kingship that were first Osiris' symbols before becoming synonymous with pharaohs. As a living god he appears as a handsome man in royal dress wearing the atef crown. His skin is often black or green, symbolizing the fertile mud of the Nile and regeneration, and he is associated with the djed symbol and the Bennu bird. In mummy form he descends to the underworld and, according to the museum account, merges with the sun god Re each night so that the sun can be reborn.

long_description.id: Abydos adalah pusat pemujaan Osiris, dan orang ingin dimakamkan sedekat mungkin dengannya. Festival Surutnya Nil memperingati kematiannya dan Festival Pilar Djed merayakan kebangkitannya; biji-bijian yang tumbuh dari kebun Osiris melambangkan kebangkitan itu. Raja-raja Mesir mengidentifikasi diri dengan Osiris setelah mati, dan ia dianggap hakim orang mati yang pengasih, pemaaf, dan adil. Ia dianggap menegakkan kerajaan serta tatanan alam dan hukum kehidupan. Pemujaannya berlangsung dari sesaat sebelum Periode Dinasti Awal hingga Dinasti Ptolemeus, dan kultus misterinya menyebar sebagai Kultus Isis.
long_description.en: Abydos was the cult center of Osiris, and people wanted to be buried as close to him as possible. The festival of the Fall of the Nile commemorated his death and the Djed Pillar Festival celebrated his resurrection; the grain sprouting from an Osiris garden symbolized that rising. Egypt's kings identified with Osiris in death, and he was regarded as a merciful, forgiving, and just judge of the dead. He was credited with establishing kingship and the natural order and law of life. His worship ran from shortly before the Early Dynastic Period to the Ptolemaic Dynasty, and his mystery cult spread as the Cult of Isis.

long_description.id: Plutarch menulis versi Yunani kisah ini: Osiris lahir pada hari pertama dari hari-hari tambahan, dan sebagai raja ia mengajar rakyat menggunakan biji-bijian dan membuat hukum bagi mereka. Dalam versinya, Typhon menyusun persekongkolan dengan tujuh puluh dua sekutu, lalu mencabik jasad Osiris menjadi empat belas bagian. Osiris kemudian keluar dari dunia bawah untuk melatih Horus berperang. Plutarch juga menyamakan Osiris dengan Bacchus dan menyebut Sungai Nil sebagai pancaran Osiris.
long_description.en: Plutarch records a Greek version of the story: Osiris is born on the first of the added days, and as king teaches the people the use of grain and makes laws for them. In his account Typhon plots with seventy-two accomplices and then tears Osiris's body into fourteen parts. Osiris later comes out of the underworld to train Horus for war. Plutarch also equates Osiris with Bacchus and calls the Nile the efflux of Osiris.

cultural_context.id: Menurut sumber, mitos Osiris mewujudkan sebagian nilai terpenting budaya Mesir: keselarasan, ketertiban, hidup abadi, dan rasa syukur.
cultural_context.en: According to the source, the Osiris myth carried several central cultural values of Egypt: harmony, order, eternal life, and gratitude.

who.en: Ancient Egyptian god, Lord of the Underworld and Judge of the Dead.

origin.en: Firstborn of the gods Geb (earth) and Nut (sky) in ancient Egyptian belief.

role.en: Early king of Egypt who was murdered by his brother Set, revived by Isis, and became ruler of the afterlife.

famous_for.id: Dikenal karena kisah kematian dan kebangkitannya serta perannya sebagai hakim orang mati.
famous_for.en: Known for the story of his death and revival and for his role as judge of the dead.

did_you_know.id: Plutarch menjelaskan keberadaan banyak makam Osiris di Mesir lewat kisah bahwa Isis mengadakan pemakaman tersendiri bagi tiap anggota tubuhnya yang ia temukan.
did_you_know.en: Plutarch explains the many sepulchres of Osiris in Egypt through the story that Isis held a separate funeral for each part of his body as she found it.

description.id: Osiris adalah Hakim Orang Mati dan hakim yang pengasih, pemaaf, dan adil yang mengawasi kehidupan seseorang di bumi dan di alam baka.
description.en: Osiris is Judge of the Dead, a merciful, forgiving, and just judge who oversaw one's life on earth and in the afterlife.

name.en: Renewing the earth and restoring life

description.id: Sungai Nil dianggap lambang kekuatan Osiris memberi kehidupan dan melambangkan kemampuannya memperbarui bumi dan memulihkan kehidupan bagi bangsa itu.
description.en: The Nile was considered a symbol of Osiris' life-giving power and represented his capacity to renew the earth and restore life to the nation.

description.id: Sebagai penguasa alam baka, Osiris menyatu dengan dewa matahari Re setiap malam agar matahari terlahir kembali dan ia sendiri tetap hidup abadi.
description.en: As lord of the afterlife, Osiris merges with the sun god Re each night to enable the sun's rebirth and his own eternal survival.

description.id: Dalam sebagian kecil penggambaran, Osiris tampil sebagai sosok menakutkan yang mengutus utusan-iblis untuk menyeret orang hidup ke alam orang mati.
description.en: In a minority of depictions Osiris appears as a terrifying figure who dispatches demon-messengers to drag the living into the realm of the dead.

description.id: Pria tampan berpakaian kerajaan dengan mahkota atef, membawa tongkat gembala dan cambuk.
description.en: A handsome man in royal dress wearing the atef crown, carrying the crook and flail.

description.id: Osiris sering ditampilkan sebagai mumi atau setengah termumifikasi, terbungkus kain kafan dengan hanya kepala dan tangan terlihat.
description.en: Osiris is often shown as a mummy or partially mummified, wrapped in a shroud with only the head and hands visible.

description.id: Plutarch mencatat versi kisah dengan Typhon sebagai musuh Osiris, jasad yang dicabik menjadi empat belas bagian, dan penyamaan Osiris dengan Bacchus.
description.en: Plutarch records a version of the story in which Typhon is the enemy of Osiris, the body is torn into fourteen parts, and Osiris is equated with Bacchus.

title.en: The murder and revival of Osiris

role.id: Osiris adalah korban pembunuhan yang dihidupkan kembali dan menjadi penguasa alam baka.
role.en: Osiris is the murdered king who is revived and becomes ruler of the afterlife.

summary.id: Set membuat peti mati seukuran tubuh Osiris dan menjebaknya di dalamnya, lalu melemparkan peti itu ke Sungai Nil. Peti itu tersangkut pada pohon dekat Byblos. Set kemudian mencincang jasad Osiris, tetapi Isis menghidupkannya kembali dan mengandung Horus. Osiris mundur ke alam baka sebagai Penguasa dan Hakim Orang Mati.
summary.en: Set has a coffin made to Osiris' measure and traps him in it, then throws it into the Nile. The coffin lodges in a tree near Byblos. Set later hacks the body to pieces, but Isis revives Osiris and conceives Horus. Osiris withdraws into the afterlife as Lord and Judge of the Dead.

role.en: Osiris rules Egypt and gives it laws and agriculture.

summary.id: Osiris memerintah sebagai Penguasa Bumi dengan Isis sebagai ratunya dan memberi rakyat hukum, budaya, ajaran agama, dan pertanian. Ia dianggap raja pertama Mesir yang menetapkan nilai-nilai budaya bagi para raja berikutnya. Plutarch menyebut ia juga menunjukkan kegunaan biji-bijian dan membuat hukum bagi rakyat.
summary.en: Osiris rules as Lord of the Earth with Isis as his queen and gives the people laws, culture, religious instruction, and agriculture. He was considered the first king of Egypt, setting the cultural values for later kings. Plutarch adds that he showed the people the use of grain and made laws for them.

role.id: Osiris adalah ayah Horus, yang membalas kematiannya.
role.en: Osiris is the father of Horus, who contends with Set.

summary.id: Horus tampil sebagai prajurit perkasa dan bertempur melawan Set untuk menguasai dunia; dalam sebagian versi Set dibunuh, dalam kebanyakan versi ia dikalahkan dan diusir. Dalam Plutarch, Osiris keluar dari dunia bawah untuk melatih Horus berperang.
summary.en: Horus emerges as a mighty warrior and battles Set for control of the world; in some versions Set is killed, in most he is defeated and driven out. In Plutarch, Osiris comes out of the underworld to train Horus for war.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa kisah kematian dan kebangkitan Osiris menjadi begitu penting bagi kehidupan beragama Mesir?
learning_questions.en: Why did the story of the death and revival of Osiris become so important to Egyptian religious life?

learning_questions.id: Apa perbedaan antara kisah Osiris versi Mesir dan versi yang dicatat Plutarch?
learning_questions.en: How does the Egyptian version of the Osiris story differ from the one Plutarch records?

sources.title: Plutarch's Essays and Miscellanies, Vol. 4 (of 5): Of Isis and Osiris, or of the Ancient Religion and Philosophy of Egypt
sources.author: Plutarch; edited by William Watson Goodwin

claims.quote: Osiris is the Egyptian Lord of the Underworld and Judge of the Dead, brother-husband to Isis, and one of the most important gods of ancient Egypt.

statement.id: Osiris adalah dewa dunia bawah dan hakim orang mati Mesir, serta suami Isis.
statement.en: Osiris is the Egyptian lord of the underworld and judge of the dead, and Isis's husband.

claims.quote: The name `Osiris' is the Latinized form of the Egyptian Usir which is interpreted as 'powerful' or 'mighty'.

statement.id: Nama Osiris berasal dari bentuk Latin nama Mesir Usir.
statement.en: Osiris is the Latinized form of Egyptian Usir.

claims.quote: He is the first-born of the gods Geb (earth) and Nut (sky) shortly after the creation of the world, was murdered by his younger brother Set, and brought back to life by his sister-wife Isis.

statement.id: Osiris adalah putra sulung Geb dan Nut, dibunuh Set, lalu dihidupkan Isis.
statement.en: Osiris is the firstborn of Geb and Nut, killed by Set and revived by Isis.

claims.quote: A mythical early king of Egypt, this god ruled with his sister-wife, Isis, until he was murdered by their jealous brother, Seth.

statement.id: Sebagai raja awal mitis Mesir, Osiris memerintah bersama Isis sebelum dibunuh Seth.
statement.en: As a mythical early Egyptian king, Osiris ruled with Isis until Seth murdered him.

claims.quote: In the form of a mummy, he descended to the underworld, which was imagined to be entered from the west, the land of the setting sun.

statement.id: Dalam bentuk mumi, Osiris turun ke dunia bawah.
statement.en: As a mummy, Osiris descended to the underworld.

claims.quote: There, he lived on forever as lord of the afterlife, merging with the sun god Re each night to enable the sun's rebirth and his own eternal survival.

statement.id: Di alam baka, Osiris bergabung dengan Re setiap malam.
statement.en: In the afterlife, Osiris merges with Re each night.

claims.quote: Osiris, ruler of the Netherworld, is shown here in his traditional form, wrapped in an enveloping shroud from which only his head and hands emerge.

statement.id: Sebuah arca menggambarkan Osiris terbungkus kain kafan dengan hanya kepala dan tangan terlihat.
statement.en: A figure shows Osiris shrouded with only his head and hands visible.

claims.quote: These hold the crook and flail, symbols of kingship.

statement.id: Tangannya memegang tongkat penggembala dan cambuk, lambang kerajaan.
statement.en: His hands hold the crook and flail, symbols of kingship.

claims.quote: Osiris was originally a fertility god, possibly from Syria (though this claim is contested) who became so popular he absorbed the function of earlier gods such as Andjeti and Khentiamenti, two gods of fertility and agriculture worshipped at Abydos.

statement.id: Osiris semula adalah dewa kesuburan, mungkin berasal dari Suriah (klaim ini diperdebatkan), yang begitu populer hingga menyerap fungsi dewa-dewa terdahulu seperti Andjeti dan Khentiamenti, dua dewa kesuburan dan pertanian yang dipuja di Abydos.
statement.en: Osiris was originally a fertility god, possibly from Syria (a contested claim), who became so popular that he absorbed the functions of earlier gods such as Andjeti and Khentiamenti, two fertility and agriculture gods worshipped at Abydos.

claims.quote: He is associated with the djed symbol and is often depicted with black or green skin symbolizing the fertile mud of the Nile and regeneration.

statement.id: Ia dikaitkan dengan lambang djed dan sering digambarkan berkulit hitam atau hijau yang melambangkan lumpur subur Sungai Nil dan pembaruan.
statement.en: He is associated with the djed symbol and is often depicted with black or green skin symbolizing the fertile mud of the Nile and regeneration.

claims.quote: He is also frequently shown as a mummy or in partially mummified form in his role as Judge of the Dead.

statement.id: Ia juga sering ditampilkan sebagai mumi atau dalam bentuk setengah termumifikasi dalam perannya sebagai Hakim Orang Mati.
statement.en: He is also frequently shown as a mummy or in partially mummified form in his role as Judge of the Dead.

claims.quote: Images of Osiris as a living god depict him as a handsome man in royal dress wearing the crown of Upper Egypt as a plumed headdress known as the atef and carrying the crook and flail, symbols of kingship.

statement.id: Gambar Osiris sebagai dewa hidup menampilkannya sebagai pria tampan berpakaian kerajaan, bermahkota Mesir Hulu berupa hiasan kepala berbulu yang disebut atef, dan membawa tongkat gembala serta cambuk, lambang kekuasaan raja.
statement.en: Images of Osiris as a living god show him as a handsome man in royal dress, wearing the crown of Upper Egypt as a plumed headdress called the atef and carrying the crook and flail, symbols of kingship.

claims.quote: He is associated with the mythical Bennu bird (inspiration for the Greek Phoenix) who rises to life from the ashes.

statement.id: Ia dikaitkan dengan burung mitos Bennu (inspirasi bagi Feniks Yunani) yang bangkit hidup dari abu.
statement.en: He is associated with the mythical Bennu bird (inspiration for the Greek Phoenix), which rises to life from the ashes.

claims.quote: Osiris was known by many names but chiefly as Wennefer, "The Beautiful One" and, in his role as Judge of the Dead, Khentiamenti, "The Foremost of the Westerners".

statement.id: Osiris dikenal dengan banyak nama, terutama Wennefer, "Sang Indah", dan, dalam perannya sebagai Hakim Orang Mati, Khentiamenti, "Yang Terdepan di antara Orang Barat".
statement.en: Osiris was known by many names, chiefly Wennefer, "The Beautiful One", and, in his role as Judge of the Dead, Khentiamenti, "The Foremost of the Westerners".

claims.quote: It has been claimed that Osiris was originally a deified Predynastic king, a primitive vegetation spirit, a jackal god of an early royal necropolis, or a mother goddess. Even the etymology of his name is uncertain, though it may simply mean 'The Mighty One'.

statement.id: Ada yang mengklaim Osiris semula adalah raja Pradinasti yang didewakan, roh tetumbuhan primitif, dewa jakal sebuah nekropolis kerajaan awal, atau dewi ibu; bahkan etimologi namanya tidak pasti, meski mungkin sekadar berarti 'Sang Perkasa'.
statement.en: It has been claimed that Osiris was originally a deified Predynastic king, a primitive vegetation spirit, a jackal god of an early royal necropolis, or a mother goddess; even the etymology of his name is uncertain, though it may simply mean 'The Mighty One'.

claims.quote: Although he is usually seen as a just, generous, and giving god of life and abundance there are also depictions of him as "a terrifying figure who dispatches demon-messengers to drag the living into the gloomy realm of the dead"

statement.id: Meski biasanya dipandang sebagai dewa kehidupan dan kelimpahan yang adil, dermawan, dan pemurah, ada pula penggambaran dirinya sebagai "sosok menakutkan yang mengutus utusan-iblis untuk menyeret orang hidup ke alam orang mati yang suram".
statement.en: Although he is usually seen as a just, generous, and giving god of life and abundance, there are also depictions of him as "a terrifying figure who dispatches demon-messengers to drag the living into the gloomy realm of the dead".

claims.quote: His worship spanned thousands of years from shortly before the Early Dynastic Period (c. 3150-2613 BCE) to the Ptolemaic Dynasty (323-30 BCE), the last dynasty to rule Egypt before the coming of Rome.

statement.id: Pemujaannya berlangsung ribuan tahun, dari sesaat sebelum Periode Dinasti Awal (sekitar 3150–2613 SM) hingga Dinasti Ptolemeus (323–30 SM), dinasti terakhir yang memerintah Mesir sebelum kedatangan Romawi.
statement.en: His worship spanned thousands of years, from shortly before the Early Dynastic Period (c. 3150-2613 BCE) to the Ptolemaic Dynasty (323-30 BCE), the last dynasty to rule Egypt before the coming of Rome.

claims.quote: Osiris, as the first born, assumed rule as Lord of the Earth, with Isis as his queen and consort. He found the people of Egypt uncivilized and lawless and so gave them laws, culture, religious instruction, and agriculture.

statement.id: Sebagai putra sulung, Osiris memegang kekuasaan sebagai Penguasa Bumi dengan Isis sebagai ratu dan permaisurinya. Ia mendapati rakyat Mesir tak beradab dan tanpa hukum, lalu memberi mereka hukum, budaya, ajaran agama, dan pertanian.
statement.en: As the firstborn, Osiris assumed rule as Lord of the Earth, with Isis as his queen and consort. Finding the people of Egypt uncivilized and lawless, he gave them laws, culture, religious instruction, and agriculture.

claims.quote: Their relationship deteriorated further after Nephthys, Set's wife, disguised herself as Isis and seduced Osiris, becoming pregnant with the god Anubis.

statement.id: Hubungan keduanya memburuk setelah Nephthys, istri Set, menyamar sebagai Isis dan memikat Osiris sehingga hamil dengan dewa Anubis.
statement.en: Their relationship worsened after Nephthys, Set's wife, disguised herself as Isis and seduced Osiris, becoming pregnant with the god Anubis.

claims.quote: Set had a beautiful coffin made to Osiris' exact height and then threw a grand party where he presented this box and told the guests that whichever of them fit in it most perfectly could have it as a gift.

statement.id: Set membuat peti mati indah seukuran tinggi Osiris, lalu mengadakan pesta besar tempat ia memamerkan peti itu dan berkata bahwa tamu yang paling pas muat di dalamnya boleh memilikinya sebagai hadiah.
statement.en: Set had a beautiful coffin made to Osiris' exact height and then threw a grand party where he presented the box and told the guests that whoever fit in it most perfectly could have it as a gift.

claims.quote: When Osiris lay down in the coffin, Set slammed the lid on, fastened it shut, and threw it into the Nile, where it was carried away down river.

statement.id: Ketika Osiris berbaring di dalam peti, Set membanting tutupnya, menguncinya, dan melemparkannya ke Sungai Nil, tempat peti itu hanyut ke hilir.
statement.en: When Osiris lay down in the coffin, Set slammed the lid on, fastened it shut, and threw it into the Nile, where it was carried away downriver.

claims.quote: Osiris' body traveled out to sea and eventually his coffin became lodged in a great tamarisk tree growing near Byblos in Phoenicia.

statement.id: Jasad Osiris hanyut ke laut dan peti matinya akhirnya tersangkut pada pohon tamariska besar yang tumbuh dekat Byblos di Fenisia.
statement.en: Osiris' body traveled out to sea and his coffin eventually became lodged in a great tamarisk tree growing near Byblos in Phoenicia.

claims.quote: He managed to get Nephthys to tell him where it was, and when he found it, he hacked it into pieces and scattered it across the land and into the Nile.

statement.id: Set berhasil membuat Nephthys memberi tahu letaknya, dan setelah menemukannya ia mencincang jasad itu lalu menebarkannya ke seluruh negeri dan ke Sungai Nil.
statement.en: Set managed to get Nephthys to tell him where it was, and when he found it he hacked it into pieces and scattered them across the land and into the Nile.

claims.quote: Isis was able to revive Osiris and, once he was alive, she assumed the form of a kite and flew around him, drew the seed from his body into her own, and became pregnant with a son, Horus. Even though Osiris now lived, he was incomplete and could no longer rule the land of the living. He withdrew into the afterlife where he became Lord and Judge of the Dead.

statement.id: Isis mampu menghidupkan Osiris kembali; ia berubah menjadi layang-layang (kite), mengitarinya, menarik benih dari tubuhnya, dan mengandung putra bernama Horus. Meski hidup lagi, Osiris tidak utuh dan tak dapat lagi memerintah negeri orang hidup; ia mundur ke alam baka dan menjadi Penguasa dan Hakim Orang Mati.
statement.en: Isis was able to revive Osiris; she took the form of a kite, flew around him, drew the seed from his body into her own, and became pregnant with a son, Horus. Though alive again, Osiris was incomplete and could no longer rule the land of the living; he withdrew into the afterlife, where he became Lord and Judge of the Dead.

claims.quote: Horus emerged as a mighty warrior and battled Set for control of the world. In some versions of the story, Set is killed but, in most, he is defeated and driven from the land.

statement.id: Horus tampil sebagai prajurit perkasa dan bertempur melawan Set untuk menguasai dunia. Dalam sebagian versi Set dibunuh, tetapi dalam kebanyakan versi ia dikalahkan dan diusir dari negeri itu.
statement.en: Horus emerged as a mighty warrior and battled Set for control of the world. In some versions Set is killed, but in most he is defeated and driven from the land.

claims.quote: The city of Abydos was his cult center and the necropolis there became the most sought-after burial ground as people wanted to be buried as close to the god as they could get.

statement.id: Kota Abydos adalah pusat pemujaannya, dan nekropolis di sana menjadi pemakaman paling diincar karena orang ingin dimakamkan sedekat mungkin dengan sang dewa.
statement.en: The city of Abydos was his cult center, and its necropolis became the most sought-after burial ground because people wanted to be buried as close to the god as possible.

claims.quote: Osiris' rebirth was associated with the Nile River, which was considered a symbol of his life-giving power.

statement.id: Kelahiran kembali Osiris dikaitkan dengan Sungai Nil, yang dianggap lambang kekuatannya memberi kehidupan.
statement.en: Osiris' rebirth was associated with the Nile River, which was considered a symbol of his life-giving power.

claims.quote: The Nile represented Osiris' capacity to renew the earth and to restore life to the nation.

statement.id: Sungai Nil melambangkan kemampuan Osiris memperbarui bumi dan memulihkan kehidupan bagi bangsa itu.
statement.en: The Nile represented Osiris' capacity to renew the earth and to restore life to the nation.

claims.quote: The festival of the Fall of the Nile commemorated his death while the Djed Pillar Festival celebrated Osiris' resurrection.

statement.id: Festival Surutnya Nil memperingati kematiannya, sedangkan Festival Pilar Djed merayakan kebangkitan Osiris.
statement.en: The festival of the Fall of the Nile commemorated his death, while the Djed Pillar Festival celebrated Osiris' resurrection.

claims.quote: The grains which would later grow symbolized Osiris rising from the dead and also the promise of eternal life for the one who tended the garden.

statement.id: Biji-bijian yang kemudian tumbuh melambangkan Osiris bangkit dari kematian sekaligus janji hidup abadi bagi orang yang merawat kebun itu.
statement.en: The grains that later grew symbolized Osiris rising from the dead and also the promise of eternal life for the one who tended the garden.

claims.quote: Although no one knows what rituals were involved in the mystery cult of Isis, they may have developed from Osiris' earlier mysteries celebrated at Abydos beginning in the Twelfth Dynasty (1991-1802 BCE).

statement.id: Meski tak ada yang tahu ritual apa saja dalam kultus misteri Isis, ritual itu mungkin berkembang dari misteri Osiris yang lebih awal, dirayakan di Abydos sejak Dinasti Kedua Belas (1991–1802 SM).
statement.en: Although no one knows what rituals were involved in the mystery cult of Isis, they may have developed from Osiris' earlier mysteries celebrated at Abydos beginning in the Twelfth Dynasty (1991-1802 BCE).

claims.quote: Osiris' identification with eternal life, with life from death, gave rise to his mystery cult which would travel beyond the boundaries of Egypt as the Cult of Isis.

statement.id: Identifikasi Osiris dengan hidup abadi, dengan kehidupan dari kematian, melahirkan kultus misterinya yang kemudian menyebar melampaui Mesir sebagai Kultus Isis.
statement.en: Osiris' identification with eternal life, with life from death, gave rise to his mystery cult, which would travel beyond Egypt as the Cult of Isis.

claims.quote: Osiris was considered the first king of Egypt who established the cultural values all later kings were sworn to uphold.

statement.id: Osiris dianggap raja pertama Mesir yang menetapkan nilai-nilai budaya yang wajib dijunjung semua raja sesudahnya.
statement.en: Osiris was considered the first king of Egypt, who established the cultural values all later kings were sworn to uphold.

claims.quote: The kings of Egypt identified with Horus during life (they each had a personal name and a 'Horus Name' they took at the beginning of their reign) and with Osiris in death.

statement.id: Raja-raja Mesir mengidentifikasi diri dengan Horus semasa hidup dan dengan Osiris setelah mati.
statement.en: The kings of Egypt identified with Horus during life and with Osiris in death.

claims.quote: the famous flail and shepherd's staff, synonymous with Egyptian pharaohs, were first Osiris' symbols as the flail represented the fertility of his land while the crook symbolized the authority of his rule.

statement.id: Cambuk dan tongkat gembala yang terkenal, identik dengan firaun Mesir, mula-mula adalah lambang Osiris: cambuk mewakili kesuburan negerinya dan tongkat gembala melambangkan wibawa kekuasaannya.
statement.en: The famous flail and shepherd's staff, synonymous with Egyptian pharaohs, were first Osiris' symbols: the flail represented the fertility of his land and the crook symbolized the authority of his rule.

claims.quote: Osiris was credited with establishing both the kingship and the natural order and law of life and so, through one's participation in one's community and observance of rituals, one was following Osiris' guidelines.

statement.id: Osiris dianggap menegakkan baik kerajaan maupun tatanan alam dan hukum kehidupan, sehingga dengan berperan dalam komunitas dan menjalankan ritual, orang mengikuti pedoman Osiris.
statement.en: Osiris was credited with establishing both kingship and the natural order and law of life, so that through participation in one's community and observance of rituals one was following Osiris' guidelines.

claims.quote: Osiris was the all-merciful, the forgiving, and the just judge of the dead who oversaw one's life on earth and in the afterlife.

statement.id: Osiris adalah hakim orang mati yang maha pengasih, pemaaf, dan adil, yang mengawasi kehidupan seseorang di bumi dan di alam baka.
statement.en: Osiris was the all-merciful, the forgiving, and the just judge of the dead, who oversaw one's life on earth and in the afterlife.

claims.quote: Upon the first of these, as they say, Osiris was born, and a voice came into the world with him, saying, The Lord of all things is now born.

statement.id: Dalam Plutarch, pada hari pertama dari hari-hari tambahan (Epagomenae), Osiris lahir, dan sebuah suara datang ke dunia bersamanya, berkata bahwa Penguasa segala sesuatu kini telah lahir.
statement.en: In Plutarch, on the first of the added days (the Epagomenae) Osiris was born, and a voice came into the world with him, saying that the Lord of all things was now born.

claims.quote: Of these they say Osiris and Arueris were begot by the Sun, Isis by Hermes, and Typhon and Nephthys by Saturn.

statement.id: Dalam Plutarch, dikatakan Osiris dan Arueris dilahirkan oleh Matahari, Isis oleh Hermes, serta Typhon dan Nephthys oleh Saturnus.
statement.en: In Plutarch, Osiris and Arueris are said to have been begotten by the Sun, Isis by Hermes, and Typhon and Nephthys by Saturn.

claims.quote: And they say that Osiris, when he was king of Egypt, drew them off from a beggarly and bestial way of living, by showing them the use of grain, and by making them laws, and teaching them to honor the Gods

statement.id: Dalam Plutarch, Osiris ketika menjadi raja Mesir menarik rakyat dari cara hidup melarat dan kebinatangan dengan menunjukkan kegunaan biji-bijian, membuat hukum, dan mengajar mereka menghormati para dewa.
statement.en: In Plutarch, Osiris as king of Egypt drew the people off from a beggarly and bestial way of living by showing them the use of grain, making them laws, and teaching them to honor the Gods.

claims.quote: he formed a plot against him, taking seventy-two men for accomplices of his conspiracy, and being also abetted by a certain Queen of Ethiopia, whose name they say was Aso.

statement.id: Dalam Plutarch, Typhon, saudara Osiris dalam kisah itu, menyusun persekongkolan dengan tujuh puluh dua orang sekutu dan dibantu seorang ratu Etiopia bernama Aso.
statement.en: In Plutarch, Typhon, the antagonist of the story, formed a plot with seventy-two men as accomplices, abetted by a certain Queen of Ethiopia named Aso.

claims.quote: Typhon, as he was hunting by moonshine, by chance lighted upon it, and knowing the body again, tore it into fourteen parts, and threw them all about.

statement.id: Dalam Plutarch, Typhon yang berburu di bawah cahaya bulan kebetulan menemukan peti itu, mengenali jasad itu, lalu mencabiknya menjadi empat belas bagian dan melemparkannya ke segala arah.
statement.en: In Plutarch, Typhon, hunting by moonlight, chanced upon the chest, recognized the body, tore it into fourteen parts, and threw them all about.

claims.quote: there are many sepulchres of Osiris in Egypt, because she made a particular funeral for each member as she found them.

statement.id: Dalam Plutarch, laporan bahwa ada banyak makam Osiris di Mesir dijelaskan oleh kisah bahwa Isis mengadakan pemakaman tersendiri bagi tiap anggota tubuh yang ia temukan.
statement.en: In Plutarch, the report that there are many sepulchres of Osiris in Egypt is explained by the story that Isis held a separate funeral for each member of the body as she found them.

claims.quote: Osiris coming out of hell to assist his son Horus, first labored and trained him up in the discipline of war

statement.id: Dalam Plutarch, Osiris keluar dari dunia bawah untuk membantu putranya, Horus, dan mula-mula melatihnya dalam disiplin perang.
statement.en: In Plutarch, Osiris comes out of the underworld to assist his son Horus and first trains him in the discipline of war.

claims.quote: It is therefore better to make Osiris to be the same with Bacchus, and Serapis again with Osiris

statement.id: Plutarch menyimpulkan lebih baik menyamakan Osiris dengan Bacchus, dan Serapis kembali dengan Osiris.
statement.en: Plutarch concludes it is better to make Osiris the same as Bacchus, and Serapis again the same as Osiris.

claims.quote: And as they term the Nile the efflux of Osiris, so they hold and esteem the earth for the body of Isis

statement.id: Menurut Plutarch, mereka menyebut Sungai Nil sebagai pancaran Osiris, sebagaimana bumi dianggap tubuh Isis.
statement.en: According to Plutarch, they call the Nile the efflux of Osiris, just as they hold the earth to be the body of Isis.

claims.quote: The myth embodied some of the most important values of Egyptian culture: harmony, order, eternal life, and gratitude.

statement.id: Mitos itu mewujudkan sebagian nilai terpenting budaya Mesir: keselarasan, ketertiban, hidup abadi, dan rasa syukur.
statement.en: The myth embodied some of the most important values of Egyptian culture: harmony, order, eternal life, and gratitude.

short_description.id: Parvati adalah dewi utama dalam agama Hindu, juga disebut Uma dan Gauri; ia istri Siwa dan ibu Ganesha serta Skanda.
short_description.en: Parvati is a principal goddess in Hinduism, also called Uma and Gauri; she is Shiva's wife and mother of Ganesha and Skanda.

long_description.id: Parvati ("putri gunung") adalah salah satu dewi paling dicintai dalam jajaran dewa Hindu, juga dikenal sebagai Uma dan Gauri. Ia dikenal sebagai istri setia Siwa, ibu Ganesha dan Skanda, serta berkaitan erat dengan sisi lembut Mahadevi, sang dewi agung. Smithsonian menyebutnya dewi gunung yang dipandang sebagai separuh feminin Siwa dan kekuatan feminin ilahi semesta (shakti). Namun ia bukan hanya istri Siwa: ia juga sakti-nya, ibu semesta, dan seorang pertapa perempuan yang tekun. Namanya diturunkan dari kata Sanskerta untuk "gunung", karena ia lahir sebagai putri raja gunung Himavan.
long_description.en: Parvati ("daughter of the mountain") is one of the most beloved goddesses in the Hindu pantheon, also known as Uma and Gauri. She is the devoted wife of Shiva and mother of Ganesha and Skanda, and is closely aligned with the benign aspect of Mahadevi, the Great Goddess. The Smithsonian calls her a mountain goddess seen as the feminine half of Shiva and the divine feminine power of the universe (shakti). Yet she is not only Shiva's wife: she is also his shakti, mother of the universe, and a disciplined female ascetic. Her name derives from the Sanskrit word for "mountain", as she was born the daughter of the mountain king Himavan.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah Sati menurut puisi Kalidasa, ayahnya yang congkak menghina sang dewa dan ia meninggalkan tubuhnya. Purana mengisahkan Parvati yang ingin menikahi Siwa; Sati terlahir kembali sebagai Parvati, putri Himavat dan Mainavati. Indra mengutus Kama untuk membangunkan Siwa dari meditasinya, tetapi Kama dibakar menjadi abu. Parvati lalu menempuh tapa yang keras, antara lain bermeditasi di air dingin saat musim dingin, untuk memperoleh kekuatan gaib dan memenangkan sang dewa. Dalam puisi Kalidasa, hanya tapa yang dapat memenangkan hati sang dewa yang dingin; Parvati tidak mau menyayangi tubuhnya jika tapa yang lebih keras berhasil, dan Siwa pun tunduk di hadapannya. Di sana pula, nama pertamanya adalah "Anak Gunung", dan seruan cemas ibunya "Forbear!" menjadi gelar barunya. Setelah menikah, Parvati pindah ke Gunung Kailash, tempat lahir Kartikeya dan Ganesha.
long_description.en: In Kalidasa's poem Sati's proud father scorns the god and she leaves her mortal body. The Puranas relate how Parvati aspired to marry Shiva; Sati is reborn as Parvati, daughter of Himavat and Mainavati. Indra sends Kama to rouse Shiva from meditation, but Kama is burned to ashes. Parvati then undertakes severe austerities, such as meditating in cold water in winter, to gain supernatural powers and win the god. In Kalidasa's poem only penance can win the cold heart of the stern god; Parvati would not spare her body if sterner penance might prevail, and Shiva bows before her. There, her first name is "Child of the Mountain", and her anxious mother's cry "Forbear!" becomes her new title. After the marriage Parvati moves to Mount Kailash, where Kartikeya and Ganesha are born.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah tentang Ganesha, Parvati membentuk seorang anak dari pasta kunyit dan menghidupkannya. Ketika Siwa memenggal kepala anak itu dengan trisulanya, Siwa memulihkannya dengan memasang kepala gajah. Dalam kisah-kisah Purana Parvati juga menjelma sebagai Kali dan Durga untuk menumpas iblis, serta sebagai Annapurna yang menyediakan pangan. Ia digambarkan cantik dan baik hati, dengan tangan yang dapat memegang trisula, cermin, tasbih, atau bunga teratai. Salah satu arca di Asia Society menampilkannya dalam pose tribhanga, tiga lekukan. Tiga citra menjadi pusat filsafatnya: Siwa-Sakti, Ardhanarishvara, serta linga dan yoni.
long_description.en: In the story of Ganesha, Parvati shapes a boy from turmeric paste and gives him life. When Shiva severs the boy's head with his trident, he restores him by attaching an elephant's head. In the Puranas Parvati also takes the forms of Kali and Durga to destroy demons, and Annapurna, who provides food. She is depicted as beautiful and benevolent, with hands that may hold a trident, mirror, rosary, or lotus. An Asia Society sculpture shows her in the triple-bend pose (tribhanga). Three images are central to her philosophy: Shiva-Shakti, Ardhanarishvara, and the linga and the yoni.

long_description.id: Di Bali, Parvati dieja Parwati dan menjadi dewi utama dalam Hindu Bali; ia lebih sering disebut Uma, dan sebagai Dewi Danu ia menguasai perairan serta Gunung Batur. Ia dipuja baik sebagai istri Siwa maupun sebagai dewi yang mandiri, dan festival Teej di India menjadikannya dewa utama.
long_description.en: In Bali, Parvati is spelled Parwati and is a principal goddess of Balinese Hinduism; she is more often called Uma, and as Dewi Danu she presides over waters and Gunung Batur. She is worshiped both as Shiva's wife and as an independent goddess, and the Teej festival in India has her as its primary deity.

cultural_context.id: Pendekatan Saiwa cenderung memandang Parvati sebagai istri yang patuh, sedangkan kaum Sakta menekankan kesetaraan atau keunggulannya atas Siwa. Ia juga disembah sebagai dewi yang mandiri.
cultural_context.en: Shaiva approaches tend to see Parvati as a submissive wife, whereas Shaktas stress her equality or superiority to Shiva. She is also worshiped as an independent goddess.

claims.quote: Pārvatī ("daughter of the mountain," also known as Umā) is considered one of the most beloved goddesses in the Hindu pantheon, although she has not been the focus of sustained scholarly study.

statement.id: Parvati adalah dewi Hindu yang namanya bermakna putri gunung dan juga disebut Uma.
statement.en: Parvati is a Hindu goddess whose name means daughter of the mountain and who is also called Uma.

claims.quote: She figures prominently as the devoted wife of the great god Śiva, mother of Gaṇeśa and Skanda (also known as Kārttikeya or Murugan), and is closely aligned with the benign aspect of Mahādevī, the Great Goddess.

statement.id: Parvati adalah istri Siwa serta ibu Ganesha dan Skanda, dan berhubungan dengan aspek lembut Mahadevi.
statement.en: Parvati is Shiva's wife and the mother of Ganesha and Skanda, associated with Mahadevi's benign aspect.

claims.quote: Her mythic profile unfolds through enduring stories told in the purāṇas including her rebirth as the daughter of Himavat and Menā, her practice of tapas (asceticism), her wedding ceremony and marriage to Śiva, the birth of her sons, her emanation as Durgā, the game of dice, and her role as half of Śiva’s body in the androgynous form Ardhanārīśvara (the half-woman lord).

statement.id: Kisah Purana menyebut Parvati terlahir kembali sebagai putri Himavat dan Mena serta melakukan tapa dan menikahi Siwa.
statement.en: Purana stories recount Parvati's rebirth as daughter of Himavat and Mena, her ascetic practice, and marriage to Shiva.

claims.quote: However, Pārvatī is not only Śiva’s wife; she is also his śakti, mother of the universe and a disciplined female ascetic (tapasvinī) in her own right.

statement.id: Parvati juga digambarkan sebagai sakti Siwa, ibu semesta, dan petapa perempuan.
statement.en: Parvati is also Shiva's shakti, mother of the universe, and an ascetic in her own right.

claims.quote: Hindu Goddess of the Mountain, also known as Uma; she is often seen as the feminine half of the god Shiva, and the divine feminine power of the universe (shakti).

statement.id: Smithsonian menggambarkan Parvati atau Uma sebagai dewi gunung dan kekuatan feminin ilahi.
statement.en: The Smithsonian describes Parvati or Uma as a mountain goddess and divine feminine power.

claims.quote: The Puranas, literally the “old stories” of Hindu traditions, relate the narrative of the goddess Parvati, who aspired to marry the god Shiva.

statement.id: Purana menceritakan Parvati ingin menikah dengan Siwa.
statement.en: The Puranas tell of Parvati's wish to marry Shiva.

claims.quote: Because Shiva could not easily be distracted from his yogic meditation, Parvati subjected herself to extreme acts of physical deprivation—such as meditating in cold water during the winter—to gain supernatural powers and win over the celibate god.

statement.id: Parvati menjalani tapa berat untuk memperoleh kekuatan dan memikat Siwa yang sedang bertapa.
statement.en: Parvati performed severe asceticism to gain power and win over the meditating Shiva.

claims.quote: The Hindu goddess Parvati, the daughter of the Himalayan Mountains, is worshiped both as Shiva's wife and as an independent deity.

statement.id: Parvati dipuja sebagai istri Siwa dan sebagai dewi tersendiri.
statement.en: Parvati is worshiped as Shiva's wife and as an independent goddess.

claims.quote: She stands in a traditional posture of self-assured grace, the triple-bend pose (tribhanga) in which the head and lower body slant in one direction, while the torso moves in the opposite direction.

statement.en: The Asia Society's Parvati statue stands in the triple-bend tribhanga pose.

claims.quote: In South India, where this sculpture was made, the Hindu goddess Parvati is known as Uma.

statement.id: Di India Selatan, Parvati juga dikenal sebagai Uma.
statement.en: In South India, Parvati is also known as Uma.

claims.quote: Born once again, for in an earlier life High fame was hers, as Śiva's faithful wife.

statement.en: In Kalidasa's poem, Parvati is described as born again, having been famed in an earlier life as Shiva's faithful wife.

claims.quote: But her proud sire had dared the God to scorn; Then was her tender soul with anguish torn, And jealous for the lord she loved so well, Her angered spirit left its mortal cell.

statement.en: Parvati's hands may hold a trident, mirror, rosary, bell, dish, goad, sugarcane stalk, or flowers such as a lotus.

claims.quote: In Skanda Purana, Parvati assumes the form of a warrior-goddess and defeats a demon called Durg who assumes the form of a buffalo. In this aspect, she is known by the name Durga.

statement.id: Dalam Skanda Purana, Parvati mengambil wujud dewi prajurit dan mengalahkan iblis bernama Durg yang berwujud kerbau; dalam aspek ini ia dikenal sebagai Durga.
statement.en: In the Skanda Purana Parvati takes the form of a warrior-goddess and defeats a demon named Durg who takes the form of a buffalo; in this aspect she is known as Durga.

claims.quote: In Linga Purana, Parvati undergoes a metamorphosis into Kali, at the request of Shiva, to destroy an asura (demon) Daruk.

statement.id: Dalam Linga Purana, atas permintaan Siwa, Parvati berubah menjadi Kali untuk membinasakan asura (iblis) Daruk.
statement.en: In the Linga Purana, at Shiva's request, Parvati transforms into Kali to destroy the asura (demon) Daruk.

claims.quote: As Mahakali, she identifies and destroys evil for protection, and as Annapurna, she creates food and abundance for nourishment.

statement.id: Sebagai Mahakali ia mengenali dan menumpas kejahatan demi perlindungan, dan sebagai Annapurna ia menciptakan pangan dan kelimpahan.
statement.en: As Mahakali she identifies and destroys evil for protection, and as Annapurna she creates food and abundance for nourishment.

claims.quote: Her rage at Shiva's attempt to walk out manifests in the form of ten terrifying goddesses who block Shiva's every exit.

statement.id: Dalam kisah kelahiran sepuluh Mahavidya, kemarahan Parvati ketika Siwa hendak pergi menjelma sepuluh dewi menyeramkan yang menghalangi setiap jalan keluarnya.
statement.en: In the story of the ten Mahavidyas, Parvati's rage at Shiva's attempt to leave takes the form of ten terrifying goddesses who block his every exit.

claims.quote: Shaiva's approaches tend to look upon Parvati as the Shiva's submissive and obedient wife. However, Shaktas focus on Parvati's equality or even superiority to her consort.

statement.id: Pendekatan Saiwa cenderung memandang Parvati sebagai istri Siwa yang patuh, sedangkan kaum Sakta menekankan kesetaraan atau bahkan keunggulannya atas pasangannya.
statement.en: Shaiva approaches tend to view Parvati as Shiva's submissive, obedient wife, whereas Shaktas stress her equality or even superiority to her consort.

claims.quote: Three images are central to the ethos, iconography, and philosophy of Parvati: the image of Shiva-Shakti, the image of Shiva as Ardhanarishvara (the Lord who is half-woman), and the image of the linga and the yoni.

statement.id: Tiga citra menjadi pusat etos, ikonografi, dan filsafat Parvati: Siwa-Sakti, Siwa sebagai Ardhanarishvara (Tuhan setengah perempuan), serta linga dan yoni.
statement.en: Three images are central to Parvati's ethos, iconography, and philosophy: Shiva-Shakti, Shiva as Ardhanarishvara (the Lord who is half-woman), and the linga and the yoni.

claims.quote: Teej is a significant festival for Hindu women, particularly in the northern and western states of India. Parvati is the primary deity of the festival

statement.id: Teej adalah festival penting bagi perempuan Hindu, terutama di negara bagian utara dan barat India; Parvati adalah dewa utama festival itu.
statement.en: Teej is a significant festival for Hindu women, particularly in the northern and western states of India, and Parvati is its primary deity.

claims.quote: Parvati, locally spelled as Parwati, is a principal goddess in modern-day Hinduism of Bali. She is more often called Uma, and sometimes referred to as Giriputri (daughter of the mountains).

statement.id: Di Bali, Parvati dieja Parwati dan merupakan dewi utama dalam Hindu Bali; ia lebih sering disebut Uma dan kadang Giriputri (putri gunung).
statement.en: In Bali, Parvati is spelled Parwati and is a principal goddess of Balinese Hinduism; she is more often called Uma and sometimes Giriputri (daughter of the mountains).

claims.quote: As Dewi Danu, she presides over waters, lake Batur and Gunung Batur, a major volcano in Bali.

statement.id: Sebagai Dewi Danu, ia menguasai perairan, Danau Batur, dan Gunung Batur, gunung berapi besar di Bali.
statement.en: As Dewi Danu she presides over waters, Lake Batur, and Gunung Batur, a major volcano in Bali.

claims.quote: Sati-Parvati appears in the epic period (400 BCE–400 CE), as both the Ramayana and the Mahabharata present Parvati as Shiva's wife.

statement.id: Sati-Parvati muncul pada masa epos (400 SM-400 M), ketika Ramayana dan Mahabharata menampilkan Parvati sebagai istri Siwa.
statement.en: Sati-Parvati appears in the epic period (400 BCE-400 CE), when both the Ramayana and the Mahabharata present Parvati as Shiva's wife.

claims.quote: Parvata (पर्वत ) is one of the Sanskrit words for "mountain"; "Parvati" derives her name from being incarnated as the daughter of king Himavan (also called Himavata, Parvata)

statement.id: Parvata adalah salah satu kata Sanskerta untuk "gunung"; nama Parvati berasal dari kelahirannya sebagai putri Raja Himavan (juga disebut Himavata, Parvata).
statement.en: Parvata is one of the Sanskrit words for "mountain"; the name Parvati derives from her incarnation as daughter of king Himavan (also called Himavata, Parvata).

claims.quote: Parvati (Sanskrit: पार्वती , IAST: Pārvatī), also known as Uma (Sanskrit: उमा , IAST: Umā) and Gauri (Sanskrit: गौरी , IAST: Gaurī), is one of the principal goddesses in Hinduism

statement.id: Parvati (Sanskerta: पार्वती), juga dikenal sebagai Uma dan Gauri, adalah salah satu dewi utama dalam agama Hindu.
statement.en: Parvati (Sanskrit: पार्वती), also known as Uma and Gauri, is one of the principal goddesses in Hinduism.

claims.quote: Meenakshi, regional form of Parvati in Madurai. She is considered the queen of Madurai.

statement.id: Meenakshi adalah wujud regional Parvati di Madurai dan dianggap ratu Madurai.
statement.en: Meenakshi is a regional form of Parvati in Madurai and is considered the queen of Madurai.

claims.quote: Kalidasa's epic Kumarasambhavam ("Birth of Kumara") describes the story of the maiden Parvati who has made up her mind to marry Shiva and get him out of his recluse, intellectual, austere world of aloofness.

statement.id: Epos Kumarasambhavam karya Kalidasa menceritakan Parvati yang bertekad menikahi Siwa dan membawanya keluar dari dunia pertapaannya yang menyendiri.
statement.en: Kalidasa's epic Kumarasambhavam ("Birth of Kumara") tells of the maiden Parvati, determined to marry Shiva and draw him out of his austere, aloof world.

claims.quote: However, it is not until the plays of Kalidasa (5th–6th centuries) and the Puranas (4th through the 13th centuries) that the stories of Sati-Parvati and Shiva acquire more comprehensive details.

statement.id: Baru pada drama Kalidasa (abad ke-5 sampai ke-6) dan Purana (abad ke-4 sampai ke-13) kisah Sati-Parvati dan Siwa memperoleh detail yang lebih lengkap.
statement.en: Only with Kalidasa's plays (5th-6th centuries) and the Puranas (4th through 13th centuries) do the stories of Sati-Parvati and Shiva gain fuller detail.

topic.en: Views of Parvati in relation to Shiva

summary.en: Shaiva approaches tend to see Parvati as Shiva's submissive, obedient wife.

summary.id: Sumber akademik menyebut Parvati bukan hanya istri Siwa, melainkan juga sakti-nya, ibu semesta, dan pertapa.
summary.en: An academic source says Parvati is not only Shiva's wife but also his shakti, mother of the universe, and an ascetic.

short_description.id: Hades adalah dewa orang mati dan penguasa alam bawah dalam agama serta mitologi Yunani kuno, yang juga dikaitkan dengan kekayaan bumi.
short_description.en: Hades is the god of the dead and ruler of the underworld in ancient Greek religion and mythology, also associated with the wealth of the earth.

long_description.id: Dalam agama Yunani kuno, Hades adalah dewa orang mati dan kekayaan serta raja alam bawah. Namanya juga dipakai untuk menyebut wilayah alam bawah itu sendiri. Ia putra sulung Kronos dan Rhea, ditelan ayahnya sejak lahir, lalu bersama Zeus dan Poseidon mengalahkan para Titan. Dalam pembagian kosmos ia memperoleh alam bawah, Zeus langit, dan Poseidon laut.
long_description.en: In ancient Greek religion Hades is god of the dead and riches and king of the underworld. His name also refers to the underworld itself. He is the eldest son of Cronus and Rhea, swallowed by his father at birth, and with Zeus and Poseidon he overcame the Titans. In the division of the cosmos he received the underworld, Zeus the sky, and Poseidon the sea.

long_description.id: Hades memimpin upacara pemakaman dan membela hak orang mati atas penguburan yang layak. Ia juga dikaitkan dengan kekayaan tersembunyi di dalam bumi, dan Plouton berarti pemberi kekayaan. Karena ditakuti, namanya dihindari dan orang memakai gelar seperti Eubuleus, kurban baginya dilakukan malam hari, dan Hesiodos menyebutnya tanpa belas kasih di hatinya; satu sumber lain menyebutnya garang dan tak kenal ampun.
long_description.en: Hades presides over funeral rites and defends the dead's right to due burial. He is also associated with hidden wealth beneath the earth, and Plouton means the giver of wealth. Because he was feared, his name was avoided and epithets such as Eubuleus were used, sacrifices to him were made at night, and Hesiod calls him pitiless in heart; another source calls him fierce and inexorable.

long_description.id: Persephone disebut istrinya, yang ia culik ke alam bawah. Ketika Demeter menimpakan paceklik, Persephone dijemput, tetapi karena telah memakan biji delima ia harus kembali selama sebagian tiap tahun. Hades sendiri digambarkan tinggal di istana gelap di bawah bumi, bukan di Olimpus.
long_description.en: Persephone is named as his wife, whom he abducted to the underworld. When Demeter brought famine, Persephone was fetched back, but since she had eaten the pomegranate seed she had to return for part of each year. Hades himself is portrayed as dwelling in a dark palace beneath the earth rather than on Olympus.

long_description.id: Dalam seni, Hades digambarkan sebagai pria dewasa berjanggut yang memegang tongkat, tombak bermata dua, bejana libasi, atau cornucopia, kadang duduk di singgasana eboni atau menunggang kereta berkuda hitam. Ia juga memiliki helm yang membuat pemakainya tak terlihat; sumber-sumber berbeda tentang siapa yang membuatnya. Orang Romawi mengenalnya sebagai Dis atau Pluto.
long_description.en: Greek artists most often show Hades as a mature bearded man with a cornucopia, a libation vase, a sceptre, or a two-pronged spear, and at times on an ebony throne or in a chariot with black horses. He also has a helmet that makes the wearer invisible; sources differ on who made it. The Romans knew him as Dis or Pluto.

long_description.id: Dunia bawah dipercaya dimasuki melalui Sungai Styx, tempat Hermes menuntun jiwa dan Charon menyeberangkan mereka ke gerbang yang dijaga Kerberos. Jiwa dinilai oleh Minos, Rhadamanthys, dan Aiakos: yang baik ke Padang Elysium, yang buruk ke Tartarus. Beberapa pahlawan mengunjunginya, antara lain Hercules, Odiseus, dan Orpheus.
long_description.en: The underworld was believed to be entered across the river Styx, where Hermes leads souls and Charon ferries them to gates guarded by Kerberos. Souls are judged by Minos, Rhadamanthys, and Aiakos: the good go to the Elysian Fields, the bad to Tartarus. Several heroes visited it, among them Hercules, Odysseus, and Orpheus.

cultural_context.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, keyakinan bahwa orang yang tak dikubur atau tak mampu membayar juru perahu mengembara sebagai hantu menunjukkan sifat Hades yang ambigu; alam bawah tidak selalu tempat siksa, tetapi pada umumnya tempat peristirahatan terakhir jiwa.
cultural_context.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, the belief that the unburied or those unable to pay the boatman wandered as ghosts points to an ambiguous view of Hades: the realm was not necessarily a place of torment, but in most cases just the soul's final resting place.

literal_meaning.id: Asalnya tidak pasti; sejak zaman kuno umumnya dianggap berarti "yang tak terlihat".
literal_meaning.en: Its origin is uncertain; since antiquity it has generally been seen as meaning "the unseen one".
