sources.title: Bronze statue of Artemis and a Deer
Ovid, Metamorphoses, Book 3 (translated by Brookes More)
sources.author: Ovid

claims.quote: Diana was the goddess of childbirth, the fertility goddess, the goddess of the moon as well as the patron goddess of wild beasts in Roman mythology.

statement.id: Diana adalah dewi Romawi yang berkaitan dengan kelahiran, kesuburan, bulan, dan hewan liar.
statement.en: Diana was a Roman goddess associated with childbirth, fertility, the moon, and wild animals.

claims.quote: However, she is best known as the goddess of the hunt, with her sacred animal being the deer.

statement.id: Diana paling dikenal sebagai dewi perburuan dengan rusa sebagai hewan sucinya.
statement.en: Diana is best known as a hunt goddess, with the deer as her sacred animal.

claims.quote: Her equivalent in Greek mythology is Artemis.

statement.id: Diana disamakan dengan Artemis dalam mitologi Yunani.
statement.en: Diana was identified with the Greek Artemis.

claims.quote: Diana was the daughter of Jupiter and Latona (the Roman equivalent of Leto), the goddess of dark nights.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam silsilah Romawi Diana adalah putri Jupiter dan Latona.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in Roman genealogy Diana is the daughter of Jupiter and Latona.

claims.quote: he sent a dolphin to carry Latona to the island of Delos where she gave birth to Apollo and Diana.

statement.id: Diana dan Apollo dikisahkan lahir di Pulau Delos.
statement.en: Diana and Apollo were said to be born on Delos.

claims.quote: In most works of Roman art, Diana is depicted armed with a bow and quiver of arrows

statement.id: Seni Romawi sering menggambarkan Diana membawa busur dan tabung panah.
statement.en: Roman art commonly portrays Diana with a bow and quiver.

claims.quote: One of the best-known myths of Diana is that of Actaeon.

statement.id: Actaeon adalah tokoh dalam salah satu kisah Diana yang paling dikenal.
statement.en: Actaeon appears in one of Diana's best-known stories.

claims.quote: he grew the horns of a stag, his hands became feet and his arms were changed into legs.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Actaeon, ia tumbuh tanduk rusa jantan, tangannya menjadi kaki, dan lengannya berubah menjadi tungkai.
statement.en: In the Actaeon story he grows the horns of a stag, his hands become feet and his arms are changed into legs.

claims.quote: The most important sanctuary of Diana for the ancient Romans was located at Aricia, some eleven miles outside of Rome on the shore of lake Nemi

statement.id: Tempat suci Diana yang penting bagi orang Romawi terletak di Aricia dekat Danau Nemi.
statement.en: An important Roman sanctuary of Diana stood at Aricia by Lake Nemi.

claims.quote: Artemis, known to the Romans as Diana, stands with her weight on her right leg, her left foot trailing.

statement.id: Patung perunggu yang dicatat The Met menampilkan Artemis yang disebut Diana oleh orang Romawi.
statement.en: A Met bronze statue depicts Artemis, known to Romans as Diana.

claims.quote: according to most accounts, her skill with the bow unquestionably equaled that of her twin brother Apollo.

statement.id: Menurut sebagian besar riwayat, keterampilan Diana memanah setara dengan saudara kembarnya, Apollo.
statement.en: According to most accounts, Diana's skill with the bow equaled that of her twin brother Apollo.

claims.quote: Latona was enraged and told Apollo and Diana to kill all 14 of Niobe's children.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Niobe, Latona yang murka menyuruh Apollo dan Diana membunuh keempat belas anak Niobe.
statement.en: In the Niobe story, an enraged Latona told Apollo and Diana to kill all 14 of Niobe's children.

claims.quote: Choosing never to marry, Diana received permission from her father to remain a virgin, joining Vesta and Minerva as the only virgin goddesses.

statement.id: Diana memilih tidak menikah dan mendapat izin dari ayahnya untuk tetap perawan, bergabung dengan Vesta dan Minerva sebagai satu-satunya dewi perawan.
statement.en: Choosing never to marry, Diana received her father's permission to remain a virgin, joining Vesta and Minerva as the only virgin goddesses.

claims.quote: Fearing that his beauty might be marred by toil and exposure, Diana caused him to fall into an eternal sleep.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Endymion, Diana membuat pemuda itu tertidur abadi karena takut kecantikannya rusak oleh kerja keras dan cuaca.
statement.en: In the Endymion story, Diana caused the youth to fall into an eternal sleep, fearing his beauty might be marred by toil and exposure.

claims.quote: Diana, of course, hit it, but the target turned out to be Orion out for a nightly swim. In her grief, she turned Orion and Sirius into a constellation.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Orion, Diana mengenai sasaran yang ternyata adalah Orion yang sedang berenang malam, lalu dalam dukanya ia mengubah Orion dan Sirius menjadi rasi bintang.
statement.en: In the Orion story, Diana hit a target that turned out to be Orion swimming at night, and in her grief turned Orion and Sirius into a constellation.

claims.quote: the nymphs could go no further and asked Diana for help. She turned them into pigeons.

statement.id: Ketika para nimfa memohon bantuan, Diana mengubah mereka menjadi merpati.
statement.en: When the nymphs asked Diana for help, she turned them into pigeons.

claims.quote: Diana, angry at his impudence, stilled the waters, preventing the Greek ships from sailing.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Perang Troya, Diana yang marah menenangkan perairan sehingga kapal-kapal Yunani tidak dapat berlayar.
statement.en: In the Trojan War story, an angered Diana stilled the waters so that the Greek ships could not sail.

claims.quote: but Diana intervened, replacing her with a deer. She would become a priestess at Diana's temple.

statement.id: Ketika Iphigenia hendak dikurbankan, Diana turun tangan dan menggantikannya dengan seekor rusa; Iphigenia kemudian menjadi pendeta di kuil Diana.
statement.en: When Iphigenia was about to be sacrificed, Diana intervened and replaced her with a deer; she later became a priestess at Diana's temple.

claims.quote: Diana is heartbroken, for Camilla was a favorite of hers.

statement.id: Dalam Aeneid, Diana berduka atas kematian Camilla, yang menjadi kesayangannya.
statement.en: In the Aeneid, Diana is heartbroken at the death of Camilla, a favorite of hers.

claims.quote: DIANA, in Roman mythology, an old Italian goddess, in later times identified with the Greek Artemis

statement.id: Menurut Britannica 1911, Diana dalam mitologi Romawi adalah dewi Italia kuno yang pada masa kemudian disamakan dengan Artemis Yunani.
statement.en: According to the 1911 Britannica, in Roman mythology Diana is an old Italian goddess, in later times identified with the Greek Artemis.

claims.quote: That she was originally an independent Italian deity is shown by her name, which is the feminine form of Janus (= Dianus).

statement.id: Namanya, bentuk feminin dari Janus (Dianus), menunjukkan bahwa ia semula dewi Italia yang berdiri sendiri.
statement.en: Her name, the feminine form of Janus (Dianus), shows she was originally an independent Italian deity.

claims.quote: She is essentially the goddess of the moon and light generally, and presides over wood, plain and water, the chase and war.

statement.id: Menurut Britannica 1911, Diana pada dasarnya dewi bulan dan cahaya, yang menguasai hutan, dataran, air, perburuan, dan perang.
statement.en: According to the 1911 Britannica, Diana is essentially the goddess of the moon and light generally, presiding over wood, plain and water, the chase and war.

claims.quote: As the goddess of childbirth, she was known, like Juno, by the name of Lucina, the “bringer to light.”

statement.id: Sebagai dewi kelahiran, Diana dikenal dengan nama Lucina, "pembawa ke cahaya", seperti Juno.
statement.en: As goddess of childbirth Diana was known, like Juno, as Lucina, the "bringer to light".

claims.quote: As the moon-goddess she was also identified with Hecate, and invoked as “three-formed” in reference to the phases of the moon.

statement.id: Sebagai dewi bulan, Diana juga disamakan dengan Hecate dan dipanggil "berwujud tiga" merujuk pada fase bulan.
statement.en: As moon-goddess Diana was also identified with Hecate and invoked as "three-formed" in reference to the phases of the moon.

claims.quote: Her most celebrated shrine was in a grove at Aricia (whence her title of Nemorensis) near the modern lake of Nemi. Here she was worshipped side by side with a male deity Virbius, a god of the forest and the chase.

statement.id: Tempat sucinya yang paling termasyhur ada di hutan kecil di Aricia dekat Danau Nemi (maka gelar Nemorensis); di sana ia dipuja bersama dewa Virbius, dewa hutan dan perburuan.
statement.en: Her most celebrated shrine was in a grove at Aricia near Lake Nemi (hence her title Nemorensis), where she was worshipped alongside Virbius, a god of the forest and the chase.

claims.quote: her priest, called Rex Nemorensis, who was a runaway slave, was obliged to qualify for office by slaying his predecessor in single combat

statement.id: Pendeta Diana di Aricia, disebut Rex Nemorensis, adalah budak pelarian yang harus membunuh pendahulunya dalam duel untuk memenuhi syarat jabatan.
statement.en: Diana's priest at Aricia, called Rex Nemorensis, was a runaway slave obliged to qualify for office by slaying his predecessor in single combat.

claims.quote: The worship of Diana was brought to Rome by Latin plebeians, and hence she was regarded as the protectress of the lower classes, and especially of slaves.

statement.id: Pemujaan Diana dibawa ke Roma oleh kaum plebeian Latin, sehingga ia dipandang sebagai pelindung kelas bawah dan terutama budak.
statement.en: The worship of Diana was brought to Rome by Latin plebeians, so she was regarded as protectress of the lower classes and especially of slaves.

claims.quote: her most important temple was that on the Aventine, the chief seat of the plebeians, founded by Servius Tullius, originally as a sanctuary of the Latin league

statement.id: Kuil terpenting Diana di Roma berada di Aventine, pusat kaum plebeian, didirikan oleh Servius Tullius semula sebagai tempat suci liga Latin.
statement.en: Diana's most important temple at Rome was on the Aventine, chief seat of the plebeians, founded by Servius Tullius originally as a sanctuary of the Latin league.

claims.quote: No man was allowed to enter the temple, and on the day of its dedication (August 13) the slaves kept holiday

statement.id: Laki-laki dilarang memasuki kuil itu, dan pada hari penahbisannya (13 Agustus) para budak berlibur.
statement.en: No man was allowed to enter the temple, and on its dedication day (August 13) the slaves kept holiday.

claims.quote: The festival of the goddess was on the ides (13th) of August, the full moon of the hot season. She was worshipped with torches, her aid was sought by women seeking a happy deliverance in childbirth, and many votive offerings have been found on the site.

statement.id: Pesta Diana jatuh pada idus (13) Agustus; ia dipuja dengan obor, dan kaum perempuan memohon bantuannya untuk persalinan yang selamat.
statement.en: The goddess's festival was on the ides (13th) of August; she was worshipped with torches, and women sought her aid for a happy delivery in childbirth.

claims.quote: As Noctiluca (“giving light by night”) she had a sanctuary on the Palatine which was kept illuminated throughout the night

statement.id: Sebagai Noctiluca, "pemberi cahaya di malam hari", Diana memiliki tempat suci di Palatine yang diterangi sepanjang malam.
statement.en: As Noctiluca, "giving light by night", Diana had a sanctuary on the Palatine kept illuminated all night.

claims.quote: Another celebrated sanctuary of Diana was that on the slopes of Mount Tifata near Capua (where she was worshipped under the name of Tifatina)

statement.id: Tempat suci Diana lain yang termasyhur berada di lereng Gunung Tifata dekat Capua, tempat ia dipuja dengan nama Tifatina.
statement.en: Another celebrated sanctuary of Diana was on the slopes of Mount Tifata near Capua, where she was worshipped as Tifatina.

claims.quote: There is a valley called Gargaphia; sacred to Diana, dense with pine trees and the pointed cypress

statement.id: Dalam Metamorphoses Ovid, lembah Gargaphia disebut keramat bagi Diana dan lebat oleh pohon pinus dan cemara runcing.
statement.en: In Ovid's Metamorphoses the valley of Gargaphia is sacred to Diana, dense with pine trees and pointed cypress.

claims.quote: Here, when a-wearied with exciting sport, the Sylvan goddess loved to come and bathe her virgin beauty in the crystal pool.

statement.id: Menurut Ovid, di lembah itu Diana, sang dewi hutan, gemar mandi di kolam jernih setelah lelah berburu.
statement.en: In Ovid, Diana, the Sylvan goddess, loved to bathe in the crystal pool of that valley when wearied with sport.

claims.quote: Oh, how she wished her arrows were at hand! But only having water, this she took and dashed it on his manly countenance

statement.id: Dalam kisah Actaeon menurut Ovid, Diana berharap panahnya ada di tangan, tetapi hanya memiliki air yang ia percikkan ke wajah pemuda itu.
statement.en: In Ovid's Actaeon story, Diana wished her arrows were at hand but, having only water, dashed it on the young man's face.

claims.quote: No more she threatened, but she fixed the horns of a great stag firm on his sprinkled brows; she lengthened out his neck; she made his ears sharp at the top; she changed his hands and feet;

statement.id: Menurut Ovid, Diana memasang tanduk rusa jantan besar pada dahi Actaeon, memanjangkan lehernya, meruncingkan telinganya, dan mengubah tangan serta kakinya.
statement.en: In Ovid, Diana fixed a great stag's horns on Actaeon's brows, lengthened his neck, made his ears sharp, and changed his hands and feet.

claims.quote: 'Tis said Diana's fury raged with none abatement till the torn flesh ceased to live.

statement.id: Menurut Ovid, kemurkaan Diana tidak mereda sampai daging Actaeon yang tercabik berhenti hidup.
statement.en: In Ovid it is said that Diana's fury did not abate until the torn flesh ceased to live.

claims.quote: Go tell it, if your tongue can tell the tale, your bold eyes saw me stripped of all my robes.

statement.id: Dalam Ovid, Diana berkata kepada Actaeon agar menceritakan, bila lidahnya mampu, bahwa matanya telah melihatnya tanpa busana.
statement.en: In Ovid, Diana tells Actaeon to tell, if his tongue can, that his bold eyes saw her stripped of all her robes.

claims.quote: And while they bathed Diana in their streams, Actaeon, wandering through the unknown woods, entered the precincts of that sacred grove;

statement.id: Menurut Ovid, ketika para nimfa memandikan Diana, Actaeon yang mengembara di hutan tak dikenal memasuki hutan keramat itu.
statement.en: In Ovid, while the nymphs bathed Diana, Actaeon, wandering through unknown woods, entered the precincts of that sacred grove.

summary.id: Britannica 1911 menyebut Diana dewi Italia kuno yang berdiri sendiri, dan baru kemudian disamakan dengan Artemis.
summary.en: The 1911 Britannica calls Diana an old, independent Italian goddess, only later identified with Artemis.

summary.id: World History Encyclopedia menuturkan silsilah Diana sebagai putri Jupiter dan Latona yang lahir bersama Apollo di Delos.
summary.en: World History Encyclopedia narrates Diana's genealogy as daughter of Jupiter and Latona, born with Apollo on Delos.

short_description.id: Dionysus adalah dewa Olimpus dalam mitologi Yunani yang dikaitkan dengan anggur, tumbuhan, perayaan, kegilaan ritual, dan teater.
short_description.en: Dionysus is an Olympian god in Greek mythology associated with wine, vegetation, festivity, ritual madness, and theatre.

long_description.id: Dionysus adalah dewa Olimpus yang dikaitkan dengan anggur, tumbuhan, kesenangan, perayaan, kegilaan, dan frenzi liar. Dalam seni ia dapat tampil sebagai sosok tua berjanggut atau pemuda berambut panjang, dengan tongkat thyrsos, cawan minum, dan mahkota ivy. Hal-hal yang suci baginya mencakup anggur, ivy, laurel, dan asphodel, juga lumba-lumba, ular, harimau, lynx, macan tutul, dan keledai; domba jantan adalah hewan yang paling sering dikurbankan kepadanya. Seni Yunani juga mengenalinya lewat kantharos atau tanduk minum dan kadang kulit macan tutul.
long_description.en: Dionysus is an Olympian god associated with wine, vegetation, pleasure, festivity, madness, and wild frenzy. In art he may appear as an older bearded god or a long-haired youth, with a thyrsos staff, a drinking cup, and a crown of ivy. Things sacred to him include the vine, ivy, laurel, and asphodel, as well as the dolphin, serpent, tiger, lynx, panther, and ass; a ram was the animal most commonly sacrificed to him. Greek art also identifies him by a kantharos or drinking-horn and sometimes a panther pelt.

long_description.id: Menurut tradisi umum, ia putra Zeus dan Semele; sumber lain menyebut ibunya Demeter, Io, Dione, atau Arge. Dalam satu kisah kelahiran, Semele meninggal sebelum melahirkan dan Zeus membawa janinnya di pahanya. Para pengasuh masa kecilnya disebut berbeda-beda, antara lain satir, nimfa, dan Silenus di Gunung Nysa. Dalam kisah lain, Hera membuatnya gila hingga ia mengembara ke banyak negeri, dan kemudian Hera memastikan ia menjadi dewa Olimpus penuh. Kisah mistik menyebut para Titan mencincang tubuhnya lalu Rhea atau Demeter memulihkannya, dan ia membawa ibunya keluar dari Hades naik ke Olimpus.
long_description.en: According to the common tradition he is the son of Zeus and Semele; other sources name his mother as Demeter, Io, Dione, or Arge. In one birth story, Semele died before delivery and Zeus carried the unborn child in his thigh. His childhood carers are named differently, including satyrs, nymphs, and Silenus on Mt. Nysa. In another story Hera drove him mad so that he wandered through many countries, and later Hera ensured he became a full Olympian god. A mystical story says the Titans cut up his body and Rhea or Demeter restored him, and he led his mother out of Hades up to Olympus.

long_description.id: Dionysus digambarkan membalas mereka yang menolak pemujaannya. Lycurgus dibuat gila dan negerinya berhenti berbuah, sedangkan Pentheus dicabik oleh ibunya sendiri yang kalap. Dalam kisah bajak laut, ia berubah menjadi singa, dan para pelaut yang melompat ke laut menjadi lumba-lumba. Ia juga disebut memberi Midas satu permintaan, membatalkannya ketika emas menjadi bencana, dan menikahi Ariadne di Naxos.
long_description.en: Dionysus is shown punishing those who refused his worship. Lycurgus was driven mad and his country ceased to bear fruit, while Pentheus was torn to pieces by his own mother in Bacchic fury. In the pirate story he changed into a lion, and sailors who leapt into the sea became dolphins. He is also said to have granted Midas a wish, reversed it when the gold became a disaster, and to have married Ariadne at Naxos.

long_description.id: Kultusnya menjadi bagian penting agama Yunani di Athena sejak abad ke-6 SM, dan Naxos adalah tempat suci yang penting. Karena drama Yunani tumbuh dari paduan suara pada festivalnya, ia dipandang sebagai dewa tragedi dan pelindung teater. Dalam puisi Homeros ia tidak tampil sebagai dewa besar. Bangsa Romawi mengenalnya sebagai Bacchus.
long_description.en: His cult became a significant part of Greek religion in Athens from the 6th century BCE, and Naxos was an important sanctuary. Because Greek drama grew out of choruses at his festivals, he was regarded as the god of tragedy and protector of theatres. In the Homeric poems he does not appear as one of the great divinities. The Romans knew him as Bacchus.

cultural_context.id: Dionysus dipandang sebagai dewa anggur, penemu dan pengajar budi dayanya, pemberi kegembiraan, dan penghalau duka. Teater diyakini tumbuh dari ritual pemujaannya, tempat para peserta dan aktor sama-sama melampaui pribadi mereka.
cultural_context.en: Ancient writers saw Dionysus as the god of wine who invented its cultivation and taught it to people, who gave joy and drove away grief and sorrow. Theatre is believed to have grown out of his worship, in which participants and actors alike transcend their own persona.

literal_meaning.id: Bacchus atau Bakchos berarti dewa yang gaduh atau liar; semula hanya julukan Dionysus.
literal_meaning.en: Bacchus or Bakchos means the noisy or riotous god; it was originally a mere epithet of Dionysus.

who.id: Dionysus adalah dewa Olimpus anggur, tumbuhan, kesenangan, perayaan, kegilaan, dan frenzi liar.
who.en: Dionysus is an Olympian god linked with wine, vegetation, pleasure, festivity, madness, and wild frenzy.

origin.id: Ia berasal dari mitologi Yunani; tradisi umum menyebut Thebes sebagai tempat kelahirannya, dan Naxos adalah tempat suci penting baginya.
origin.en: He comes from Greek mythology; the common tradition names Thebes as his birthplace, and Naxos was an important sanctuary for him.

role.id: Ia mengajarkan budi daya anggur dan memimpin rombongan pengikut yang liar, serta dipandang sebagai pelindung teater.
role.en: He teaches the cultivation of the vine, leads a wild following, and is regarded as protector of theatres.

famous_for.id: Ia paling dikenal sebagai dewa anggur dan perayaan, yang membalas mereka yang menolak pemujaannya.
famous_for.en: He is best known as the god of wine and festivity, who punished those who refused his worship.

did_you_know.id: Menurut Himne Homerik VII, ketika para bajak laut membawa Dionysus ke kapal, anggur manis mengalir di seluruh kapal dan ikatan mereka tidak dapat menahannya.
did_you_know.en: According to Homeric Hymn 7, when pirates took Dionysus aboard their ship, sweet wine streamed throughout the ship and their bonds could not hold him.

description.id: Dalam kisah bajak laut, Dionysus berubah menjadi singa.
description.en: In the pirate story, Dionysus changed into a lion.

description.id: Lycurgus menjadi gila dan membunuh putranya sendiri; para pelaut dalam kisah bajak laut menjadi gila dan melompat ke laut.
description.en: Lycurgus became mad and killed his own son; the sailors in the pirate story were seized with madness and leapt into the sea.

description.id: Para pelaut yang melompat ke laut dalam kisah bajak laut berubah menjadi lumba-lumba.
description.en: The sailors who leapt into the sea in the pirate story were changed into dolphins.

description.id: Ia dipandang memiliki kuasa menyingkapkan masa depan lewat orakel.
description.en: He was regarded as having the power of revealing the future by oracles.

description.id: Di orakelnya di Amphicleia, ia menyembuhkan penyakit dengan menyingkapkan obat dalam mimpi para penderita.
description.en: At his oracle of Amphicleia he cured diseases by revealing remedies in the sufferers' dreams.

description.id: Ia membatalkan anugerah sentuhan emas Midas dengan menyuruhnya mandi di sungai Pactolus.
description.en: He reversed Midas's golden touch by telling him to wash in the Pactolus river.

title.id: Kelahiran Dionysus dari Semele dan Zeus
title.en: The birth of Dionysus from Semele and Zeus

role.id: Putra yang dilahirkan dari paha Zeus.
role.en: The son carried to birth in Zeus's thigh.

summary.id: Hera membujuk Semele meminta Zeus menampakkan diri dalam kemegahan ilahi; Semele tewas, dan Zeus membesarkan janinnya di pahanya. Para satir dan nimfa lalu mengasuhnya, dengan Silenus sebagai pendidik utama di Gunung Nysa.
summary.en: Hera persuaded Semele to ask Zeus to reveal himself in godly splendour; Semele expired, and Zeus reared the unborn child in his thigh. Satyrs and nymphs then cared for him, with Silenus as chief educator on Mt. Nysa.

role.id: Dewa yang diculik tanpa dikenali dan membalas dengan wujud singa.
role.en: The god abducted unrecognised, who answers in the form of a lion.

summary.id: Para bajak laut menculik Dionysus tanpa tahu siapa dia. Anggur mengalir di kapal, tiang menjadi anggur merambat, sang dewa menjadi singa, dan para pelaut yang melompat ke laut menjadi lumba-lumba.
summary.en: Pirates abducted Dionysus without knowing his identity. Wine streamed through the ship, the mast became a vine, the god became a lion, and the sailors who leapt into the sea became dolphins.

title.en: The punishment of Lycurgus and Pentheus

role.id: Dewa yang membalas penolakan terhadap perayaannya.
role.en: The god who answers rejection of his festivals.

summary.id: Lycurgus, raja Thrace, dan Pentheus, raja Thebes, mencoba menghentikan perayaan Dionysus. Lycurgus dibuat gila; Pentheus dicabik oleh ibunya, Agave, dalam kegilaan Bacchus.
summary.en: Lycurgus, King of Thrace, and Pentheus, King of Thebes, tried to stop Dionysus's festivals. Lycurgus was driven mad; Pentheus was torn to pieces by his mother, Agave, in Bacchic fury.

role.id: Dewa yang mengabulkan lalu membatalkan permintaan.
role.en: The god who grants and then reverses a wish.

summary.id: Midas mengembalikan Silenus kepada Dionysos dan diberi satu permintaan. Ia meminta segala yang disentuhnya menjadi emas, lalu Dionysos membatalkannya dengan menyuruhnya mandi di sungai Pactolus.
summary.en: Midas returned Silenus to Dionysos and was granted a wish. He asked that everything he touched turn to gold, and Dionysos reversed it by telling him to wash in the Pactolus river.

role.id: Penakluk yang mengajarkan budi daya anggur.
role.en: The conqueror who taught the cultivation of the vine.

summary.id: Bersama rombongan Pan, satir, dan perempuan Bacchus, Dionysus menaklukkan musuh-musuhnya di India dan mengajarkan budi daya anggur dan berbagai buah serta pemujaan dewa.
summary.en: With a following of Pans, Satyrs, and Bacchic women, Dionysus defeated enemies in India and taught the Indians to grow the vine and various fruits and to worship the gods.

role.id: Dewa yang memberi manusia pohon anggur.
role.en: The god who gives mankind the vine.

summary.id: Sang dewa memberikan pohon anggur kepada Ikarios, warga terhormat Ikaria di Attika.
summary.en: The god gave the vine tree to Ikarios, a noble citizen of Ikaria in Attica.

description.id: Pulau yang menjadi tempat suci penting bagi Dionysos, dengan bukti kultus sejak masa Mikenai.
description.en: An island that was an important sanctuary of Dionysos, with evidence of a cult from the Mycenaean period.

description.id: Tempat Dionysos diasuh dan dididik, jauh dari murka Hera.
description.en: Where Dionysos was cared for and educated, far from Hera's wrath.

description.id: Kultus Dionysos menjadi bagian penting agama di sana sejak abad ke-6 SM.
description.en: Where the cult of Dionysos became a significant part of religion from the 6th century BCE.

title.en: Evidence of a cult in the Mycenaean period

description.id: Ada bukti kultus Dionysos sejak masa Mikenai (abad ke-14 SM).
description.en: There is evidence of a cult of Dionysos dating from the Mycenaean period (14th century BCE).

description.id: Kultus Dionysos menjadi bagian penting agama Yunani di Athena sejak abad ke-6 SM.
description.en: The cult of Dionysos became a significant part of Greek religion in Athens from the 6th century BCE.

note.id: Ayah Dionysus menurut tradisi umum.
note.en: Dionysus's father in the common tradition.

note.id: Ibu Dionysus menurut tradisi umum.
note.en: Dionysus's mother in the common tradition.

note.id: Membuatnya gila hingga mengembara, tetapi kemudian memastikan ia menjadi dewa Olimpus penuh.
note.en: Threw him into madness so that he wandered, but later ensured he became a full Olympian god.

note.id: Dionysos menikahinya di Naxos.
note.en: Dionysos married her at Naxos.

note.id: Pendidik utama dan pengikut utama Dionysos.
note.en: Dionysos's chief educator and chief follower.

note.id: Pendamping tetap Dionysus.
note.en: Constant companions of Dionysus.

note.id: Pengikut perempuan Dionysos dalam seni sejak akhir abad ke-6 SM.
note.en: Female followers of Dionysos in art from the late 6th century BCE.

note.id: Beberapa sumber menyebut Demeter ibunya.
note.en: Some sources name Demeter as his mother.

note.id: Nama Romawi Dionysus.
note.en: The Roman name of Dionysus.

sources.title: Homeric Hymns 4-33: VII. To Dionysus and XXVI. To Dionysus (trans. H. G. Evelyn-White)
sources.author: Anonymous (translated by H. G. Evelyn-White)

claims.quote: is the god of wine-making, orchards, fruit, vegetation, fertility, festivity, insanity, ritual madness, religious ecstasy, and theatre.

statement.id: Dionysus adalah dewa Yunani yang berkaitan dengan anggur, tumbuhan, dan perayaan.
statement.en: Dionysus is a Greek deity associated with wine, vegetation, and festivities.

claims.quote: was the ancient Greek god of wine, merriment, and theatre.

statement.id: Dionysus dikenal sebagai dewa Yunani bagi anggur, kegembiraan, dan teater.
statement.en: Dionysus is known as the Greek god of wine, merriment, and theatre.

claims.quote: DIONYSOS (Dionysus) was the Olympian god of wine, vegetation, pleasure, festivity, madness and wild frenzy.

statement.id: Dionysus adalah dewa Olimpus yang berhubungan dengan anggur, tumbuhan, dan perayaan.
statement.en: Dionysus is an Olympian god of wine, vegetation, and festivity.

claims.quote: He was depicted as either an older, bearded god or an effeminate, long-haired youth. His attributes included the thyrsos (a pine-cone tipped staff), a drinking cup and a crown of ivy.

statement.id: Dionysus digambarkan sebagai lelaki berjanggut atau pemuda berambut panjang dengan thyrsos dan ivy.
statement.en: Dionysus is depicted as a bearded man or long-haired youth with a thyrsos and ivy.

claims.quote: Dionysos was a son of Zeus and the princess Semele of Thebes.

statement.id: Dionysus adalah putra Zeus dan Semele.
statement.en: Dionysus is a son of Zeus and Semele.

claims.quote: This was too much for the mortal and she immediately expired; however, Zeus took the unborn child and reared him in his thigh.

statement.id: Setelah Semele meninggal, Zeus membawa anak yang belum lahir di pahanya.
statement.en: After Semele died Zeus carried the unborn child in his thigh.

claims.quote: Dionysos (Roman name: Bacchus, also known as Dionysus)

statement.id: Bacchus adalah nama Dionysus dalam tradisi Romawi.
statement.en: Bacchus is the Roman name for Dionysus.

claims.quote: He is also called both by Greeks and Romans Bacchus (Bakchos), that is, the noisy or riotous god

statement.id: Greek dan Romawi juga menyebutnya Bacchus (Bakchos), yang berarti dewa yang gaduh atau liar.
statement.en: Greeks and Romans also called him Bacchus (Bakchos), that is, the noisy or riotous god.

claims.quote: According to the common tradition, Dionysus was the son of Zeus and Semele, the daughter of Cadmus of Thebes ... whereas others describe him as a son of Zeus by Demeter, Io, Dione, or Arge.

statement.id: Menurut tradisi umum, Dionysus putra Zeus dan Semele, putri Kadmos dari Thebes; yang lain menyebutnya putra Zeus dengan Demeter, Io, Dione, atau Arge.
statement.en: According to the common tradition Dionysus was the son of Zeus and Semele, daughter of Cadmus of Thebes; others describe him as a son of Zeus by Demeter, Io, Dione, or Arge.

claims.quote: while in others we find India, Libya, Crete, Dracanum in Samos, Naxos, Elis, Eleutherae, or Teos, mentioned as his birthplace

statement.id: Tempat kelahirannya menurut tradisi umum adalah Thebes, sedangkan tradisi lain menyebut India, Libya, Kreta, Dracanum di Samos, Naxos, Elis, Eleutherae, atau Teos.
statement.en: In the common tradition his native place is Thebes, while others name India, Libya, Crete, Dracanum in Samos, Naxos, Elis, Eleutherae, or Teos as his birthplace.

claims.quote: When Dionysus had grown up, Hera threw him also into a state of madness, in which he wandered about through many countries of the earth.

statement.id: Setelah Dionysus dewasa, Hera membuatnya gila sehingga ia mengembara ke banyak negeri.
statement.en: When Dionysus had grown up, Hera threw him into a state of madness in which he wandered through many countries of the earth.

claims.quote: But Dionysus and the host of Pans, Satyrs, and Bacchic women, by whom he was accompanied, conquered his enemies, taught the Indians the cultivation of the vine and of various fruits, and the worship of the gods

statement.id: Dionysus bersama rombongan Pan, satir, dan perempuan Bacchus menaklukkan musuh-musuhnya dan mengajarkan kepada orang India budi daya anggur dan berbagai buah serta pemujaan dewa-dewa.
statement.en: Dionysus with the host of Pans, Satyrs, and Bacchic women conquered his enemies and taught the Indians the cultivation of the vine and of various fruits, and the worship of the gods.

claims.quote: The country of the Edones thereupon ceased to bear fruit, and Lycurgus became mad and killed his own son, whom he mistook for a vine

statement.id: Setelah Lycurgus menawan rombongan Dionysus, negeri bangsa Edones berhenti berbuah dan Lycurgus menjadi gila serta membunuh putranya sendiri yang ia kira pohon anggur.
statement.en: After Lycurgus took Dionysus's host prisoner, the country of the Edones ceased to bear fruit and Lycurgus became mad and killed his own son, whom he mistook for a vine.

claims.quote: Pentheus, who then ruled at Thebes, endeavoured to check the riotous proceedings, and went out to the mountains to seek the Bacchic women; but his own mother, Agave, in her Bacchic fury, mistook him for an animal, and tore him to pieces.

statement.id: Pentheus, penguasa Thebes, berusaha menghentikan perayaan Bacchus dan pergi ke pegunungan; ibunya sendiri, Agave, dalam kegilaan Bacchus mengiranya hewan dan mencabik-cabiknya.
statement.en: Pentheus, who ruled at Thebes, tried to check the Bacchic proceedings and went out to the mountains; his own mother, Agave, in her Bacchic fury, mistook him for an animal and tore him to pieces.

claims.quote: The god, however, on perceiving this, changed the mast and oars into serpents, and himself into a lion; he filled the vessel with ivy and the sound of flutes, so that the sailors, who were seized with madness, leaped into the sea, where they were metamorphosed into dolphins.

statement.id: Ketika menyadari niat para bajak laut, Dionysus mengubah tiang dan dayung menjadi ular dan dirinya menjadi singa; kapal dipenuhi ivy dan bunyi seruling sehingga para pelaut menjadi gila, melompat ke laut, dan menjadi lumba-lumba.
statement.en: On perceiving the pirates' plan, the god changed the mast and oars into serpents and himself into a lion; he filled the vessel with ivy and the sound of flutes, so that the sailors, seized with madness, leaped into the sea and were metamorphosed into dolphins.

claims.quote: Dionysus is, therefore, the god of wine, the inventor and teacher of its cultivation, the giver of joy, and the disperser of grief and sorrow.

statement.id: Dionysus adalah dewa anggur, penemu dan pengajar budi dayanya, pemberi kegembiraan, dan penghalau duka.
statement.en: Dionysus is the god of wine, the inventor and teacher of its cultivation, the giver of joy, and the disperser of grief and sorrow.

claims.quote: As the god of wine, he is also both an inspired and an inspiring god, that is, a god who has the power of revealing the future to man by oracles.

statement.id: Sebagai dewa anggur, Dionysus juga dewa yang terilhami dan mengilhami, yaitu memiliki kuasa menyingkapkan masa depan kepada manusia lewat orakel.
statement.en: As the god of wine he is also an inspired and an inspiring god, that is, a god with the power of revealing the future to man by oracles.

claims.quote: at his oracle of Amphicleia, in Phocis, he cured diseases by revealing the remedies to the sufferers in their dreams.

statement.id: Di orakelnya di Amphicleia, Phocis, Dionysus menyembuhkan penyakit dengan menyingkapkan obat kepada para penderita dalam mimpi mereka.
statement.en: At his oracle of Amphicleia, in Phocis, he cured diseases by revealing the remedies to the sufferers in their dreams.

claims.quote: As the Greek drama had grown out of the dithyrambic choruses at the festivals of Dionysus, he was also regarded as the god of tragic art, and as the protector of theatres.

statement.id: Karena drama Yunani tumbuh dari paduan suara dithyramb pada festival Dionysus, ia juga dipandang sebagai dewa seni tragedi dan pelindung teater.
statement.en: As Greek drama grew out of the dithyrambic choruses at the festivals of Dionysus, he was also regarded as the god of tragic art and the protector of theatres.

claims.quote: Sileni, Pans, satyrs, centaurs, and other beings of a like kind, are also the constant companions of the god.

statement.id: Sileni, Pan, satir, centaur, dan makhluk sejenisnya adalah pendamping tetap sang dewa.
statement.en: Sileni, Pans, satyrs, centaurs, and other beings of a like kind are the constant companions of the god.

claims.quote: Among the things sacred to him, we may notice the vine, ivy, laurel, and asphodel; the dolphin, serpent, tiger, lynx, panther, and ass; but he hated the sight of an owl.

statement.id: Hal-hal yang suci baginya antara lain pohon anggur, ivy, laurel, dan asphodel; lumba-lumba, ular, harimau, lynx, macan tutul, dan keledai; tetapi ia membenci pemandangan burung hantu.
statement.en: Things sacred to him include the vine, ivy, laurel, and asphodel; the dolphin, serpent, tiger, lynx, panther, and ass; but he hated the sight of an owl.

claims.quote: The animal most commonly sacrificed to Dionysus was a ram.

statement.id: Hewan yang paling sering dikurbankan bagi Dionysus adalah domba jantan.
statement.en: The animal most commonly sacrificed to Dionysus was a ram.

claims.quote: he led his mother out of Hades, called her Thyone, and rose with her into Olympus.

statement.id: Dionysus menuntun ibunya keluar dari Hades, menamainya Thyone, dan naik bersamanya ke Olimpus.
statement.en: Dionysus led his mother out of Hades, called her Thyone, and rose with her into Olympus.

claims.quote: There is also a mystical story, that the body of Dionysus was cut up and thrown into a cauldron by the Titans, and that he was restored and cured by Rhea or Demeter.

statement.id: Ada kisah mistik bahwa tubuh Dionysus dicincang dan dilemparkan ke dalam kuali oleh para Titan, lalu dipulihkan dan disembuhkan oleh Rhea atau Demeter.
statement.en: There is also a mystical story that the body of Dionysus was cut up and thrown into a cauldron by the Titans, and that he was restored and cured by Rhea or Demeter.

claims.quote: in those poems Dionysus does not appear as one of the great divinities, and the story of his birth by Zeus and the Bacchic orgies are not alluded to in any way : Dionysus is there simply described as the god who teaches man the preparation of wine

statement.id: Dalam puisi-puisi Homeros, Dionysus tidak tampil sebagai salah satu dewa besar, dan ceritanya hanya digambarkan sebagai dewa yang mengajarkan manusia membuat anggur.
statement.en: In the Homeric poems Dionysus does not appear as one of the great divinities, but is simply described as the god who teaches man the preparation of wine.

claims.quote: The god gave Ikarios, a noble citizen of Ikaria in Attica, the vine tree.

statement.id: Sang dewa memberikan pohon anggur kepada Ikarios, warga terhormat Ikaria di Attika.
statement.en: The god gave Ikarios, a noble citizen of Ikaria in Attica, the vine tree.

claims.quote: In gratitude, the god granted Midas a wish. The king requested that everything he touched would turn to gold but alas this included food and water, so the king almost died of starvation and thirst until Dionysos reversed the gift by telling Midas to wash in the Pactolus river.

statement.id: Sebagai balas budi, sang dewa mengabulkan satu permintaan Midas; raja meminta semua yang disentuhnya menjadi emas, hingga hampir mati kelaparan dan kehausan, sampai Dionysos membatalkan pemberian itu dengan menyuruhnya mandi di sungai Pactolus.
statement.en: In gratitude, the god granted Midas a wish; the king asked that everything he touched turn to gold, and almost died of starvation and thirst until Dionysos reversed the gift by telling him to wash in the Pactolus river.

claims.quote: The god transformed the ship's mast into a huge vine, the sails dripped with wine, and a heavenly choir filled the air with music. Dionysos transformed himself into a lion and, assisted by a bear, he dispatched the pirate captain.

statement.id: Sang dewa mengubah tiang kapal menjadi pohon anggur raksasa, layar meneteskan anggur, dan paduan suara surgawi memenuhi udara; Dionysos berubah menjadi singa dan, dibantu seekor beruang, menghabisi kapten bajak laut.
statement.en: The god transformed the ship's mast into a huge vine, the sails dripped with wine, and a heavenly choir filled the air with music; Dionysos transformed himself into a lion and, assisted by a bear, dispatched the pirate captain.

claims.quote: falling in love with and marrying Ariadne when Theseus stopped off on his return from killing the Minotaur.

statement.id: Di Naxos, Dionysos jatuh cinta dan menikahi Ariadne ketika Theseus singgah dalam perjalanan pulang setelah membunuh Minotaur.
statement.en: At Naxos, Dionysos fell in love with and married Ariadne when Theseus stopped off on his return from killing the Minotaur.

claims.quote: Hera in her gratitude ensured that Dionysos, actually only a demigod, became a full Olympian god with permission to reside on Mt. Olympus for all time.

statement.id: Dalam rasa terima kasih, Hera memastikan Dionysos, yang sebenarnya hanya setengah dewa, menjadi dewa Olimpus penuh dengan izin tinggal di Gunung Olimpus selamanya.
statement.en: In her gratitude Hera ensured that Dionysos, actually only a demigod, became a full Olympian god with permission to reside on Mt. Olympus for all time.

claims.quote: Lycurgus, King of Thrace, and Pentheus, King of Thebes, both suffered Dionysos' wrath when they prudishly tried to stop the excesses of the god's festivals. The former was driven mad and the latter was ripped to pieces by a maddened group of female worshippers after he had disguised himself as a woman to spy on their debauchery.

statement.id: Lycurgus, raja Thrace, dan Pentheus, raja Thebes, sama-sama menanggung murka Dionysos ketika mencoba menghentikan perayaannya; yang pertama menjadi gila dan yang kedua dicabik oleh para pemuja perempuan yang kalap.
statement.en: Lycurgus, King of Thrace, and Pentheus, King of Thebes, both suffered Dionysos' wrath when they tried to stop the excesses of his festivals; the former was driven mad and the latter was ripped to pieces by a maddened group of female worshippers.

claims.quote: The cult of Dionysos became a significant part of the Greek religion in Athens from the 6th century BCE and the Dionysia festival of Athens and other cities would later evolve into the Bacchanalia of Rome.

statement.id: Kultus Dionysos menjadi bagian penting agama Yunani di Athena sejak abad ke-6 SM, dan festival Dionysia kemudian berkembang menjadi Bacchanalia di Roma.
statement.en: The cult of Dionysos became a significant part of Greek religion in Athens from the 6th century BCE, and the Dionysia festival would later evolve into the Bacchanalia of Rome.

claims.quote: The island of Naxos was a particularly important sanctuary to the god. There is evidence of a cult to Dionysos dating from the Mycenaean period (14th century BCE)

statement.id: Pulau Naxos adalah tempat suci yang sangat penting bagi sang dewa; ada bukti kultus Dionysos sejak masa Mikenai (abad ke-14 SM).
statement.en: The island of Naxos was a particularly important sanctuary to the god; there is evidence of a cult of Dionysos dating from the Mycenaean period (14th century BCE).

claims.quote: He is often identified through his association with the vine, thyrsos - a sacred rod topped with ivy and vine leaves and sometimes a pinecone, a kantharos - drinking vessel for wine - or a drinking-horn, and on occasion, he wears a wreath of ivy or the pelt of a panther.
claims.locator: How is Dionysos Represented in Art?

statement.id: Dionysos sering dikenali dari kaitannya dengan pohon anggur, thyrsos, kantharos atau tanduk minum, dan kadang karangan ivy atau kulit macan tutul.
statement.en: Dionysos is often identified through his association with the vine, thyrsos, a kantharos or drinking-horn, and on occasion a wreath of ivy or the pelt of a panther.

claims.quote: is often depicted with his thiasos or troupe of satyrs (half-men, half-goat) and nymphs, who from the late 6th century BCE were replaced by maenads, daemonic creatures, who when overtaken by Dionysian frenzy, hunted the forests for victims and ate their raw flesh.
claims.locator: How is Dionysos Represented in Art?

statement.id: Dalam seni Arkais dan Klasik, Dionysos sering digambarkan bersama thiasos, rombongan satir dan nimfa, yang sejak akhir abad ke-6 SM digantikan para maenad, makhluk daimonik yang saat dilanda kegilaan Dionysian memburu korban di hutan dan memakan dagingnya mentah.
statement.en: In Archaic and Classical Greek art, Dionysos is often depicted with his thiasos or troupe of satyrs and nymphs, who from the late 6th century BCE were replaced by maenads, daemonic creatures who in Dionysian frenzy hunted the forests for victims and ate their raw flesh.

claims.quote: It is believed that theatre sprang from this activity as, like Dionysos' worshippers, actors strive to leave behind their own persona and become one with the character they are playing. Indeed, priests of Dionysos were given seats of honour in Greek theatres.

statement.id: Diyakini teater bermula dari kegiatan ritual ini karena para aktor, seperti pemuja Dionysos, berusaha meninggalkan pribadi mereka dan menyatu dengan tokoh yang dimainkan; para imam Dionysos mendapat tempat duduk kehormatan di teater Yunani.
statement.en: It is believed that theatre sprang from this activity as actors, like Dionysos' worshippers, strive to leave behind their own persona and become one with the character they play; priests of Dionysos were given seats of honour in Greek theatres.

claims.quote: Most accounts then attribute the satyrs and nymphs as the carers of Dionysos in his childhood and the wise Silenus as his chief educator on Mt. Nysa, far from Hera's wrath.

statement.id: Sebagian besar kisah menyebut para satir dan nimfa sebagai pengasuh Dionysos di masa kecil, dan Silenus yang bijak sebagai pendidik utamanya di Gunung Nysa, jauh dari murka Hera.
statement.en: Most accounts attribute the satyrs and nymphs as the carers of Dionysos in his childhood and the wise Silenus as his chief educator on Mt. Nysa, far from Hera's wrath.

claims.quote: the bonds would not hold him, and the withes fell far away from his hands and feet

statement.id: Dalam Himne Homerik VII, ikatan para bajak laut tidak dapat menahannya dan lepas dari tangan dan kakinya.
statement.en: In Homeric Hymn 7, the pirates' bonds would not hold him and fell away from his hands and feet.

claims.quote: But soon strange things were seen among them. First of all sweet, fragrant wine ran streaming throughout all the black ship and a heavenly smell arose

statement.id: Dalam Himne Homerik VII, anggur yang manis dan harum mengalir di seluruh kapal dan aroma surgawi menyebar.
statement.en: In Homeric Hymn 7, sweet, fragrant wine ran streaming throughout the ship and a heavenly smell arose.

claims.quote: But the god changed into a dreadful lion there on the ship, in the bows, and roared loudly ... and were changed into dolphins.

statement.id: Dalam Himne Homerik VII, sang dewa berubah menjadi singa yang mengerikan di kapal; para pelaut melompat ke laut dan berubah menjadi lumba-lumba.
statement.en: In Homeric Hymn 7, the god changed into a dreadful lion on the ship; the sailors leapt overboard and were changed into dolphins.

claims.quote: The rich-haired Nymphs received him in their bosoms from the lord his father and fostered and nurtured him carefully in the dells of Nysa

statement.id: Dalam Himne Homerik XXVI, para Nimfa berambut indah menerimanya dari ayahnya dan merawatnya dengan cermat di lembah Nysa.
statement.en: In Homeric Hymn 26, the rich-haired Nymphs received him from his father and nurtured him carefully in the dells of Nysa.

summary.id: Putra Zeus dan Semele menurut tradisi umum.
summary.en: Son of Zeus and Semele in the common tradition.

summary.id: Putra Zeus dengan Demeter, Io, Dione, atau Arge menurut sumber lain.
summary.en: Son of Zeus by Demeter, Io, Dione, or Arge according to others.

short_description.id: Durga adalah dewi utama dalam Hinduisme yang digambarkan menunggang singa atau harimau dengan banyak lengan bersenjata, dan paling dikenal karena membunuh iblis kerbau Mahisha.
short_description.en: Durga is a principal Hindu goddess, depicted riding a lion or tiger with many armed hands, and best known for slaying the buffalo demon Mahisha.

long_description.id: Durga adalah salah satu dewi utama dalam Hinduisme dan perwujudan Devi sebagai pejuang yang menakutkan. Namanya dalam bahasa Sanskerta berarti "yang tak terjangkau" atau "yang tak dapat dilewati", dan berkaitan dengan kata durg yang berarti benteng. Sumber lain menyebut nama itu dipakai untuk semua dewi yang berwujud garang dan bersikap bertempur. Ia juga dikenal dengan julukan seperti Mahishasura-mardini dan Vindhyavasini.
long_description.en: Durga is one of the principal goddesses of Hinduism and the manifestation of Devi as a fearsome warrior. Her Sanskrit name means "the inaccessible" or "the impassable" and is related to the word durg, meaning fortress. Another source notes that the name is applied to all goddesses of terrible appearance who stand in a fighting attitude. She is also known by epithets such as Mahishasura-mardini and Vindhyavasini.

long_description.id: Dalam ikonografi, Durga digambarkan menunggang singa atau harimau dan memegang banyak senjata; jumlah lengannya berbeda-beda menurut sumber, mulai dari empat hingga delapan belas. Senjata itu secara tradisional diberikan oleh para dewa laki-laki, antara lain cakra, trisula, busur, pedang, perisai, dan gada. Singa disebut sebagai tunggangan ilahinya, dan dalam salah satu kisah singa itu dihadiahkan oleh Himavan. Ia juga digambarkan mampu memunculkan dewi pejuang lain seperti Kali dan para Matrika untuk membantunya bertempur.
long_description.en: In iconography Durga rides a lion or a tiger and carries many weapons; the number of her arms differs by source, from four to eighteen. The weapons are traditionally given by male gods and include the discus, trident, bow, sword, shield and mace. The lion is called her divine mount, and in one account it was a gift from Himavan. She is also said to manifest other warrior goddesses such as Kali and the Matrikas to aid her in battle.

long_description.id: Kisah Durga yang paling terkenal adalah pertempurannya melawan Mahisha atau Mahishasura, iblis berkepala kerbau. Para dewa memberinya senjata, dan dalam salah satu versi Durga lahir dari energi para dewa yang menyatu. Mahisha berganti rupa berkali-kali menjadi kerbau, manusia, singa, dan gajah, hingga Durga menusuknya dengan trisula dan memenggal kepalanya. Tradisi Waisnawa memiliki kisah lain: Durga sebagai Yoganidra lahir sebagai putri Yashoda dan Nanda agar dapat ditukar dengan Krishna.
long_description.en: Durga's most famous story is her battle with Mahisha, or Mahishasura, the buffalo-headed demon. The gods gave her weapons, and in one version Durga was formed from the gods' combined energy. Mahisha changed shape repeatedly into a buffalo, a man, a lion and an elephant, until Durga stabbed him with her trident and cut off his head. Vaishnava tradition has another story: Durga as Yoganidra is born as the daughter of Yashoda and Nanda so that she can be swapped with Krishna.

long_description.id: Durga dipuja dalam perayaan Navaratri sembilan malam di India dan Nepal, dan Dusshera dirayakan pada akhir Navaratri. Para sarjana memperkirakan ia berasal dari dewi kuno penduduk pegunungan yang kemudian mapan dalam panteon Hindu; prasasti abad ke-6 M sudah menyebut kemenangannya atas Mahishasura, dan penggambaran Durga membunuh Mahisha menjadi subjek populer dalam seni Hindu.
long_description.en: Durga is worshipped in the nine-night festival of Navaratri in India and Nepal, and Dusshera is celebrated at the end of Navaratri. Scholars believe she originated as an ancient goddess of mountain-dwellers who was later established in the Hindu pantheon; sixth-century CE inscriptions already mention her victory over Mahishasura, and depictions of Durga slaying Mahisha became a popular subject in Hindu art.

cultural_context.id: Dalam Hinduisme, kisah Durga berpusat pada perlawanan terhadap kejahatan dan kekuatan iblis yang mengancam perdamaian, dharma, dan tatanan kosmis, sehingga ia melambangkan kemenangan kebaikan atas kejahatan. Ia juga merupakan sisi Devi yang paling sering dipuja.
cultural_context.en: In Hinduism, Durga's stories center on combating evil and demonic forces that threaten peace, dharma and cosmic order, so she represents the power of good over evil. She is also the side of Devi that is most frequently worshipped.

literal_meaning.id: "tak terjangkau", "tak dapat dilewati"; juga "tak tertembus, tak terkalahkan"
literal_meaning.en: "inaccessible", "impassable"; also "invincible, unassailable"

who.id: Durga adalah dewi pejuang dalam Hinduisme, perwujudan Devi yang membunuh iblis.
who.en: Durga is a warrior goddess in Hinduism, a manifestation of Devi who slays demons.

origin.id: Ia dipercaya berasal dari dewi kuno penduduk pegunungan di anak benua India dan mapan dalam panteon Hindu pada abad ke-4 M.
origin.en: She is believed to have originated as an ancient goddess of mountain-dwellers in the Indian subcontinent and to have been established in the Hindu pantheon by the 4th century CE.

role.id: Kisahnya berpusat pada perlawanan terhadap kejahatan dan kekuatan iblis yang mengancam dharma dan tatanan kosmis.
role.en: Her legends center on combating evil and demonic forces that threaten dharma and cosmic order.

famous_for.id: Ia paling dikenal karena membunuh Mahisha, iblis kerbau.
famous_for.en: She is best known for slaying Mahisha, the buffalo demon.

did_you_know.id: Ikonografi Durga lentur: sebagian cendekiawan meletakkan pena atau alat tulis di tangannya karena menganggap pena mereka sebagai senjata.
did_you_know.en: Durga iconography is flexible: some intellectuals place a pen or other writing implement in her hand because they regard their stylus as their weapon.

description.id: Durga secara tradisional memegang senjata para dewa laki-laki, antara lain cakra, trisula, busur, anak panah, pedang, lembing, perisai, gada, dan jerat; menurut Devi Mahatmya para dewa tidak sanggup mengalahkan iblis itu sendiri-sendiri.
description.en: Durga traditionally holds the weapons of the male gods, including the discus, trident, bow, arrow, sword, javelin, shield, mace and noose; according to the Devi Mahatmya, the gods could not defeat the demon singly.

description.id: Dalam kisah Mahisha, Durga menanggapi lamaran menikah dari iblis itu dengan mengubah dirinya menjadi api.
description.en: In the Mahisha story, Durga responds to the demon's proposal by transforming herself into fire.

description.id: Dalam pertempuran melawan iblis Shumbha dan Nishumbha, Durga memunculkan Kali dan para Matrika untuk membantunya.
description.en: In her battles with the demons Shumbha and Nishumbha, Durga manifests Kali and the Matrikas to aid her.

description.id: Singa adalah tunggangan ilahi (vahana) Durga yang tampil dalam penggambaran pertempurannya melawan Mahisha.
description.en: The lion is Durga's divine mount (vahana) shown in imagery of her battle with Mahisha.

description.id: Dalam Shaktisme Durga punya sembilan sebutan (Navadurga): Shailaputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayini, Kalaratri, Mahagauri, dan Siddhidatri.
description.en: In Shaktism Durga has nine appellations (Navadurga): Shailaputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayini, Kalaratri, Mahagauri and Siddhidatri.

description.id: Saivagama menguraikan sembilan ragam Durga yang semuanya berlengan dua tetapi bersenjata berbeda.
description.en: The Saivagama describes nine varieties of Durga, all with two arms but different weapons.

description.id: Dalam konteks Waisnawa, Durga dihormati sebagai Yoganidra, adik perempuan sekaligus versi perempuan Wisnu.
description.en: In Vaishnava contexts, Durga is revered as Yoganidra, the younger sister and a female version of Vishnu.

role.id: Tokoh utama yang mengalahkan iblis kerbau.
role.en: The central figure who defeats the buffalo demon.

summary.id: Mahisha, iblis berkepala kerbau, mengusir para dewa dari surga. Durga menerima senjata dari para dewa, menolak lamaran Mahisha, lalu bertempur dengannya. Mahisha berganti rupa dari kerbau menjadi manusia, singa, dan gajah, dan akhirnya Durga menusuknya dengan trisula serta memenggal kepalanya.
summary.en: Mahisha, a demon with a buffalo's head, drove most gods out of heaven. Durga received weapons from the gods, spurned Mahisha's proposal and fought him. Mahisha changed from a buffalo to a man, a lion and an elephant, and in the end Durga stabbed him with her trident and cut off his head.

title.en: Durga and the birth of Krishna

role.id: Dalam tradisi Waisnawa, Durga lahir sebagai bayi perempuan yang ditukar dengan Krishna.
role.en: In Vaishnava tradition, Durga is born as the infant girl swapped with Krishna.

summary.id: Wisnu menugaskan Durga memindahkan anak ketujuh Devaki ke rahim Rohini dan lahir sebagai putri Yashoda dan Nanda agar dapat ditukar dengan Krishna.
summary.en: Vishnu gives Durga the task of moving Devaki's seventh child into Rohini's womb and being born as the daughter of Yashoda and Nanda so that she can be swapped with Krishna.

description.id: Dinding utara gua granit di Mamallapuram, Tamil Nadu, memuat relief besar Durga membunuh Mahisasura yang diukir sekitar 630-674 M.
description.en: The north wall of a granite cave at Mamallapuram, Tamil Nadu, bears a large relief of Durga slaying Mahisasura, carved around 630-674 CE.

description.id: Kuil Kailasanatha di Ellora (pertengahan abad ke-8 M) termasuk penggambaran paling awal Durga membunuh Mahisa.
description.en: The Kailasanatha temple at Ellora (mid-8th century CE) is among the earliest representations of Durga slaying Mahisa.

description.id: Prasasti abad ke-6 M di gua bukit Nagarjuni pada masa Maukhari sudah menyebut kisah kemenangan Durga atas Mahishasura.
description.en: Sixth-century CE inscriptions at the Nagarjuni hill cave from the Maukhari era already mention the legend of Durga's victory over Mahishasura.

title.en: Established in the main Hindu pantheon

description.id: Durga dipercaya telah mapan dalam panteon utama Hindu pada abad ke-4 M, setelah bermula sebagai dewi kuno penduduk pegunungan.
description.en: Durga is believed to have been established in the main Hindu pantheon by the 4th century CE, after originating as an ancient goddess of mountain-dwellers.

description.id: Para sarjana memperkirakan Devi Mahatmya disusun antara 400 dan 600 M; Durga sebagai dewi pembunuh iblis kemungkinan sudah mapan saat itu.
description.en: Scholars estimate the Devi Mahatmya was composed between 400 and 600 CE; Durga as a demon-slaying goddess was likely well established by then.

description.id: Prasasti beraksara Siddhamatrika awal sudah menyebut kisah kemenangannya atas Mahishasura.
description.en: Inscriptions in early Siddhamatrika script already mention the legend of her victory over Mahishasura.

description.id: Relief besar Durga membunuh Mahisasura diukir di gua granit Mamallapuram.
description.en: A large relief of Durga slaying Mahisasura was carved in the granite cave at Mamallapuram.

note.en: Demons Durga fights with the warrior goddesses she manifests.
