claims.quote: This very elegant bronze figure of Devi (goddess) Durga is an attractive and prominent figure and a principal deity in Hinduism.

statement.id: Durga adalah dewi penting dalam Hinduisme.
statement.en: Durga is a principal goddess in Hinduism.

claims.quote: In Sanskrit, Durga means the inaccessible or impassable.

statement.id: Nama Durga berarti tidak terjangkau atau tidak dapat dilewati dalam Sanskerta.
statement.en: Durga means inaccessible or impassable in Sanskrit.

claims.quote: Devi is most often manifested as the fearsome female warriors Durga and Kali, both of whom famously killed a number of terrible demons in Hindu mythology.

statement.id: Durga adalah perwujudan Devi sebagai pejuang yang mengalahkan iblis.
statement.en: Durga is a warrior manifestation of Devi who defeats demons.

claims.quote: Devi's dark side is represented as the terrible Durga (the Inaccessible) who has ten arms, an impressive armoury of weapons, and who rides a magnificent lion or tiger.
claims.locator: The Two Sides of Devi: Uma & Durga

statement.id: Durga digambarkan berlengan sepuluh, bersenjata, dan menunggangi singa atau harimau.
statement.en: Durga is depicted with ten arms and weapons, riding a lion or tiger.

claims.quote: Durga slaying Mahisha (Mahishamardini) is here represented in her multi-armed form, manifesting her supreme power as the dispeller of evil, personified in the buffalo demon (asura) Mahisha, seen slumped at her feet.

statement.id: Durga mengalahkan Mahisha, iblis kerbau yang melambangkan kejahatan.
statement.en: Durga defeats Mahisha, a buffalo demon representing evil.

claims.quote: Following the Devi Mahatmya text, she wields the mighty weapons lent to her by the assembly of male gods who singly could not defeat the demon.

statement.id: Menurut Devi Mahatmya, para dewa meminjamkan senjata kepada Durga untuk mengalahkan iblis.
statement.en: In the Devi Mahatmya, gods lend Durga weapons to defeat the demon.

claims.quote: Durga is also worshipped in the nine-night festival Navaratri which is celebrated across India and Nepal.

statement.id: Durga dipuja dalam perayaan Navaratri di India dan Nepal.
statement.en: Durga is worshipped during Navaratri in India and Nepal.

claims.quote: The festival of Dusshera is celebrated at the end of Navaratri by Hindus wherever they live.

statement.id: Dusshera dirayakan pada akhir Navaratri.
statement.en: Dusshera is celebrated at the end of Navaratri.

claims.quote: The lion, Durga’s divine mount (vahana) on which she is shown riding majestically into battle in manuscript illustrations, is here seen emerging from behind the goddess, mauling the demon-buffalo’s hind quarters.

statement.id: Singa adalah tunggangan ilahi Durga yang tampil dalam seni pertempurannya melawan Mahisha.
statement.en: The lion is Durga's divine mount in battle imagery against Mahisha.

claims.quote: One of Devi's most famous mythological escapades is her slaying of Mahisa, the demon who had the body of a man and the head of a buffalo, as told in the epic poem the Candipat (or Candi-mahatmya), which is part of the Skanda Purana.

statement.id: Salah satu kisah paling terkenal Devi adalah pembunuhan Mahisa, iblis bertubuh manusia berkepala kerbau, seperti dikisahkan dalam puisi epik Candipat (Candi-mahatmya), bagian dari Skanda Purana.
statement.en: One of Devi's most famous episodes is her slaying of Mahisa, a demon with a man's body and a buffalo's head, as told in the epic poem Candipat (Candi-mahatmya), part of the Skanda Purana.

claims.quote: Swirling around heaven, this tremendous energy condensed into a single mass and formed the terrible goddess Durga. As with many Hindu tales, this is but one version of Durga's birth.

statement.id: Dalam salah satu versi, energi dahsyat para dewa menyatu menjadi satu massa dan membentuk Durga; sumber menyebut ini hanya satu versi kelahirannya.
statement.en: In one version, the tremendous energy of the gods condensed into a single mass and formed Durga; the source notes this is only one version of her birth.

claims.quote: In other versions, Devi has already long existed as the daughter of Himavat, the personified deity of the Himalaya Mountains, and in this episode she is only given weapons by the angered gods. These arms include a discus, trident, bow, sword, dagger, harpoon, and a noose

statement.id: Dalam versi lain, Devi sudah lama ada sebagai putri Himavat, dewa personifikasi Himalaya, dan para dewa yang murka hanya memberinya senjata: cakram, trisula, busur, pedang, belati, tombak, dan jerat.
statement.en: In other versions Devi has long existed as the daughter of Himavat, the personified deity of the Himalayas, and the angered gods only give her weapons: a discus, trident, bow, sword, dagger, harpoon, and noose.

claims.quote: The problem for Devi was that whenever she tried to strike Mahisa with a fatal blow he transformed into another creature - from a buffalo to a man to a lion, then to an elephant and back to a buffalo.

statement.id: Setiap kali Devi hendak menghantam Mahisa dengan pukulan mematikan, Mahisa berubah menjadi makhluk lain: kerbau, manusia, singa, gajah, lalu kerbau lagi.
statement.en: Whenever Devi tried to deliver a fatal blow, Mahisa changed into another creature: a buffalo, a man, a lion, an elephant, and then a buffalo again.

claims.quote: At this moment, the goddess pounced and, straddling the creature, stabbed him in the neck with her trident. At this, the spirit of Mahisa came out of the mouth of the dying buffalo and Durga finally killed him by lopping off his head.

statement.id: Devi menerkam, menunggangi makhluk itu, dan menusuk lehernya dengan trisula; ketika roh Mahisa keluar dari mulut kerbau yang sekarat, Durga membunuhnya dengan memenggal kepalanya.
statement.en: The goddess pounced, straddled the creature and stabbed its neck with her trident; when Mahisa's spirit came out of the dying buffalo's mouth, Durga killed him by cutting off his head.

claims.quote: Durga slaying Mahisa is a popular subject in Hindu art. One of the earliest representations is in a cave temple near Mallapuram dating to the 7th or 8th century CE and on the mid-8th century CE Kailasanatha temple at Ellora.

statement.id: Durga membunuh Mahisa adalah subjek populer dalam seni Hindu; salah satu penggambaran paling awal ada di kuil gua dekat Mallapuram (abad ke-7 atau ke-8 M) dan di Kuil Kailasanatha di Ellora (pertengahan abad ke-8 M).
statement.en: Durga slaying Mahisa is a popular subject in Hindu art; one of the earliest representations is in a cave temple near Mallapuram (7th or 8th century CE) and on the Kailasanatha temple at Ellora (mid-8th century CE).

claims.quote: Devi's character has two opposing sides represented by various separate female deities: as Uma, the benevolent, and as Durga, the terrible. It is as the latter, more fierce personification that she is most frequently worshipped.

statement.id: Watak Devi punya dua sisi yang berlawanan: Uma yang lembut dan Durga yang menakutkan; sisi yang lebih garang inilah yang paling sering dipuja.
statement.en: Devi's character has two opposing sides: Uma, the benevolent, and Durga, the terrible; it is the fiercer side that is most frequently worshipped.

claims.quote: Mahisa then revealed himself and boasted of his tremendous wealth and power so that Durga might be persuaded to marry him. Durga's somewhat dismissive response to this proposal was to transform herself into fire.

statement.id: Mahisa menyingkap dirinya dan membual tentang kekayaan serta kekuasaannya agar Durga mau menikah dengannya; Durga menanggapi lamaran itu dengan acuh dan mengubah dirinya menjadi api.
statement.en: Mahisa revealed himself and boasted of his wealth and power so that Durga would marry him; Durga responded dismissively to the proposal by transforming herself into fire.

claims.quote: Durga is believed to have originated as an ancient goddess worshipped by indigenous mountain-dwellers of the Indian subcontinent, before being established in the main Hindu pantheon by the 4th century CE.

statement.id: Durga dipercaya berasal dari dewi kuno yang dipuja penduduk pegunungan asli anak benua India, sebelum mapan dalam panteon utama Hindu pada abad ke-4 M.
statement.en: Durga is believed to have originated as an ancient goddess worshipped by indigenous mountain-dwellers of the Indian subcontinent, before being established in the main Hindu pantheon by the 4th century CE.

claims.quote: She is best known as Mahishasura-mardini; for slaying Mahishasura—the buffalo demon. In accounts of her battles with other demons such as Shumbha and Nishumbha, Durga manifests other warrior goddesses, the Matrikas, and Kali, to aid in combat.

statement.id: Durga paling dikenal sebagai Mahishasura-mardini karena membunuh Mahishasura, iblis kerbau; dalam pertempuran melawan Shumbha dan Nishumbha ia memunculkan dewi-dewi pejuang lain, yaitu para Matrika dan Kali, untuk membantunya.
statement.en: She is best known as Mahishasura-mardini for slaying the buffalo demon Mahishasura; in her battles with Shumbha and Nishumbha she manifests other warrior goddesses, the Matrikas and Kali, to aid her.

claims.quote: She is associated with protection, strength, motherhood, destruction, and wars; her legends center around combating evils and demonic forces that threaten peace, dharma and cosmic order, representing the power of good over evil.

statement.id: Durga dikaitkan dengan perlindungan, kekuatan, keibuan, kehancuran, dan perang; kisahnya berpusat pada perlawanan terhadap kejahatan dan kekuatan iblis yang mengancam perdamaian, dharma, dan tatanan kosmis, melambangkan kemenangan kebaikan atas kejahatan.
statement.en: She is associated with protection, strength, motherhood, destruction and war; her legends center on combating evil and demonic forces that threaten peace, dharma and cosmic order, representing the power of good over evil.

claims.quote: Durga traditionally holds the weapons of various male gods of Hindu mythology, which they give her to fight the evil forces because they feel that she is shakti (energy, power). These include the chakra (divine discus), conch, bow, arrow, sword, javelin, trishula trident, shield, mace, pink lotus flower, and noose.

statement.id: Durga secara tradisional memegang senjata berbagai dewa laki-laki yang mereka berikan agar ia melawan kejahatan karena mereka memandangnya sebagai shakti (energi, daya); di antaranya cakra, kerang, busur, anak panah, pedang, lembing, trisula, perisai, gada, bunga teratai merah muda, dan jerat.
statement.en: Durga traditionally holds the weapons of various male gods, given to her to fight evil because they regard her as shakti (energy, power); these include the discus, conch, bow, arrow, sword, javelin, trident, shield, mace, pink lotus and noose.

claims.quote: The word Durga (दुर्गा) literally means "impassable", "invincible, unassailable". It is related to the word Durg (दुर्ग) which means "fortress, something difficult to defeat or pass".

statement.id: Kata Durga secara harfiah berarti "tak dapat dilewati", "tak terkalahkan, tak tertembus", dan berkaitan dengan kata durg yang berarti "benteng, sesuatu yang sulit dikalahkan atau dilewati".
statement.en: The word Durga literally means "impassable", "invincible, unassailable"; it is related to durg, meaning "fortress, something difficult to defeat or pass".

claims.quote: In Vaishnava contexts, Durga is revered as Yoganidrā, the divine slumber, younger sister and a female version of Vishnu.

statement.id: Dalam konteks Waisnawa, Durga dihormati sebagai Yoganidra, tidur ilahi, adik perempuan sekaligus versi perempuan Wisnu.
statement.en: In Vaishnava contexts, Durga is revered as Yoganidra, the divine slumber, younger sister and a female version of Vishnu.

claims.quote: Vishnu offers Durga the task of transferring the seventh child of Devaki into the womb of Rohini, as well as being born on earth as the infant daughter of Yashoda and Nanda, so that she could be swapped with Krishna.

statement.id: Menurut tradisi Waisnawa, Wisnu menugaskan Durga memindahkan anak ketujuh Devaki ke rahim Rohini dan lahir sebagai bayi perempuan Yashoda dan Nanda agar dapat ditukar dengan Krishna.
statement.en: In Vaishnava tradition, Vishnu gives Durga the task of moving Devaki's seventh child into Rohini's womb and of being born as the infant daughter of Yashoda and Nanda so she could be swapped with Krishna.

claims.quote: There are many epithets for Durga in Shaktism and her nine appellations are (Navadurga): Shailaputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayini, Kalaratri, Mahagauri and Siddhidatri.

statement.id: Dalam Shaktisme Durga punya banyak julukan, dan sembilan sebutannya (Navadurga) adalah Shailaputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayini, Kalaratri, Mahagauri, dan Siddhidatri.
statement.en: In Shaktism Durga has many epithets, and her nine appellations (Navadurga) are Shailaputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayini, Kalaratri, Mahagauri and Siddhidatri.

claims.quote: In the north wall of a granite cave in Mamallapuram, Tamil Nadu there is a large relief of Durga slaying Mahisasura, carved around 630–674 CE.

statement.id: Di dinding utara sebuah gua granit di Mamallapuram, Tamil Nadu, terdapat relief besar Durga membunuh Mahisasura yang diukir sekitar 630-674 M.
statement.en: On the north wall of a granite cave in Mamallapuram, Tamil Nadu, there is a large relief of Durga slaying Mahisasura, carved around 630-674 CE.

claims.quote: The 6th-century CE inscriptions in early Siddhamatrika script, such as at the Nagarjuni hill cave during the Maukhari era, already mention the legend of her victory over Mahishasura

statement.id: Prasasti abad ke-6 M beraksara Siddhamatrika awal, misalnya di gua bukit Nagarjuni pada masa Maukhari, sudah menyebut kisah kemenangannya atas Mahishasura.
statement.en: Sixth-century CE inscriptions in early Siddhamatrika script, such as at the Nagarjuni hill cave in the Maukhari era, already mention the legend of her victory over Mahishasura.

claims.quote: Durga as a demon-slaying goddess was likely well established by the time the classic Hindu text called Devi Mahatmya was composed, which scholars variously estimate to between 400 and 600 CE.

statement.id: Durga sebagai dewi pembunuh iblis kemungkinan sudah mapan ketika teks klasik Devi Mahatmya disusun, yang oleh para sarjana diperkirakan antara 400 dan 600 M.
statement.en: Durga as a demon-slaying goddess was likely well established when the classic text Devi Mahatmya was composed, which scholars variously date to between 400 and 600 CE.

claims.quote: Her iconography typically resonates with these attributes, where she rides a lion or a tiger, has between eight and eighteen hands, each holding a weapon to destroy and create.

statement.id: Ikonografinya biasanya menampilkan Durga menunggangi singa atau harimau dengan delapan sampai delapan belas tangan yang masing-masing memegang senjata.
statement.en: Her iconography typically shows her riding a lion or a tiger, with between eight and eighteen hands, each holding a weapon.

claims.quote: Durga iconography has been flexible in the Hindu traditions, where for example some intellectuals place a pen or other writing implements in her hand since they consider their stylus as their weapon.

statement.id: Ikonografi Durga lentur dalam tradisi Hindu; misalnya sebagian cendekiawan meletakkan pena atau alat tulis di tangannya karena menganggap penanya sebagai senjata.
statement.en: Durga iconography has been flexible in Hindu traditions; for example some intellectuals place a pen or other writing implement in her hand because they consider their stylus their weapon.

claims.quote: Himavan, the personification of the Himalayas, gifted a lion as her mount.

statement.id: Dalam kisah ini, Himavan, personifikasi Himalaya, menghadiahkan seekor singa sebagai tunggangannya.
statement.en: In this account Himavan, the personification of the Himalayas, gifted a lion as her mount.

claims.quote: Durga has a significant following all over Nepal, India, Bangladesh and many other countries.

statement.id: Durga memiliki banyak pengikut di seluruh Nepal, India, Bangladesh, dan banyak negara lain.
statement.en: Durga has a significant following all over Nepal, India, Bangladesh and many other countries.

claims.quote: Durga is typically portrayed as a celibate warrior goddess. However, at a certain point in her history, she becomes associated with the god Śiva as his wife.

statement.id: Durga umumnya digambarkan sebagai dewi pejuang yang selibat, tetapi pada suatu titik dalam sejarahnya ia dikaitkan dengan Dewa Siwa sebagai istrinya.
statement.en: Durga is typically portrayed as a celibate warrior goddess, but at a certain point in her history she becomes associated with the god Shiva as his wife.

claims.quote: Durgā is a very popular deity. The name is indifferently applied to all goddesses with a terrible appearance and in a fighting attitude.

statement.id: Durga adalah dewi yang sangat populer; nama itu dipakai tanpa pembedaan untuk semua dewi berwujud menakutkan dan bersikap bertempur.
statement.en: Durga is a very popular deity; the name is applied indifferently to all goddesses with a terrible appearance and in a fighting attitude.

claims.quote: The Saivāgama specifically describes nine varieties of Durgā, all of which have two arms but different weapons

statement.id: Saivagama secara khusus menguraikan sembilan ragam Durga, semuanya bertangan dua tetapi bersenjata berbeda.
statement.en: The Saivagama specifically describes nine varieties of Durga, all with two arms but different weapons.

claims.quote: In this role, Durgā assumes domestic characteristics and is often identified with the goddess Parvati.

statement.id: Dalam peran sebagai istri Siwa, Durga mengambil sifat rumah tangga dan sering diidentifikasi dengan dewi Parwati.
statement.en: In this role as Shiva's wife, Durga assumes domestic characteristics and is often identified with the goddess Parvati.

claims.quote: The general description of Durgā given in the Kāsyapa-Silpa represents her as having four arms, two eyes

statement.id: Uraian umum tentang Durga dalam Kasyapa-Silpa menggambarkannya berlengan empat dan bermata dua.
statement.en: The general description of Durga in the Kasyapa-Silpa shows her with four arms and two eyes.

claims.quote: From Mahābalipuram comes the figure of a Durgā (fig. 124) who stands on the buffalo's head. She has eight arms, in the uppermost of which are found the discus and the conch.

statement.id: Sebuah arca Durga dari Mahabalipuram berdiri di atas kepala kerbau dan berlengan delapan; di tangan teratasnya terdapat cakram dan kerang.
statement.en: A figure of Durga from Mahabalipuram stands on the buffalo's head and has eight arms; the discus and the conch are in the uppermost ones.

claims.quote: Durga is commonly known as Mahishasura-mardini for slaying the half-buffalo demon Mahishasura. She is also known as Vindhyavasini (she who dwells in the Vindhya Mountains).

statement.id: Durga lazim disebut Mahishasura-mardini karena membunuh iblis setengah kerbau Mahishasura, dan juga dikenal sebagai Vindhyavasini (ia yang tinggal di Pegunungan Vindhya).
statement.en: Durga is commonly known as Mahishasura-mardini for slaying the half-buffalo demon Mahishasura, and also as Vindhyavasini (she who dwells in the Vindhya Mountains).

claims.quote: Durga is also known as Durgati Nashini, meaning one who eliminates suffering.

statement.id: Durga juga dikenal sebagai Durgati Nashini, yang berarti ia yang melenyapkan penderitaan.
statement.en: Durga is also known as Durgati Nashini, meaning one who eliminates suffering.

claims.quote: Doing rather well, Mahisa managed to kick most of the gods out of heaven, forcing them to wander the earth as mere men.

statement.id: Mahisa berhasil mengusir sebagian besar dewa dari surga sehingga mereka berkelana di bumi sebagai manusia biasa.
statement.en: Mahisa managed to drive most of the gods out of heaven, forcing them to wander the earth as mere men.

summary.id: Energi para dewa yang menyatu membentuk Durga.
summary.en: The combined energy of the gods formed Durga.

summary.id: Devi sudah lama ada sebagai putri Himavat dan para dewa hanya memberinya senjata.
summary.en: Devi long existed as the daughter of Himavat and the gods only gave her weapons.

summary.id: Sepuluh lengan menurut satu sumber.
summary.en: Ten arms according to one source.

summary.id: Antara delapan dan delapan belas tangan menurut sumber lain.
summary.en: Between eight and eighteen hands according to another source.

summary.id: Empat lengan menurut Kasyapa-Silpa, dan delapan lengan pada arca Mahabalipuram menurut sumber ketiga.
summary.en: Four arms according to the Kasyapa-Silpa, and eight arms on the Mahabalipuram figure according to a third source.

short_description.id: Fairy adalah makhluk gaib dalam cerita rakyat, terutama Britania dan Irlandia, dengan bentuk dan perilaku beragam: ada yang berukuran manusia, ada yang kecil, dan sikap mereka bisa berbahaya atau baik hati.
short_description.en: Fairies are supernatural beings of folklore, especially in Britain and Ireland, with varied forms and behaviour: some are human-sized, some small, and their conduct can be dangerous or benevolent.

long_description.id: Fairy adalah istilah umum bagi makhluk gaib yang dalam cerita dianggap mencampuri urusan manusia dengan sihir. Dalam kisah Britania dan Irlandia, bentuknya beragam, dari ratu peri seukuran manusia sampai peri rumah yang kecil. Mereka digambarkan abadi dan mampu menghilang, berubah wujud, dan menciptakan ilusi; sikap mereka bisa berbahaya atau baik hati, tergantung bagaimana manusia memperlakukan mereka.
long_description.en: Fairy is the common term for supernatural beings said to intermeddle magically in human affairs. In British and Irish stories they range from human-sized queens to small house fairies. They are described as immortal and able to vanish, shapeshift and create illusions; their conduct can be dangerous or benevolent depending on how humans treat them.

long_description.id: Dalam kepercayaan Irlandia, fairy hidup di "raths", benteng tanah tua, dan di rumah bawah tanah; mereka digambarkan sebagai bangsa terorganisasi yang kehidupannya sejajar dengan manusia. Cerita menyebut mereka menculik anak dan menggantinya dengan changeling, serta membawa manusia ke negeri peri. Manusia hidup tidak boleh makan di negeri peri, kalau tidak ia tinggal di sana selamanya. Sebagian fairy dapat terbang tanpa sayap, dan di Irlandia serta Skotlandia mereka biasanya berukuran manusia biasa. Menurut Lang, holly disayangi fairy dan mata panah batu masih dianggap senjata fairy di Irlandia.
long_description.en: In Irish belief, fairies live in "raths", old earth-forts, and in subterranean houses; they are described as an organized people whose life corresponds to human life. Stories say they carry off children, leaving changeling substitutes, and take men and women into fairyland. A living human being must not eat in fairyland, or he stays there for ever. Some fairies fly without wings, and in Ireland and Scotland they are usually of ordinary human size. According to Lang, holly is dear to fairies and Neolithic arrow-heads are still regarded as fairy weapons in Ireland.

long_description.id: Penulis lama membedakan fairy roman Abad Pertengahan, yang sedikit berbeda dari manusia selain pengetahuan dan kekuatan gaibnya, dari elf kecil dalam kepercayaan rakyat. Kisah Melusine menggambarkan seorang fay yang setiap pekan berubah menjadi ular dari pinggang ke bawah. Menurut Keightley, kata fairy akhirnya dipakai untuk kedua golongan itu, dan setelah Faerie Queene nama serta sifat fay roman dialihkan kepada makhluk kecil. Lang juga menyebut perempuan fairy yang datang pada kelahiran anak dan meramalkan nasibnya. Lang menilai fairy dan jān praktis identik, dan menyebut beberapa asal-usul yang diusulkan, termasuk ingatan tentang bangsa kerdil.
long_description.en: Older writers distinguish the fairies of medieval romance, who differ little from humans except in supernatural knowledge and power, from the little elves of popular belief. The tale of Melusine describes a fay who each week took the form of a serpent from the waist down. According to Keightley, the word fairy came to be used for both classes, and after the Faerie Queene the name and attributes of the fays were transferred to the little beings. Lang also notes fairy women who attend the birth of children and predict their futures. Lang judges fairies and jān practically identical and mentions several proposed origins, including memories of a pigmy people.

long_description.id: Tradisi fairy telah lama dikaji: jurnal Folklore memuat penelitian tentangnya sejak akhir abad ke-19, dan Britannica 1911 menyebut kata fairy berasal dari bahasa Latin fatare dan fatum.
long_description.en: Fairy traditions have long been studied: the journal Folklore has carried research on them since the late nineteenth century, and the 1911 Britannica traces the word fairy to Latin fatare and fatum.

literal_meaning.id: Britannica 1911 menurunkan kata ini dari fatare, "memikat", dari fatum, "nasib".
literal_meaning.en: The 1911 Britannica derives the word from fatare, "to enchant", from fatum, "fate, destiny".

who.id: Fairy adalah makhluk gaib dalam cerita rakyat yang dianggap mencampuri urusan manusia dengan sihir.
who.en: Fairies are supernatural beings of folklore said to intermeddle magically in human affairs.

origin.id: Kepercayaan ini dicatat dalam kisah-kisah lama Britania dan Irlandia.
origin.en: The belief is recorded in old British and Irish narratives.

role.en: In stories, fairies carry off children, leave changelings and take people into fairyland.

famous_for.en: Fairies are known for their magic, the beauty ascribed to them by medieval poets, and conduct that can be dangerous or benevolent.

statement.id: Fairy adalah istilah bagi makhluk gaib yang dalam cerita turut campur secara ajaib dalam urusan manusia.
statement.en: Fairy refers to supernatural beings said to interfere magically in human affairs.

claims.quote: Discover the intriguing, formidable faeries of old British and Irish folk narratives.

statement.id: Fairy tampil dalam cerita rakyat lama Britania dan Irlandia.
statement.en: Fairies appear in old British and Irish folk narratives.

claims.quote: Split between numerous local species, ranging from full-sized Scottish elf-queens to small, wizened male house fairies, they share a number of common characteristics.

statement.id: Fairy terbagi dalam banyak jenis lokal, dari ratu elf Skotlandia berukuran penuh sampai peri rumah laki-laki yang kecil dan keriput.
statement.en: Fairies are split between numerous local species, from full-sized Scottish elf-queens to small, wizened male house fairies.

claims.quote: All are immortal, with supernatural powers that include vanishing, shape-shifting and creating illusions.

statement.id: Dalam cerita Britania dan Irlandia, fairy bersifat abadi dan dapat menghilang, berubah wujud, atau menciptakan ilusi.
statement.en: In British and Irish tales, fairies are immortal and can vanish, shapeshift, or create illusions.

claims.quote: They are typically capricious, dangerous and vengeful, though may display benevolence so long as great care is taken not to offend them by breaking their curious protocols.

statement.id: Fairy dapat berbahaya atau baik hati tergantung perlakuan manusia dalam cerita.
statement.en: Fairies may be dangerous or benevolent depending on human conduct in stories.

claims.quote: They carry off children, leaving changeling substitutes, transport men and women into fairyland

statement.id: Cerita fairy memuat penculikan anak dan penggantian dengan changeling.
statement.en: Fairy stories include child abduction and changeling substitution.

claims.quote: Though some can fly, they do not have wings, but levitate by mounting twigs, bundles of grass or plant stems, wearing a special cap or uttering a set of potent words.

statement.id: Dalam cerita lama, sebagian fairy terbang tanpa sayap.
statement.en: In older stories some fairies fly without wings.

claims.quote: fairy lore has provided a fruitful area of investigation for contributors to the journal Folklore since its founding in the late nineteenth century.

statement.id: Cerita fairy telah diteliti dalam jurnal Folklore sejak akhir abad ke-19.
statement.en: Fairy lore has been studied in Folklore since the late nineteenth century.

claims.quote: The “people of peace” (Daoine Shie) of Ireland and Scotland are usually of ordinary stature, indeed not to be recognized as varying from mankind except by their proceedings

statement.id: Daoine Shie ("people of peace") Irlandia dan Skotlandia biasanya berukuran biasa dan tidak dapat dibedakan dari manusia kecuali dari tindakan mereka.
statement.en: The "people of peace" (Daoine Shie) of Ireland and Scotland are usually of ordinary stature and not recognisable as differing from mankind except by their proceedings.

claims.quote: Med. Lat. fatare, to enchant, from Lat. fatum, fate, destiny

statement.id: Britannica 1911 menelusuri kata fairy (dan padanannya fée, fada, hada, fata) ke bahasa Latin Abad Pertengahan fatare, "memikat", dari Latin fatum, nasib.
statement.en: The 1911 Britannica traces the word fairy (and its cognates fée, fada, hada, fata) to Medieval Latin fatare, "to enchant", from Latin fatum, fate or destiny.

claims.quote: Of all the minor creatures of mythology the Fairies are the most beautiful, the most numerous, the most memorable in literature.

statement.id: Andrew Lang menilai fairy sebagai makhluk kecil mitologi yang paling indah, paling banyak, dan paling berkesan dalam sastra.
statement.en: Andrew Lang judges fairies the most beautiful, most numerous and most memorable in literature of the minor creatures of mythology.

claims.quote: Here they dwell in the "raths," old earth-forts, or earthen bases of later palisaded dwellings of the Norman period, and in the subterranean houses, common also in Scotland.

statement.id: Dalam kepercayaan Irlandia, fairy tinggal di "raths", benteng tanah tua, dan di rumah bawah tanah yang juga umum di Skotlandia.
statement.en: In Irish belief, fairies dwell in the "raths", old earth-forts, and in subterranean houses, which are also common in Scotland.

claims.quote: They are an organized people, often called "the army," and their life corresponds to human life in all particulars.

statement.id: Fairy Irlandia digambarkan sebagai bangsa yang terorganisasi, sering disebut "pasukan", dengan kehidupan yang sejajar dengan kehidupan manusia dalam segala hal.
statement.en: Irish fairies are described as an organized people, often called "the army", whose life corresponds to human life in all particulars.

claims.quote: a living human being must not eat in Fairyland; if he does, he dwells there for ever.

statement.id: Manusia hidup tidak boleh makan di negeri peri; jika makan, ia tinggal di sana selamanya.
statement.en: A living human being must not eat in Fairyland; if he does, he dwells there for ever.

claims.quote: The neighbours said that the Fairies caused the phenomenon, as the man had swept his chimney with a bough of holly, and the holly is "a gentle tree," dear to the Fairies.

statement.id: Dalam satu laporan, tetangga menyebut fairy menyebabkan lemparan batu karena si pemilik rumah menyapu cerobong dengan ranting holly, pohon "lembut" yang disayangi fairy.
statement.en: In one report, neighbours said fairies caused flying stones because the man had swept his chimney with a bough of holly, "a gentle tree" dear to the fairies.

claims.quote: In Ireland and the West Highlands Neolithic arrow-heads and flint chips are still fairy weapons.

statement.id: Di Irlandia dan Dataran Tinggi Barat, mata panah Neolitik dan serpihan batu api masih dianggap senjata fairy.
statement.en: In Ireland and the West Highlands, Neolithic arrow-heads and flint chips are still regarded as fairy weapons.

claims.quote: the nearest analogy to the shape which it takes in Scotland and Ireland—the "pixies" of south-western England—is to be found in Jān or Jinnis of the Arabs, Moors and people of Palestine.

statement.id: Lang menulis bahwa padanan terdekat bentuk kepercayaan ini di Skotlandia dan Irlandia, serta "pixies" Inggris barat daya, ada pada jān atau jin orang Arab, Moor, dan Palestina.
statement.en: Lang writes that the nearest analogy to the form of the belief in Scotland and Ireland, and the "pixies" of south-western England, is found in the jān or jinn of Arabs, Moors and people of Palestine.

claims.quote: It is plain that Fairies and Jān are practically identical

statement.id: Lang menyimpulkan bahwa fairy dan jān praktis identik.
statement.en: Lang concludes that fairies and jān are practically identical.

claims.quote: Fairies naturally won their way into the poetry of the Middle Ages. They take lovers from among men, and are often described as of delicate, unearthly, ravishing beauty.

statement.id: Fairy masuk ke puisi Abad Pertengahan; mereka mengambil kekasih dari kalangan manusia dan sering dilukiskan sangat indah dan tak berbau duniawi.
statement.en: Fairies entered the poetry of the Middle Ages; they take lovers from among men and are often described as delicately, unearthly beautiful.

claims.quote: as in the notable tale of Melusine. This fay by enchantment built the Castle of Lusignan for her husband. It was her nature to take every week the form of a serpent from the waist below.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Melusine, fay itu membangun Kastil Lusignan dengan sihir untuk suaminya dan setiap pekan berubah menjadi ular dari pinggang ke bawah.
statement.en: In the tale of Melusine, the fay built the Castle of Lusignan by enchantment for her husband and each week took the form of a serpent from the waist down.

claims.quote: There seems little in the characteristics of these Fairies of romance to distinguish them from human beings, except their supernatural knowledge and power. They are not often represented as diminutive in stature

statement.id: Fairy dalam roman Abad Pertengahan sedikit berbeda dari manusia kecuali pengetahuan dan kekuatan gaibnya, dan jarang digambarkan bertubuh kecil.
statement.en: The fairies of medieval romance differ little from human beings except in supernatural knowledge and power, and are not often shown as diminutive.

claims.quote: The fairy women who come to the births of children and foretell their fortunes

statement.id: Lang menyebut adanya perempuan fairy yang datang pada kelahiran anak dan meramalkan nasibnya.
statement.en: Lang mentions fairy women who come to the births of children and foretell their fortunes.

claims.quote: It is a not uncommon theory that the Fairies survive in legend from prehistoric memories of a pigmy people dwelling in the subterranean earth-houses, but the contents of these do not indicate an age prior to the close of the Roman occupation of Britain

statement.id: Lang menyebut teori bahwa fairy berasal dari ingatan prasejarah tentang bangsa kerdil penghuni rumah bawah tanah, tetapi isi rumah-rumah itu tidak menunjukkan zaman sebelum berakhirnya pendudukan Romawi di Britania.
statement.en: Lang mentions the theory that fairies survive from prehistoric memories of a pigmy people in subterranean earth-houses, but notes the contents of these do not point to an age before the close of the Roman occupation of Britain.

claims.quote: Gervaise of Tilbury, writing early in the 13th century, has in his Otia Imperialia a chapter, De lamiis et nocturnis larvis, where he gives it out, as proved by individuals beyond all exception, that men have been lovers of beings of this kind whom they call fadas

statement.id: Gervaise dari Tilbury, menulis pada awal abad ke-13 dalam Otia Imperialia, menyatakan bahwa ada manusia yang menjadi kekasih makhluk yang mereka sebut fadas.
statement.en: Gervaise of Tilbury, writing in the early 13th century in his Otia Imperialia, reports that men have been lovers of beings they call fadas.

claims.quote: The first, beings of the human race, but endowed with powers beyond those usually allotted to men, whom we shall term Fays, or Fairies of Romance.

statement.id: Keightley membagi makhluk bernama fairy menjadi dua golongan; golongan pertama adalah makhluk dari ras manusia dengan kekuatan melampaui manusia biasa, yang disebutnya fays atau fairy roman.
statement.en: Keightley divides the beings called fairies into two classes; the first are beings of the human race endowed with powers beyond those usually allotted to men, whom he terms fays, or fairies of romance.

claims.quote: The second, those little beings of the popular creeds, whose descent we propose to trace from the cunning and ingenious Duergar or Dwarfs of Northern Mythology, and whom we shall denominate Elves or popular Fairies.

statement.id: Golongan kedua menurut Keightley adalah makhluk kecil dalam kepercayaan rakyat, yang ia usulkan berasal dari Duergar atau kurcaci mitologi Nordik, dan disebutnya elf atau fairy rakyat.
statement.en: The second class, in Keightley's scheme, are the little beings of popular creeds, whose descent he proposes to trace from the Duergar or dwarfs of Northern mythology, and whom he calls elves or popular fairies.

claims.quote: The root is evidently, we think, the Latin fatum.

statement.id: Keightley menyimpulkan bahwa akar kata fée, fada, hada, dan fata dalam bahasa-bahasa Roman adalah kata Latin fatum.
statement.en: Keightley concludes that the root of the Romance words fée, fada, hada and fata is the Latin fatum.

claims.quote: no theory is so plausible, or is supported by such names, as that which deduces the English fairy from the Persian peri.

statement.id: Keightley menulis bahwa tidak ada teori yang sepopuler atau sekuat dukungan nama-namanya seperti yang menurunkan kata Inggris fairy dari peri Persia.
statement.en: Keightley writes that no theory is so plausible, or supported by such names, as the one deriving English fairy from Persian peri.

claims.quote: the word came to signify the individual denizen of Fairy-land, and was equally applied to the full-sized fairy knights and ladies of romance, and to the pygmy elves that haunt the woods and dells.

statement.id: Kata fairy akhirnya berarti penghuni negeri peri secara individual, dan dipakai baik untuk ksatria serta putri fairy berukuran penuh dalam roman maupun elf kerdil yang menghuni hutan dan lembah.
statement.en: The word came to mean the individual inhabitant of Fairy-land, applied both to the full-sized fairy knights and ladies of romance and to the pygmy elves of woods and dells.

claims.quote: They generally excel mankind in power and in knowledge, and like them are subject to the inevitable laws of death, though after a more prolonged period of existence.
claims.locator: Origin of the belief in fairies

statement.id: Keightley menulis bahwa makhluk-makhluk semacam ini umumnya melebihi manusia dalam kekuatan dan pengetahuan, dan seperti manusia tunduk pada kematian, meski setelah umur yang lebih panjang.
statement.en: Keightley writes that such beings generally excel mankind in power and knowledge and, like humans, are subject to death, though after a longer span of existence.

claims.quote: After the appearance of the Faerie Queene, all distinctions were confounded, the name and attributes of the real Fays or Fairies of romance were completely transferred to the little beings

statement.id: Keightley menulis bahwa setelah terbitnya Faerie Queene, semua pembedaan menjadi kabur dan nama serta sifat fay roman dialihkan sepenuhnya kepada makhluk-makhluk kecil.
statement.en: Keightley writes that after the appearance of the Faerie Queene all distinctions were confounded and the name and attributes of the fays of romance were transferred to the little beings.

claims.quote: The herb rue is potent against them, as in British folk-lore

statement.id: Lang menulis bahwa tanaman rue ampuh melawan jān, seperti dalam cerita rakyat Britania.
statement.en: Lang writes that the herb rue is potent against the jān, as in British folk-lore.

summary.id: Ukuran beragam, dari ratu peri seukuran manusia sampai peri rumah kecil; fairy Irlandia dan Skotlandia biasanya seukuran manusia.
summary.en: Sizes vary from full-sized elf-queens to small house fairies; Irish and Scottish fairies are usually of ordinary stature.

summary.en: Popular elves are described as pygmy, while the fairy knights and ladies of romance are full-sized.

summary.en: British and Irish fairies are all immortal.

summary.en: Keightley: such beings are subject to death, though after a more prolonged existence.

summary.en: The 1911 Britannica and Keightley derive it from Latin fatum.

short_description.id: Mars adalah dewa perang Romawi, kedua sesudah Jupiter, sekaligus pelindung Roma dan pertanian. Ia dikenal sebagai ayah Romulus dan Remus, dan serigala serta burung pelatuk suci baginya.
short_description.en: Mars is the Roman god of war, second only to Jupiter, and a guardian of Rome and agriculture. He is known as father of Romulus and Remus, and the wolf and woodpecker were sacred to him.

long_description.id: Mars adalah dewa perang Romawi, kedua sesudah Jupiter dalam jajaran dewa Romawi. Sebagian besar mitosnya dipinjam dari Ares Yunani, tetapi ia dipandang lebih tenang dan lebih berbudi luhur oleh orang Romawi. Berbeda dengan Ares yang dianggap pengacau, Mars melambangkan kekuatan militer sebagai cara mengamankan perdamaian. Ia juga pelindung pertanian, perpaduan yang khas Roma awal, dan putra Jupiter dan Juno. Ciri hakiki Mars adalah kejantanan, yang dipahami sebagai daya hidup (vis) atau keutamaan (virtus).
long_description.en: Mars is the Roman god of war, second only to Jupiter in the Roman pantheon. Most of his myths were borrowed from Greek Ares, but the Romans saw him as more level-headed and more virtuous. Unlike Ares, seen as a disruptive force, Mars represented military power as a way to secure peace. He was also an agricultural guardian, a combination characteristic of early Rome, and a son of Jupiter and Juno. Mars is characterised above all by virility, understood as vital force (vis) or manly virtue (virtus).

long_description.id: Mars dipandang sebagai pelindung Roma dan cara hidup Romawi, yang membela batas dan perbatasan kota. Dalam perang, sebuah tombak diguncang di Regia dan ia dipanggil untuk menjaga rakyat Romawi; panglima yang hendak berangkat mengguncang tombak sucinya. Persaudaraan Arval memanggilnya untuk melindungi para pemohon dari malapetaka, dan sebagai pelindung pertanian ia mengarahkan tenaganya agar tanaman tumbuh. Pada abad ke-3 M ia terutama disembah legiun Romawi.
long_description.en: Mars was seen as a protector of Rome and the Roman way of life, defending city borders and frontiers. In wartime a spear was shaken in the Regia and he was called on to watch over the Roman people, and the departing commander shook his sacred spears. The Arval Brotherhood invoked him to protect suppliants from ill, and as agricultural guardian he directs his energies toward making crops grow. By the 3rd century CE he was mainly worshipped by Roman legions.

long_description.id: Dalam mitos pendirian Roma, Mars dianggap ayah Romulus dan Remus, kembar pendiri Roma yang mitis. Livy mencatat bahwa sang Perawan Vesta menyebut Mars sebagai ayah mereka, entah karena sungguh percaya atau agar kesalahannya tampak lebih ringan. Serigala betina menyusui bayi-bayi itu; serigala dan burung pelatuk adalah hewan liar paling suci bagi Mars. Dalam asal-usul Roma menurut Virgil, Mars adalah leluhur Romulus. Di wilayah bangsa Aequi, Mars memiliki orakel kuno tempat ramalan konon diucapkan seekor burung pelatuk. Mars juga dikaitkan dengan Venus, dengan pasangan Nerio, dan dalam kisah khas Romawi dengan pernikahannya yang licik dengan Anna Perenna.
long_description.en: In the myth of Rome's founding, Mars is considered father of Romulus and Remus, the mythical twin founders of Rome. Livy records that the Vestal named Mars as their father, either because she believed it or to make the fault seem lighter. A she-wolf suckled the infants; the wolf and woodpecker were the wild animals most sacred to Mars. In Virgil's account of Rome's origin, Mars is the ancestor of Romulus. Among the Aequi, Mars had an ancient oracle where a woodpecker was said to speak the prophecies. Mars is also linked to Venus, to his consort Nerio, and in a uniquely Roman story to his tricked marriage to Anna Perenna.

long_description.id: Bulan Martius dinamai menurut Mars. Festival untuknya digelar pada Maret dan Oktober, sering terkait persiapan dan penutupan kampanye militer, dan dilaksanakan antara lain oleh imam khusus flamen Martialis. Pada Maret para imam Salii menyanyikan himne dengan baju zirah zaman perunggu, dan Tubilustrium membersihkan terompet. Di antaranya Equus October, perlombaan kuda di Campus Martius, dan Armilustrium, penyucian senjata sebelum disimpan. Kurban khasnya adalah suovetaurilia dan Kuda Oktober. Kuil dan altar didirikan baginya di Roma dan seluruh kekaisaran, dan relief menampilkannya sebagai pria berjanggut dengan helm Korintus.
long_description.en: The month Martius was named after Mars. Festivals for him were held in March and October, often tied to preparing for and closing military campaigns, and were carried out by his dedicated priests, the flamen Martialis. In March the Salii priests sang hymns in bronze-age armour, and the Tubilustrium cleansed trumpets. They included the Equus October, a horse race in the Campus Martius, and the Armilustrium, the purification of weapons before storage. His distinctive sacrifices were the suovetaurilia and the October Horse. Temples and altars were dedicated to him in Rome and throughout the Empire, and relief art shows him as a bearded man in a Corinthian helmet.

literal_meaning.id: Asal kata tidak pasti: bentuk tertua Mamart- mungkin berasal dari luar, mungkin dari Maris, nama dewa anak Etruria; penyamaan dengan Marut Weda kini ditolak.
literal_meaning.en: The origin is uncertain: the oldest form Mamart- is likely foreign, perhaps from Maris, an Etruscan child-god; equating it with the Vedic Maruts is now rejected.

summary.en: In Ovid's version Juno conceives Mars alone with a magic flower from Flora; Ovid is the only source for the story.

summary.id: Pada Pertempuran Sentinum tahun 295 SM, serigala Mars yang muncul menjadi tanda kemenangan Romawi.
summary.en: Mars's wolf showing up at Sentinum in 295 BCE signalled a coming Roman victory.

claims.quote: Mars was the Roman god of war and second only to Jupiter in the Roman pantheon.

statement.id: Mars adalah dewa perang Romawi yang kedudukannya hanya di bawah Jupiter.
statement.en: Mars is the Roman war god, second only to Jupiter in the Roman pantheon.

claims.quote: Although most of the myths involving Mars were borrowed from the Greek god of war Ares, Mars did have some uniquely Roman features.

statement.id: Kisah Mars banyak meminjam mitos Ares, tetapi memiliki ciri khas Romawi.
statement.en: Mars myths drew on Greek Ares but retained distinct Roman features.

claims.quote: Mar was a protector of Rome and the Roman way of life. He defended city borders and frontiers.

statement.id: Mars dipandang sebagai pelindung Roma dan perbatasannya.
statement.en: Mars was seen as protector of Rome and its borders.

claims.quote: Mars was considered the father of Romulus and Remus, the mythical twin founders of Rome.

statement.id: Mars disebut ayah Romulus dan Remus, pendiri mitis Roma.
statement.en: Mars was said to father Romulus and Remus, Rome's mythical founders.

claims.quote: The month of Martius (March) was named after the god.

statement.id: Bulan Martius dinamai dari Mars.
statement.en: The month Martius was named after Mars.

claims.quote: These rites may also have been connected to agriculture but the nature of Mars' role in this area of Roman life is disputed by scholars.

statement.id: Sebagian ritus Mars mungkin berkaitan dengan pertanian, tetapi perannya dalam bidang itu masih diperdebatkan.
statement.en: Some Mars rites may have agricultural links, but his agricultural role is debated.

claims.quote: the god was also closely associated with the wolf and woodpecker.

statement.id: Serigala dan burung pelatuk berkaitan erat dengan Mars.
statement.en: The wolf and woodpecker were associated with Mars.

claims.quote: Numerous temples, shrines, and altars were dedicated to him in Rome and throughout the Empire.

statement.id: Kuil dan altar Mars didirikan di Roma dan seluruh kekaisaran.
statement.en: Temples and altars to Mars stood in Rome and across the empire.

claims.quote: Mars is represented in the canonical guise of an older, bearded man wearing a Corinthian helmet tipped back on his head.

statement.id: Relief Romawi di The Met menggambarkan Mars sebagai pria tua berjanggut dengan helm Korintus.
statement.en: A Roman relief at The Met portrays Mars as an older bearded man wearing a Corinthian helmet.

claims.quote: Important festivals and ceremonies, usually connected to the preparation and closure of military campaigns, were held in honour of the god in March and October

statement.id: Festival Mars berlangsung pada Maret dan Oktober, terkait awal dan akhir musim kampanye militer.
statement.en: Mars festivals in March and October marked military campaign preparations and closure.

claims.quote: is the god of war and also an agricultural guardian, a combination characteristic of early Rome. He is the son of Jupiter and Juno, and was pre-eminent among the Roman army's military gods.

statement.id: Mars adalah dewa perang sekaligus pelindung pertanian, perpaduan yang khas Roma awal; ia putra Jupiter dan Juno dan terkemuka di antara dewa-dewa militer tentara Romawi.
statement.en: Mars is the god of war and also an agricultural guardian, a combination characteristic of early Rome; he is the son of Jupiter and Juno and was pre-eminent among the Roman army's military gods.

claims.quote: Unlike Ares, who was viewed primarily as a destructive and destabilizing force, Mars represented military power as a way to secure peace, and was a father (pater) of the Roman people.

statement.id: Berbeda dengan Ares yang dipandang terutama sebagai kekuatan perusak dan pengacau, Mars melambangkan kekuatan militer sebagai cara mengamankan perdamaian dan menjadi bapak (pater) bangsa Romawi.
statement.en: Unlike Ares, who was seen mainly as a destructive and destabilizing force, Mars represented military power as a way to secure peace and was a father (pater) of the Roman people.

claims.quote: Mars's altar in the Campus Martius, the area of Rome that took its name from him, was supposed to have been dedicated by Numa, the peace-loving semi-legendary second king of Rome

statement.id: Altar Mars di Campus Martius, kawasan Roma yang dinamai menurut namanya, konon didedikasikan oleh Numa, raja kedua Roma yang cinta damai dan setengah legendaris.
statement.en: Mars's altar in the Campus Martius, the area of Rome named after him, was supposed to have been dedicated by Numa, the peace-loving semi-legendary second king of Rome.

claims.quote: Augustus shifted the focus of Mars's cult to within the pomerium (Rome's ritual boundary), and built a temple to Mars Ultor as a key religious feature of his new forum.

statement.id: Augustus memindahkan pusat kultus Mars ke dalam pomerium (batas ritual Roma) dan membangun kuil bagi Mars Ultor sebagai ciri keagamaan utama forum barunya.
statement.en: Augustus shifted the focus of Mars's cult inside the pomerium (Rome's ritual boundary) and built a temple to Mars Ultor as a key religious feature of his new forum.

claims.quote: Mars's association with the wolf is familiar from what may be the most famous of Roman myths, the story of how a she-wolf (lupa) suckled his infant sons when they were exposed by order of King Amulius

statement.id: Kaitan Mars dengan serigala dikenal dari kisah paling terkenal mitos Romawi: seekor serigala betina (lupa) menyusui putra-putranya yang masih bayi ketika mereka dibuang atas perintah Raja Amulius.
statement.en: Mars's association with the wolf is familiar from what may be the most famous Roman myth: a she-wolf (lupa) suckled his infant sons when they were exposed on the order of King Amulius.

claims.quote: The wild animals most sacred to Mars were the woodpecker and the wolf, which in the natural lore of the Romans were said always to inhabit the same foothills and woodlands.

statement.id: Hewan liar yang paling suci bagi Mars adalah burung pelatuk dan serigala, yang menurut pengetahuan alam Romawi selalu menghuni kaki bukit dan hutan yang sama.
statement.en: The wild animals most sacred to Mars were the woodpecker and the wolf, said in Roman natural lore always to inhabit the same foothills and woodlands.

claims.quote: As the beak of the picus Martius contained the god's power to ward off harm, it was carried as a magic charm to prevent bee stings and leech bites.

statement.id: Karena paruh picus Martius mengandung kekuatan sang dewa untuk menangkal bahaya, paruh itu dibawa sebagai jimat untuk mencegah sengatan lebah dan gigitan lintah.
statement.en: Because the beak of the picus Martius held the god's power to ward off harm, it was carried as a magic charm to prevent bee stings and leech bites.

claims.quote: In the territory of the Aequi, another Italic people, Mars had an oracle of great antiquity where the prophecies were supposed to be spoken by a woodpecker perched on a wooden column.

statement.id: Di wilayah bangsa Aequi, Mars memiliki orakel yang sangat kuno, tempat ramalan konon diucapkan oleh burung pelatuk yang bertengger di tiang kayu.
statement.en: In the territory of the Aequi, Mars had an oracle of great antiquity where prophecies were supposed to be spoken by a woodpecker perched on a wooden column.

claims.quote: At the Battle of Sentinum in 295 BCE, the appearance of the wolf of Mars (Martius lupus) was a sign that Roman victory was to come.

statement.id: Pada Pertempuran Sentinum tahun 295 SM, munculnya serigala Mars (Martius lupus) menjadi tanda bahwa kemenangan Romawi akan datang.
statement.en: At the Battle of Sentinum in 295 BCE, the appearance of the wolf of Mars (Martius lupus) was a sign that Roman victory was to come.

claims.quote: In Roman Gaul, the goose was associated with the Celtic forms of Mars, and archaeologists have found geese buried alongside warriors in graves.

statement.id: Di Gaul Romawi, angsa dikaitkan dengan bentuk-bentuk Mars versi Kelt, dan arkeolog menemukan angsa dikubur bersama prajurit di makam.
statement.en: In Roman Gaul the goose was associated with the Celtic forms of Mars, and archaeologists have found geese buried alongside warriors in graves.

claims.quote: The two most distinctive animal sacrifices made to Mars were the suovetaurilia, a triple offering of a pig (sus), ram (ovis) and bull (taurus), and the October Horse, the only horse sacrifice known to have been carried out in ancient Rome

statement.id: Dua kurban hewan yang paling khas bagi Mars adalah suovetaurilia, persembahan tiga hewan (babi, domba jantan, banteng), dan Kuda Oktober, satu-satunya kurban kuda yang diketahui di Roma kuno.
statement.en: The two most distinctive animal sacrifices to Mars were the suovetaurilia, a triple offering of pig, ram and bull, and the October Horse, the only horse sacrifice known in ancient Rome.

claims.quote: Cato the Elder invokes Mars Silvanus for a ritual to be carried out in silva

statement.id: Cato yang Tua memanggil Mars Silvanus untuk sebuah ritual yang dilaksanakan di silva, yaitu di hutan.
statement.en: Cato the Elder invokes Mars Silvanus for a ritual to be carried out in silva, in the woods.

claims.quote: As an agricultural guardian, Mars directs his energies toward creating conditions that allow crops to grow, which may include warding off hostile forces of nature.

statement.id: Sebagai pelindung pertanian, Mars mengarahkan tenaganya untuk menciptakan kondisi agar tanaman tumbuh, yang mungkin mencakup menangkal kekuatan alam yang bermusuhan.
statement.en: As an agricultural guardian, Mars directs his energies toward creating conditions for crops to grow, which may include warding off hostile forces of nature.

claims.quote: the god Mars is invoked by the Arval Brotherhood specifically to protect and defend the suppliants from ill.

statement.id: Mars dipanggil oleh Persaudaraan Arval khusus untuk melindungi dan membela para pemohon dari malapetaka.
statement.en: Mars is invoked by the Arval Brotherhood specifically to protect and defend the suppliants from ill.

claims.quote: Mars may have originated as a god of the wild, who dwelt beyond the boundaries set by humans.

statement.id: Mars mungkin berasal sebagai dewa alam liar yang bermukim di luar batas yang dibuat manusia.
statement.en: Mars may have originated as a god of the wild who dwelt beyond the boundaries set by humans.

claims.quote: Virility as a kind of life force (vis ) or virtue (virtus ) is an essential characteristic of Mars.

statement.id: Kejantanan sebagai semacam daya hidup (vis) atau keutamaan (virtus) merupakan ciri hakiki Mars.
statement.en: Virility as a kind of life force (vis) or virtue (virtus) is an essential characteristic of Mars.

claims.quote: By the 3rd-century CE, Mars was primarily worshipped by Roman military legions.

statement.id: Pada abad ke-3 M, Mars terutama disembah oleh legiun militer Romawi.
statement.en: By the 3rd century CE, Mars was primarily worshipped by Roman military legions.

claims.quote: According to the 4th-century author Servius the Grammarian, during wartime, a spear was shaken in the Regia and Mars was called upon to watch over the Roman people with the words

statement.id: Menurut Servius, pada masa perang sebuah tombak diguncang di Regia dan Mars dipanggil untuk menjaga rakyat Romawi dengan ucapan tertentu.
statement.en: According to Servius, in wartime a spear was shaken in the Regia and Mars was called upon to watch over the Roman people with a set formula.

claims.quote: Like Ares who was the son of Zeus and Hera, Mars is usually considered to be the son of Jupiter and Juno. In Ovid's version of Mars's origin, he was the son of Juno alone.

statement.id: Seperti Ares yang putra Zeus dan Hera, Mars biasanya dianggap putra Jupiter dan Juno; dalam versi Ovidius, ia putra Juno seorang diri.
statement.en: Like Ares, son of Zeus and Hera, Mars is usually considered the son of Jupiter and Juno; in Ovid's version he was the son of Juno alone.

claims.quote: Flora obtained a magic flower (Latin flos, plural flores, a masculine word) and tested it on a heifer who became fecund at once. Flora ritually plucked a flower, using her thumb, touched Juno's belly, and impregnated her. ... Ovid tells this story in the Fasti, his long-form poetic work on the Roman calendar.

statement.id: Dalam versi Ovidius, Flora memperoleh bunga ajaib, mengujinya pada anak sapi betina yang langsung subur, lalu menyentuh perut Juno dengan bunga itu dan membuatnya hamil.
statement.en: In Ovid's version Flora obtained a magic flower, tested it on a heifer that became fecund at once, and touched Juno's belly with it, impregnating her.

claims.quote: Ovid is the only source for the story.

statement.id: Ovidius adalah satu-satunya sumber untuk kisah itu.
statement.en: Ovid is the only source for the story.

claims.quote: The consort of Mars was Nerio or Neriene, meaning "Valor".

statement.id: Pasangan Mars adalah Nerio atau Neriene, yang berarti "Keberanian".
statement.en: The consort of Mars was Nerio or Neriene, meaning "Valor".

claims.quote: In the early 3rd century BCE, the comic playwright Plautus has a reference to Mars greeting Nerio, his wife.

statement.id: Pada awal abad ke-3 SM, penulis komedi Plautus menyinggung Mars menyapa Nerio, istrinya.
statement.en: In the early 3rd century BCE, the comic playwright Plautus refers to Mars greeting Nerio, his wife.

claims.quote: Although not originally part of the Roman tradition, in 217 BCE Venus and Mars were presented as a complementary pair in the lectisternium

statement.id: Meski semula bukan bagian tradisi Romawi, pada 217 SM Venus dan Mars ditampilkan sebagai pasangan yang saling melengkapi dalam lectisternium.
statement.en: Although not originally part of the Roman tradition, in 217 BCE Venus and Mars were presented as a complementary pair in the lectisternium.

claims.quote: The oldest recorded Latin form, Mamart-, is likely of foreign origin. It has been explained as deriving from Maris, the name of an Etruscan child-god, though this is not universally agreed upon.

statement.id: Bentuk Latin tertua yang tercatat, Mamart-, mungkin berasal dari luar; ada penjelasan yang menurunkannya dari Maris, nama dewa anak Etruria, meski tidak disepakati semua orang.
statement.en: The oldest recorded Latin form, Mamart-, is likely of foreign origin; it has been explained as deriving from Maris, an Etruscan child-god, though this is not universally agreed.

claims.quote: In older literature, the god Mars was equated with the Vedic storm deities known as the Maruts ... However, this etymology is now rejected in more modern Indo-Europeanist scholarship.

statement.id: Etimologi yang menyamakan Mars dengan Marut Weda kini ditolak dalam kajian Indo-Eropa yang lebih modern.
statement.en: The older etymology equating Mars with the Vedic Maruts is now rejected in more modern Indo-Europeanist scholarship.

claims.quote: In older literature, the god Mars was equated with the Vedic storm deities known as the Maruts

statement.id: Dalam literatur lama, Mars disamakan dengan dewa-dewa badai Weda yang disebut Marut.
statement.en: In older literature, Mars was equated with the Vedic storm deities known as the Maruts.

claims.quote: Latin adjectives from the name of Mars are ... meaning "of Mars" or "warlike" from which derive the English term "martial"

statement.id: Kata sifat Latin turunan nama Mars berarti "milik Mars" atau "suka perang", yang melahirkan kata Inggris "martial".
statement.en: Latin adjectives from the name of Mars mean "of Mars" or "warlike", from which the English term "martial" derives.

claims.quote: Within the mythological origin of Rome outlined by the 1st-century BCE poet Virgil, Mars was cast as the ancestor of Romulus and Venus as the ancestor of Aeneas

statement.id: Dalam asal-usul mitologis Roma yang diuraikan penyair Virgil abad ke-1 SM, Mars adalah leluhur Romulus dan Venus leluhur Aeneas.
statement.en: In the mythological origin of Rome outlined by the 1st-century BCE poet Virgil, Mars was cast as the ancestor of Romulus and Venus as the ancestor of Aeneas.

claims.quote: Mars is considered more level-headed than the impulsive and disruptive Ares. Mars is also a more virtuous figure to the more martial-oriented Romans.

statement.id: Mars dianggap lebih tenang daripada Ares Yunani yang impulsif dan pengacau, dan lebih berbudi luhur bagi orang Romawi yang berorientasi militer.
statement.en: Mars is considered more level-headed than the impulsive and disruptive Ares, and more virtuous to the martially minded Romans.

claims.quote: According to the story, their mother, the Vestal Virgin Rhea Silvia, was raped by Mars while she slept, and in her dreams she had a vision where she dropped a hairpin to the ground, and from which there sprang two twin trees.

statement.id: Menurut kisahnya, ibu mereka, Perawan Vesta Rhea Silvia, diperkosa Mars saat tidur, dan dalam mimpinya ia melihat jepit rambut yang dijatuhkannya menumbuhkan dua pohon kembar.
statement.en: In the story their mother, the Vestal Virgin Rhea Silvia, was raped by Mars while she slept, and in a dream she dropped a hairpin that sprang up as two twin trees.

claims.quote: However, Anna Perenna quite fancied the handsome war god for herself, and so she double-crossed Mars by disguising herself as Minerva and, wearing a veil, she tricked the god into marrying her.

statement.id: Anna Perenna menyukai sang dewa perang untuk dirinya sendiri, lalu menipu Mars dengan menyamar sebagai Minerva dan berkerudung sehingga Mars menikahinya.
statement.en: Anna Perenna fancied the war god for herself and double-crossed Mars by disguising herself as Minerva, veiled, tricking him into marrying her.

claims.quote: Another myth concerning the god of war, this one uniquely Roman, was his marriage to Anna Perenna. The story is re-told in Ovid's Fasti and begins with Mars falling in love with no less a figure than Minerva

statement.id: Mitos khas Romawi lainnya adalah pernikahan Mars dengan Anna Perenna; kisah yang diceritakan ulang dalam Fasti karya Ovidius ini bermula ketika Mars jatuh cinta kepada Minerva.
statement.en: Another uniquely Roman myth is Mars's marriage to Anna Perenna; the story, retold in Ovid's Fasti, begins with Mars falling in love with Minerva.

claims.quote: Mars again took centre stage during the Equus October, held on the 15th of that month. This was when a great horse race was held in the Campus Martius of Rome.

statement.id: Mars kembali menjadi pusat perhatian pada Equus October, 15 Oktober, ketika perlombaan kuda besar diadakan di Campus Martius, Roma.
statement.en: Mars again took centre stage at the Equus October on 15 October, when a great horse race was held in the Campus Martius of Rome.

claims.quote: Finally, there was the Armilustrium festival on the 19th of October, held on the Aventine and which involved the purification of weapons before they were stored away for the winter.

statement.id: Terakhir ada festival Armilustrium pada 19 Oktober di Aventine, berupa penyucian senjata sebelum disimpan selama musim dingin.
statement.en: Finally the Armilustrium festival on 19 October, held on the Aventine, involved the purification of weapons before they were stored away for the winter.

claims.quote: The Tubilustrium involved a series of rites to cleanse and favour trumpets, whilst the Equirria was to ensure all would be well with the horses when on campaign.

statement.id: Tubilustrium berupa rangkaian ritus membersihkan dan memberkati terompet, sedangkan Equirria memastikan kuda-kuda baik-baik saja saat berkampanye.
statement.en: The Tubilustrium involved rites to cleanse and favour trumpets, while the Equirria ensured all would be well with the horses on campaign.

claims.quote: Another important ritual was performed by the commander of the army about to depart who shook the sacred spears of the god which were kept in the Regia.

statement.id: Ritus penting lain dilakukan panglima pasukan yang hendak berangkat dengan mengguncang tombak suci sang dewa yang disimpan di Regia.
statement.en: Another important ritual was performed by the commander of the departing army, who shook the god's sacred spears kept in the Regia.

claims.quote: On the 1st, 9th and 23rd of March, the priests of this sacred trio, the Salii, sang hymns and dressed themselves in bronze-age armour which included the ancient ancilia figure-of-eight shields.

statement.id: Pada 1, 9, dan 23 Maret, para imam Salii menyanyikan himne dan mengenakan baju zirah zaman perunggu termasuk perisai ancilia berbentuk angka delapan.
statement.en: On 1, 9 and 23 March the priests called the Salii sang hymns and dressed in bronze-age armour including the ancient figure-of-eight ancilia shields.

claims.quote: he was also involved with ceremonies relating to the ancient triad of gods which included himself, Jupiter, and Quirinus.

statement.id: Mars juga terlibat dalam upacara untuk triad dewa kuno yang terdiri dari dirinya, Jupiter, dan Quirinus.
statement.en: Mars was also involved in ceremonies for the ancient triad of gods that included himself, Jupiter and Quirinus.

claims.quote: were held in honour of the god in March and October and carried out by Mars' specially dedicated priests, the flamen Martialis.

statement.id: Upacara itu dilaksanakan oleh imam khusus Mars, flamen Martialis.
statement.en: The ceremonies were carried out by Mars' specially dedicated priests, the flamen Martialis.

claims.quote: The Vestal was forcibly violated and gave birth to twins. She named Mars as their father, either because she really believed it, or because the fault might appear less heinous if a deity were the cause of it.

statement.id: Dalam Livy, Perawan Vesta itu dinodai dengan paksa dan melahirkan anak kembar; ia menyebut Mars sebagai ayah mereka, entah karena sungguh percaya atau agar kesalahannya tampak lebih ringan jika seorang dewa penyebabnya.
statement.en: In Livy the Vestal was forcibly violated and gave birth to twins; she named Mars as their father, either because she believed it or because the fault might seem less heinous if a deity were the cause.

claims.quote: a thirsty she-wolf from the surrounding hills, attracted by the crying of the children, came to them, gave them her teats to suck and was so gentle towards them that the king's flock-master found her licking the boys with her tongue.

statement.id: Dalam Livy, seekor serigala betina yang haus dari bukit sekitar datang karena tangisan anak-anak itu, menyusui mereka, dan begitu lembut hingga gembala raja mendapatinya menjilati anak-anak itu.
statement.en: In Livy a thirsty she-wolf from the surrounding hills, drawn by the children's crying, came and suckled them and was so gentle that the king's flock-master found her licking the boys.

summary.id: Biasanya dianggap putra Jupiter dan Juno.
summary.en: Usually considered the son of Jupiter and Juno.

summary.id: Dalam versi Ovidius, ia putra Juno seorang diri; Ovidius satu-satunya sumber.
summary.en: In Ovid's version he is the son of Juno alone; Ovid is the only source.

topic.en: The father of Romulus and Remus

summary.id: Satu sumber: Mars dianggap ayah mereka dan memperkosa Rhea Silvia.
summary.en: One source: Mars was considered their father and raped Rhea Silvia.

summary.en: Livy: the Vestal named Mars as father, either from belief or to make the fault seem lighter.

summary.id: Satu sumber: Mars adalah pelindung pertanian yang menciptakan kondisi tanaman tumbuh.
summary.en: One source: Mars is an agricultural guardian creating conditions for crops to grow.

summary.id: Sumber lain: hakikat peran Mars di bidang ini diperdebatkan para sarjana.
summary.en: Another source: the nature of Mars's role in this area is disputed by scholars.

summary.id: Literatur lama menyamakan Mars dengan Marut Weda, tetapi etimologi itu kini ditolak.
summary.en: Older literature equated Mars with the Vedic Maruts, but this etymology is now rejected.

short_description.id: Herakles adalah pahlawan mitologi Yunani yang termasyhur karena kekuatannya, dua belas tugasnya, dan kenaikannya menjadi dewa.
short_description.en: Heracles is a Greek mythic hero famed for his strength, his twelve labors, and his rise to godhood.

long_description.id: Herakles adalah pahlawan mitologi Yunani yang terkenal karena kekuatan dan daya tahannya. Menurut mitos, Zeus adalah ayahnya dan Alkmene ibunya. Hera, yang cemburu, mengirim dua ular kepada Herakles bayi, tetapi bayi itu mencekik keduanya.
long_description.en: Heracles is a Greek mythic hero famed for strength and endurance. In myth, Zeus is his father and Alkmene his mother. Hera, who was jealous, sent two snakes to the infant Heracles, but the baby strangled them.

long_description.id: Hera juga membuat Herakles gila hingga ia membunuh istri dan anak-anaknya. Peramal Delphi lalu memerintahkannya menjalani dua belas tugas untuk Eurystheus. Dalam tugas-tugas itu ia mencekik Singa Nemea dan mengenakan kulitnya, membunuh Hydra dengan bantuan Iolaos, dan membawa Kerberos dari dunia bawah tanpa senjata. Diodorus mencatat janji keabadian setelah tugas-tugas itu selesai.
long_description.en: Hera also drove Heracles insane so that he killed his wife and children. The Delphic Oracle then ordered him to perform twelve labors for Eurystheus. In them he strangled the Nemean Lion and wore its pelt, killed the Hydra with the help of Iolaos, and brought Kerberos from the underworld without weapons. Diodorus records a promise of immortality once the labors were done.

long_description.id: Di luar kedua belas tugas itu, Herakles membebaskan Prometheus dengan menembak jatuh elang yang menyiksanya. Ia juga mengalahkan raksasa Antaeus dan Thanatos, dewa kematian, dalam adu gulat. Menurut Apollodorus, ia menerima pedang dari Hermes, busur dan anak panah dari Apollo, baju zirah emas dari Hephaestus, dan jubah dari Athena, sedangkan gadanya ia potong sendiri di Nemea.
long_description.en: Beyond the twelve labors, Heracles freed Prometheus by shooting down the eagle that tormented him. He also defeated the giant Antaeus and Thanatos, the god of death, in wrestling. According to Apollodorus, he received a sword from Hermes, a bow and arrows from Apollo, a golden breastplate from Hephaestus, and a robe from Athena, while he cut his club himself at Nemea.

long_description.id: Kisah hidupnya berakhir ketika jubah berlumur darah Nessos, yang dikirim Deianeira, membakar kulitnya. Athena kemudian membawanya dari api ke Gunung Olympus, tempat ia menikahi Hebe dan diizinkan tinggal bersama para dewa. Herakles dipuja sebagai dewa di Yunani pada zaman klasik, dan ia dianggap sekaligus pahlawan dan dewa.
long_description.en: His life ends when the cloak stained with the blood of Nessos, sent by Deianeira, burns his skin. Athena then takes him from the flames to Mount Olympus, where he marries Hebe and is allowed to live with the gods. Heracles was worshipped as a god in classical Greece, and he was thought to be both a hero and a god.

cultural_context.id: Dalam masyarakat Yunani kuno, Herakles dipuja sebagai dewa pada zaman klasik dan sebagai pelindung kaum muda dan gimnasium. Pada sebagian festival, ia lebih dulu menerima persembahan sebagai pahlawan, kemudian sebagai dewa.
cultural_context.en: In ancient Greek society Heracles was worshipped as a god in the classical age and as a patron of young men and gymnasia. Some festivals honoured him with offerings, first in his heroic role and afterwards in his divine one.
