claims.quote: Hercules (Herakles) was a hero of Greek mythology famous for his great strength and endurance.

statement.id: Herakles adalah pahlawan mitologi Yunani yang terkenal karena kekuatan dan daya tahannya.
statement.en: Heracles is a Greek mythic hero renowned for strength and endurance.

claims.quote: In mythology, though, it was Zeus who lay with Alkmene and so fathered Hercules, explaining the origin of Hercules' great strength.

statement.id: Zeus disebut sebagai ayah Herakles dan Alkmene sebagai ibunya.
statement.en: Zeus is named as Heracles's father and Alkmene as his mother.

claims.quote: Hera also sent two snakes to kill the new-born Hercules, but the baby easily strangled them.

statement.id: Hera mengirim dua ular kepada Herakles bayi, tetapi ia mencekiknya.
statement.en: Hera sent two snakes to the infant Heracles, who strangled them.

claims.quote: Heracles was commanded by the Delphic Oracle to perform twelve labors for King Eurystheus of Mycenae.

statement.id: Peramal Delphi memerintahkannya menjalani dua belas tugas untuk Raja Eurystheus.
statement.en: The Delphic Oracle ordered Heracles to perform twelve labors for Eurystheus.

claims.quote: Heracles journeyed to Delphi, and on inquiring of the god regarding the matter he received a reply which stated that the gods had decided that he should perform twelve Labours at the command of Eurystheus and that upon their conclusion he should receive the gift of immortality.

statement.id: Menurut Diodorus, Herakles menjalani dua belas tugas atas perintah Eurystheus dan dijanjikan keabadian setelah selesai.
statement.en: Diodorus says Heracles was commanded to complete twelve labors and promised immortality afterward.

claims.quote: Hercules strangled the lion with his bare hands and forever after wore its pelt as a protective cloak.

statement.id: Herakles mencekik Singa Nemea dan mengenakan kulitnya.
statement.en: Heracles strangled the Nemean Lion and wore its pelt.

claims.quote: Heracles was worshipped throughout Greece in the classical age as a god.

statement.id: Herakles juga dipuja sebagai dewa di Yunani pada zaman klasik.
statement.en: Heracles was worshipped as a god throughout classical Greece.

claims.quote: Hera once more interfered and drove Hercules insane so that he killed his wife and children.

statement.id: Hera membuat Herakles gila sehingga ia membunuh istri dan anak-anaknya.
statement.en: Hera drove Heracles insane so that he killed his wife and children.

claims.quote: Helped by his faithful companion and nephew Iolaos, who used fire to stop the heads re-growing, Hercules eventually killed the Hydra and dipped his arrows in its poisonous blood.

statement.id: Dibantu keponakannya Iolaos yang memakai api agar kepala Hydra tidak tumbuh lagi, Herakles membunuh Hydra dan mencelupkan anak panahnya ke darah beracunnya.
statement.en: With the help of his nephew Iolaos, who used fire to stop the heads regrowing, Heracles killed the Hydra and dipped his arrows in its poisonous blood.

claims.quote: On his journey in Hades, the hero encounters many souls and persuades the god Hades to allow him to take Kerberos provided he does so without weapons.

statement.id: Dalam perjalanannya ke Hades, Herakles membujuk dewa Hades agar mengizinkannya membawa Kerberos asalkan tanpa senjata.
statement.en: On his journey in Hades, Heracles persuades the god Hades to let him take Kerberos provided he does so without weapons.

claims.quote: Hercules shot down the eagle with one of his arrows and freed Prometheus

statement.id: Herakles menembak jatuh elang itu dengan anak panah dan membebaskan Prometheus.
statement.en: Heracles shot down the eagle with one of his arrows and freed Prometheus.

claims.quote: Immortality was assured, though, when Athena descended in her chariot and took Hercules from the flames to Mount Olympus where he married the goddess Hebe, was given the gift of eternal youth, and permitted to reside with the gods for all time.

statement.id: Athena membawa Herakles dari api ke Gunung Olympus, tempat ia menikahi dewi Hebe, diberi masa muda abadi, dan diizinkan tinggal bersama para dewa selamanya.
statement.en: Athena took Heracles from the flames to Mount Olympus, where he married the goddess Hebe, received eternal youth, and was allowed to live with the gods forever.

claims.quote: In ancient Greek Archaic and Classical pottery art Hercules is often depicted carrying a knotted club, a quiver full of arrows, and wearing a lion's pelt with sometimes also a lion's head helmet.

statement.id: Dalam seni tembikar Yunani Arkais dan Klasik, Herakles sering digambarkan membawa gada berbuku, wadah anak panah, dan mengenakan kulit singa, kadang dengan helm berkepala singa.
statement.en: In Archaic and Classical Greek pottery, Heracles is often shown carrying a knotted club and a quiver of arrows and wearing a lion pelt, sometimes with a lion-head helmet.

claims.quote: It was on his journey to this island in the western ocean that he set markers in the Strait of Gades which thereafter became known as the Pillars of Hercules.

statement.id: Dalam perjalanannya ke pulau di samudra barat itu, ia memasang penanda di Selat Gades yang kemudian dikenal sebagai Tiang-tiang Herkules.
statement.en: On his journey to that island in the western ocean, he set markers in the Strait of Gades that became known as the Pillars of Hercules.

claims.quote: Hercules received a sword from Hermes, a bow and arrows from Apollo ... a golden breastplate from Hephaestus, and a robe from Athena; for he had himself cut a club at Nemea.

statement.id: Menurut Apollodorus, Herakles menerima pedang dari Hermes, busur dan anak panah dari Apollo, baju zirah emas dari Hephaestus, dan jubah dari Athena; gadanya ia potong sendiri di Nemea.
statement.en: According to Apollodorus, Heracles received a sword from Hermes, a bow and arrows from Apollo, a golden breastplate from Hephaestus, and a robe from Athena; he had cut his club himself at Nemea.

claims.quote: A Libyan giant who drew his strength directly from the earth. He challenged Heracles to a wrestling death match but was defeated when the hero lifted him from the earth and crushed him.
claims.locator: A Selection of Characters & Creatures: Antaeus

statement.id: Antaeus, raksasa Libya yang menarik kekuatan dari bumi, mengajak Herakles bergulat sampai mati, tetapi kalah ketika Herakles mengangkatnya dari tanah dan meremukkannya.
statement.en: Antaeus, a Libyan giant who drew strength from the earth, challenged Heracles to a deadly wrestling match but was defeated when Heracles lifted him from the earth and crushed him.

claims.quote: The god of death. Heracles defeated him in a wrestling match when he came to fetch Alcestis to the Underworld.
claims.locator: A Selection of Characters & Creatures: Thanatus

statement.id: Herakles mengalahkan Thanatos, dewa kematian, dalam adu gulat ketika Thanatos datang menjemput Alcestis ke dunia bawah.
statement.en: Heracles defeated Thanatos, the god of death, in a wrestling match when he came to fetch Alcestis to the Underworld.

claims.quote: Ancient Greek: Ἡρακλῆς, lit. 'glory/fame of Hera'

statement.id: Nama Yunani Ἡρακλῆς secara harfiah berarti "kemuliaan/ketenaran Hera".
statement.en: The Greek name Ἡρακλῆς literally means "glory/fame of Hera".

claims.quote: He was thought to be both a hero and a god, possessing superhuman strength. No tomb was ever identified as his, and at some festivals sacrifice was offered to him first as a hero and then as a god.

statement.id: Herakles dianggap sekaligus pahlawan dan dewa, memiliki kekuatan manusia super; tidak ada makam yang pernah dipastikan sebagai miliknya, dan pada sebagian festival kurban dipersembahkan kepadanya lebih dulu sebagai pahlawan lalu sebagai dewa.
statement.en: Heracles was thought to be both hero and god, possessing superhuman strength; no tomb was ever identified as his, and at some festivals sacrifice was offered to him first as a hero and then as a god.

claims.quote: Deianeira decided to use the blood of Nessos, covered a cloak in it and gave it to a messenger to take to Hercules. The hero wore it but the impregnated cloak caused his skin to burn terribly.

statement.id: Deianeira melumuri jubah dengan darah Nessos dan mengirimkannya kepada Herakles; ketika dipakai, jubah itu membuat kulitnya terbakar hebat.
statement.en: Deianeira smeared a cloak with the blood of Nessos and sent it to Heracles; when he wore it, the cloak burned his skin terribly.

claims.quote: The earliest complete depiction of Hercules' twelve labours in ancient sculpture is from the metopes of the Temple of Zeus at Olympia (completed in 457 BCE).

statement.id: Penggambaran lengkap tertua kedua belas tugas Herakles dalam seni pahat kuno ada pada metope Kuil Zeus di Olimpia (selesai 457 SM).
statement.en: The earliest complete depiction of Heracles's twelve labours in ancient sculpture is on the metopes of the Temple of Zeus at Olympia (completed 457 BCE).

claims.quote: He was widely worshipped as a patron of young men and gymnasia.

statement.id: Herakles dipuja luas sebagai pelindung kaum muda dan gimnasium.
statement.en: Heracles was widely worshipped as a patron of young men and gymnasia.

claims.quote: CERBERUS (Kerberos) The hound of Hades who guarded the entrance to the underworld. Heracles was sent to fetch the beast as one of his twelve labours, and captured it with the approval of the goddess Persephone.
claims.locator: A Selection of Characters & Creatures: Cerberus

statement.id: Kerberos, anjing Hades penjaga pintu masuk dunia bawah; Herakles diutus membawanya sebagai salah satu dari dua belas tugasnya dan menangkapnya dengan persetujuan dewi Persephone.
statement.en: Cerberus, the hound of Hades who guarded the entrance to the underworld; Heracles was sent to fetch him as one of his twelve labours and captured him with the approval of the goddess Persephone.

short_description.id: Hermes adalah dewa Olimpus dalam mitologi Yunani, juru warta para dewa, pelindung pelancong dan pedagang, serta penuntun jiwa ke alam kematian.
short_description.en: Hermes is an Olympian god of Greek myth, herald of the gods, protector of travelers and merchants, and guide of souls to the afterlife.

long_description.id: Hermes adalah dewa Olimpus dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno, dikenal sebagai juru warta dan pembawa pesan para dewa. Ia dipandang pula sebagai pelindung juru warta, pelancong, pencuri, pedagang, dan orator, serta penuntun jiwa menuju alam kematian. Theoi mengaitkannya dengan kawanan ternak, jalan, perdagangan, dan diplomasi. Orang Yunani percaya ia putra Zeus dan nimfa Maia yang lahir di Gunung Cyllene di Arkadia, dan bangsa Romawi mengenalnya sebagai Mercury.
long_description.en: Hermes is an Olympian deity in ancient Greek religion and myth, known as the herald and messenger of the gods. He is also regarded as protector of heralds, travelers, thieves, merchants, and orators, and as a guide of souls into the afterlife. Theoi links him with herds, roads, trade, and diplomacy. The Greeks believed him the son of Zeus and the nymph Maia, born on Mt. Cyllene in Arcadia, and the Romans knew him as Mercury.

long_description.id: Sebagai bayi, Hermes mencuri ternak Apollo dan membuat lira dari tempurung kura-kura. Setelah sidang di hadapan Zeus dan para dewa, ia boleh menyimpan ternak itu dengan memberikan lira kepada Apollo, dan Zeus yang terhibur memberinya tempat di antara dua belas dewa Olimpus. Ia dikreditkan menciptakan lira, alfabet, dan dadu serta menjadi pelindung gembala, dan Apollo memberinya tongkat gembala emas sementara Zeus menjadikannya juru warta. Ia juga dikenal sebagai penipu cerdik yang mencuri trisula Poseidon, panah Artemis, dan ikat pinggang Aphrodite.
long_description.en: As a baby, Hermes stole Apollo's cattle and made a lyre from a tortoise-shell. After a hearing before Zeus and the gods he was allowed to keep the cattle by giving Apollo the lyre, and an amused Zeus gave him a place among the twelve Olympian gods. He is credited with inventing the lyre, the alphabet, and dice and is patron of shepherds, and Apollo gave him a golden shepherd's staff while Zeus made him his herald. He is also known as a trickster who stole Poseidon's trident, Artemis' arrows, and Aphrodite's girdle.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah-kisah pahlawan, Hermes membunuh monster Argos atas perintah Zeus untuk membebaskan Io, memberi Perseus pedang adamantin dan menuntunnya kepada para Graiai, serta memberi Odiseus penawar mantra Kirke. Ia juga menuntun jiwa ke Sungai Styx, tempat Charon membawa mereka ke Hades. Himne Homerik 4 menyebutnya satu-satunya utusan yang ditunjuk ke Hades.
long_description.en: In hero stories Hermes kills the monster Argos on Zeus's orders to free Io, gives Perseus an adamantine sword and guides him to the Graeae, and gives Odysseus an antidote to Circe's spells. He also leads souls to the river Styx, where Charon takes them to Hades. Homeric Hymn 4 calls him the only appointed messenger to Hades.

long_description.id: Dalam seni Yunani Arkais dan Klasik, Hermes digambarkan membawa tongkat kerykeion atau kaduseus, bersandal bersayap, dan kadang bertopi bersayap atau membawa lira. Atribut khasnya adalah tongkat juru warta, dan hewan sucinya adalah domba jantan dan kelinci. Tugu batu hermai dipasang di tepi jalan sebagai penunjuk bagi pelancong, dan kurban baginya berupa kemenyan, madu, kue, babi, serta terutama domba dan anak kambing.
long_description.en: In Archaic and Classical Greek art Hermes is shown with the kerykeion or caduceus staff, winged sandals, and sometimes a winged cap or a lyre. His most distinctive attribute is the herald's wand, and his sacred animals are the ram and the hare. Stone hermae were set up along roads as guides for travellers, and offerings to him included incense, honey, cakes, pigs, and especially lambs and young goats.

long_description.id: Pemujaan Hermes sudah tercatat dalam lempeng Linear B Mykenai, dan Athena memiliki salah satu pemujaan tertuanya dengan festival Hermaia. Pada periode Helenistik ia sering dikaitkan dengan gimnasium. Nama Hermes sejak lama dikaitkan dengan kata herma, tetapi hal itu diperdebatkan, dan satu teori menyebut Hermes berasal dari bentuk dewa Pan.
long_description.en: Hermes already appears in Mycenaean Linear B tablets, and Athens had one of his oldest cults with the Hermaia festival. In the Hellenistic period he was often associated with gymnasia. His name has long been linked to the word herma, though this is disputed, and one theory holds that Hermes originated as a form of the god Pan.

cultural_context.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam perannya sebagai pemandu antara alam dewa dan manusia Hermes menjadi lambang penyeberangan batas; para orator dan juru bahasa pun menganggapnya pelindung mereka.
cultural_context.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in his role as a guide between the realms of gods and humanity Hermes came to symbolise the crossing of boundaries, and orators and interpreters regarded him as their patron.

literal_meaning.id: Nama itu sejak lama diturunkan dari herma ('timbunan batu'), tetapi dugaan ini diperdebatkan.
literal_meaning.en: The name has long been derived from herma ('stone heap, cairn'), but this is disputed.

who.id: Dewa Olimpus, juru warta para dewa.
who.en: An Olympian god, herald of the gods.

origin.id: Agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno; lahir di Gunung Cyllene di Arkadia menurut tradisi Yunani.
origin.en: Ancient Greek religion and mythology; born on Mt. Cyllene in Arcadia according to Greek tradition.

role.id: Penuntun jiwa menuju alam kematian dan pemandu antara alam dewa dan manusia.
role.en: Guide of souls to the afterlife and of travel between the realms of gods and humanity.

famous_for.id: Mencuri ternak Apollo saat masih bayi dan menciptakan lira.
famous_for.en: Stealing Apollo's cattle as a baby and creating the lyre.

did_you_know.id: Kata hermeneutika, yaitu kajian dan penafsiran teks, membawa nama Hermes.
did_you_know.en: The word hermeneutics, the study and interpretation of texts, carries Hermes's name.

description.id: Ia menuntun jiwa ke Sungai Styx, tempat Charon membawa mereka ke Hades.
description.en: He leads souls to the river Styx, where Charon takes them to Hades.

description.id: Menurut satu sumber, puisi Homerik menyebut tongkatnya sebagai tongkat ajaib yang dapat menutup dan membuka mata manusia.
description.en: According to one source, the Homeric poems mention his staff as a magic staff that closes and opens the eyes of mortals.

description.id: Ia digambarkan berkuasa mengirim tidur yang menyegarkan atau mencabutnya.
description.en: He is described as having the power to send refreshing sleep or take it away.

description.id: Ia mencuri ternak Apollo saat bayi serta trisula Poseidon, panah Artemis, dan ikat pinggang Aphrodite.
description.en: He stole Apollo's cattle as a baby, and Poseidon's trident, Artemis' arrows, and Aphrodite's girdle.

summary.en: As a baby Hermes steals Apollo's 50 sacred cattle and disguises their tracks. After a hearing before Zeus he may keep them if he gives Apollo the lyre.

role.id: Dewa yang menghukum penyingkap pencurian.
role.en: The god who punishes the informer.

summary.id: Hermes mengubah gembala Battos menjadi batu karena melaporkan pencurian ternak Apollon.
summary.en: Hermes turns the herdsman Battos into stone for reporting the theft of Apollon's cattle.

role.id: Pembunuh monster atas perintah Zeus.
role.en: Slayer of the monster on Zeus's orders.

summary.en: On Zeus's orders Hermes kills the many-eyed monster Argos to free Io.

role.id: Penolong dan pemandu pahlawan.

summary.id: Hermes memberi Perseus pedang atau sabit adamantin dan menuntunnya ke tiga Graiai yang akan menunjukkan lokasi Medusa.

role.id: Penolong Odiseus dalam perjalanan pulang.

summary.id: Dalam Odyssey Hermes menolong Odiseus, antara lain dengan memberinya penawar mantra Kirke.
summary.en: In the Odyssey Hermes helps Odysseus, among other things by giving him an antidote to Circe's spells.

role.id: Pembebas dewa yang dikurung.
role.en: Liberator of the imprisoned god.

summary.id: Hermes membebaskan Ares dari penahanan setahun dalam kuali oleh raksasa kembar Otus dan Ephialtes.
summary.en: Hermes rescues Ares after the twin Giants Otus and Ephialtes kept him locked in a cauldron for a year.

description.en: Where Praxiteles's statue of Hermes once stood in the temple of Hera and now resides in the site's archaeological museum.

claims.quote: is an Olympian deity in ancient Greek religion and mythology considered the herald of the gods. He is also widely considered the protector of human heralds, travelers, thieves, merchants, and orators.

statement.id: Hermes adalah dewa Olimpus Yunani, pembawa pesan dewa dan pelindung pelancong serta pedagang.
statement.en: Hermes is a Greek Olympian herald of the gods and protector of travelers and merchants.

claims.quote: Hermes plays the role of the psychopomp or "soul guide"—a conductor of souls into the afterlife.

statement.id: Hermes berperan sebagai pembimbing jiwa menuju alam kematian.
statement.en: Hermes serves as a guide of souls to the afterlife.

claims.quote: HERMES was the Olympian god of herds and flocks, travellers and hospitality, roads and trade, thievery and cunning, heralds and diplomacy, language and writing, athletic contests and gymnasiums, astronomy and astrology.

statement.id: Theoi menyebut Hermes dewa ternak, pelancong, jalan, perdagangan, kecerdikan, pembawa pesan, dan diplomasi.
statement.en: Theoi identifies Hermes with flocks, travelers, roads, trade, cunning, heralds, and diplomacy.

claims.quote: Hermes was depicted as either a handsome and athletic, beardless youth or as an older, bearded man, with winged boots and a herald's wand.

statement.id: Hermes digambarkan sebagai pemuda tanpa janggut atau pria tua berjanggut dengan sepatu bersayap dan tongkat pembawa pesan.
statement.en: Hermes is shown as a beardless youth or older bearded man with winged boots and a herald's wand.

claims.quote: One of the cleverest and most mischievous of the 12 Olympian gods, Hermes was their herald and messenger.

statement.id: World History Encyclopedia menyebut Hermes pembawa pesan dewa-dewa Olimpus.
statement.en: World History Encyclopedia calls Hermes the Olympian gods' herald and messenger.

claims.quote: To the Romans, the god was known as Mercury.

statement.id: Bangsa Romawi mengenal Hermes sebagai Mercury.
statement.en: Romans knew Hermes as Mercury.

claims.quote: In that position, he came to symbolise the crossing of boundaries in his role as a guide between the two realms of gods and humanity.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam kedudukannya sebagai utusan, Hermes menjadi lambang penyeberangan batas sebagai pemandu antara dua alam, dewa dan manusia.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in his position as herald he came to symbolise the crossing of boundaries as a guide between the realms of gods and humanity.

claims.quote: He invented the lyre, the alphabet, and dice. The latter explains why the god was beloved by gamblers.

statement.id: Hermes dikisahkan menciptakan lira, alfabet, dan dadu; yang terakhir menjelaskan mengapa para penjudi memujanya.
statement.en: Hermes is said to have invented the lyre, the alphabet, and dice; the latter explains why gamblers loved him.

claims.quote: Hermes was the patron of shepherds and invented the panpipes they used to call their flock.

statement.id: Hermes adalah pelindung para gembala dan menciptakan seruling pan yang mereka pakai untuk memanggil kawanan.
statement.en: Hermes was the patron of shepherds and invented the panpipes they used to call their flock.

claims.quote: With origins, then, as an Arcadian fertility god who had a special love for the Peloponnese, the ancient Greeks believed Hermes was the son of Zeus and the nymph Maia (daughter of the Titan Atlas) and that he was born on Mt. Cyllene in Arcadia.

statement.id: Dengan asal-usul sebagai dewa kesuburan Arkadia yang sangat mencintai Peloponnesos, orang Yunani kuno percaya Hermes putra Zeus dan nimfa Maia (putri Titan Atlas) dan lahir di Gunung Cyllene di Arkadia.
statement.en: With origins as an Arcadian fertility god with a special love for the Peloponnese, the ancient Greeks believed Hermes was the son of Zeus and the nymph Maia (daughter of the Titan Atlas) and was born on Mt. Cyllene in Arcadia.

claims.quote: While still a baby, he stole his half-brother Apollo's herd of 50 sacred cattle from Pieria, cleverly reversing their hoofmarks by adding bark shoes to make it difficult to follow their tracks.

statement.id: Ketika masih bayi, Hermes mencuri kawanan 50 ternak suci milik saudara tirinya, Apollo, dari Pieria, dengan cerdik membalik jejak kuku dengan menambahkan sepatu kulit kayu agar sulit dilacak.
statement.en: While still a baby, Hermes stole his half-brother Apollo's herd of 50 sacred cattle from Pieria, cleverly reversing their hoofmarks with bark shoes to make them hard to track.

claims.quote: After a hearing before Zeus and the Olympian gods, Hermes was permitted to hold on to the herd (now down to 48 as he had already sacrificed two of them) if he gave Apollo his lyre.

statement.id: Setelah sidang di hadapan Zeus dan para dewa Olimpus, Hermes boleh menyimpan kawanan ternak (kini tinggal 48 karena dua telah ia korbankan) dengan syarat memberikan lira kepada Apollo.
statement.en: After a hearing before Zeus and the Olympian gods, Hermes was permitted to keep the herd (now 48, since he had sacrificed two) if he gave Apollo his lyre.

claims.quote: Perhaps most celebrated was his killing of the many-eyed (some accounts say 100-eyed) monster Argos on the orders of Zeus in order to free Io.

statement.id: Yang mungkin paling termasyhur adalah pembunuhan monster bermata banyak (sebagian kisah menyebut 100 mata), Argos, atas perintah Zeus untuk membebaskan Io.
statement.en: Perhaps most celebrated was his killing of the many-eyed (some accounts say 100-eyed) monster Argos on Zeus's orders to free Io.

claims.quote: One of his most famous regular roles was as a leader of souls to the river Styx in the underworld, where the boatman Charon would take them to Hades.

statement.id: Salah satu peran rutinnya yang termasyhur adalah menuntun jiwa ke Sungai Styx di dunia bawah, tempat juru perahu Charon membawa mereka ke Hades.
statement.en: One of his most famous regular roles was leading souls to the river Styx in the underworld, where the boatman Charon would take them to Hades.

claims.quote: Another hero helped by the god was Perseus, Hermes giving him an unbreakable sword or sickle (harpe) of adamantine and guiding him to the three Graeae who would reveal the location of Medusa.

statement.id: Pahlawan lain yang dibantu Hermes adalah Perseus: Hermes memberinya pedang atau sabit (harpe) adamantin yang tak patah dan menuntunnya ke tiga Graiai yang akan menunjukkan lokasi Medusa.
statement.en: Another hero helped by Hermes was Perseus: Hermes gave him an unbreakable sword or sickle (harpe) of adamantine and guided him to the three Graeae who would reveal Medusa's location.

claims.quote: Hermes gives particular help to Odysseus, especially on his long return voyage to Ithaca (as told in Homer's Odyssey), for example, giving him an antidote to the spells of Circe.

statement.id: Hermes membantu Odiseus secara khusus, terutama pada pelayaran pulangnya yang panjang ke Ithaka (dalam Odyssey karya Homeros), misalnya dengan memberinya penawar mantra Kirke.
statement.en: Hermes gives particular help to Odysseus, especially on his long voyage home to Ithaca (as told in Homer's Odyssey), for example by giving him an antidote to Circe's spells.

claims.quote: He was the patron of travellers, and stone pillars (hermae) with a phallus symbol were often to be seen set up along roadsides to act as guides and offer good fortune to those who passed.

statement.id: Hermes adalah pelindung para pelancong, dan tugu batu (hermai) dengan lambang falus sering dipasang di tepi jalan sebagai penunjuk dan pembawa keberuntungan bagi yang lewat.
statement.en: Hermes was the patron of travellers, and stone pillars (hermae) with a phallus symbol were often set up along roadsides as guides and to offer good fortune to passers-by.

claims.quote: In ancient Greek Archaic and Classical art, Hermes is depicted holding the kerykeion or caduceus staff (signifying his role as a herald, the stick is either cleft or with an open figure of 8 at the top), wearing winged sandals (symbolic of his role as a messenger), a long tunic or leopard skin, sometimes also a winged cap (petasos), and occasionally with a lyre.
claims.locator: How is Hermes Represented in Art?

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani Arkais dan Klasik, Hermes digambarkan memegang tongkat kerykeion atau kaduseus (tanda perannya sebagai juru warta), bersandal bersayap (lambang perannya sebagai utusan), berjubah panjang atau kulit macan tutul, kadang bertopi bersayap (petasos), dan sesekali membawa lira.
statement.en: In Archaic and Classical Greek art Hermes is shown holding the kerykeion or caduceus staff (signifying his role as herald), wearing winged sandals (symbolic of his role as messenger), a long tunic or leopard skin, sometimes a winged cap (petasos), and occasionally a lyre.

claims.quote: Hermes has a very long history, being mentioned in the Linear B tablets of the Mycenaean civilization, at its height from the 15th to 13th century BCE.

statement.id: Hermes memiliki sejarah yang sangat panjang: ia disebut dalam lempeng Linear B peradaban Mykenai, yang mencapai puncaknya dari abad ke-15 hingga ke-13 SM.
statement.en: Hermes has a very long history, being mentioned in the Linear B tablets of the Mycenaean civilization, at its height from the 15th to 13th century BCE.

claims.quote: Orators regarded the god who transferred words from sender to receiver as their patron, as did interpreters (another group of boundary-crossers) and, even today, the study and interpretation of texts carries his name: hermeneutics.

statement.id: Para orator menganggap dewa yang memindahkan kata dari pengirim ke penerima sebagai pelindung mereka, begitu pula para juru bahasa; hingga kini kajian dan penafsiran teks memakai namanya: hermeneutika.
statement.en: Orators regarded the god who transferred words from sender to receiver as their patron, as did interpreters, and even today the study and interpretation of texts carries his name: hermeneutics.

claims.quote: Hermes was also known as something of a trickster, stealing at one time or another Poseidon's trident, Artemis' arrows, and Aphrodite's girdle.

statement.id: Hermes juga dikenal agak sebagai penipu cerdik, yang pada suatu waktu mencuri trisula Poseidon, panah Artemis, dan ikat pinggang Aphrodite.
statement.en: Hermes was also known as something of a trickster, at one time or another stealing Poseidon's trident, Artemis' arrows, and Aphrodite's girdle.

claims.quote: Athens had one of the oldest cults to the god where the Hermaia festival for young boys was held annually.

statement.id: Athena memiliki salah satu pemujaan tertua bagi Hermes, tempat festival Hermaia untuk anak laki-laki diadakan setiap tahun.
statement.en: Athens had one of the oldest cults of the god, where the Hermaia festival for young boys was held annually.

claims.quote: Hermes also freed Ares from his year-long imprisonment in a cauldron by the twin Giants Otus and Ephialtes.

statement.id: Hermes juga membebaskan Ares dari penahanan setahun dalam kuali oleh raksasa kembar Otus dan Ephialtes.
statement.en: Hermes also freed Ares from his year-long imprisonment in a cauldron by the twin Giants Otus and Ephialtes.

claims.quote: As a new-born infant Hermes snuck out of his crib, stole the cattle of the god Apollon, and crafted the first lyre from a tortoise-shell. Zeus was so amused by the young god's antics that he granted him a place as one of the twelve supreme gods of Olympos.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, sebagai bayi baru lahir Hermes menyelinap keluar dari buaian, mencuri ternak Apollon, dan membuat lira pertama dari tempurung kura-kura; Zeus begitu terhibur sehingga memberinya tempat sebagai satu dari dua belas dewa agung Olimpos.
statement.en: According to Theoi, as a newborn Hermes snuck out of his crib, stole Apollon's cattle, and crafted the first lyre from a tortoise-shell; Zeus was so amused that he granted him a place among the twelve supreme gods of Olympos.

claims.quote: Hermes transformed the tell-tale, herdsman Battos into a stone as punishment for reporting his theft of Apollon's cattle.

statement.id: Hermes mengubah gembala pembocor, Battos, menjadi batu sebagai hukuman karena melaporkan pencurian ternak Apollon.
statement.en: Hermes turned the tell-tale herdsman Battos into stone as punishment for reporting his theft of Apollon's cattle.

claims.quote: Hermes' most distinctive attribute was the herald's wand (Greek kerykeion, Latin caduceus) but he was sometimes armed instead with a short sword.

statement.id: Atribut Hermes yang paling khas adalah tongkat juru warta (kerykeion dalam bahasa Yunani, caduceus dalam bahasa Latin), tetapi kadang ia dipersenjatai pedang pendek.
statement.en: Hermes' most distinctive attribute was the herald's wand (Greek kerykeion, Latin caduceus), though he was sometimes armed with a short sword instead.

claims.quote: Hermes' sacred animals were the ram and the hare. In ancient art he rode on the back of a large ram.

statement.id: Hewan suci Hermes adalah domba jantan dan kelinci; dalam seni kuno ia menunggangi domba jantan besar.
statement.en: Hermes' sacred animals were the ram and the hare; in ancient art he rode on the back of a large ram.

claims.quote: commanded that glorious Hermes should be lord over all birds of omen and grim-eyed lions, and boars with gleaming tusks, and over dogs and all flocks that the wide earth nourishes, and over all sheep; also that he only should be the appointed messenger to Hades
claims.locator: Classical Literature Quotes, Homeric Hymn 4 to Hermes (trans. Evelyn-White)

statement.id: Himne Homerik 4 menyatakan Zeus memerintahkan Hermes menjadi penguasa atas burung pertanda, singa, babi hutan, anjing, semua kawanan, dan semua domba, serta satu-satunya utusan yang ditunjuk ke Hades.
statement.en: Homeric Hymn 4 says Zeus commanded that Hermes be lord over birds of omen, lions, boars, dogs, all flocks and all sheep, and the only appointed messenger to Hades.

claims.quote: he is said to have invented the alphabet, numbers, astronomy, music, the art of fighting, gymnastics, the cultivation of the olive tree, measures, weights, and many other things.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology yang dikutip Theoi, Hermes dikatakan menciptakan alfabet, bilangan, astronomi, musik, seni bertarung, senam, budidaya zaitun, ukuran, timbangan, dan banyak hal lain.
statement.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology reproduced on Theoi, Hermes is said to have invented the alphabet, numbers, astronomy, music, the art of fighting, gymnastics, olive cultivation, measures, weights, and many other things.

claims.quote: These qualities were combined with similar ones, such as cunning both in words and actions, and even fraud, perjury, and the inclination to steal; but acts of this kind were committed by Hermes always with a certain skill, dexterity, and even gracefulness.

statement.id: Menurut kamus yang dikutip Theoi, Hermes memiliki kecerdikan dalam kata dan perbuatan, bahkan penipuan, sumpah palsu, dan kecenderungan mencuri, tetapi selalu dilakukan dengan keterampilan, kelincahan, dan keanggunan.
statement.en: According to the dictionary reproduced on Theoi, Hermes had cunning in words and actions, even fraud, perjury, and an inclination to steal, but always committed with skill, dexterity, and gracefulness.

statement.en: According to the dictionary reproduced on Theoi, Hermes, a son of Zeus and Maia, the daughter of Atlas, was born in a cave of Mount Cyllene in Arcadia, but Philostratus places his birth in Olympus.

claims.quote: Apollo presented his young friend with his own golden shepherd's staff, taught him the art of prophesying by means of dice, and Zeus made him his own herald, and also of the gods of the lower world.

statement.id: Menurut kamus yang dikutip Theoi, Apollo memberi Hermes tongkat gembala emasnya dan mengajarinya meramal dengan dadu, dan Zeus menjadikannya juru wartanya sendiri serta juru warta dewa-dewa dunia bawah.
statement.en: According to the dictionary reproduced on Theoi, Apollo gave Hermes his golden shepherd's staff and taught him prophesying by dice, and Zeus made him his own herald and herald of the gods of the lower world.

claims.quote: Among the things sacred to him we may mention the palm tree, the tortoise, the number four, and several kinds of fish; and the sacrifices offered to him consisted of incense, honey, cakes, pigs, and especially lambs and young goats.

statement.id: Menurut kamus yang dikutip Theoi, hal-hal yang suci bagi Hermes mencakup pohon palem, kura-kura, angka empat, dan beberapa jenis ikan, dan kurban untuknya berupa kemenyan, madu, kue, babi, serta terutama domba dan anak kambing.
statement.en: According to the dictionary reproduced on Theoi, things sacred to Hermes included the palm tree, the tortoise, the number four, and several kinds of fish, and offerings to him consisted of incense, honey, cakes, pigs, and especially lambs and young goats.

claims.quote: Hermes has long been derived from Greek ἕρμα (herma 'stone heap, cairn'), but this scholarly speculation is also disputed.

statement.id: Nama Hermes sejak lama diturunkan dari kata Yunani herma ('timbunan batu'), tetapi dugaan ilmiah ini juga diperdebatkan.
statement.en: The name Hermes has long been derived from Greek herma ('stone heap, cairn'), but this scholarly speculation is also disputed.

claims.quote: The earliest form of the name Hermes (Ἑρμῆς) is the Mycenaean Greek ... in the Linear B syllabic script.

statement.id: Bentuk tertua nama Hermes (Ἑρμῆς) adalah bentuk Yunani Mykenai yang ditulis dalam aksara silabis Linear B.
statement.en: The earliest form of the name Hermes (Ἑρμῆς) is the Mycenaean Greek form written in the Linear B syllabic script.

claims.quote: Perhaps the most celebrated depiction of Hermes in Greek art is the magnificent statue by Praxiteles (c. 330 BCE) which once stood in the temple of Hera at Olympia and now resides in the archaeological museum of the site.

statement.id: Penggambaran Hermes dalam seni Yunani yang mungkin paling termasyhur adalah patung agung karya Praxiteles (sekitar 330 SM) yang dahulu berdiri di kuil Hera di Olimpia dan kini berada di museum arkeologi situs itu.
statement.en: Perhaps the most celebrated depiction of Hermes in Greek art is the statue by Praxiteles (c. 330 BCE) that once stood in the temple of Hera at Olympia and now resides in the site's archaeological museum.

claims.quote: In the Hellenistic period, the god was often associated with gymnasia and seen as the protector of youths.

statement.id: Pada periode Helenistik, Hermes sering dikaitkan dengan gimnasium dan dipandang sebagai pelindung kaum muda.
statement.en: In the Hellenistic period the god was often associated with gymnasia and seen as the protector of youths.

claims.quote: In mythology, Hermes was also the father of the pastoral god Pan and Eudoros (with Polymele), one of the leaders of the Myrmidons, although the god was not given a wife in any Greek myth.

text.id: Pemujaannya dimulai dalam Ṛgveda sekitar 1200 SM, dan ia tampaknya dewa pra-Weda.
text.en: His worship begins in the Ṛgveda around 1200 BCE, and he is evidently a pre-Vedic god.

short_description.id: Indra adalah raja para dewa dalam tradisi Weda dan Hindu, dewa cuaca, hujan, petir, dan perang, yang menggenggam vajra dan membunuh Vritra untuk membebaskan sungai.
short_description.en: Indra is the king of the gods in Vedic and Hindu tradition, a god of weather, rain, lightning, and war who wields the vajra and slays Vritra to free the rivers.

long_description.id: Indra adalah dewa cuaca Weda dan raja para dewa. Ia dikaitkan dengan langit, petir, badai, hujan, aliran sungai, dan perang. Ia dewa yang paling sering disebut dalam Ṛgveda, dan lebih dari seperempat himne dalam kumpulan itu ditujukan kepadanya. Dalam teks-teks Weda ia dilukiskan berjanggut, bertubuh raksasa, dan mengendarai kereta; ia dikenal juga dengan julukan Maghavan, dan ia disebut raja segala yang bergerak dan tak bergerak.
long_description.en: Indra is the Vedic god of weather and king of the gods. He is associated with the sky, lightning, storms, rain, river flows, and war. He is the most frequently mentioned deity in the Rigveda, with over a quarter of that collection's hymns directed to him. In Vedic texts he is portrayed as bearded, gigantic, and chariot-driving; he is also known by the epithet Maghavan and is called king of all that moves and moves not.

long_description.id: Atributnya adalah vajra atau petir, yang ditempa Tvashṭar; ia juga dapat membawa cakram chakra, ankusa, dan kapak tanka, dan sering digambarkan menunggang gajah putih Airāvata. Ia memimpin Marut, dewa badai prajurit, dan menjadi pelindung kaum kṣatriya. Ia umumnya baik hati, menjamin kemakmuran dan hujan yang mengakhiri kekeringan, tetapi dalam tradisi belakangan ia juga digambarkan lemah akibat soma dan keburukannya.
long_description.en: His attributes are the vajra or thunderbolt, which Tvashṭar fashioned; he may also carry the chakra discus, the ankusa, and the tanka axe, and is often shown riding the white elephant Airāvata. He leads the Maruts, martial storm gods, and is patron of the kṣatriyas. He is generally benevolent, guaranteeing prosperity and rain that ends droughts, but later tradition also portrays him as weakened by soma and his own excesses.

long_description.id: Kisah utamanya adalah pembunuhan Vritra, yang menghalangi sungai dan menyebabkan kekeringan; dengan menghancurkannya Indra membawa hujan dan sinar matahari. Dalam Ṛgveda, Indra membunuh Naga itu dengan petirnya, membuka gua tempat banjir dipenjara, dan melepaskan Tujuh Sungai. Ia juga membebaskan sapi dari gua Vala, menemukan matahari, membawa soma ke bumi, dan dikatakan menyangga langit dan bumi agar terpisah. Para sarjana menafsirkan Vritra sebagai uap yang terkumpul dalam awan yang dibelah Indra sehingga hujan turun.
long_description.en: His chief story is the slaying of Vritra, who blocked rivers and caused drought; by destroying him Indra brings rain and sunshine. In the Ṛgveda, Indra slays the Dragon with his thunderbolt, opens the cave in which the floods were imprisoned, and lets loose the Seven Rivers. He also frees the cows from Vala's cave, finds the sun, brings the soma to earth, and is said to have propped heaven and earth apart. Interpreters read Vritra as vapour shut up in a cloud that Indra divides so that rain descends.

long_description.id: Sumber sejarah menyebut Indra penting dalam agama Weda yang kemudian tampil dalam Hinduisme dan Buddhisme. Dalam Buddhisme ia dikenal sebagai Sakra, penjaga agama dan dewa utama surga tiga puluh tiga dewa. Reputasinya menurun dalam Brāhmaṇa dan wiracarita, tempat ia digambarkan rentan dan bergantung pada Śiva dan Viṣṇu. Ia masih dipuja dalam festival Inder Puja di Rajasthan.
long_description.en: Historical sources identify Indra as important in Vedic religion and later present in Hinduism and Buddhism. In Buddhism he is known as Sakra, guardian of the religion and chief deity of the heaven of the thirty-three gods. His reputation declines in the Brāhmaṇas and the epics, where he is portrayed as vulnerable and dependent on Śiva and Viṣṇu. He is still worshipped in the Inder Puja festival in Rajasthan.

cultural_context.id: Dalam mitologi India, awan disamakan dengan ternak ilahi dan guntur adalah Indra yang bertarung melawan iblis yang mencuri sapi surgawi. Ia juga menjadi pelindung kaum kṣatriya, kelas prajurit kerajaan.
cultural_context.en: In Indian mythology, clouds are equated with divine cattle and thunder is Indra fighting the demons who steal the celestial cows. He is also the patron of the kṣatriyas, the class of royal warriors.

who.id: Indra adalah dewa cuaca Weda dan raja para dewa.
who.en: Indra is the Vedic god of weather and king of the gods.

origin.id: Ia berasal dari agama Weda, tempat pemujaannya dimulai dalam Ṛgveda.
origin.en: He comes from Vedic religion, where his worship begins in the Ṛgveda.

role.id: Ia raja para dewa dan pelindung kaum prajurit, pembawa hujan, dan pembunuh musuh para dewa.
role.en: He is the king of the gods, patron of warriors, bringer of rain, and slayer of the gods' enemies.

famous_for.id: Ia paling dikenal karena membunuh Vritra dengan petirnya untuk membebaskan sungai.
famous_for.en: He is best known for slaying Vritra with his thunderbolt to free the rivers.

did_you_know.id: Citra jaring Indra, yang terbentang tak terhingga di langit, menjadi metafora keterkaitan semua makhluk dalam tradisi Mahāyāna.
did_you_know.en: In the Mahāyāna tradition, the image of Indra's net stretching infinitely across the heavens became a metaphor for the interconnectedness of all beings.

description.id: Indra dikaitkan dengan petir, badai, dan hujan; ia mendatangkan hujan badai yang mengakhiri kekeringan dan, dalam Ṛgveda, membuka perairan yang terkurung.
description.en: Indra is associated with lightning, storms, and rain; he delivers rainstorms that end droughts and, in the Ṛgveda, discloses the imprisoned waters.

description.id: Ia menggenggam petir yang ditempa Tvashṭar untuk menghancurkan Vritra, dan petir yang sama membelah gunung tempat sapi disembunyikan.
description.en: He wields the thunderbolt fashioned by Tvashṭar to smash Vritra, and the same thunderbolt splits the mountain where the cattle were hidden.

description.id: Saat membinasakan iblis atau musuh manusia, Indra menjadi pengubah wujud; dalam satu kisah ia membawa soma ke bumi dalam wujud elang atau menunggang elang.
description.en: When destroying demons or human foes, Indra becomes a shape-changer; in one tale he brings soma to earth in the shape of a falcon or riding on one.

description.id: Indra dikatakan menciptakan alam semesta dengan menyangga langit dan bumi, mengokohkan bumi yang goyah, dan menopang langit.
description.en: Indra is said to have created the universe by propping apart heaven and earth, fixing the staggering earth firm, and supporting the heaven.

description.id: Ia memimpin Marut, dewa badai prajurit, meraih kemenangan bagi Indo-Arya.
description.en: He leads the Maruts, martial storm gods, to victory for the Indo-Aryans.

description.id: Indra gemar soma yang tidak selalu diminum secukupnya; ia mabuk berat dan harus dipulihkan, dan dalam wiracarita kegemarannya mengejar perempuan membuatnya menderita.
description.en: Indra's fondness for soma is not always moderate; he becomes badly hungover and must be restored, and in the epics his womanizing brings him suffering.

description.id: Ketika kelebihannya melemahkannya, ia sering dikalahkan iblis dan harus meminta bantuan Śiva dan Viṣṇu; pembunuhan Vṛtra juga membuatnya lemah dan perlu pemurnian.
description.en: When his excesses weaken him he is often overcome by demons and must enlist Śiva and Viṣṇu; the killing of Vṛtra also leaves him weakened and in need of purification.

description.id: Dalam Buddhisme Indra dikenal sebagai Sakra dan menguasai tiga puluh tiga dewa; ia digambarkan sebagai penjaga agama dan, dalam sebagian versi kisah hidup Buddha, menerima dan memandikan bayi Buddha. Dalam Buddhisme belakangan petirnya menjadi tongkat kerajaan berlian.
description.en: In Buddhism Indra is known as Sakra and rules the thirty-three gods; he is portrayed as a guardian of the religion and, in some versions of the Buddha's life story, receives and bathes the infant Buddha. In later Buddhism his thunderbolt becomes a diamond sceptre.

summary.en: Vritra, a coiled serpent, blocked the rivers and caused drought. Only Indra dared, fortified with soma, and he slew Vritra with a thunderbolt, freeing the waters.

sources.title: The Hymns of the Rigveda, Book 2, Hymn 12 (trans. Ralph T. H. Griffith)

claims.quote: is the supreme Vedic god and a major deity in Hinduism who is the king of the devas and Heaven (Known as Svar in Vedism and later Svarga in Hinduism). He is associated with the sky, lightning, weather, thunder, sovereignty, power, kingship, truth, fertility, virtue, storms, rains, river flows, and war.

statement.id: Indra adalah dewa Weda tertinggi dan dewa utama dalam Hinduisme, raja para deva dan Surga; ia dikaitkan dengan langit, petir, cuaca, guntur, kedaulatan, kekuasaan, kerajaan, kebenaran, kesuburan, kebajikan, badai, hujan, aliran sungai, dan perang.
statement.en: Indra is the supreme Vedic god and a major deity in Hinduism, king of the devas and Heaven; he is associated with the sky, lightning, weather, thunder, sovereignty, power, kingship, truth, fertility, virtue, storms, rains, river flows, and war.

claims.quote: Indra is frequently portrayed wielding a thunderbolt (vajra) but he may also carry the chakra discus

statement.id: Indra sering digambarkan memegang vajra.
statement.en: Indra is often depicted with a vajra thunderbolt.

claims.quote: He is often shown riding his white elephant Airāvata

statement.id: Indra sering digambarkan menaiki gajah putih Airavata.
statement.en: Indra is often shown riding the white elephant Airavata.

claims.quote: these tremendous coils were blocking up the rivers and streams and causing a great drought. So horrifying was Vritra that none of the gods dared intervene and it was only Indra who found the courage, fortified with soma, to slay the beast with one of his thunderbolts.

statement.id: Indra membunuh Vritra yang menghalangi sungai dan menyebabkan kekeringan.
statement.en: Indra killed Vritra, who blocked rivers and caused drought.

claims.quote: Indra was the most important god in the Vedic religion and he later became a major figure in Hinduism and an important deity in Buddhism

statement.id: Indra penting dalam agama Weda dan kemudian tampil dalam Hinduisme serta Buddhisme.
statement.en: Indra was important in Vedic religion and later in Hindu and Buddhist traditions.

claims.quote: Indra is known as Sakra in Buddhism and he rules the 33 gods.

statement.id: Indra dikenal sebagai Sakra dalam Buddhisme.
statement.en: Indra is known as Sakra in Buddhism.

claims.quote: appropriated the lighting-bolt scepter (Skt: vajra) of Indra, the Vedic storm god, and repurposed it.

statement.id: Penggambaran Vajrapani memakai tongkat vajra yang dikaitkan dengan Indra.
statement.en: Depictions of Vajrapani adopted the vajra scepter associated with Indra.

claims.quote: According to the Vishnu Purana, Indra is the title borne by the king of the gods, which changes every Manvantara – a cyclic period of time in Hindu cosmology. Each Manvantara has its own Indra and the Indra of the current Manvantara is called Purandhara.

statement.id: Menurut Vishnu Purana, Indra adalah gelar yang disandang raja para dewa dan berganti setiap Manvantara; setiap Manvantara punya Indra sendiri, dan Indra pada Manvantara sekarang disebut Purandhara.
statement.en: According to the Vishnu Purana, Indra is the title borne by the king of the gods, which changes every Manvantara; each Manvantara has its own Indra, and the Indra of the current Manvantara is called Purandhara.

claims.quote: Indra is the most frequently mentioned deity in the Rigveda.

statement.id: Indra adalah dewa yang paling sering disebut dalam Rigveda.
statement.en: Indra is the most frequently mentioned deity in the Rigveda.

claims.quote: Indra destroys Vritra and his "deceiving forces", and thereby brings rain and sunshine as the saviour of mankind.

statement.id: Indra menghancurkan Vritra dan "kekuatan penipunya", dan dengan itu membawa hujan dan sinar matahari sebagai penyelamat umat manusia.
statement.en: Indra destroys Vritra and his "deceiving forces", and thereby brings rain and sunshine as the saviour of mankind.

claims.quote: But the hymns to Indra, who is after all the chief god of the Ṛgveda (more than a quarter of the hymns in the collection are addressed to him), emphasize his heroic deeds.

statement.id: Indra adalah dewa utama Ṛgveda; lebih dari seperempat himne dalam kumpulan itu ditujukan kepadanya, dan himne-himne itu menekankan perbuatan kepahlawanannya.
statement.en: Indra is the chief god of the Ṛgveda; more than a quarter of the hymns in the collection are addressed to him, and they emphasize his heroic deeds.

claims.quote: He wields the thunderbolt, drinks the ambrosial soma to excess, bestows fertility upon human women (often by sleeping with them himself), and leads his band of Maruts, martial storm gods, to win victory for the conquering Indo-Aryans.

statement.id: Indra menggenggam petir, minum soma hingga berlebihan, memberi kesuburan kepada perempuan manusia (sering dengan tidur bersama mereka), dan memimpin Marut, dewa badai prajurit, meraih kemenangan bagi bangsa Indo-Arya penakluk.
statement.en: Indra wields the thunderbolt, drinks the ambrosial soma to excess, bestows fertility upon human women (often by sleeping with them himself), and leads his band of Maruts, martial storm gods, to victory for the conquering Indo-Aryans.

claims.quote: the worship of the god Indra, king of the gods, warrior of the gods, god of rain, begins properly in the Ṛgveda, circa 1200 bce

statement.id: Pemujaan Indra, raja dewa, pejuang para dewa, dan dewa hujan, dimulai dengan sebenarnya dalam Ṛgveda, sekitar 1200 SM.
statement.en: The worship of Indra, king of the gods, warrior of the gods, and god of rain, begins properly in the Ṛgveda, circa 1200 bce.

claims.quote: Kept against his will inside his mother's womb for many years, he bursts forth out of her side and kills his own father

statement.id: Dalam Ṛgveda, kelahiran Indra tidak wajar: ia ditahan di rahim ibunya selama bertahun-tahun, lalu keluar dari sisinya dan membunuh ayahnya sendiri.
statement.en: In the Ṛgveda, Indra's birth is unnatural: kept against his will inside his mother's womb for many years, he bursts forth out of her side and kills his own father.

claims.quote: He is said to have created the universe by propping apart heaven and earth ... and to have freed the cows that had been penned up in a cave

statement.id: Indra dikatakan menciptakan alam semesta dengan menyangga langit dan bumi agar terpisah, menemukan matahari, dan membebaskan sapi-sapi yang dikurung dalam gua.
statement.en: Indra is said to have created the universe by propping apart heaven and earth, finding the sun, and freeing the cows that had been penned up in a cave.

claims.quote: It was Indra who, in the shape of a falcon or riding on a falcon, brought down the soma plant from heaven, where it had been guarded by demons, to earth, where it became accessible to humans

statement.id: Indra, dalam wujud elang atau menunggang elang, membawa tanaman soma dari surga, tempat para iblis menjaganya, ke bumi sehingga dapat diakses manusia.
statement.en: Indra, in the shape of a falcon or riding on a falcon, brought the soma plant down from heaven, where demons had guarded it, to earth, where it became accessible to humans.

claims.quote: But Indra's principal function is to kill enemies—non-Aryan humans and demons, who are often conflated.

statement.id: Fungsi utama Indra adalah membunuh musuh, yaitu manusia non-Arya dan iblis, yang sering dicampuradukkan.
statement.en: Indra's principal function is to kill enemies: non-Aryan humans and demons, who are often conflated.

claims.quote: As the supreme god of the kṣatriyas or class of royal warriors, Indra is invoked as a destroyer of cities and destroyer of armies, as the staunch ally of his generous worshipers, to whom Indra is in turn equally generous (Maghavan, "the generous," is one of his most popular epithets)

statement.id: Sebagai dewa tertinggi kaum kṣatriya, kelas prajurit kerajaan, Indra dipanggil sebagai penghancur kota dan pasukan serta sekutu setia para pemuja yang dermawan; Maghavan, "yang murah hati", adalah salah satu julukannya yang paling populer.
statement.en: As the supreme god of the kṣatriyas, the class of royal warriors, Indra is invoked as a destroyer of cities and armies and as the staunch ally of his generous worshipers; Maghavan, "the generous," is one of his most popular epithets.

claims.quote: Indra's reputation begins to decline in the Brāhmaṇas, about 900 bce, where his supremacy is preempted by Prajāpati, the primordial creator.

statement.id: Reputasi Indra mulai menurun dalam Brāhmaṇa, sekitar 900 SM, ketika kedudukan tertingginya diambil alih Prajāpati, sang pencipta primordial.
statement.en: Indra's reputation begins to decline in the Brāhmaṇas, about 900 bce, where his supremacy is preempted by Prajāpati, the primordial creator.

claims.quote: Indra still drinks the soma, but now he becomes badly hungover and has to be restored to health by the worshiper. Similarly, the killing of Vṛtra leaves Indra weakened and in need of purification.

statement.id: Indra masih minum soma tetapi kini mabuk berat dan harus dipulihkan oleh pemuja; pembunuhan Vṛtra juga membuatnya lemah dan memerlukan pemurnian.
statement.en: Indra still drinks the soma, but now becomes badly hungover and has to be restored to health by the worshiper; the killing of Vṛtra leaves him weakened and in need of purification.

claims.quote: His notorious womanizing leads, on one occasion (when the sage Gautama catches Indra in bed with Ahalyā, the sage's wife), to Indra's castration, though his testicles are later replaced by those of a ram

statement.id: Dalam wiracarita, kegemarannya mengejar perempuan menyebabkan Indra dikebiri ketika resi Gautama memergokinya bersama Ahalyā, istri sang resi, meskipun buah zakarnya kemudian diganti dengan milik domba jantan.
statement.en: In the epics, his notorious womanizing leads to Indra's castration when the sage Gautama catches him in bed with Ahalyā, the sage's wife, though his testicles are later replaced by those of a ram.

claims.quote: When Indra's excesses weaken him, he becomes vulnerable in battle; often he is overcome by demons and must enlist the aid of the now supreme sectarian gods, Śiva and Viṣṇu, to restore his throne.

statement.id: Ketika kelebihan-kelebihannya melemahkannya, Indra menjadi rentan dalam pertempuran; ia sering dikalahkan iblis dan harus meminta bantuan Śiva dan Viṣṇu untuk memulihkan takhtanya.
statement.en: When Indra's excesses weaken him, he becomes vulnerable in battle; often he is overcome by demons and must enlist the aid of the now supreme sectarian gods, Śiva and Viṣṇu, to restore his throne.

claims.quote: Indra is evidently a pre-Vedic god, invoked by Mitanni Aryans of northern Syria in their famous treaty with the Hittites about 1380 b.c.

statement.id: Indra tampaknya dewa pra-Weda, yang dipanggil oleh bangsa Arya Mitanni di Suriah utara dalam perjanjian terkenal mereka dengan bangsa Het sekitar 1380 SM.
statement.en: Indra is evidently a pre-Vedic god, invoked by Mitanni Aryans of northern Syria in their famous treaty with the Hittites about 1380 b.c.

claims.quote: When destroying demons or human foe, Indra wields his vajra, a thunderbolt-mace forged by ... and becomes a shape-changer

statement.id: Ketika membinasakan iblis atau musuh manusia, Indra menggunakan vajra, gada petir yang ditempa, dan menjadi pengubah wujud.
statement.en: When destroying demons or human foe, Indra wields his vajra, a thunderbolt-mace forged by another, and becomes a shape-changer.

claims.quote: Above all, he is Vritrahan (slayer of Vritra) an epithet cognate to ancient Iranian Verethraghna.

statement.id: Terutama, ia adalah Vritrahan (pembunuh Vritra), julukan yang sekerabat dengan Verethraghna dalam bahasa Iran kuno.
statement.en: Above all, he is Vritrahan (slayer of Vritra), an epithet cognate to ancient Iranian Verethraghna.

claims.quote: Chariot-driving Indra, said to have a hundred powers, is bearded and gigantic in size.

statement.id: Indra yang mengendarai kereta, konon berkuasa seratus daya, digambarkan berjanggut dan bertubuh raksasa.
statement.en: Chariot-driving Indra, said to have a hundred powers, is bearded and gigantic in size.

claims.quote: He is typically portrayed as a guardian of the religion and the chief deity in the heaven of the thirty-three gods.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia of Buddhism entry (Jacob N. Kinnard)

statement.id: Dalam Buddhisme, Indra biasanya digambarkan sebagai penjaga agama dan dewa utama di surga tiga puluh tiga dewa.
statement.en: In Buddhism, Indra is typically portrayed as a guardian of the religion and the chief deity in the heaven of the thirty-three gods.

claims.quote: In some versions of the Buddha's life story, Indra receives the infant Buddha as he emerges from his mother's side and then bathes him.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia of Buddhism entry (Jacob N. Kinnard)

statement.id: Dalam sebagian versi kisah hidup Buddha, Indra menerima bayi Buddha ketika keluar dari sisi ibunya lalu memandikannya.
statement.en: In some versions of the Buddha's life story, Indra receives the infant Buddha as he emerges from his mother's side and then bathes him.

claims.quote: He is venerated at the end of the year as Thagya Min in Myanmar (Burma).
claims.locator: Encyclopedia of Buddhism entry (Jacob N. Kinnard)

statement.id: Di Myanmar (Burma), Indra dihormati pada akhir tahun sebagai Thagya Min.
statement.en: In Myanmar (Burma), Indra is venerated at the end of the year as Thagya Min.

claims.quote: The image of Indra's net, which stretches infinitely across the heavens, becomes important in the ... as a metaphor for the interconnectedness of all beings.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia of Buddhism entry (Jacob N. Kinnard)

statement.id: Citra jaring Indra, yang terbentang tak terhingga di langit, menjadi penting dalam tradisi Mahāyāna sebagai metafora keterkaitan semua makhluk.
statement.en: The image of Indra's net, which stretches infinitely across the heavens, becomes important in the Mahāyāna tradition as a metaphor for the interconnectedness of all beings.

claims.quote: In the Hindu creation myth Indra was born (along with his brother Agni) from the mouth of the primordial god or giant Purusha

statement.id: Dalam mitos penciptaan Hindu, Indra lahir (bersama saudaranya Agni) dari mulut dewa atau raksasa primordial Purusha.
statement.en: In the Hindu creation myth Indra was born (along with his brother Agni) from the mouth of the primordial god or giant Purusha.

claims.quote: Indra, seated on his throne within the storm clouds of the svarga or third heaven is ruler of the clouds and skies alongside his wife Indrāni.

statement.id: Indra duduk di takhtanya dalam awan badai di svarga atau surga ketiga sebagai penguasa awan dan langit bersama istrinya, Indrāni.
statement.en: Indra, seated on his throne within the storm clouds of the svarga or third heaven, is ruler of the clouds and skies alongside his wife Indrāni.

claims.quote: In Indian mythology the clouds are equated with divine cattle and the sound of thunder during storms is Indra fighting with the demons who are forever trying to steal these celestial cows.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi India, awan disamakan dengan ternak ilahi, dan suara guntur saat badai adalah Indra yang bertarung dengan iblis yang selalu berusaha mencuri sapi surgawi itu.
statement.en: In Indian mythology the clouds are equated with divine cattle and the sound of thunder during storms is Indra fighting with the demons who are forever trying to steal these celestial cows.

claims.quote: Indra encompasses and controls the universe, balancing the earth in the palm of his hand and manipulating it according to his whim. He also created the rivers and streams by shaping the mountains and valleys with his sacred axe.

statement.id: Indra mencakup dan mengendalikan alam semesta, menyeimbangkan bumi di telapak tangannya dan mengaturnya sesuka hati; ia juga menciptakan sungai dan aliran dengan membentuk gunung dan lembah menggunakan kapak sucinya.
statement.en: Indra encompasses and controls the universe, balancing the earth in the palm of his hand and manipulating it according to his whim; he also created the rivers and streams by shaping the mountains and valleys with his sacred axe.

claims.quote: as king of the gods he is generally benevolent, being generous to his worshippers, guaranteeing peace and prosperity and delivering beneficial rainstorms to end droughts.

statement.id: Sebagai raja para dewa, Indra umumnya baik hati, murah hati kepada pemujanya, menjamin perdamaian dan kemakmuran, serta mendatangkan hujan badai yang menguntungkan untuk mengakhiri kekeringan.
statement.en: As king of the gods he is generally benevolent, generous to his worshippers, guaranteeing peace and prosperity and delivering beneficial rainstorms to end droughts.

claims.quote: Vala cleverly hid his prize in the depths of a mountain but was tracked down by Indra's servants the Maruts or Rudras (storm gods), then, one thunderbolt from Indra was enough to split the mountain in two and release the herd who were safely escorted back to the heavens.

statement.id: Vala menyembunyikan hasil curiannya di dalam gunung, tetapi dilacak oleh para Marut (atau Rudra), pelayan Indra, lalu satu petir Indra cukup untuk membelah gunung dan melepaskan kawanan sapi yang dikawal pulang ke langit.
statement.en: Vala hid his prize in the depths of a mountain but was tracked down by Indra's servants the Maruts or Rudras (storm gods), then one thunderbolt from Indra was enough to split the mountain in two and release the herd, who were safely escorted back to the heavens.

claims.quote: he is known for his fondness of the alcoholic elixir drink soma which he does not always take in moderation and so he sometimes suffers from its after-effects.

statement.id: Indra dikenal gemar minum soma, minuman memabukkan, yang tidak selalu ia minum secukupnya sehingga kadang menderita efek sampingnya.
statement.en: Indra is known for his fondness for the alcoholic elixir soma, which he does not always take in moderation, so that he sometimes suffers from its after-effects.

claims.quote: As a result of this episode he won great favour among the other great gods and one of Indra's surnames became Vritrahan, meaning the 'slayer of Vritra'.

statement.id: Karena kisah itu, Indra mendapat restu besar dari dewa-dewa lain dan salah satu julukannya menjadi Vritrahan, "pembunuh Vritra".
statement.en: As a result of this episode he won great favour among the other great gods and one of Indra's surnames became Vritrahan, meaning the "slayer of Vritra".

claims.quote: In the Sanskrit epic Mahabharata, Indra is the father of the hero Arjuna and he manages to win the magic armour that would make his son invincible.

statement.id: Dalam wiracarita Sanskerta Mahabharata, Indra adalah ayah pahlawan Arjuna dan berhasil memperoleh baju zirah ajaib yang membuat putranya tak terkalahkan.
statement.en: In the Sanskrit epic Mahabharata, Indra is the father of the hero Arjuna and manages to win the magic armour that would make his son invincible.

claims.quote: In the Cham religion of Vietnam he is also the god of thunder and rides a white elephant. In Chinese tradition he is identified with the god Ti-shi.

statement.id: Dalam agama Cham di Vietnam, Indra juga dewa guntur dan menunggang gajah putih; dalam tradisi Tionghoa ia diidentikkan dengan dewa Ti-shi.
statement.en: In the Cham religion of Vietnam he is also the god of thunder and rides a white elephant; in Chinese tradition he is identified with the god Ti-shi.

claims.quote: In Cambodian tradition he is known as Pah En the god of the sky and he is the most popular of the gods. He is considered to live atop Mt. Meru or Prah Sumer

statement.id: Dalam tradisi Kamboja, Indra dikenal sebagai Pah En, dewa langit, yang dianggap tinggal di puncak Gunung Meru atau Prah Sumer.
statement.en: In Cambodian tradition he is known as Pah En, the god of the sky, and is considered to live atop Mt. Meru or Prah Sumer.

claims.quote: the god is still worshipped today in the Rajasthan region of India in the festival of Inder Puja which calls for rains to prevent the frequent droughts prevalent in this desert state.

statement.id: Indra masih dipuja hingga kini di wilayah Rajasthan, India, dalam festival Inder Puja yang memohon hujan untuk mencegah kekeringan yang sering terjadi di negara bagian gurun itu.
statement.en: The god is still worshipped today in the Rajasthan region of India in the festival of Inder Puja, which calls for rains to prevent the frequent droughts prevalent in this desert state.

claims.quote: but he may also carry the chakra discus, an ankusa or elephant goad and an axe, the tanka.

statement.id: Selain vajra, Indra dapat membawa cakram chakra, ankusa (kait gajah), dan kapak yang disebut tanka.
statement.en: Besides the vajra, Indra may carry the chakra discus, an ankusa or elephant goad, and an axe, the tanka.

claims.quote: In later Buddhism the god's thunderbolt becomes a diamond sceptre, the Vajrayana.

statement.id: Dalam Buddhisme belakangan, petir sang dewa menjadi tongkat kerajaan berlian, Vajrayana.
statement.en: In later Buddhism the god's thunderbolt becomes a diamond sceptre, the Vajrayana.

claims.quote: I will declare the manly deeds of Indra, the first that he achieved, the Thunder-wielder. He slew the Dragon, then disclosed the waters, and cleft the channels of the mountain torrents.

statement.id: Dalam Ṛgveda 1.32, penyair menyatakan perbuatan jantan Indra, sang pemegang petir: ia membunuh Naga, membuka perairan, dan membelah saluran arus gunung.
statement.en: In Rigveda 1.32 the poet declares the manly deeds of Indra, the Thunder-wielder: he slew the Dragon, disclosed the waters, and cleft the channels of the mountain torrents.

claims.quote: He slew the Dragon lying on the mountain: his heavenly bolt of thunder Tvashṭar fashioned.

statement.id: Indra membunuh Naga yang berbaring di gunung; petir surgawinya ditempa oleh Tvashṭar.
statement.en: Indra slew the Dragon lying on the mountain; his heavenly bolt of thunder was fashioned by Tvashṭar.

claims.quote: Impetuous as a bull, he chose the Soma, and in three sacred beakers drank the juices. Maghavan grasped the thunder for his weapon, and smote to death this firstborn of the dragons.

statement.id: Bagaikan banteng yang menggebu, Indra memilih Soma dan meminum sarinya dalam tiga cawan suci; Maghavan menggenggam petir sebagai senjata dan menghantam mati anak sulung para naga.
statement.en: Impetuous as a bull, Indra chose the Soma and drank the juices in three sacred beakers; Maghavan grasped the thunder for his weapon and smote to death the firstborn of the dragons.

claims.quote: Indra with his own great and deadly thunder smote into pieces Vṛitra, worst of Vṛitras.

statement.id: Indra dengan petirnya yang dahsyat dan mematikan menghancurkan Vṛitra, yang terburuk di antara para Vṛitra.
statement.en: Indra with his own great and deadly thunder smote into pieces Vṛitra, worst of Vṛitras.

claims.quote: But he, when he had smitten Vṛitra, opened the cave wherein the floods had been imprisoned.

statement.id: Setelah menghantam Vṛitra, Indra membuka gua tempat banjir air dipenjara.
statement.en: When he had smitten Vṛitra, Indra opened the cave wherein the floods had been imprisoned.

claims.quote: Indra is King of all that moves and moves not, of creatures tame and horned, the Thunder-wielder.

statement.id: Indra adalah Raja segala yang bergerak dan tak bergerak, makhluk jinak dan bertanduk, sang pemegang petir.
statement.en: Indra is King of all that moves and moves not, of creatures tame and horned, the Thunder-wielder.

claims.quote: Vṛitra, sometimes also named Ahi, is nothing more than the accumulation of vapour, condensed or figuratively shut up in, or obstructed by, a cloud. Indra, with his thunderbolt, or atmospheric or electrical influence, divides the aggregated mass, and vent is given to the rain which then descends upon the earth.

statement.id: Menurut catatan kaki yang mengutip Wilson, Vṛitra (kadang disebut Ahi) hanyalah akumulasi uap yang terkumpul dalam awan, dan Indra dengan petirnya membelah massa itu sehingga hujan turun ke bumi.
statement.en: According to a footnote quoting Wilson, Vṛitra (sometimes named Ahi) is nothing more than the accumulation of vapour shut up in a cloud, and Indra with his thunderbolt divides the mass so that rain descends upon the earth.

claims.quote: just born, chief God of lofty spirit by power and might became the Gods' protector

statement.id: Dalam Ṛgveda 2.12, ia yang begitu lahir menjadi dewa utama berjiwa luhur dan dengan daya dan kekuatan menjadi pelindung para dewa disebut Indra.
statement.en: In Rigveda 2.12, he who, just born, was chief God of lofty spirit and by power and might became the Gods' protector is named as Indra.

claims.quote: He who fixed fast and firm the earth that staggered, and set at rest the agitated mountains, Who measured out the air's wide middle region and gave the heaven support

statement.id: Indra mengokohkan bumi yang goyah, menenangkan gunung-gunung yang bergolak, mengukur ruang tengah udara, dan menopang langit.
statement.en: Indra fixed fast and firm the earth that staggered, set at rest the agitated mountains, measured out the air's wide middle region, and gave the heaven support.

claims.quote: Who slew the Dragon, freed the Seven Rivers, and drove the kine forth from the cave of Vala, Begat the fire between two stones, the spoiler in warriors' battle

statement.id: Indra membunuh Naga, membebaskan Tujuh Sungai, menggiring sapi keluar dari gua Vala, dan melahirkan api di antara dua batu.
statement.en: Indra slew the Dragon, freed the Seven Rivers, drove the kine forth from the cave of Vala, and begat the fire between two stones.

summary.id: Sebagai raja para dewa, ia umumnya baik hati dan murah hati kepada pemujanya.
summary.en: As king of the gods he is generally benevolent and generous to his worshippers.

summary.id: Dalam kisah belakangan ia digambarkan tidak selalu terpuji, gemar soma dan rentan.
summary.en: In later tales he is portrayed in a less than favourable light, fond of soma and vulnerable.

topic.id: Indra sebagai satu dewa atau sebagai gelar
topic.en: Indra as one god or as a title

summary.id: Indra adalah dewa Weda tertinggi dan raja para deva.
summary.en: Indra is the supreme Vedic god and king of the devas.

summary.id: Menurut Vishnu Purana, Indra adalah gelar yang berganti setiap Manvantara.
summary.en: According to the Vishnu Purana, Indra is a title that changes every Manvantara.

summary.id: Pertarungan literal antara Indra dan seekor naga atau iblis yang menghalangi sungai.
summary.en: A literal fight between Indra and a dragon or demon that blocks the rivers.

summary.id: Catatan Wilson: kisah alegoris tentang terjadinya hujan; Vṛitra adalah uap yang terkumpul dalam awan.

text.id: Namanya pertama tercatat pada Dinasti Kelima (sekitar 2494-2345 SM); pemujaannya berlanjut hingga Philae ditutup pada 529 M
text.en: Her name is first attested in the Fifth Dynasty (c. 2494-2345 BCE); her worship continued until Philae was closed in 529 CE

short_description.id: Isis adalah dewi Mesir kuno, istri Osiris dan ibu Horus, yang dikenal karena kuasa sihirnya dan perlindungannya, dan pemujaannya menyebar ke dunia Yunani-Romawi.
short_description.en: Isis is an ancient Egyptian goddess, wife of Osiris and mother of Horus, known for her magical power and protection, whose worship spread throughout the Greco-Roman world.

long_description.id: Isis adalah dewi Mesir kuno yang menjadi paling populer dan paling lestari di antara dewa-dewa Mesir. Ia istri Osiris dan ibu Horus, sehingga secara simbolis menjadi ibu bagi firaun. Namanya pertama tercatat dalam Teks Piramida dari Dinasti Kelima. Kultusnya bermula di Delta Nil, dengan tempat suci terpenting di Behbeit El-Hagar, lalu menyebar ke seluruh Mesir.
long_description.en: Isis is an ancient Egyptian goddess who rose to be the most popular and long-lasting of the Egyptian deities. She is the wife of Osiris and the mother of Horus, and so symbolically the mother of the pharaoh. Her name is first attested in the Pyramid Texts of the Fifth Dynasty. Her cult began in the Nile Delta, with its most important sanctuary at Behbeit El-Hagar, and spread to all parts of Egypt.

long_description.id: Dalam mitos Osiris, Set iri kepada saudaranya dan membuat peti mati seukuran tubuh Osiris. Isis mencari suaminya ke seluruh Mesir, membawa jasadnya kembali, lalu menghidupkannya; dalam wujud kite, sejenis elang, ia terbang mengelilinginya dan mengandung Horus. Osiris kemudian mundur ke alam baka sebagai Penguasa dan Hakim Orang Mati, sementara Isis menyembunyikan Horus di rawa-rawa sampai dewasa. Horus kemudian melawan Set demi menguasai dunia.
long_description.en: In the myth of Osiris, Set was jealous of his brother and had a coffin made to Osiris's exact height. Isis searched all through Egypt for her husband, brought his body back, and revived him; in the form of a kite, a kind of falcon, she flew around him and became pregnant with Horus. Osiris then withdrew to the afterlife as Lord and Judge of the Dead, while Isis hid Horus in the swamps until he was grown. Horus then battled Set for control of the world.

long_description.id: Isis dikenal karena sihirnya. Kuasa sihirnya konon melampaui semua dewa lain, dan ia dikatakan mengatur alam serta berkuasa atas takdir; ia juga disebut Weret-Kekau, "Sihir Agung". Dalam sebuah mantra ia membuat Ra sakit dengan gigitan ular dan menawarkan penyembuhan jika Ra mengungkapkan nama rahasianya. Dalam kisah Isis dan Tujuh Kalajengking, ia menyembuhkan seorang anak dengan memanggil nama rahasia para kalajengking dan melafalkan mantra sihir agung. Bantuan keibuannya juga dipanggil dalam mantra penyembuhan bagi orang biasa.
long_description.en: Isis was known for her magic. Her magic was reputed to surpass that of every other god, and she was said to rule the natural world and hold sway over fate; she was also called Weret-Kekau, "the Great Magic". In one spell she makes Ra ill with a snake's bite and offers to cure him if he reveals his secret name. In the story of Isis and the Seven Scorpions she heals a child by calling the scorpions by their secret names and reciting spells of great magic. Her maternal aid was also invoked in healing spells for ordinary people.

long_description.id: Ketika Aleksander Agung menaklukkan Mesir pada 331 SM, pasukannya mengaitkan Isis dengan Demeter. Di Roma pemujaannya dikukuhkan pada masa Caligula, dan kuil Isis ditemukan antara lain di Pompeii dan Londinium. Dalam karya Apuleius (terjemahan Adlington), sang dewi menyebut dirinya ibu alami segala sesuatu dan Ratu Langit, dan menyatakan bahwa orang Mesir menyebutnya Ratu Isis. Kuil Isis di Philae tetap menjadi tempat ziarah hingga ditutup oleh kaisar Justinian pada 529 M.
long_description.en: When Alexander the Great conquered Egypt in 331 BCE his troops associated Isis with Demeter. In Rome her worship was firmly established under Caligula, and temples of Isis have been found at Pompeii and Londinium, among other places. In Apuleius's work (Adlington's translation) the goddess calls herself the natural mother of all things and Queen of heaven, and says the Egyptians call her Queen Isis. Her temple at Philae remained a pilgrimage site until the emperor Justinian closed it in 529 CE.

long_description.id: Seiring waktu Isis menjadi begitu populer sehingga semua dewa dianggap sekadar aspek Isis, dan ia satu-satunya dewa Mesir yang dipuja semua orang. Bersama suami dan putranya ia menggantikan Triad Thebes yang berisi Amon, Mut, dan Khons. Kultusnya tumbuh menjadi agama misteri yang menjanjikan rahasia hidup dan mati kepada para peserta inisiasi, ia dikaitkan dengan laut sebagai pelindung pelaut dan pedagang, dan orang Yunani serta Romawi memuliakannya sebagai dewa tertinggi pencipta dunia.
long_description.en: Over time Isis grew so popular that all gods were regarded as mere aspects of her, and she was the one Egyptian deity worshipped by everyone. With her husband and son she replaced the Theban Triad of Amon, Mut, and Khons. Her cult developed into a mystery cult that offered initiates knowledge of life and death, she became linked with the sea as protector of sailors and merchants, and Greeks and Romans honoured her as the supreme deity who created the world.

cultural_context.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Isis menjadi dewi seluruh rakyat Mesir, laki-laki dan perempuan, bangsawan dan rakyat biasa, dan ia biasanya digambarkan sebagai ibu, istri, dan pelindung yang mengutamakan kepentingan orang lain. Dalam sebuah patung kecil, ia tampil menyusui Horus, dan patung-patung seperti itu menonjolkan perannya sebagai pemberi kehidupan dan pelindung.
cultural_context.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Isis was embraced as goddess by every Egyptian, men and women, royal and ordinary, and is regularly portrayed as a mother, wife, and protectress who puts others' interests first. A statuette shows her nursing Horus, and such statuettes emphasize her role as life-giver and protector.
