name.en: Power over the elements, according to Apuleius

description.id: Dalam terjemahan Adlington atas Apuleius, sang dewi menyatakan bahwa atas kehendaknya planet-planet langit, angin laut, dan kesunyian neraka diatur, dan menyebut dirinya penguasa semua unsur.
description.en: In Adlington's translation of Apuleius, the goddess declares that at her will the planets of the air, the winds of the seas, and the silences of hell are disposed, and calls herself mistress of all the elements.

description.id: Lambangnya adalah kalajengking, kite, takhta kosong, dan sistrum; dalam penglihatan Apuleius ia memegang rebana kuningan dan cawan emas dengan ular aspis.
description.en: Her symbols are the scorpion, the kite, the empty throne, and the sistrum; in Apuleius's vision she holds a brass timbrel and a golden cup with an asp.

description.id: Pemuja Yunani mengaitkan Isis dengan Demeter dan menyematkan sifat dewa Yunani padanya, seperti penemuan pernikahan dan perlindungan kapal; di Roma ia dikenal dan dipuja luas.
description.en: Greek devotees associated Isis with Demeter and ascribed to her traits of Greek deities, such as the invention of marriage and the protection of ships; in Rome she was widely known and worshipped.

claims.quote: In time, she became so popular that all gods were considered mere aspects of Isis and she was the only Egyptian deity worshiped by everyone in the country.

statement.id: Lama-kelamaan Isis begitu populer sehingga semua dewa dianggap sekadar aspek Isis dan ia satu-satunya dewa Mesir yang dipuja semua orang di negeri itu.
statement.en: In time Isis became so popular that all gods were considered mere aspects of her and she was the only Egyptian deity worshiped by everyone in the country.

claims.quote: Like the Eleusinian Mysteries, the Cult of Isis grew into a Mystery Religion promising the secrets of life and death to initiates, who were then sworn to secrecy.

statement.id: Seperti Misteri Eleusis, kultus Isis tumbuh menjadi agama misteri yang menjanjikan rahasia hidup dan mati kepada para peserta inisiasi, yang disumpah merahasiakannya.
statement.en: Like the Eleusinian Mysteries, the cult of Isis grew into a mystery religion promising the secrets of life and death to initiates, who were sworn to secrecy.

claims.quote: Her temple on the island of Philae in Upper Egypt would remain an active pilgrimage site for thousands of years until closed in the 6th century CE by the Christian emperor Justinian.

statement.id: Kuil Isis di pulau Philae di Mesir Hulu tetap menjadi tempat ziarah selama ribuan tahun hingga ditutup pada abad ke-6 M oleh kaisar Kristen Justinian.
statement.en: Her temple on the island of Philae in Upper Egypt remained an active pilgrimage site for thousands of years until closed in the 6th century CE by the Christian emperor Justinian.

claims.quote: Eventually, she became associated with the sea and was a protectress of sailors and merchants who wore talismans honoring her and invoked her aid in times of trouble (attested to by archaeological evidence).

statement.id: Isis akhirnya dikaitkan dengan laut dan menjadi pelindung pelaut dan pedagang yang memakai jimat untuknya dan memohon bantuannya saat bahaya.
statement.en: Isis eventually became associated with the sea and was protectress of sailors and merchants who wore talismans honoring her and invoked her aid in times of trouble.

claims.quote: Unlike the other gods of Egypt, Isis transcended national borders and was worshiped by the Greeks and the Romans who believed in her as the supreme deity who created the world.

statement.id: Berbeda dari dewa Mesir lainnya, Isis melampaui batas negara dan dipuja orang Yunani dan Romawi yang meyakininya sebagai dewa tertinggi pencipta dunia.
statement.en: Unlike other Egyptian gods, Isis transcended national borders and was worshiped by Greeks and Romans, who believed in her as the supreme deity who created the world.

claims.quote: Set was jealous of his brother's power and prestige, however, and so conceived a plan to get rid of him. He had a beautiful coffin made to Osiris' exact height

statement.id: Set iri pada kekuasaan dan gengsi saudaranya dan merencanakan menyingkirkannya, dengan membuat peti mati indah seukuran tinggi Osiris.
statement.en: Set was jealous of his brother's power and prestige and plotted to get rid of him, having a beautiful coffin made to Osiris's exact height.

claims.quote: Isis was distraught when she found her husband was missing and went searching for him all through Egypt without success.

statement.id: Isis sangat bersedih ketika suaminya hilang dan mencarinya ke seluruh Mesir tanpa hasil.
statement.en: Isis was distraught when her husband went missing and searched all through Egypt without success.

claims.quote: After leaving the court, Isis cut Osiris from the tree and carried his body back to Egypt where she hid him from Set in the swampy region of the Nile Delta.

statement.id: Isis mengeluarkan Osiris dari pohon dan membawa jasadnya kembali ke Mesir, menyembunyikannya dari Set di rawa-rawa Delta Nil.
statement.en: Isis cut Osiris from the tree and carried his body back to Egypt, hiding him from Set in the swampy region of the Nile Delta.

claims.quote: Isis still was able to revive Osiris and, once he was alive, she assumed the form of a kite and flew around him, drew the seed from his body into her own, and became pregnant with a son, Horus

statement.id: Isis berhasil menghidupkan kembali Osiris, mengambil wujud kite (sejenis elang), terbang mengelilinginya, dan mengandung putra, Horus.
statement.en: Isis was still able to revive Osiris and, in the form of a kite, flew around him and became pregnant with a son, Horus.

claims.quote: Even though Osiris now lived, he was incomplete and could no longer rule the land of the living. He withdrew into the afterlife where he became Lord and Judge of the Dead.

statement.id: Meski hidup lagi, Osiris tidak lengkap dan tak bisa lagi memerintah dunia orang hidup; ia mundur ke alam baka dan menjadi Penguasa dan Hakim Orang Mati.
statement.en: Though alive again, Osiris was incomplete and could no longer rule the living; he withdrew into the afterlife where he became Lord and Judge of the Dead.

claims.quote: Isis, fearing what Set might do to her son, hid Horus among the swamps of Egypt until he was grown. At that point, Horus emerged as a mighty warrior and battled Set for control of the world.

statement.id: Karena takut akan perbuatan Set, Isis menyembunyikan Horus di rawa-rawa Mesir sampai dewasa; Horus lalu muncul sebagai prajurit perkasa dan melawan Set demi menguasai dunia.
statement.en: Fearing what Set might do, Isis hid Horus in the swamps of Egypt until he was grown; Horus then emerged as a mighty warrior and battled Set for control of the world.

claims.quote: Isis took the child in her arms and called each of the scorpions by their secret name, thereby dominating them and neutralizing their power, and recited spells of great magic. The poison evaporated, leaving the child's body, and he revived.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Isis dan Tujuh Kalajengking, Isis memanggil tiap kalajengking dengan nama rahasianya sehingga menundukkan mereka, melafalkan mantra sihir agung, dan racun lenyap dari tubuh anak itu sehingga ia sadar kembali.
statement.en: In the story of Isis and the Seven Scorpions, Isis called each scorpion by its secret name, dominating them, and recited spells of great magic; the poison left the child's body and he revived.

claims.quote: The story relates how, when Horus was an infant and Isis was hiding him in the swamp lands from Set, seven scorpions kept her company. She would sometimes go out in the evenings for food, and the scorpions would form a kind of bodyguard around her.

statement.id: Ketika Horus masih bayi dan Isis menyembunyikannya di rawa dari Set, tujuh kalajengking menemaninya dan membentuk semacam pengawal di sekelilingnya saat ia keluar mencari makan pada malam hari.
statement.en: When Horus was an infant and Isis was hiding him in the swamp from Set, seven scorpions kept her company and formed a kind of bodyguard around her when she went out for food in the evenings.

claims.quote: When Alexander the Great (l. 356-323 BCE) conquered Egypt in 331 BCE his troops associated Isis with the popular Greek goddess Demeter.

statement.id: Ketika Aleksander Agung menaklukkan Mesir pada 331 SM, pasukannya mengaitkan Isis dengan dewi Yunani Demeter.
statement.en: When Alexander the Great conquered Egypt in 331 BCE his troops associated Isis with the Greek goddess Demeter.

claims.quote: under the reign of Caligula (r. 37-41 CE) the worship of Isis in Rome was firmly established by the emperor through the Isiac Festival in her honor.

statement.id: Pada masa Caligula (37-41 M) pemujaan Isis di Roma dikukuhkan oleh kaisar lewat Festival Isiak.
statement.en: Under Caligula (37-41 CE) the worship of Isis in Rome was firmly established by the emperor through the Isiac Festival in her honor.

claims.quote: A temple of Isis has been found in Pompeii, and another in Great Britain at the Roman site of Londinium (modern London).

statement.id: Kuil Isis ditemukan di Pompeii dan di situs Romawi Londinium (London modern) di Britania Raya.
statement.en: A temple of Isis has been found in Pompeii, and another at the Roman site of Londinium (modern London) in Great Britain.

claims.quote: Her cult in Rome was the greatest rival to the young religion of Christianity, which drew upon the image of Isis and the child-god Horus for the depiction of the Madonna with the Christ child.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, kultus Isis di Roma adalah saingan terbesar agama Kristen yang masih muda, yang meminjam citra Isis dan Horus kecil untuk penggambaran Madonna dengan bayi Kristus.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, her cult in Rome was the greatest rival of the young Christian religion, which drew on the image of Isis and the child-god Horus for the Madonna with the Christ child.

claims.quote: Philae continued as a vital site dedicated to Isis until the emperor Justinian closed it, along with other important centers of learning and worship in 529 CE.

statement.id: Philae tetap menjadi situs penting bagi Isis hingga kaisar Justinian menutupnya pada 529 M.
statement.en: Philae continued as a vital site dedicated to Isis until the emperor Justinian closed it in 529 CE.

claims.quote: Nephthys was never depicted as evil to Isis' good but was associated with death while Isis with life and so these two sister-deities symbolized cosmic balance.

statement.id: Nephthys tidak pernah digambarkan jahat bagi Isis yang baik, melainkan dikaitkan dengan kematian sedangkan Isis dengan kehidupan, sehingga kedua dewi bersaudari itu melambangkan keseimbangan kosmis.
statement.en: Nephthys was never depicted as evil to Isis's good but was associated with death while Isis was associated with life, so the two sister-deities symbolized cosmic balance.

claims.quote: She and her husband and son replaced the Theban Triad of Amon, Mut, and Khons, who had been the most popular trinity of gods in Egypt.

statement.id: Isis bersama suami dan putranya menggantikan Triad Thebes (Amon, Mut, dan Khons), trinitas dewa yang paling populer di Mesir.
statement.en: Isis, her husband, and her son replaced the Theban Triad of Amon, Mut, and Khons, the most popular trinity of gods in Egypt.

claims.quote: As the goddess who brought the yearly inundation of the Nile which fertilized the land she was Sati, for example, and as the goddess who created and preserved life she was Ankhet, and so on.

statement.id: Sebagai dewi pembawa banjir tahunan Sungai Nil yang menyuburkan tanah ia disebut Sati, dan sebagai dewi yang menciptakan dan memelihara kehidupan ia disebut Ankhet.
statement.en: As the goddess who brought the yearly Nile inundation that fertilized the land she was Sati, and as the goddess who created and preserved life she was Ankhet.

claims.quote: She is regularly portrayed as the selfless, giving, mother, wife, and protectress, who places other's interests and well-being ahead of her own.

statement.id: Isis biasanya digambarkan sebagai ibu, istri, dan pelindung yang tanpa pamrih, murah hati, dan mengutamakan kepentingan orang lain.
statement.en: Isis is regularly portrayed as a selfless, giving mother, wife, and protectress who puts others' interests and well-being ahead of her own.

claims.quote: Nut, however, was already pregnant by Geb and soon gave birth to five children: Osiris, Isis, Set, Nephthys, and Horus (known as Horus the Elder).

statement.id: Nut melahirkan lima anak dari Geb: Osiris, Isis, Set, Nephthys, dan Horus (Horus yang Tua).
statement.en: Nut gave birth to five children by Geb: Osiris, Isis, Set, Nephthys, and Horus (known as Horus the Elder).

claims.quote: Osiris married Isis and, as the first born, assumed rule as Lord of the Earth, with Isis as his queen and consort.

statement.id: Osiris menikahi Isis dan, sebagai anak sulung, memerintah sebagai Penguasa Bumi dengan Isis sebagai ratu dan pendampingnya.
statement.en: Osiris married Isis and, as the firstborn, ruled as Lord of the Earth with Isis as his queen and consort.

claims.quote: I am she that is the naturall mother of all things, mistresse and governesse of all the Elements, the initiall progeny of worlds, chiefe of powers divine, Queene of heaven!
claims.locator: Book 11, the goddess speaks to Lucius

statement.id: Dalam terjemahan Adlington atas karya Apuleius, sang dewi menyebut dirinya ibu alami segala sesuatu, penguasa semua unsur, keturunan awal dunia, pemimpin kuasa ilahi, dan Ratu Langit.
statement.en: In Adlington's translation of Apuleius, the goddess calls herself the natural mother of all things, mistress of all the elements, the initial progeny of worlds, chief of divine powers, and Queen of heaven.

claims.quote: at my will the planets of the ayre, the wholesome winds of the Seas, and the silences of hell be diposed
claims.locator: Book 11, the goddess speaks to Lucius

statement.id: Sang dewi dalam karya Apuleius menyatakan bahwa atas kehendaknya planet-planet langit, angin laut yang menyehatkan, dan kesunyian neraka diatur.
statement.en: In Apuleius's work the goddess declares that at her will the planets of the air, the wholesome winds of the seas, and the silences of hell are disposed.

claims.quote: for the Phrygians call me the mother of the Gods: the Athenians, Minerva: the Cyprians, Venus: the Candians, Diana: the Sicilians Proserpina: the Eleusians, Ceres: some Juno, other Bellona, other Hecate
claims.locator: Book 11, the goddess speaks to Lucius

statement.id: Dalam karya Apuleius sang dewi menyebut bahwa ia dipuja dengan banyak nama: bangsa Frigia menyebutnya ibu para dewa, orang Athena Minerva, orang Siprus Venus, dan seterusnya.
statement.en: In Apuleius's work the goddess says she is worshipped under many names: the Phrygians call her mother of the Gods, the Athenians Minerva, the Cyprians Venus, and so on.

claims.quote: and the Aegyptians which are excellent in all kind of ancient doctrine, and by their proper ceremonies accustome to worship mee, doe call mee Queene Isis.
claims.locator: Book 11, the goddess speaks to Lucius

statement.id: Dalam karya Apuleius, orang Mesir, yang unggul dalam segala ajaran kuno dan memujanya dengan upacara mereka sendiri, menyebutnya Ratu Isis.
statement.en: In Apuleius's work the Egyptians, excellent in all ancient doctrine and worshipping her with their own ceremonies, call her Queen Isis.

claims.quote: In her right hand shee had a timbrell of brasse, which gave a pleasant sound, in her left hand shee bare a cup of gold, out of the mouth whereof the serpent Aspis lifted up his head
claims.locator: Book 11, the vision of the goddess

statement.id: Dalam penglihatan di karya Apuleius, sang dewi memegang rebana kuningan di tangan kanan dan cawan emas di tangan kiri, dengan ular aspis mengangkat kepala dari mulut cawan.
statement.en: In the vision in Apuleius's work, the goddess holds a brass timbrel in her right hand and a golden cup in her left, from whose mouth a serpent, the asp, lifts its head.

claims.quote: Isis was a major goddess in ancient Egyptian religion whose worship spread throughout the Greco-Roman world.

statement.id: Isis adalah dewi utama dalam agama Mesir kuno yang pemujaannya menyebar ke seluruh dunia Yunani-Romawi.
statement.en: Isis was a major goddess in ancient Egyptian religion whose worship spread throughout the Greco-Roman world.

claims.quote: Her reputed magical power was greater than that of all other gods, and she was said to govern the natural world and wield power over fate itself.

statement.id: Kekuatan sihirnya konon lebih besar daripada semua dewa lain, dan ia dikatakan mengatur alam dan berkuasa atas takdir.
statement.en: Her reputed magical power was greater than that of all other gods, and she was said to govern the natural world and wield power over fate itself.

claims.quote: In one spell, Isis creates a snake that bites Ra, who is older and greater than she is, and makes him ill with its venom. She offers to cure Ra if he will tell her his true, secret name

statement.id: Dalam salah satu mantra, Isis menciptakan ular yang menggigit Ra dan membuatnya sakit dengan bisanya, lalu menawarkan menyembuhkannya jika Ra mau menyebut nama rahasianya yang sejati.
statement.en: In one spell Isis creates a snake that bites Ra and makes him ill with its venom, then offers to cure him if he tells her his true, secret name.

claims.quote: In later texts, she uses her powers of transformation to fight and destroy Set and his followers.

statement.id: Dalam teks-teks kemudian, Isis memakai kekuatan perubahan wujudnya untuk melawan dan menghancurkan Set dan para pengikutnya.
statement.en: In later texts Isis uses her powers of transformation to fight and destroy Set and his followers.

claims.quote: She was believed to help the dead enter the afterlife as she had helped Osiris, and she was considered the divine mother of the pharaoh, who was likened to Horus. Her maternal aid was invoked in healing spells to benefit ordinary people.

statement.id: Isis dipercaya membantu orang mati memasuki alam baka seperti ia menolong Osiris, dianggap ibu ilahi firaun, dan bantuannya dipanggil dalam mantra penyembuhan bagi orang biasa.
statement.en: Isis was believed to help the dead enter the afterlife as she had helped Osiris, was considered the divine mother of the pharaoh, and her maternal aid was invoked in healing spells for ordinary people.

claims.quote: neither Isis nor her husband Osiris were mentioned by name before the Fifth Dynasty (c. 2494-2345 BCE).

statement.id: Baik Isis maupun suaminya Osiris tidak disebut namanya sebelum Dinasti Kelima (sekitar 2494-2345 SM).
statement.en: Neither Isis nor her husband Osiris were mentioned by name before the Fifth Dynasty (c. 2494-2345 BCE).

claims.quote: During the New Kingdom (c. 1550 - c. 1070 BCE), Isis took on traits that originally belonged to Hathor, the preeminent goddess of earlier time.

statement.id: Pada Kerajaan Baru (sekitar 1550-1070 SM), Isis mengambil sifat yang semula milik Hathor, dewi terkemuka masa sebelumnya.
statement.en: During the New Kingdom (c. 1550-1070 BCE) Isis took on traits that originally belonged to Hathor, the preeminent goddess of an earlier time.

claims.quote: Her Egyptian name was written as 𓊨𓏏𓐰𓆇𓁐 (ꜣst)

statement.id: Nama Mesir Isis ditulis 𓊨𓏏𓐰𓆇𓁐 (ꜣst).
statement.en: Isis's Egyptian name was written 𓊨𓏏𓐰𓆇𓁐 (ꜣst).

claims.quote: Therefore, the Egyptologist Kurt Sethe suggested she was originally a personification of thrones.

statement.id: Egiptolog Kurt Sethe mengusulkan bahwa Isis semula adalah personifikasi takhta.
statement.en: The Egyptologist Kurt Sethe suggested she was originally a personification of thrones.

claims.quote: Other scholars, such as Jürgen Osing and Klaus P. Kuhlmann, have disputed this interpretation, because of dissimilarities between Isis's name and the word for a throne or a lack of evidence that the throne was ever deified.

statement.id: Sarjana lain, seperti Jürgen Osing dan Klaus P. Kuhlmann, menolak tafsir itu karena perbedaan antara nama Isis dan kata untuk takhta, atau kurangnya bukti bahwa takhta pernah diilahikan.
statement.en: Other scholars, such as Jürgen Osing and Klaus P. Kuhlmann, dispute this interpretation because of dissimilarities between Isis's name and the word for a throne, or a lack of evidence that the throne was ever deified.

claims.quote: Isis continues to appear in Western culture, particularly in esotericism and modern paganism, often as a personification of nature or the feminine aspect of divinity.

statement.id: Isis terus muncul dalam budaya Barat, khususnya dalam esoterisme dan paganisme modern, sering sebagai personifikasi alam atau sisi feminin keilahian.
statement.en: Isis continues to appear in Western culture, particularly in esotericism and modern paganism, often as a personification of nature or the feminine aspect of divinity.

claims.quote: Isis's Greek devotees ascribed to her traits taken from Greek deities, such as the invention of marriage and the protection of ships at sea.

statement.id: Para pemuja Yunani Isis mengaitkan dengannya sifat dari dewa Yunani, seperti penemuan pernikahan dan perlindungan kapal di laut.
statement.en: Isis's Greek devotees ascribed to her traits taken from Greek deities, such as the invention of marriage and the protection of ships at sea.

claims.quote: Her worship may have influenced Christian beliefs and practices such as the veneration of Mary, but the evidence for this influence is ambiguous and often controversial.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, pemujaan Isis mungkin memengaruhi kepercayaan dan praktik Kristen seperti penghormatan kepada Maria, tetapi bukti pengaruh itu tidak jelas dan sering diperdebatkan.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, her worship may have influenced Christian beliefs and practices such as the veneration of Mary, but the evidence for this influence is ambiguous and often controversial.

claims.quote: Isis became the goddess of all the people of Egypt, male and female, royal and common, alike.

statement.id: Isis menjadi dewi seluruh rakyat Mesir, laki-laki dan perempuan, bangsawan dan rakyat biasa.
statement.en: Isis became the goddess of all the people of Egypt, male and female, royal and common alike.

summary.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, namanya berasal dari Eset, "tempat duduk", yang merujuk pada kestabilan dan takhta Mesir.
summary.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, her name comes from Eset, "the seat", referring to stability and the throne of Egypt.

summary.id: Egiptolog Kurt Sethe mengusulkan Isis semula personifikasi takhta.
summary.en: The Egyptologist Kurt Sethe suggested Isis was originally a personification of thrones.

summary.id: Jürgen Osing dan Klaus P. Kuhlmann menolak tafsir itu karena perbedaan nama dan kata takhta serta kurangnya bukti takhta pernah diilahikan.
summary.en: Jürgen Osing and Klaus P. Kuhlmann dispute it because of dissimilarities between the name and the word for throne and a lack of evidence that the throne was deified.

summary.id: World History Encyclopedia menyebut agama Kristen meminjam citra Isis dan Horus untuk penggambaran Madonna dengan bayi Kristus.
summary.en: World History Encyclopedia says Christianity drew on the image of Isis and Horus for the Madonna with the Christ child.

summary.id: Wikipedia menyebut pengaruhnya mungkin ada, tetapi buktinya tidak jelas dan sering diperdebatkan.
summary.en: Wikipedia says influence is possible, but the evidence is ambiguous and often controversial.

gaps.searched: Sesuai instruksi tugas pengayaan, tidak ada gambar yang ditambahkan; entri ini tidak memuat gambar.

Wikipedia hanya menyebut Isis muncul dalam karya fiksi "seperti waralaba superhero" tanpa judul, dan karya bernama yang disebut (Sethos 1731, The Magic Flute 1791, Isis Unveiled 1877) bukan abad ke-20-21; tidak ada karya modern bernama yang dikutip.

short_description.id: Gaia adalah dewi purba dan perwujudan Bumi dalam mitologi Yunani, ibu para dewa, Titan, dan Raksasa, penasihat Zeus, dan dalam satu tradisi pemilik awal orakel Delphi.
short_description.en: Gaia is the primordial Earth goddess of Greek myth, mother of gods, Titans and Giants, adviser to Zeus, and in one tradition the original owner of the Delphic oracle.

long_description.id: Gaia adalah dewi bumi dan perwujudan Bumi dalam mitologi Yunani. Dalam Theogony Hesiod ia muncul setelah Chaos, lalu melahirkan Langit, pegunungan (Ourea), dan Pontus. Bersama Uranus ia menjadi ibu dua belas Titan, serta Cyclopes dan tiga putra bernama Cottus, Briareos, dan Gyes, yaitu para Hecatoncheires. Theoi menyebutnya ibu agung seluruh ciptaan, dan padanan Romawi Gaia adalah Terra Mater atau Tellus Mater.
long_description.en: Gaia is the goddess of the earth and personifies it in Greek myth. In Hesiod's Theogony she appears after Chaos and bears Heaven, the mountains (Ourea), and Pontus. With Uranus she becomes mother of the twelve Titans, as well as the Cyclopes and three sons named Cottus, Briareos and Gyes, the Hecatoncheires. Theoi calls her the great mother of all creation, and her Roman equivalent is Terra Mater or Tellus Mater.

long_description.id: Gaia menentang Uranus karena menyembunyikan anak-anak mereka. Menurut Hesiod ia membuat sabit dari batu api dan menyerahkannya kepada Cronos. Kemudian ia menyelamatkan Zeus yang masih bayi dengan menyembunyikannya di sebuah gua dan memberi Cronos sebuah batu sebagai gantinya, lalu menasihati Zeus agar membebaskan Hekatonkheires dan Cyclopes dalam perang melawan para Titan.
long_description.en: Gaia opposed Uranus for hiding their children. According to Hesiod she made a sickle of flint and gave it to Cronos. She later saved the infant Zeus by hiding him in a cave and giving Cronos a stone instead, and advised Zeus to free the Hecatoncheires and Cyclopes in the war against the Titans.

long_description.id: Setelah para Titan kalah, Gaia mengirim para Raksasa melawan dewa Olimpus; kisah lain menyebutnya juga ibu Typhon bersama Tartarus. Menurut Theoi, usahanya menggulingkan Zeus melalui para Raksasa dan Typhoeus gagal. Sebuah orakel menyebut ramuan ajaib yang akan membuat seorang fana kebal; Gaia mencarinya, tetapi Zeus mencegahnya menemukan ramuan itu.
long_description.en: After the Titans fell, Gaia sent the Giants against the Olympian gods; another tale also makes her mother of Typhon with Tartarus. According to Theoi her attempts to overthrow Zeus through the Giants and Typhoeus failed. An oracle named a magic herb that would make a mortal invulnerable; Gaia searched for it, but Zeus prevented her from finding it.

long_description.id: Gaia dipandang sebagai dewi peramal. Orakel Delphi, menurut satu tradisi, semula milik Gaia, yang kemudian menyerahkannya kepada putri-putrinya; tradisi lain menyebut Apollo merebutnya. Ia dipuja luas, dipanggil dalam sumpah, dan digambarkan dalam seni vas sebagai perempuan berdada besar yang muncul dari bumi.
long_description.en: Gaia was regarded as an oracular goddess. The Delphic oracle, in one tradition, originally belonged to Gaia, who later handed it to her daughters; another tradition says Apollo stole it. She was widely worshipped, invoked in oaths, and shown in vase painting as a buxom woman rising from the earth.

cultural_context.id: Menurut Theoi, pemujaan Gaia tampaknya meluas di kalangan bangsa Yunani; domba hitam dikurbankan kepadanya dan ia dipanggil dalam sumpah.
cultural_context.en: According to Theoi, the worship of Gaia appears to have been universal among the Greeks; black sheep were sacrificed to her and she was invoked in oaths.

who.id: Gaia adalah dewi purba yang merupakan perwujudan Bumi.
who.en: Gaia is the primordial goddess who personifies Earth.

origin.id: Dalam Theogony Hesiod ia muncul dari Chaos, meski tradisi Orfik menyebut asal lain.
origin.en: In Hesiod's Theogony she emerges from Chaos, though the Orphic tradition gives another origin.

role.id: Ia ibu para dewa, Titan, dan Raksasa, penasihat Zeus, dan dewi peramal.
role.en: She is mother of gods, Titans and Giants, adviser to Zeus, and an oracular goddess.

famous_for.id: Gaia paling dikenal sebagai ibu agung dan karena perannya dalam pergantian kekuasaan para dewa.
famous_for.en: Gaia is best known as the great mother and for her part in the succession of the gods.

did_you_know.id: Gaia tetap memiliki tempat ramalan di Aegeira di Akhaia, tempat pendetanya meminum darah banteng, bahkan setelah Delphi lepas dari tangannya.
did_you_know.en: Gaia kept an oracle seat at Aegeira in Achaea, where her priestess drank bull's blood, even after Delphi passed from her hands.

description.id: Gaia melahirkan Langit, pegunungan, dan Pontus, lalu Titan, Cyclopes, Hecatoncheires, Erinyes, dan Raksasa; Theoi menyebutnya ibu agung seluruh ciptaan.
description.en: Gaia bore Heaven, the mountains, and Pontus, then Titans, Cyclopes, Hecatoncheires, Erinyes and Giants; Theoi calls her the great mother of all creation.

description.id: Gaia dianggap dewi peramal; ia meramalkan Cronus akan digulingkan putranya dan bahwa Zeus akan mempunyai anak yang kuat, dan Cronos mengetahui takdirnya darinya dan dari Langit.
description.en: Gaia was regarded as an oracular goddess; she foretold that Cronus would be overthrown by his son and that Zeus would have a strong child, and Cronos learned his fate from her and Heaven.

name.en: Forging a weapon and devising plans

description.id: Gaia membuat sabit besar dari batu api kelabu, menceritakan rencananya kepada putra-putranya, dan menyembunyikan Cronos dalam penyergapan.
description.en: Gaia made a great sickle of grey flint, told her plan to her sons, and hid Cronos in an ambush.

description.id: Gaia menolong Rhea melarikan diri ke Kreta dan menyembunyikan Zeus dalam gua, sementara Cronos diberi batu berbalut kain.
description.en: Gaia helped Rhea escape to Crete and hid Zeus in a cave while Cronos was given a swaddled stone.

description.id: Menurut sebagian penulis, Gaia mengubah Daphne menjadi pohon salam untuk menyelamatkannya.
description.en: According to some writers, Gaia transformed Daphne into a laurel tree to save her.

description.id: Gaia memberi Zeus dan Hera apel emas dari pohon ajaib yang memberi keabadian kepada pemiliknya.
description.en: Gaia gave Zeus and Hera golden apples from a magical tree that granted immortality to their owner.

description.id: Gaia mengirim para Raksasa, yang tak tertandingi dalam ukuran dan kekuatan, melawan para dewa Olimpus, dan melahirkan Typhon, monster terbesar yang pernah lahir.
description.en: Gaia sent the Giants, unmatched in size and strength, against the Olympian gods and bore Typhon, the biggest monster ever born.

description.id: Menurut Theoi, baik para Raksasa maupun Typhoeus yang ia lahirkan untuk menggulingkan Zeus gagal; Zeus juga mencegahnya menemukan ramuan ajaib yang akan membuat seorang fana kebal.
description.en: According to Theoi, neither the Giants nor Typhoeus whom she birthed to overthrow Zeus succeeded; Zeus also prevented her from finding the magic herb that would make a mortal invulnerable.

description.id: Dalam Orfisme, Gaia dan Uranus lahir dari Phanes, dan Himne Orfik menyebutnya "ibu manusia" serta pemberi makan dan pemberi segalanya.
description.en: In Orphism Gaia and Uranus come from Phanes, and the Orphic Hymn calls her the "mother of men" and the nourisher and giver of all.

description.id: Dalam satu tradisi orakel Delphi semula milik Gaia; setelah melepaskannya ia masih dimintai ramalan di Aegeira.
description.en: In one tradition the Delphic oracle originally belonged to Gaia; after giving it up she was still consulted at Aegeira.

role.id: Gaia merancang dan membantu rencana melawan Uranus.
role.en: Gaia devises and aids the plan against Uranus.

summary.id: Gaia, yang terhimpit karena anak-anaknya disembunyikan, membuat sabit, membujuk putra-putranya, dan menyembunyikan Cronos hingga ia menyerang Uranus. Dari tetesan darah itu, Gaia melahirkan Erinyes dan para Raksasa.
summary.en: Gaia, straitened by her hidden children, made a sickle, urged her sons, and hid Cronos until he struck Uranus. From the drops of blood she bore the Erinyes and the Giants.

title.en: The birth and rescue of Zeus

role.id: Gaia melindungi Zeus dari Cronos.
role.en: Gaia protects Zeus from Cronos.

summary.id: Cronos diberi tahu bahwa ia akan dikalahkan putranya, sehingga menelan anak-anaknya. Rhea meminta bantuan Gaia, yang menyembunyikan Zeus dalam gua dan memberi Cronos batu berbalut kain.
summary.en: Cronos learned he would be overcome by his son and swallowed his children. Rhea sought Gaia's help, and Gaia hid Zeus in a cave and gave Cronos a swaddled stone.

role.id: Gaia menasihati Zeus.
role.en: Gaia advises Zeus.

summary.id: Pada tahun kesepuluh perang, Gaia memberi tahu Zeus agar membebaskan Hecatoncheires dan Cyclopes dari Tartarus untuk mengalahkan para Titan.
summary.en: In the tenth year of the war Gaia told Zeus to free the Hecatoncheires and Cyclopes from Tartarus to defeat the Titans.

role.id: Gaia melahirkan lawan bagi para dewa Olimpus.
role.en: Gaia brings forth opponents of the Olympian gods.

summary.id: Setelah para Titan dikalahkan, Gaia mengirim para Raksasa, lalu melahirkan Typhon bersama Tartarus. Zeus mencegahnya menemukan ramuan bagi pembantu fana, dan kedua upaya itu gagal.
summary.en: After the Titans were defeated Gaia sent the Giants and then bore Typhon with Tartarus. Zeus prevented her from finding the herb for a mortal helper, and both attempts failed.

role.id: Gaia adalah pemilik awal orakel dalam satu tradisi.
role.en: Gaia is the original owner of the oracle in one tradition.

summary.id: Orakel Delphi semula milik Gaia, yang menyerahkannya kepada putri-putrinya; tradisi lain menyebut Apollo merebutnya atau Gaia dan Poseidon berbagi orakel.
summary.en: The Delphic oracle originally belonged to Gaia, who handed it to her daughters; other traditions say Apollo took it or that Gaia and Poseidon shared it.

role.id: Gaia menyelamatkan Daphne dengan mengubahnya.
role.en: Gaia saves Daphne by transforming her.

summary.id: Menurut sebagian penulis, Daphne berseru minta tolong dan Gaia mengubahnya menjadi pohon salam untuk menyelamatkannya.
summary.en: According to some writers, Daphne cried out for help and Gaia transformed her into a laurel tree to save her.

description.id: Tempat orakel yang semula milik Gaia menurut satu tradisi.
description.en: Site of the oracle that originally belonged to Gaia in one tradition.

description.id: Tempat Gaia masih dimintai ramalan dan pendetanya meminum darah banteng.
description.en: Place where Gaia was still consulted as an oracle and her priestess drank bull's blood.

description.id: Gunung berhutan lebat, lokasi gua tempat Gaia menyembunyikan Zeus.
description.en: The thick-wooded mountain where Gaia hid Zeus in a cave.

description.id: Sebagian tempat yang menurut Theoi memiliki kuil atau altar Gaia.
description.en: Some of the places that had temples or altars of Gaia according to Theoi.

timeline.period: as early as the Homeric poems

description.id: Gaia tampil sebagai makhluk ilahi dan dipanggil dalam sumpah.
description.en: Gaia appears as a divine being and is invoked in oaths.

description.id: Menurut Hesiod, Gaia muncul dari Chaos.
description.en: According to Hesiod, Gaia emerged from Chaos.

note.id: Gaia dan Uranus menjadi orang tua para Titan.
note.en: Gaia and Uranus parented the Titans.

note.id: Gaia dikisahkan melahirkan Typhon bersama Tartarus.
note.en: Gaia was said to bear Typhon with Tartarus.

note.id: Gaia melahirkan Typhon dari persatuannya dengan Tartarus.
note.en: Gaia bore Typhon from her union with Tartarus.

note.id: Gaia melahirkan Pontus (Laut) dan kemudian melahirkan dewa-dewi laut bersamanya.
note.en: Gaia bore Pontus (Sea) and later bore the sea gods with him.

note.id: Cronus membantu Gaia melawan Uranus.
note.en: Cronus helped Gaia against Uranus.

note.id: Gaia menasihati Zeus melawan para Titan, tetapi kemudian melawan Zeus melalui para Raksasa dan Typhoeus.
note.en: Gaia advised Zeus against the Titans, but later opposed him through the Giants and Typhoeus.

note.id: Gaia menolong Rhea yang hamil melarikan diri ke Kreta.
note.en: Gaia helped the pregnant Rhea escape to Crete.

note.id: Menurut satu tradisi, Gaia menyerahkan orakel Delphi kepada putri-putrinya Themis dan Phoebe.
note.en: In one tradition Gaia handed the Delphic oracle to her daughters Themis and Phoebe.

note.id: Menurut satu tradisi, Gaia menyerahkan orakel Delphi kepada putri-putrinya Themis dan Phoebe.
note.en: In one tradition Gaia handed the Delphic oracle to her daughters Themis and Phoebe.

note.id: Padanan Romawi Gaia adalah Terra Mater atau Tellus Mater.
note.en: Gaia's Roman equivalent is Terra Mater or Tellus Mater.

note.id: Menurut sumber lain, Apollo merebut orakel Delphi dari Gaia setelah membunuh Python.
note.en: According to other sources, Apollo stole the Delphic oracle from Gaia after killing Python.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa Gaia digambarkan sebagai ibu para dewa sekaligus lawan para dewa langit?
learning_questions.en: Why is Gaia portrayed both as mother of the gods and as an opponent of the heavenly gods?

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana sumber-sumber yang berbeda menjelaskan siapa yang menguasai orakel Delphi?
learning_questions.en: How do the different sources explain who held the Delphic oracle?

learning_questions.id: Apa yang membedakan asal-usul Gaia menurut Hesiod dan menurut Orfisme?
learning_questions.en: What distinguishes Gaia's origin in Hesiod from that in Orphism?

sources.title: Hesiod, Theogony (translated by H. G. Evelyn-White)
sources.author: Hesiod

claims.quote: Gaia (also Gaea or Ge) is a primordial goddess and the personification of the Earth in Greek mythology.

statement.id: Gaia adalah dewi purba yang mempersonifikasikan Bumi dalam mitologi Yunani.
statement.en: Gaia is the primordial personification of Earth in Greek myth.

claims.quote: Gaia emerged from Chaos and is considered the supreme or mother goddess by immortals and mortals alike.

statement.id: Dalam satu kisah penciptaan, Gaia muncul setelah Chaos dan dipandang sebagai ibu para makhluk.
statement.en: In one creation account Gaia emerges from Chaos and is regarded as a mother goddess.

claims.quote: Her Roman equivalent is Terra Mater or Tellus Mater.

statement.id: Padanan Romawi Gaia ialah Terra Mater atau Tellus Mater.
statement.en: Gaia's Roman equivalent is Terra Mater or Tellus Mater.

claims.quote: Gaia emerged from Chaos (the great void) and gave birth to Uranus (Heaven), Ourea (Mountains), and Pontus (Sea).

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Gaia melahirkan Uranus, Ourea, dan Pontus.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, Gaia bore Uranus, Ourea, and Pontus.

claims.quote: She married her son Uranus, and together they had the 12 Titans

statement.id: Gaia dan Uranus adalah orang tua dua belas Titan.
statement.en: Gaia and Uranus parented the twelve Titans.

claims.quote: Uranus hated his children and hid them away out of sight in the depths of the earth. Gaia was heartbroken over how her children were being treated by their father and devised a plan to destroy him.

statement.id: Gaia menentang Uranus setelah ia menyembunyikan anak-anak mereka di kedalaman Bumi.
statement.en: Gaia opposed Uranus after he hid their children deep in Earth.

claims.quote: During the tenth year of the battle, Gaia gave council to Zeus and told him to free the Hecatoncheires and the Cyclopes from Tartarus

statement.id: Gaia menasihati Zeus membebaskan Hekatonkheires dan Cyclopes dalam perang melawan Titan.
statement.en: Gaia advised Zeus to free the Hecatoncheires and Cyclopes during the Titan war.

claims.quote: After the Titans were defeated and sent down to Tartarus by Zeus and the Olympian deities, Gaia sent her children, the Giants, to destroy the Olympians.

statement.id: Sesudah kekalahan Titan, Gaia mengirim para Raksasa melawan para dewa Olimpus.
statement.en: After the Titans' defeat, Gaia sent the Giants against the Olympian gods.

claims.quote: In revenge, Gaia lay with Tartarus and bore her youngest child, Typhon, the biggest monster ever born.

statement.id: Gaia dikisahkan melahirkan Typhon bersama Tartarus.
statement.en: Gaia was said to bear Typhon with Tartarus.

claims.quote: The Oracle at Delphi originally belonged to Gaia, who later handed over the rights to her daughters Themis and Phoebe

statement.id: Salah satu tradisi menyatakan orakel Delphi mula-mula milik Gaia.
statement.en: One tradition holds that the Delphic oracle originally belonged to Gaia.

claims.quote: In Greek vase painting Gaia was depicted as a buxom, matronly woman rising from the earth, inseparable from her native element.

statement.id: Pada lukisan vas Yunani, Gaia tampil sebagai perempuan dewasa yang muncul dari Bumi.
statement.en: Greek vase painting shows Gaia as a matronly woman rising from Earth.

claims.quote: Verily at the first Chaos came to be, but next wide-bosomed Earth

statement.id: Dalam Theogony Hesiod, mula-mula Chaos ada, lalu Bumi yang berdada lapang.
statement.en: In Hesiod's Theogony, Chaos came first, and next wide-bosomed Earth.

claims.quote: And Earth first bare starry Heaven, equal to herself, to cover her on every side, and to be an ever-sure abiding-place for the blessed gods.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi pertama-tama melahirkan Langit berbintang yang setara dengannya, untuk menutupinya dari segala sisi dan menjadi tempat tinggal para dewa.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, Earth first bore starry Heaven, equal to herself, to cover her on every side and be an abiding place for the blessed gods.

claims.quote: But vast Earth groaned within, being straitened, and she made the element of grey flint and shaped a great sickle, and told her plan to her dear sons.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi yang terhimpit mengerang, membuat sabit besar dari batu api kelabu, dan menceritakan rencananya kepada putra-putranya.
statement.en: In Hesiod, a straitened Earth groaned, made a great sickle from grey flint, and told her plan to her sons.

claims.quote: But great Cronos the wily took courage and answered his dear mother ... vast Earth rejoiced greatly in spirit, and set and hid him in an ambush, and put in his hands a jagged sickle, and revealed to him the whole plot.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Cronos yang licik menjawab ibunya dengan berani, lalu Bumi bersukacita, menyembunyikannya dalam penyergapan, memberinya sabit bergerigi, dan menyingkapkan seluruh rencana kepadanya.
statement.en: In Hesiod, the wily Cronos took courage and answered his mother, and Earth rejoiced, hid him in an ambush, put a jagged sickle in his hands, and revealed the whole plot to him.

claims.quote: all the bloody drops that gushed forth Earth received, and as the seasons moved round she bare the strong Erinyes and the great Giants with gleaming armour

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi menerima tetesan darah itu dan kemudian melahirkan Erinyes yang kuat dan para Raksasa besar berbaju zirah berkilau.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, Earth received the drops of blood and later bore the strong Erinyes and the great Giants with gleaming armour.

claims.quote: These great Cronos swallowed as each came forth from the womb to his mother's knees with this intent, that no other of the proud sons of Heaven should hold the kingly office amongst the deathless gods. For he learned from Earth and starry Heaven that he was destined to be overcome by his own son, strong though he was, through the contriving of great Zeus.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Cronos menelan anak-anaknya begitu lahir karena ia mengetahui dari Bumi dan Langit berbintang bahwa ia ditakdirkan dikalahkan oleh putranya sendiri.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, Cronos swallowed his children as each was born because he learned from Earth and starry Heaven that he was destined to be overcome by his own son.

claims.quote: Zeus, the youngest of her children. Him did vast Earth receive from Rhea in wide Crete to nourish and to bring up. Thither came Earth carrying him swiftly through the black night to Lyctus first, and took him in her arms and hid him in a remote cave beneath the secret places of the holy earth on thick-wooded Mount Aegeum

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi membawa Zeus melintasi malam gelap dan menyembunyikannya dalam gua terpencil di Gunung Aegeum.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, Earth carried Zeus through the black night and hid him in a remote cave on Mount Aegeum.

claims.quote: but to the mightily ruling son of Heaven, the earlier king of the gods, she gave a great stone wrapped in swaddling clothes.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi memberikan sebongkah batu besar berbalut kain kepada putra Langit yang berkuasa, raja para dewa terdahulu.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, Earth gave a great stone wrapped in swaddling clothes to the mightily ruling son of Heaven, the earlier king of the gods.

claims.quote: great Cronos the wily was beguiled by the deep suggestions of Earth, and brought up again his offspring

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Cronos yang licik terperdaya oleh bujukan Bumi dan memuntahkan kembali anak-anaknya.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, the wily Cronos was beguiled by Earth's deep suggestions and brought up his offspring again.

claims.quote: brought them up again to the light at Earth's advising. For she herself recounted all things to the gods fully, how that with these they would gain victory and a glorious cause to vaunt themselves.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, para dewa membawa mereka naik kembali ke cahaya atas nasihat Bumi, yang menjelaskan bahwa dengan mereka para dewa akan menang.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, the gods brought them up again to the light at Earth's advising; she explained that with them the gods would gain victory.

claims.quote: huge Earth bare her youngest child Typhoeus of the love of Tartarus, by the aid of golden Aphrodite.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi melahirkan anak bungsunya, Typhoeus, dari cinta Tartarus.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, Earth bore her youngest child Typhoeus from the love of Tartarus.

claims.quote: three other sons were born of Earth and Heaven, great and doughty beyond telling, Cottus and Briareos and Gyes, presumptuous children.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi dan Langit melahirkan tiga putra lain yang luar biasa besar dan gagah, yaitu Cottus, Briareos, dan Gyes.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, three other sons were born of Earth and Heaven, great and doughty beyond telling: Cottus, Briareos and Gyes.

claims.quote: GAIA (Gaea) was the goddess of the earth.

statement.id: Gaia adalah dewi bumi.
statement.en: Gaia was the goddess of the earth.

claims.quote: Gaia was the great mother of all creation--the heavenly gods were descended from her through her union with Ouranos (Uranus) (Sky), the sea-gods from her union with Pontos (Sea), the Gigantes (Giants) from her mating with Tartaros (the Pit), and mortal creatures born directly from her earthy flesh.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, Gaia adalah ibu agung seluruh ciptaan: para dewa langit lahir dari persatuannya dengan Ouranos, dewa laut dari Pontos, para Raksasa dari Tartaros, dan makhluk fana langsung dari dagingnya.
statement.en: According to Theoi, Gaia was the great mother of all creation: the heavenly gods came from her union with Ouranos, the sea-gods from Pontos, the Giants from Tartaros, and mortal creatures directly from her flesh.

claims.quote: Gaia was the chief antagonist of the heavenly gods. First she rebelled against her husband Ouranos (Sky) who had imprisoned several of her giant-sons within her womb.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, Gaia adalah lawan utama para dewa langit; pertama-tama ia memberontak melawan suaminya, Ouranos, yang memenjarakan putra-putra raksasanya dalam rahimnya.
statement.en: According to Theoi, Gaia was the chief antagonist of the heavenly gods; first she rebelled against her husband Ouranos, who had imprisoned several of her giant-sons within her womb.

claims.quote: She birthed a tribe of Gigantes (Giants) and later the monster Typhoeus to overthrow him, but both failed in their attempts.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, Gaia melahirkan suku Raksasa dan kemudian monster Typhoeus untuk menggulingkan Zeus, tetapi keduanya gagal.
statement.en: According to Theoi, Gaia birthed a tribe of Giants and later the monster Typhoeus to overthrow Zeus, but both failed.

claims.quote: She appears in the character of a divine being as early as the Homeric poems, for we read in the Iliad (iii. 104) that black sheep were sacrificed to her, and that she was invoked by persons taking oaths.

statement.id: Gaia tampil sebagai makhluk ilahi sejak puisi-puisi Homeros; dalam Iliad domba hitam dikurbankan kepadanya dan ia dipanggil dalam sumpah.
statement.en: Gaia appears as a divine being as early as the Homeric poems; in the Iliad black sheep were sacrificed to her and she was invoked in oaths.

claims.quote: As Ge was the source from which arose the vapours producing divine inspiration, she herself also was regarded as an oracular divinity

statement.id: Karena Ge dipandang sebagai sumber uap yang menimbulkan ilham ilahi, ia sendiri juga dianggap dewi peramal.
statement.en: Because Ge was seen as the source of the vapours producing divine inspiration, she herself was also regarded as an oracular divinity.

claims.quote: Her worship appears to have been universal among the Greeks, and she had temples or altars at Athens, Sparta, Delphi, Olympia, Bura, Tegea, Phlyus, and other places.

statement.id: Pemujaan Gaia tampaknya meluas di kalangan bangsa Yunani, dengan kuil atau altar di Athena, Sparta, Delphi, Olympia, Bura, Tegea, Phlyus, dan tempat lain.
statement.en: Her worship appears to have been universal among the Greeks, with temples or altars at Athens, Sparta, Delphi, Olympia, Bura, Tegea, Phlyus and other places.

claims.quote: Gaia also bore the three one-eyed Cyclopes (Brontes, Arges, and Steropes) and the three Hecatoncheires, the hundred-handed and fifty-headed Giants (Kottos, Gyes, and Briareus).

statement.id: Gaia juga melahirkan tiga Cyclopes bermata satu dan tiga Hecatoncheires, raksasa berlengan seratus dan berkepala lima puluh.
statement.en: Gaia also bore the three one-eyed Cyclopes and the three Hecatoncheires, the hundred-handed and fifty-headed Giants.

claims.quote: With Pontus, Gaia gave birth to the sea gods and goddesses Thaumas, Phorcys, Ceto, and Eurybia.

statement.id: Bersama Pontus, Gaia melahirkan dewa-dewi laut Thaumas, Phorcys, Ceto, dan Eurybia.
statement.en: With Pontus, Gaia gave birth to the sea gods and goddesses Thaumas, Phorcys, Ceto, and Eurybia.

claims.quote: A pregnant Rhea approached Gaia for help, and Gaia helped her escape to Crete, where she gave birth to Zeus.

statement.id: Rhea yang hamil meminta bantuan Gaia, yang menolongnya melarikan diri ke Kreta tempat ia melahirkan Zeus.
statement.en: A pregnant Rhea approached Gaia for help, and Gaia helped her escape to Crete, where she gave birth to Zeus.

claims.quote: Just as Gaia foretold that Cronus would be overthrown by his son, she also prophecised that Zeus and his wife Metis would have a daughter who would be strong and wise like her father and a son who would become king of the gods in Zeus' place.

statement.id: Gaia meramalkan bahwa Cronus akan digulingkan putranya dan bahwa Zeus dan Metis akan mempunyai seorang putri yang kuat dan bijak serta seorang putra yang menjadi raja para dewa.
statement.en: Gaia foretold that Cronus would be overthrown by his son and prophesied that Zeus and Metis would have a strong, wise daughter and a son who would become king of the gods.

claims.quote: An oracle told the Olympian gods that they could not defeat the Giants on their own but needed the help of a mortal who would be made invulnerable by a magic herb. Once Gaia learned of this prophecy, she searched for the herb. However, Zeus prevented her from finding the herb

statement.id: Sebuah orakel menyebut para dewa memerlukan seorang fana yang dibuat kebal oleh ramuan ajaib untuk mengalahkan para Raksasa; Gaia mencari ramuan itu, tetapi Zeus mencegahnya menemukannya.
statement.en: An oracle said the gods needed a mortal made invulnerable by a magic herb to defeat the Giants; Gaia searched for the herb, but Zeus prevented her from finding it.

claims.quote: The Giants were unmatched in size and strength and fearful to behold, with feet made from dragon scales and long hair hanging from their head and cheeks.

statement.id: Para Raksasa tak tertandingi dalam ukuran dan kekuatan, menakutkan, berkaki bersisik naga dan berambut panjang.
statement.en: The Giants were unmatched in size and strength and fearful to behold, with feet of dragon scales and long hair.

claims.quote: Gaia gave them a gift of golden apples, which grew on a magical tree and granted immortality to anyone who was in possession of them.

statement.id: Gaia memberi Zeus dan Hera hadiah apel emas dari pohon ajaib yang memberi keabadian kepada siapa pun yang memilikinya.
statement.en: Gaia gave Zeus and Hera golden apples from a magical tree that granted immortality to anyone who possessed them.

claims.quote: she cried out for help. Gaia transformed her into a laurel tree to save her.

statement.id: Menurut sebagian penulis, Gaia mengubah Daphne menjadi pohon salam untuk menyelamatkannya ketika ia berseru minta tolong.
statement.en: According to some writers, Gaia transformed Daphne into a laurel tree to save her when she cried out for help.

claims.quote: Other sources say that Apollo stole the oracle from Gaia after killing Python, the serpent who guarded the Delphic Oracle.

statement.id: Sumber lain menyebut Apollo merebut orakel dari Gaia setelah membunuh Python, ular penjaga orakel Delphi.
statement.en: Other sources say Apollo stole the oracle from Gaia after killing Python, the serpent who guarded the Delphic Oracle.

claims.quote: According to the ancient poem Eumolpia, Gaia and Poseidon shared the oracle until Gaia gave her share to Themis.

statement.id: Menurut puisi kuno Eumolpia, Gaia dan Poseidon berbagi orakel itu sampai Gaia memberikan bagiannya kepada Themis.
statement.en: According to the ancient poem Eumolpia, Gaia and Poseidon shared the oracle until Gaia gave her share to Themis.

claims.quote: After giving up Delphi, Gaia was still consulted as an oracle at Aegeira in Achaea, where her priestess drank bull's blood.

statement.id: Setelah melepaskan Delphi, Gaia masih dimintai ramalan di Aegeira di Akhaia, tempat pendetanya meminum darah banteng.
statement.en: After giving up Delphi, Gaia was still consulted as an oracle at Aegeira in Achaea, where her priestess drank bull's blood.

claims.quote: Gaia has an Orphic Hymn dedicated to her, where she is referred to as the "mother of men" and the nourisher and giver of all.

statement.id: Gaia memiliki Himne Orfik yang didedikasikan kepadanya, yang menyebutnya "ibu manusia" serta pemberi makan dan pemberi segalanya.
statement.en: Gaia has an Orphic Hymn dedicated to her, calling her the "mother of men" and the nourisher and giver of all.

claims.quote: Phanes gave birth to Nyx (Night) and then had Gaia and Uranus with her.

statement.id: Menurut Orfisme, Phanes melahirkan Nyx dan kemudian memiliki Gaia dan Uranus bersamanya.
statement.en: According to Orphism, Phanes gave birth to Nyx and then had Gaia and Uranus with her.

claims.quote: According to Hesiod (c. 700 BCE) in his Theogony, Gaia emerged from Chaos

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod (sekitar 700 SM) dalam Theogony, Gaia muncul dari Chaos.
statement.en: According to Hesiod (c. 700 BCE) in his Theogony, Gaia emerged from Chaos.

claims.quote: In revenge, Gaia lay with Tartarus and bore her youngest child, Typhon, the biggest monster ever born.

statement.id: Sebagai balas dendam, Gaia berbaring bersama Tartarus dan melahirkan anak bungsunya, Typhon, monster terbesar yang pernah lahir.
statement.en: In revenge, Gaia lay with Tartarus and bore her youngest child, Typhon, the biggest monster ever born.

summary.id: Menurut Hesiod, Gaia muncul sesudah Chaos.
summary.en: According to Hesiod, Gaia emerged after Chaos.

summary.en: According to Orphism, Gaia and Uranus were born of Phanes.

summary.en: Theoi summarises that the Giants came from Gaia's mating with Tartaros.

summary.en: The oracle originally belonged to Gaia, who handed it to Themis and Phoebe.

text.id: Namanya tercatat sejak awal Periode Dinasti; penguasa pradinasti disebut "Pengikut Horus".
text.en: His name is attested from the beginning of the Dynastic Period; predynastic rulers were called "Followers of Horus".

short_description.id: Horus adalah dewa langit Mesir kuno berwujud elang, putra Isis dan Osiris yang mengalahkan Set dan dikaitkan dengan kerajaan.
short_description.en: Horus is an ancient Egyptian falcon-linked sky god, son of Isis and Osiris, who defeated Set and was bound to kingship.

long_description.id: Horus adalah nama dewa langit dalam mitologi Mesir kuno yang terutama merujuk pada dua dewa: Horus Tua dan Horus Muda. Horus Tua disebut sebagai anak bungsu dari lima dewa pertama dan saudara Osiris, Isis, Set, dan Nephthys, sedangkan Horus Muda adalah putra Osiris dan Isis yang mengalahkan Set serta memulihkan ketertiban negeri. Horus Tua juga disebut Horus Agung, atau Harwer dan Haroeris dalam bahasa Mesir.
long_description.en: Horus is a sky god of ancient Egyptian religion, and the name chiefly covers two deities: Horus the Elder and Horus the Younger. The Elder is described as the last born of the first five gods and as a sibling of Osiris, Isis, Set, and Nephthys, while the Younger is the son of Osiris and Isis who defeated Set and restored order to the land. The Elder is also called Horus the Great, or Harwer and Haroeris in Egyptian.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah tentang Horus Tua, Horus lahir dari persatuan Geb dan Nut, dan diberi tanggung jawab atas langit, khususnya matahari. Ia juga digambarkan sebagai dewa pencipta dan pelindung yang baik hati. Sebagai elang, ia dibayangkan dapat terbang jauh dari Ra lalu kembali membawa kabar penting. Dalam versi lain, Horus adalah putra Hathor, dan dalam versi lainnya Hathor adalah istrinya.
long_description.en: In the account of Horus the Elder, he was born of the union of Geb and Nut and was given charge of the sky, specifically the sun. He is also depicted as a creator god and benevolent protector. As a falcon he was imagined flying far from Ra and returning with vital information. In another version Horus is the son of Hathor, and in others Hathor is his wife.

long_description.id: Horus Muda dikaitkan terutama dengan matahari dan juga bulan. Ia dikenal sebagai pelindung kerajaan Mesir, pembalas kezaliman, pembela ketertiban, pemersatu dua negeri, dan dewa perang yang diseru para penguasa sebelum bertempur. Lambangnya adalah Mata Horus dan elang. Kelak ia berpadu dengan Ra menjadi Ra-Harahkhte, dewa matahari berkepala elang. Britannica 1911 menyebutnya dewa surya yang sangat awal muncul dalam lingkaran dewa Osiris dan lawan Set.
long_description.en: Horus the Younger was associated mainly with the sun and also with the moon. He was known as a protector of Egypt's royalty who avenged wrongs, upheld order, united the two lands, and, as a war god, was called upon by rulers before battle. His symbols are the Eye of Horus and the falcon. He later combined with Ra as Ra-Harahkhte, a falcon-headed sun god. Britannica 1911 calls him a solar divinity who appears very early in the Osiris cycle and an opponent of Set.

long_description.id: Menurut Mitos Osiris, Isis mengandung Horus dan melahirkannya seorang diri di rawa-rawa Delta. Pertarungan Horus melawan Set paling terkenal dalam naskah The Contendings of Horus and Set, yang menggambarkannya sebagai pengadilan di hadapan Ennead. Dalam pertarungan itu Horus kehilangan sebelah mata tetapi menang setiap kali. Setelah mengalahkan Set, ia dikenal sebagai Horu-Sema-Tawy, dan raja-raja Mesir memilih "Nama Horus" saat penobatan.
long_description.en: In the Osiris myth Isis conceived Horus and gave birth to him alone in the Delta swamps. The contest between Horus and Set is best known from The Contendings of Horus and Set, which presents it as a trial before the Ennead. In these battles Horus loses an eye but wins each time. After defeating Set he became known as Horu-Sema-Tawy, and Egyptian kings chose a "Horus Name" at their coronation.

long_description.id: Horus Muda juga disebut Horus Anak; dalam tradisi Yunani ia dikenal sebagai Harpokrates. Horus dikaitkan dengan akhirat melalui Empat Putranya yang melindungi organ vital orang yang meninggal, dan dalam adegan penghakiman ia memperkenalkan almarhum kepada Osiris. Ia disembah antara lain di Edfu dan Kom Ombo. Orang Yunani menyamakannya dengan Apollo. Firaun Nectanebo II sering menegaskan hubungan yang sangat dekat, bahkan penyatuan, antara dirinya dan Horus.
long_description.en: Horus the Younger was also called Horus the Child and became known as Harpocrates in Greek tradition. Through his Four Sons, who guarded the organs of the dead, Horus was tied to the afterlife, and in the judgment scene he presents the deceased to Osiris. He was worshipped at places including Edfu and Kom Ombos. The Greeks equated him with Apollo. The pharaoh Nectanebo II often claimed a very close connection, even a merging, between himself and Horus.

cultural_context.id: Sejak Periode Dinasti Awal Horus dikaitkan dengan raja Mesir, dan raja-raja memilih "Nama Horus" saat penobatan karena Horus dipandang sebagai pemulih ketertiban yang mengalahkan Set.
cultural_context.en: From the Early Dynastic Period Horus was linked with the king of Egypt, and kings chose a "Horus Name" at their coronation because Horus was seen as the one who restored order by defeating Set.

statement.en: The elder Horus is one of Egypt's oldest gods, born of the union of Geb (earth) and Nut (sky) shortly after the creation of the world.

claims.quote: In another version of the story, Horus is the son of Hathor while, in others, she is his wife and, sometimes, she is mother, wife, and daughter of Horus.

statement.id: Dalam versi lain, Horus adalah putra Hathor; dalam versi lainnya Hathor adalah istrinya, dan kadang ia ibu, istri, sekaligus putri Horus.
statement.en: In another version Horus is the son of Hathor; in others she is his wife, and sometimes she is mother, wife, and daughter of Horus.

claims.quote: Horus is also depicted as a creator god and benevolent protector.

statement.id: Horus juga digambarkan sebagai dewa pencipta dan pelindung yang baik hati.
statement.en: Horus is also depicted as a creator god and benevolent protector.

claims.quote: Imagined as a falcon, he could fly far from Ra and return with vital information and, in the same way, could quickly bring comfort to those in need.

statement.id: Dibayangkan sebagai elang, Horus dapat terbang jauh dari Ra dan kembali membawa kabar penting, dan dengan cara yang sama cepat memberi penghiburan bagi yang membutuhkan.
statement.en: Imagined as a falcon, Horus could fly far from Ra and return with vital information, and likewise quickly bring comfort to those in need.

claims.quote: From the Early Dynastic Period (c. 3150-c.2613 BCE) onwards, Horus was linked with the king of Egypt (though later rulers associated themselves with Horus the Younger).

statement.id: Sejak Periode Dinasti Awal (sekitar 3150-2613 SM), Horus dikaitkan dengan raja Mesir, meskipun penguasa kemudian mengaitkan diri dengan Horus Muda.
statement.en: From the Early Dynastic Period (c. 3150-c. 2613 BCE) onward Horus was linked with the king of Egypt, though later rulers associated themselves with Horus the Younger.

claims.quote: Prior to his departure, though, Isis transformed herself into a kite (a falcon) and flew around his body, drawing his seed into her own and becoming pregnant with Horus.
claims.locator: Horus the Younger & The Osiris Myth

statement.id: Menurut Mitos Osiris, sebelum Osiris pergi, Isis mengubah diri menjadi elang layang dan terbang mengitari tubuhnya hingga mengandung Horus.
statement.en: In the Osiris myth, before Osiris departed, Isis transformed herself into a kite and flew around his body, becoming pregnant with Horus.

claims.quote: The story of the battles between Horus and Set have many different versions but the best known is from a manuscript dating to the 20th Dynasty (1090-1077 BCE), The Contendings of Horus and Set which describes their contest as a legal trial in front of the Ennead, a tribunal of nine powerful gods.

statement.id: Kisah pertarungan Horus dan Set punya banyak versi; yang paling dikenal berasal dari naskah Dinasti ke-20 (1090-1077 SM), The Contendings of Horus and Set, yang menggambarkan perseteruan itu sebagai pengadilan di hadapan Ennead, dewan sembilan dewa.
statement.en: The battles of Horus and Set exist in many versions; the best known is from a 20th Dynasty manuscript (1090-1077 BCE), The Contendings of Horus and Set, which presents the contest as a trial before the Ennead, a tribunal of nine gods.

claims.quote: In the course of these battles, Horus loses an eye and Set is castrated (or, at least, severely damaged) but Horus is victorious each time.

statement.id: Dalam pertarungan itu Horus kehilangan sebelah mata dan Set dikebiri atau setidaknya terluka parah, tetapi Horus menang setiap kali.
statement.en: In these battles Horus loses an eye and Set is castrated or at least severely damaged, but Horus wins each time.

claims.quote: In another version of the story, the trial lasts for 80 years until the frustrated gods turn to the wise goddess Neith, mediator of disputes, who rules in favor of Horus.

statement.id: Dalam versi lain, sidang berlangsung 80 tahun hingga para dewa meminta putusan Neith, dewi penengah sengketa, yang memenangkan Horus.
statement.en: In another version the trial lasts 80 years until the gods turn to Neith, mediator of disputes, who rules in favor of Horus.

claims.quote: Set is then banished to the desert lands beyond Egypt's borders while Horus assumes the throne of his father with his mother and aunt Nephthys as consorts.

statement.id: Dalam versi pertama, Set diusir ke gurun di luar perbatasan Mesir, sementara Horus naik takhta ayahnya dengan ibunya dan bibinya, Nephthys, sebagai permaisuri.
statement.en: In the first version Set is banished to the deserts beyond Egypt's borders while Horus takes his father's throne with his mother and aunt Nephthys as consorts.

claims.quote: Having conquered Set and restored order, Horus became known as Horu-Sema-Tawy, The Horus, Uniter of the Two Lands.

statement.id: Setelah menaklukkan Set dan memulihkan ketertiban, Horus dikenal sebagai Horu-Sema-Tawy, Horus Pemersatu Dua Negeri.
statement.en: Having conquered Set and restored order, Horus became known as Horu-Sema-Tawy, the Horus who unites the Two Lands.

claims.quote: It is for this reason that kings of Egypt, from the First Dynastic Period on, aligned themselves with Horus and chose a "Horus Name" to rule under at their coronation.

statement.id: Karena itu raja-raja Mesir sejak Periode Dinasti Pertama mengaitkan diri dengan Horus dan memilih "Nama Horus" saat penobatan.
statement.en: For this reason Egyptian kings from the First Dynastic Period onward aligned themselves with Horus and chose a "Horus Name" at their coronation.

claims.quote: Horus was associated with the afterlife through his Four Sons who protected the vital organs of the deceased.

statement.id: Horus dikaitkan dengan akhirat melalui Empat Putranya yang melindungi organ vital orang yang meninggal.
statement.en: Horus was associated with the afterlife through his Four Sons, who protected the vital organs of the deceased.

claims.quote: In Upper Egypt he was worshipped along with Hathor and their son Harsomptus at Edfu and Kom Ombos.

statement.id: Di Mesir Hulu, Horus disembah bersama Hathor dan putra mereka Harsomptus di Edfu dan Kom Ombo.
statement.en: In Upper Egypt Horus was worshipped with Hathor and their son Harsomptus at Edfu and Kom Ombos.

claims.quote: By the time of the Ptolemaic Dynasty (323-30 BCE), the last dynasty to rule Egypt, the elder Horus had been completely replaced by the younger.
claims.locator: Horus the Younger & The Osiris Myth

statement.id: Pada masa Dinasti Ptolemeus (323-30 SM), Horus Tua telah sepenuhnya digantikan oleh Horus Muda.
statement.en: By the Ptolemaic Dynasty (323-30 BCE) the elder Horus had been completely replaced by the younger.

claims.quote: He was a solar divinity, but appears very early in the Osiris cycle of deities, a son of Isis and probably of Osiris, and opponent of Sēth.

statement.id: Britannica 1911 menyebut Horus sebagai dewa surya yang sangat awal muncul dalam lingkaran dewa Osiris, putra Isis dan kemungkinan Osiris, serta lawan Set.
statement.en: Britannica 1911 calls Horus a solar divinity who appears very early in the Osiris cycle, a son of Isis and probably of Osiris, and opponent of Set.

claims.quote: is connected with a root signifying “upper,” and probably means “the high-flyer.”

statement.id: Britannica 1911 menyatakan nama Hōr berkaitan dengan akar kata yang berarti "atas" dan mungkin berarti "si penerbang tinggi".
statement.en: Britannica 1911 says the name Hōr is connected with a root meaning "upper" and probably means "the high-flyer".

claims.quote: In the judgment scene Horus introduces the deceased to Osiris.

statement.id: Dalam adegan penghakiman, Horus memperkenalkan orang yang meninggal kepada Osiris.
statement.en: In the judgment scene Horus introduces the deceased to Osiris.

claims.quote: To the Greeks Horus was equivalent to Apollo

statement.id: Bagi orang Yunani, Horus setara dengan Apollo.
statement.en: To the Greeks Horus was equivalent to Apollo.

claims.quote: Harendotes (Har-ent-yotf), i.e. “Hōr, avenger of his father (Osiris)”

statement.id: Salah satu julukan Horus adalah Harendotes, "Hōr, pembalas ayahnya (Osiris)".
statement.en: One epithet of Horus is Harendotes, "Hōr, avenger of his father (Osiris)".

claims.quote: Har-behtet, i.e. Hōr of Beht, the winged solar disk, god of Edfu (Apollinopolis Magna)

statement.id: Har-behtet, "Hōr dari Beht", adalah cakram surya bersayap, dewa Edfu (Apollinopolis Magna).
statement.en: Har-behtet, "Hōr of Beht", is the winged solar disk, god of Edfu (Apollinopolis Magna).

claims.quote: Isis endured a difficult pregnancy with exceptionally long labor and gave birth to Horus alone in the swamps of the Delta.

statement.id: Isis melahirkan Horus seorang diri di rawa-rawa Delta setelah kehamilan yang sulit dan persalinan yang sangat lama.
statement.en: Isis gave birth to Horus alone in the Delta swamps after a difficult pregnancy and exceptionally long labor.

claims.quote: Rulers of the Predynastic Period in Egypt (c. 6000-3150 BCE) were known as "Followers of Horus" which attests to an even earlier point of veneration in Egypt's history.

statement.id: Penguasa Periode Pradinasti Mesir (sekitar 6000-3150 SM) disebut "Pengikut Horus", yang menunjukkan pemujaan yang lebih awal lagi.
statement.en: Rulers of Egypt's Predynastic Period (c. 6000-3150 BCE) were known as "Followers of Horus", attesting to even earlier veneration.

claims.quote: Horus was one of the earliest of Egyptian deities. His name is attested from the beginning of the Dynastic Period

statement.id: Menurut Egiptolog Richard H. Wilkinson, Horus adalah salah satu dewa Mesir paling awal dan namanya tercatat sejak awal Periode Dinasti.
statement.en: According to Egyptologist Richard H. Wilkinson, Horus was one of the earliest Egyptian deities and his name is attested from the beginning of the Dynastic Period.

summary.en: One source: Hor means "the Distant One", a reference to his role as a sky god.

short_description.id: Prometheus adalah Titan dalam mitologi Yunani yang dikenal licik, memberikan api kepada manusia, dan dihukum Zeus.
short_description.en: Prometheus is a Greek Titan known for his cleverness, who gave fire to humans and was punished by Zeus.

long_description.id: Prometheus adalah Titan dalam mitologi Yunani yang dikenal licik dan terkenal karena memberi manusia api dan keterampilan menempa logam. Namanya biasanya diartikan "pemikiran ke depan". Menurut Hesiodos, ayahnya adalah Iapetus dan ibunya Clymene, sedangkan sumber lain menyebut Themis atau Iapetus dan Asia. Dalam Perang Titan, ia berpindah pihak dan mendukung para dewa Olimpus.
long_description.en: Prometheus is a Greek Titan with a reputation for cleverness, famous for giving humans fire and the skill of metalwork. His name is usually understood to mean "forethought". According to Hesiod his father was Iapetus and his mother Clymene, while other sources name Themis or give Iapetus and Asia as parents. In the war of the Titans he switched sides and supported the Olympians.

long_description.id: Dalam beberapa tradisi ia membentuk manusia pertama dari tanah liat, dan menurut Apollodorus dari air dan tanah. Ia mencuri api dari bengkel Hephaistos dan Athena, menyembunyikannya dalam batang adas, lalu memberikannya kepada manusia. Versi lain menyebut ia lebih dulu mencoba menipu Zeus dengan pembagian daging kurban di Mecone, sehingga Zeus mengambil api dari manusia.
long_description.en: In some traditions he made the first human from clay, and according to Apollodorus from water and earth. He stole fire from the workshop of Hephaistos and Athena, hid it in a fennel stalk, and gave it to humans. Another version says he first tried to trick Zeus with the division of sacrificial meat at Mecone, so that Zeus took fire away from humans.

long_description.id: Zeus memerintahkan Hephaestus memaku atau mengikat Prometheus di Gunung Kaukasus. Seekor elang memakan hatinya setiap hari, dan hati itu tumbuh kembali pada malam hari. Hesiodos menambahkan bahwa sebuah tiang ditusukkan melalui tengah tubuhnya. Herakles akhirnya membunuh elang itu dan membebaskannya.
long_description.en: Zeus ordered Hephaestus to nail or bind Prometheus to Mount Caucasus. An eagle ate his liver each day, and it grew back at night. Hesiod adds that a shaft was driven through his middle. Heracles finally killed the eagle and freed him.

long_description.id: Dalam Prometheus Bound karya Aeschylus, Prometheus berkata bahwa ia membuat manusia berakal, mengajari mereka membaca bintang, dan menemukan kendaraan pelaut. Prometheus dipuja di Athena, terutama oleh para pembuat tembikar, dan di sana diadakan lomba obor tahunan untuk menghormatinya.
long_description.en: In Aeschylus's Prometheus Bound, Prometheus says he gave humans reason, taught them to read the stars, and invented the mariner's vessel. Prometheus was worshipped in Athens, particularly by potters, where an annual torch race was held in his honour.

cultural_context.id: Prometheus dipuja terutama di Athena, tempat ia dikaitkan dengan Athena dan Hephaestus, dewa-dewi keterampilan kreatif dan teknologi. Para pembuat tembikar memujanya dan lomba obor tahunan diadakan untuk menghormatinya. Dalam tradisi klasik Barat, ia kemudian menjadi lambang usaha manusia, dan Mary Shelley memberi novelnya Frankenstein judul alternatif The Modern Prometheus.
cultural_context.en: Prometheus was worshipped mainly in Athens, where he was linked with Athena and Hephaestus, deities of creative skills and technology. Potters venerated him and an annual torch race was held in his honour. Mary Shelley later gave her novel Frankenstein the alternate title The Modern Prometheus.

claims.quote: In Greek mythology, the Titan Prometheus had a reputation as being something of a clever trickster and he famously gave the human race the gift of fire and the skill of metalwork, an action for which he was punished by Zeus, who ensured everyday that an eagle ate the liver of the Titan as he was helplessly chained to a rock.
