claims.quote: Every day an eagle swooped on him and devoured the lobes of his liver, which grew by night.

statement.id: Elang memakan hatinya setiap hari dan hati itu tumbuh kembali pada malam hari.
statement.en: An eagle ate his liver daily and it grew back each night.

claims.quote: Fortunately for man's benefactor, but only after many years, the hero Hercules, when passing one day during his celebrated labours, killed the eagle with one of his arrows.

statement.id: Herakles kemudian membunuh elang yang menyiksa Prometheus.
statement.en: Heracles later killed the eagle tormenting Prometheus.

claims.quote: Prometheus did, however, switch sides and support the victorious Olympians when the Titans would not follow his advice to use trickery in the battle.

statement.id: Prometheus berpindah pihak dan mendukung para dewa Olimpus yang menang ketika para Titan menolak nasihatnya untuk memakai tipu daya dalam pertempuran.
statement.en: Prometheus switched sides and supported the victorious Olympians when the Titans would not follow his advice to use trickery in the battle.

claims.quote: According to Hesiod's Theogony, Prometheus' father was Iapetus, his mother was Clymene (or Themis in other versions) and his brothers were fellow Titans Epimetheus (Afterthought or Hindsight), Menoetius, and Atlas.

statement.id: Menurut Theogony karya Hesiodos, ayah Prometheus adalah Iapetus, ibunya Clymene (atau Themis dalam versi lain), dan saudaranya adalah Epimetheus, Menoetius, dan Atlas.
statement.en: According to Hesiod's Theogony, Prometheus's father was Iapetus, his mother Clymene (or Themis in other versions), and his brothers were Epimetheus, Menoetius, and Atlas.

claims.quote: Feeling sorry for man's weak and naked state, Prometheus raided the workshop of Hephaistos and Athena on Mt. Olympus and stole fire, and by hiding it in a hollow fennel-stalk, he gave the valuable gift to man which would help him in life's struggle.

statement.id: Karena iba pada keadaan manusia yang lemah dan telanjang, Prometheus menyusup ke bengkel Hephaistos dan Athena di Gunung Olympus, mencuri api, menyembunyikannya dalam batang adas berongga, lalu memberikannya kepada manusia.
statement.en: Feeling sorry for humanity's weak and naked state, Prometheus raided the workshop of Hephaistos and Athena on Mount Olympus, stole fire, hid it in a hollow fennel stalk, and gave it to humans.

claims.quote: In a slightly different version of the story, mankind already had fire, and when Prometheus tried to trick Zeus into eating bones and fat instead of the best meat during a meal at Mt. Olympus, Zeus, in anger, took away fire so that man would have to eat his meat raw.

statement.id: Dalam versi yang sedikit berbeda, manusia sudah punya api; Zeus mengambilnya karena marah ketika Prometheus mencoba menipunya agar memakan tulang dan lemak, bukan daging terbaik.
statement.en: In a slightly different version, humans already had fire; Zeus took it away in anger when Prometheus tried to trick him into eating bones and fat instead of the best meat.

claims.quote: Prometheus was worshipped in Athens, particularly by potters (who, of course, needed fire in their kilns) and there was an annual torch race held in the god's honour.

statement.id: Prometheus dipuja di Athena, terutama oleh para pembuat tembikar, dan setiap tahun diadakan lomba obor untuk menghormatinya.
statement.en: Prometheus was worshipped in Athens, particularly by potters, and an annual torch race was held in his honour.

claims.quote: In the Greek poet Hesiod's Works & Days we are told that Zeus punished man for receiving the fire by instructing Hephaistos to create the first woman, Pandora, from clay

statement.id: Menurut Works & Days karya Hesiodos, Zeus menghukum manusia karena menerima api dengan memerintahkan Hephaistos membuat perempuan pertama, Pandora, dari tanah liat.
statement.en: In Hesiod's Works & Days, Zeus punished humans for receiving fire by instructing Hephaistos to create the first woman, Pandora, from clay.

claims.quote: Prometheus first appears in Greek art in a 7th century BCE ivory from Sparta and on Greek pottery from c. 600 BCE, usually being punished.

statement.id: Prometheus pertama kali muncul dalam seni Yunani pada gading abad ke-7 SM dari Sparta dan pada tembikar Yunani sekitar 600 SM, biasanya sedang dihukum.
statement.en: Prometheus first appears in Greek art on a 7th-century BCE ivory from Sparta and on Greek pottery from about 600 BCE, usually being punished.

claims.quote: The Titan also taught man how to use their gift and so the skill of metalwork began; he also came to be associated with science and culture.

statement.id: Prometheus juga mengajari manusia memakai karunia itu sehingga keterampilan menempa logam dimulai, dan ia dikaitkan dengan ilmu pengetahuan dan budaya.
statement.en: The Titan also taught humans to use the gift, so metalworking began, and he came to be associated with science and culture.

claims.quote: PROMETHEUS was the Titan god of forethought and crafty counsel who was given the task of moulding mankind out of clay.

statement.id: Theoi menyebut Prometheus sebagai dewa Titan pemikiran ke depan dan nasihat licik yang diberi tugas membentuk manusia dari tanah liat.
statement.en: Theoi calls Prometheus the Titan god of forethought and crafty counsel who was given the task of moulding mankind out of clay.

claims.quote: Prometheus was loosely identified in cult and myth with the fire-god Hephaistos (Hephaestus) and the giant Tityos (Tityus).

statement.id: Prometheus secara longgar disamakan dalam kultus dan mitos dengan dewa api Hephaistos dan raksasa Tityos.
statement.en: Prometheus was loosely identified in cult and myth with the fire-god Hephaistos and the giant Tityos.

claims.quote: Prometheus himself is an immortal god, the friend of the human race, the giver of fire, the inventor of the useful arts, an omniscient seer, an heroic sufferer, who is overcome by the superior power of Zeus, but will not bend his inflexible mind.

statement.id: Dalam uraian ensiklopedia di Theoi tentang Aeschylus, Prometheus adalah dewa abadi, sahabat umat manusia, pemberi api, penemu seni yang berguna, peramal serba tahu, dan penderita yang gagah, yang dikalahkan kekuatan Zeus tetapi tidak mau menekuk pikirannya.
statement.en: In the encyclopedia entry on Theoi describing Aeschylus, Prometheus is an immortal god, friend of humankind, giver of fire, inventor of the useful arts, an omniscient seer, and an heroic sufferer overcome by Zeus's power but unbending in mind.

claims.quote: Prometheus had cautioned his brother Epimetheus against accepting any present from Zeus, but Epimetheus, disregarding the advice, accepted Pandora

statement.id: Prometheus telah memperingatkan saudaranya Epimetheus agar tidak menerima hadiah dari Zeus, tetapi Epimetheus mengabaikannya dan menerima Pandora.
statement.en: Prometheus had cautioned his brother Epimetheus against accepting any gift from Zeus, but Epimetheus disregarded the advice and accepted Pandora.

claims.quote: Generations later the great hero Herakles (Heracles) came along and released the old Titan from his torture.

statement.id: Beberapa generasi kemudian, pahlawan Herakles datang dan membebaskan Titan tua itu dari siksaannya.
statement.en: Generations later the hero Herakles came along and released the old Titan from his torment.

claims.quote: to Iapetus and Asia was born Atlas, who has the sky on his shoulders, and Prometheus, and Epimetheus,

statement.id: Apollodorus menyebut Atlas, Prometheus, dan Epimetheus lahir dari Iapetus dan Asia.
statement.en: Apollodorus says Atlas, Prometheus, and Epimetheus were born to Iapetus and Asia.

claims.quote: Prometheus or, as others say, Hephaestus, smote the head of Zeus with an axe, and Athena, fully armed, leaped up from the top of his head at the river Triton.

statement.id: Prometheus, atau menurut yang lain Hephaestus, membelah kepala Zeus dengan kapak, lalu Athena melompat keluar dengan perlengkapan perang lengkap.
statement.en: Prometheus, or as others say Hephaestus, struck the head of Zeus with an axe, and Athena leaped out fully armed.

claims.quote: and gave them also fire, which, unknown to Zeus, he had hidden in a stalk of fennel.

statement.id: Menurut Apollodorus, Prometheus juga memberi manusia api yang tanpa sepengetahuan Zeus disembunyikannya dalam batang adas.
statement.en: According to Apollodorus, Prometheus also gave humans fire, which, unknown to Zeus, he had hidden in a stalk of fennel.

claims.quote: And when Zeus would destroy the men of the Bronze Age, Deucalion by the advice of Prometheus constructed a chest

statement.id: Ketika Zeus hendak membinasakan manusia Zaman Perunggu, Deucalion membuat peti atas nasihat Prometheus.
statement.en: When Zeus wished to destroy the men of the Bronze Age, Deucalion built a chest on the advice of Prometheus.

claims.quote: And ready-witted Prometheus he bound with inextricable bonds, cruel chains, and drove a shaft through his middle, and set on him a long-winged eagle, which used to eat his immortal liver

statement.id: Hesiodos menyebut Zeus mengikat Prometheus dengan rantai yang kejam, menusukkan tiang melalui tengah tubuhnya, dan mengirim elang bersayap panjang untuk memakan hatinya yang abadi.
statement.en: Hesiod says Zeus bound Prometheus with cruel chains, drove a shaft through his middle, and set a long-winged eagle on him to eat his immortal liver.

claims.quote: For when the gods and mortal men had a dispute at Mecone, even then Prometheus was forward to cut up a great ox and set portions before them, trying to befool the mind of Zeus.

statement.id: Ketika para dewa dan manusia berselisih di Mecone, Prometheus memotong seekor lembu besar dan membagi bagiannya untuk mengelabui pikiran Zeus.
statement.en: When gods and mortals disputed at Mecone, Prometheus cut up a great ox and set out portions, trying to befool the mind of Zeus.

claims.quote: For your own flower, flashing fire, source of all arts, he has purloined and bestowed upon mortal creatures.

statement.id: Dalam Prometheus Bound karya Aeschylus, Kekuasaan berkata bahwa Prometheus mencuri api, sumber segala seni, dan memberikannya kepada makhluk fana.
statement.en: In Aeschylus's Prometheus Bound, Power says Prometheus stole fire, the source of all arts, and gave it to mortal creatures.

claims.quote: Lofty-minded son of Themis who counsels straight, against my will, no less than yours, I must rivet you with brazen bonds

statement.id: Dalam Prometheus Bound, Hephaestus menyapa Prometheus sebagai putra Themis dan berkata ia harus mengikatnya dengan belenggu perunggu.
statement.en: In Prometheus Bound, Hephaestus addresses Prometheus as son of Themis and says he must rivet him with brazen bonds.

claims.quote: how they were witless before and I made them have sense and endowed them with reason.

statement.id: Dalam Prometheus Bound, Prometheus berkata manusia dulu tak berakal dan ia memberi mereka pengertian serta nalar.
statement.en: In Prometheus Bound, Prometheus says humans were witless before and he gave them sense and reason.

claims.quote: until I taught them to discern the risings of the stars and their settings, which are difficult to distinguish.

statement.id: Dalam Prometheus Bound, Prometheus berkata ia mengajari manusia membedakan terbit dan terbenamnya bintang-bintang.
statement.en: In Prometheus Bound, Prometheus says he taught humans to discern the risings and settings of the stars.

claims.quote: It was I and no one else who invented the mariner's flaxen-winged car that roams the sea.

statement.id: Dalam Prometheus Bound, Prometheus mengaku dialah yang menemukan kendaraan pelaut bersayap lenan yang mengarungi laut.
statement.en: In Prometheus Bound, Prometheus claims he invented the mariner's flaxen-winged car that roams the sea.

claims.quote: The etymology of the theonym prometheus is debated. The usual view is that it signifies "forethought", as that of his brother Epimetheus denotes "afterthought"

statement.id: Asal-usul nama Prometheus diperdebatkan; pandangan yang lazim menyatakan artinya "pemikiran ke depan", seperti nama saudaranya Epimetheus berarti "pemikiran belakangan".
statement.en: The etymology of the name Prometheus is debated; the usual view is that it means "forethought", as his brother Epimetheus's name denotes "afterthought".

claims.quote: Evidence of a cult to Prometheus himself is not widespread. He was a focus of religious activity mainly at Athens, where he was linked with Athena and Hephaestus, the Greek deities of creative skills and technology.

statement.id: Bukti kultus Prometheus sendiri tidak meluas; ia menjadi pusat kegiatan keagamaan terutama di Athena, tempat ia dikaitkan dengan Athena dan Hephaestus, dewa-dewi keterampilan kreatif dan teknologi.
statement.en: Evidence of a cult to Prometheus himself is not widespread; he was a focus of religious activity mainly at Athens, where he was linked with Athena and Hephaestus, deities of creative skills and technology.

claims.quote: Mary Shelley, for instance, gave The Modern Prometheus as the alternate title to her novel Frankenstein (1818).

statement.id: Mary Shelley, misalnya, memberi novelnya Frankenstein (1818) judul alternatif The Modern Prometheus.
statement.en: Mary Shelley, for instance, gave The Modern Prometheus as the alternate title of her novel Frankenstein (1818).

claims.quote: In the Western classical tradition, Prometheus became a figure who represented human striving (particularly the quest for scientific knowledge) or “playing God” and the risk of overreaching or unintended consequences.

statement.id: Dalam tradisi klasik Barat, Prometheus menjadi sosok yang mewakili usaha manusia (terutama pencarian pengetahuan ilmiah) atau "bermain Tuhan" serta risiko berlebihan dan akibat tak terduga.
statement.en: In the Western classical tradition, Prometheus became a figure representing human striving (particularly the quest for scientific knowledge) or "playing God" and the risk of overreaching or unintended consequences.

text.id: Disebut sejak Teks Piramida (sekitar 2400-2300 SM) dan naik ke puncak pada awal Kerajaan Baru (sekitar 1570-1069 SM).
text.en: Mentioned from the Pyramid Texts (c. 2400-2300 BCE) and rose to prominence at the beginning of the New Kingdom (c. 1570-1069 BCE).

short_description.id: Amun adalah dewa matahari dan udara Mesir kuno yang namanya berarti "yang tersembunyi" dan kemudian dipuja sebagai Amun-Ra, raja para dewa.
short_description.en: Amun is an ancient Egyptian god of the sun and air whose name means "the hidden one" and who was later worshiped as Amun-Ra, king of the gods.

long_description.id: Amun, juga ditulis Amon, Ammon, atau Amen, adalah dewa matahari dan udara Mesir kuno. Namanya berarti "yang tersembunyi", dan berbeda dari kebanyakan dewa Mesir lain, ia dipandang sebagai penguasa atas segala sesuatu yang merangkum setiap aspek penciptaan. Britannica 1911 menyebut para imam mengaitkan namanya dengan akar kata yang berarti "menyembunyikan". Ia digambarkan sebagai pria berjanggut dengan mahkota dua bulu atau, setelah Kerajaan Baru, sebagai manusia berkepala domba atau domba saja. Britannica 1911 menambahkan bahwa dua bulu itu mungkin melambangkan bulu ekor elang, bahwa perwujudannya yang paling terkenal adalah domba berbulu wol bertanduk melengkung, dan bahwa angsa Mesir pada Dinasti ke-18 digambarkan suci baginya; gelarnya antara lain "penguasa takhta dua negeri".
long_description.en: Amun, also written Amon, Ammon, or Amen, is the ancient Egyptian god of the sun and air. His name means "the hidden one", and he stood apart from most Egyptian deities as master of everything, taking in every side of creation. Britannica 1911 says the priests connected his name with a root meaning "conceal". He is depicted as a bearded man in a headdress topped by two plumes; once the New Kingdom had passed, he could also be shown with a ram's head, or just as a ram. Britannica 1911 adds that the plumes may represent a hawk's tail feathers, that his most celebrated incarnation was the woolly sheep with curved horns, and that the Egyptian goose is figured as sacred to him in the 18th Dynasty; his titles included "lord of the thrones of the two lands".

long_description.id: Amun pertama disebut dalam Teks Piramida sebagai dewa lokal Thebes bersama Amaunet, dan pada awalnya dikaitkan dengan perlindungan raja serta kesuburan dalam Ogdoad. Britannica 1911 melukiskannya semula sebagai dewa setempat di Thebes yang kecil. Sejak masa Middle Kingdom ia menjadi bagian triad Thebes bersama Mut dan putra mereka Khonsu. Setelah Ahmose I mengalahkan Hyksos dan menyatakan kemenangannya berkat Amun, dewa ini berpadu dengan Ra menjadi Amun-Ra, pencipta alam semesta dan raja para dewa.
long_description.en: Amun is first mentioned in the Pyramid Texts as a local god of Thebes with Amaunet, and was at first linked with protecting the king and with fertility in the Ogdoad. Britannica 1911 describes him at first as the local god of a small Thebes. From the Middle Kingdom he was part of the Theban triad with Mut and their son Khonsu. After Ahmose I defeated the Hyksos and credited Amun with the victory, the god combined with Ra as Amun-Ra, creator of the universe and king of the gods.

long_description.id: Sebagai Amun-Ra ia menyatukan sisi tak kasatmata (dilambangkan angin) dan sisi kasatmata sebagai matahari. Ia dipuji sebagai "Yang Menciptakan Diri" dan Dewa Pencipta, mengambil aspek surya Ra, kesuburan Min, dan sifat dewa perang Montu. Orakelnya menyampaikan kehendak ilahi; menurut tradisi ia datang menolong raja di medan perang dan orang miskin, dan rakyat memanggilnya pembela jelata serta pelindung pengelana.
long_description.en: As Amun-Ra he combined his invisible side (symbolized by the wind) with his visible side as the sun. He was hailed as "The Self-created One" and as Creator God, taking on Ra's solar aspect, Min's fertility, and the war-god traits of Montu. His oracles conveyed the divine will; he was said to help kings on the battlefield and the poor, and people called him an advocate of the common man and protector of travellers.

long_description.id: Amun dipuja sebagai dewa kosmis, dan kultusnya berasal dari Thebes dengan kuil besar di Karnak. Pada Perayaan Opet, patung Amun dibawa dengan perahu dari Karnak ke Luxor. Akhenaten menindas Amun dan menghapus nama serta gambarnya, tetapi Tutankhamun memulihkan monumen Amun di Karnak. Ahmose I mengangkat kebiasaan menahbiskan perempuan kerajaan sebagai "istri ilahi Amun". Kultus Amun juga menyebar ke Sudan dan, lewat Zeus-Ammon, ke dunia Yunani.
long_description.en: Amun was worshiped as a cosmic god, and his cult originated in Thebes with a great temple at Karnak. At the Feast of Opet his statue was carried by barque from Karnak to Luxor. Akhenaten persecuted Amun and removed his name and images, but Tutankhamun restored Amun's monuments at Karnak. Ahmose I elevated the custom of consecrating royal women as "divine wives of Amun". Amun's cult also spread to Sudan and, through Zeus-Ammon, to the Greek world.

cultural_context.id: Karena Amun mewakili "ketersembunyian" yang tidak terikat pada satu fenomena alam tertentu, ia mudah dikaitkan dengan sifat apa pun dan menjadi dewa yang merangkum setiap segi penciptaan.
cultural_context.en: Because Amun represented "hiddenness" and was linked to no single natural phenomenon, he could take on any attribute and became a god embracing every facet of creation.

literal_meaning.id: "yang tersembunyi", "tak terlihat", "berwujud misterius"; dikaitkan dengan akar kata yang berarti "menyembunyikan".
literal_meaning.en: "the hidden one", "invisible", "mysterious of form"; connected with a root meaning "conceal".

who.id: Dewa matahari dan udara Mesir kuno yang dikenal sebagai Amun-Ra, raja para dewa.
who.en: An ancient Egyptian god of sun and air known as Amun-Ra, king of the gods.

origin.id: Berasal dari dewa lokal Thebes yang pertama disebut dalam Teks Piramida.
origin.en: Originated as a local god of Thebes first mentioned in the Pyramid Texts.

role.id: Dewa pencipta dan raja para dewa yang kultusnya berpusat di Thebes dan Karnak.
role.en: Creator god and king of the gods whose cult centered on Thebes and Karnak.

famous_for.id: Paling dikenal sebagai Amun-Ra, dewa yang kultusnya paling kuat dan populer di Mesir selama berabad-abad.
famous_for.en: Best known as Amun-Ra, whose cult was the most powerful and popular in Egypt for centuries.

did_you_know.id: Alexander Agung pada 331 SM di Oasis Siwa menyatakan dirinya putra Zeus-Ammon, versi Yunani dari Amun.
did_you_know.en: In 331 BCE at the Siwa Oasis, Alexander the Great proclaimed himself a son of Zeus-Ammon, the Greek version of Amun.

description.id: Orakel Amun menyampaikan kehendak ilahi kepada manusia.
description.en: Amun's oracles communicated the divine will to humanity.

description.id: Amun adalah Dewa Pencipta yang menciptakan dunia dengan berpadu dengan dirinya sendiri dan dipuji sebagai pencipta segala sesuatu, termasuk dirinya.
description.en: Amun was the Creator God who made the world by mating with himself and was hailed as creator of all things, himself included.

description.id: Amun sering diseru dalam pertempuran dan konon datang cepat menolong raja-raja Mesir di medan perang.
description.en: Amun was regularly invoked in battle and was said to come swiftly to help Egyptian kings on the battlefield.

description.id: Amun dipandang sebagai pembela rakyat jelata dan, sebagai "Amun di Jalan", pelindung pengelana.
description.en: Amun was regarded as an advocate of the common man and, as "Amun of the Road", protector of travellers.

description.id: Perpaduan Amun dengan Ra sebagai pencipta alam semesta dan raja para dewa.
description.en: Amun combined with Ra as creator of the universe and king of the gods.

description.id: Amun sebagai dewa kesuburan yang dikaitkan dengan Min.
description.en: Amun as a fertility god linked with Min.

description.id: Versi Yunani Amun: Zeus berjanggut penuh dengan tanduk domba Amun.
description.en: The Greek version of Amun: the full-bearded Zeus with Amun's ram's horns.

description.en: The god was taken to Rome as Jupiter-Ammon.

role.en: The god persecuted and then restored

summary.id: Akhenaten (1353-1336 SM) melarang pemujaan banyak dewa dan menetapkan Aten sebagai dewa sejati, menindas Amun dan menghapus nama serta gambarnya. Tutankhamun kemudian memulihkan monumen Amun di Karnak.
summary.en: Akhenaten (1353-1336 BCE) banned polytheistic worship and established Aten as the one true god, persecuting Amun and removing his name and images. Tutankhamun later restored Amun's monuments at Karnak.

role.id: Dewa yang berkunjung
role.en: The visiting god

summary.id: Pada perayaan agung Amun, perahunya membawa patung Amun dari kuil Karnak ke kuil Luxor agar sang dewa dapat berkunjung.
summary.en: At Amun's great festival, his barque carried Amun's statue from the Karnak temple to the Luxor temple so the god could visit.

role.id: Dewa yang diakui sebagai ayah
role.en: The god claimed as father

summary.id: Pada 331 SM Alexander menyatakan dirinya putra Zeus-Ammon di Oasis Siwa, seperti Hatshepsut yang lebih dulu menyatakan Amun sebagai ayahnya.
summary.en: In 331 BCE Alexander proclaimed himself a son of Zeus-Ammon at the Siwa Oasis, as Hatshepsut had earlier claimed Amun as her father.

description.id: Kota asal kultus Amun, tempat ia pertama disebut sebagai dewa lokal.
description.en: The city where Amun's cult originated and where he was first mentioned as a local god.

description.id: Kuil utama Amun, masih merupakan bangunan keagamaan terbesar yang pernah dibangun.
description.en: Amun's main temple, still the largest religious structure ever built.

description.id: Tujuan perahu Amun dari Karnak pada Perayaan Opet.
description.en: The destination of Amun's barque from Karnak at the Feast of Opet.

description.id: Tempat Alexander Agung menyatakan dirinya putra Zeus-Ammon pada 331 SM.
description.en: Where Alexander the Great proclaimed himself son of Zeus-Ammon in 331 BCE.

description.id: Di Sudan, imam Amun menjadi cukup berkuasa untuk memaksakan kehendak pada raja-raja Meroe.
description.en: In Sudan, the priests of Amun became powerful enough to enforce their will on the kings of Meroe.

description.id: Amun pertama disebut sebagai dewa lokal Thebes bersama Amaunet.
description.en: Amun is first mentioned as a local god of Thebes with Amaunet.

description.id: Sejak masa Middle Kingdom Amun makin berkuasa di Thebes dan menjadi bagian triad bersama Mut dan Khonsu.
description.en: Since the Middle Kingdom Amun had been growing in power at Thebes, part of a triad with Mut and Khonsu.

description.id: Amun naik ke puncak kejayaan di Thebes pada awal Kerajaan Baru.
description.en: Amun rose to prominence at Thebes at the beginning of the New Kingdom.

description.id: Akhenaten melarang pemujaan banyak dewa dan menetapkan Aten sebagai dewa sejati.
description.en: Akhenaten banned polytheistic worship and established Aten as the one true god.

description.en: Alexander the Great proclaims himself a son of Zeus-Ammon.

description.id: Raja Ergamenes membantai para imam Amun di Meroe.
description.en: King Ergamenes had the priests of Amun at Meroe massacred.

note.id: Pendamping Amun dalam triad Thebes.
note.en: Amun's consort in the Theban triad.

note.id: Putra Amun dan Mut.
note.en: Son of Amun and Mut.

note.id: Pasangan awal Amun, yang kemudian digantikan Mut dalam triad Thebes.
note.en: Amun's early consort, later replaced by Mut in the Theban triad.

note.id: Berpadu dengan Amun sebagai Amun-Ra.
note.en: Combined with Amun as Amun-Ra.

note.en: Fertility god linked with Amun as Amun-Min.

note.en: The war god of Thebes whose attributes Amun absorbed.

note.id: Orang Yunani menyamakan Amun dengan Zeus.
note.en: The Greeks identified Amun with Zeus.

note.en: Amun took on many of Atum's attributes and more or less replaced him, but the two remained distinct deities.

claims.quote: Amun (also Amon, Ammon, Amen, Amun-Ra) is the ancient Egyptian god of the sun and air.

statement.id: Amun, juga disebut Amon atau Amen, adalah dewa matahari dan udara Mesir Kuno.
statement.en: Amun, also called Amon or Amen, is an ancient Egyptian god of the sun and air.

claims.quote: His name means "the hidden one," "invisible," "mysterious of form," and unlike most other Egyptian gods, he was considered Lord of All who encompassed every aspect of creation.

statement.id: Nama Amun berarti 'yang tersembunyi' atau 'tak terlihat'.
statement.en: Amun's name means 'the hidden one' or 'invisible'.

claims.quote: He is usually depicted as a bearded man wearing a headdress with a double plume or, after the New Kingdom, as a ram-headed man or simply a ram, symbolizing fertility in his role as Amun-Min.

statement.id: Amun digambarkan sebagai pria berjanggut dengan mahkota dua bulu atau sebagai domba jantan.
statement.en: Amun is depicted as a bearded man with double plumes or as a ram-headed man or ram.

claims.quote: Amun is first mentioned in the Pyramid Texts (c. 2400-2300 BCE) as a local god of Thebes along with his consort Amaunet.

statement.id: Amun disebut dalam Teks Piramida sebagai dewa lokal Thebes bersama Amaunet.
statement.en: Amun appears in the Pyramid Texts as a local god of Thebes paired with Amaunet.

claims.quote: Since the time of the Middle Kingdom (2040-1782 BCE) Amun had been growing in power in Thebes and was a part of the Theban triad of deities with his consort Mut (who replaced Amaunet) and their son Khonsu, the moon god.

statement.id: Dalam triad Thebes, Amun berpasangan dengan Mut dan memiliki putra Khonsu.
statement.en: In the Theban triad, Amun's consort was Mut and their son was Khonsu.

claims.quote: Amun then became Amun-Ra, creator of the universe, and King of the Gods.

statement.id: Amun berpadu dengan Ra sebagai Amun-Ra, pencipta alam semesta dan raja para dewa.
statement.en: Amun became Amun-Ra, creator of the universe and king of the gods.

claims.quote: Amun was one of Egypt’s most celebrated deities, worshipped as a universal, cosmic god and frequently called the king of the gods.

statement.id: Amun dipuja sebagai dewa kosmis universal dan sering disebut raja para dewa.
statement.en: Amun was worshiped as a universal cosmic god and called king of the gods.

claims.quote: His cult originated in Thebes and his temple at Karnak remains one of the most stunning achievements of Egyptian cult and architecture, but he was worshipped in temples and shrines throughout Egypt.

statement.id: Kultus Amun berasal dari Thebes, berpusat di kuil Karnak, dan meluas ke berbagai kuil Mesir.
statement.en: Amun's cult originated in Thebes, included the Karnak temple, and spread across Egyptian temples.

claims.quote: On Amun's great festival, The Feast of Opet, the barque would move with great ceremony - carrying Amun's statue from the Karnak temple downriver to the Luxor temple so the god could visit.

statement.id: Pada Perayaan Opet, arca Amun dibawa dengan perahu dari Karnak ke kuil Luxor.
statement.en: At the Feast of Opet, Amun's statue was carried by barque from Karnak to Luxor.

claims.quote: The statue was certainly created for Karnak, Amun's great temple at Thebes, as part of Tutankhamun's restoration of the god's monuments that had been defaced or destroyed during the reign of Akhenaten.

statement.id: Tutankhamun memulihkan monumen Amun di Karnak yang rusak pada masa Akhenaten.
statement.en: Tutankhamun restored Amun's Karnak monuments damaged during Akhenaten's reign.

claims.quote: He is one of the most important gods of ancient Egypt who rose to prominence at Thebes at the beginning of the period of the New Kingdom (c. 1570-1069 BCE). His cult was the most powerful and popular in Egypt for centuries.

statement.id: Amun adalah salah satu dewa terpenting Mesir kuno yang naik ke puncak kejayaan di Thebes pada awal Kerajaan Baru (sekitar 1570-1069 SM); kultusnya paling kuat dan populer di Mesir selama berabad-abad.
statement.en: Amun is one of ancient Egypt's most important gods, who rose to prominence at Thebes at the beginning of the New Kingdom (c. 1570-1069 BCE); his cult was the most powerful and popular in Egypt for centuries.

claims.quote: Amun, at this time, was associated with protecting the king but, largely, was simply a local fertility god paired with his consort Amaunet as part of the Ogdoad, eight gods who represented the primordial elements of creation.

statement.id: Pada masa awal itu Amun dikaitkan dengan perlindungan raja, tetapi terutama hanyalah dewa kesuburan lokal yang berpasangan dengan Amaunet dalam Ogdoad, delapan dewa unsur purba penciptaan.
statement.en: At that early time Amun was associated with protecting the king but was largely a local fertility god paired with Amaunet within the Ogdoad, eight gods of the primordial elements of creation.

claims.quote: Amun was considered no more powerful or significant than the other gods who were part of the Ogdoad but represented the element of "hiddenness" or "obscurity"

statement.id: Di antara anggota Ogdoad, Amun tidak dianggap lebih berkuasa daripada yang lain, tetapi mewakili unsur "ketersembunyian" atau "ketidakjelasan".
statement.en: Among the Ogdoad, Amun was considered no more powerful than the others but represented the element of "hiddenness" or "obscurity".

claims.quote: When Ahmose I defeated the Hyksos he attributed his victory to Amun linking him to the well-known sun god Ra.

statement.id: Ketika Ahmose I mengalahkan bangsa Hyksos, ia menyatakan kemenangannya berkat Amun, sehingga Amun dikaitkan dengan dewa matahari Ra.
statement.en: When Ahmose I defeated the Hyksos he attributed his victory to Amun, linking him to the sun god Ra.

claims.quote: Following Amun's ascendancy during the New Kingdom, he was hailed as "The Self-created One" and "King of the Gods" who had created all things, including himself.

statement.id: Setelah Amun naik daun pada masa Kerajaan Baru, ia dipuji sebagai "Yang Menciptakan Diri" dan "Raja Para Dewa" yang menciptakan segala sesuatu, termasuk dirinya sendiri.
statement.en: After Amun's ascendancy in the New Kingdom he was hailed as "The Self-created One" and "King of the Gods", who had created all things including himself.

claims.quote: In his role as Amun-Ra, the god combines his invisible aspect (symbolized by the wind which one cannot see but is aware of) and his visible aspect as the life-giving sun.

statement.id: Sebagai Amun-Ra, sang dewa menggabungkan aspek tak kasatmata (dilambangkan angin) dan aspek kasatmata sebagai matahari pemberi kehidupan.
statement.en: As Amun-Ra the god combines his invisible aspect (symbolized by the wind) with his visible aspect as the life-giving sun.

claims.quote: He was also the Creator God who originally stood on the first dry ground at the beginning of time and created the world by mating with himself.

statement.id: Amun juga adalah Dewa Pencipta yang semula berdiri di tanah kering pertama pada awal waktu dan menciptakan dunia dengan berpadu dengan dirinya sendiri.
statement.en: Amun was also the Creator God who originally stood on the first dry ground at the beginning of time and created the world by mating with himself.

claims.quote: Once he was linked with Ra to become Amun-Ra, he took on Ra's aspects as a solar god and, as one would expect from a creator, was also a fertility god linked with the fertility deity Min (a very ancient god) and known in this regard as Amun-Min.

statement.id: Setelah berpadu dengan Ra menjadi Amun-Ra, ia mengambil aspek Ra sebagai dewa surya dan juga menjadi dewa kesuburan yang dikaitkan dengan Min, dikenal sebagai Amun-Min.
statement.en: Once linked with Ra as Amun-Ra he took on Ra's solar aspects and was also a fertility god linked with Min, known as Amun-Min.

claims.quote: As he had absorbed the attributes of the war god Montu of Thebes, he was regularly invoked in battle (as Ahmose I had done) and so was also a war god.

statement.id: Karena menyerap sifat-sifat dewa perang Montu dari Thebes, Amun sering diseru dalam pertempuran dan dengan demikian juga menjadi dewa perang.
statement.en: Having absorbed the attributes of Thebes's war god Montu, Amun was regularly invoked in battle and so was also a war god.

claims.quote: His presence was everywhere, unseen but felt like the wind. His oracles communicated the divine will to humanity.

statement.id: Menurut Egiptolog Geraldine Pinch, kehadiran Amun ada di mana-mana, tak terlihat tetapi terasa seperti angin, dan orakelnya menyampaikan kehendak ilahi kepada manusia.
statement.en: According to Egyptologist Geraldine Pinch, Amun's presence was everywhere, unseen but felt like the wind, and his oracles communicated the divine will to humanity.

claims.quote: Amun was said to come swiftly to help Egyptian kings on the battle field or to aid the poor and friendless.

statement.id: Konon Amun datang dengan cepat menolong raja-raja Mesir di medan perang atau membantu orang miskin dan tak bersahabat.
statement.en: Amun was said to come swiftly to help Egyptian kings on the battlefield or to aid the poor and friendless.

claims.quote: The god was regarded as an advocate of the common man, being called "the vizier of the humble" and "he who comes at the voice of the poor" and as "Amun of the Road" he was also regarded as the protector of travellers.

statement.id: Dalam religi rakyat, Amun dipandang sebagai pembela rakyat jelata, disebut "wazir kaum rendah" dan "dia yang datang pada suara orang miskin", dan sebagai "Amun di Jalan" ia pelindung para pengelana.
statement.en: In popular religion Amun was seen as an advocate of the common man, called "the vizier of the humble" and "he who comes at the voice of the poor", and as "Amun of the Road" a protector of travellers.

claims.quote: With the move to Akhetaten, Akhenaten no longer just ignored the other gods of Egypt, but started to persecute them, especially Amun, whose name and images he had removed
claims.locator: The Priests of Amun & Pharaoh Akhenaten

statement.id: Menurut sejarawan Marc van de Mieroop, setelah pindah ke Akhetaten, Akhenaten mulai menindas dewa-dewa lain, terutama Amun, yang nama dan gambarnya ia hapus.
statement.en: According to historian Marc van de Mieroop, after moving to Akhetaten Akhenaten began persecuting the other gods, especially Amun, whose name and images he had removed.

claims.quote: The popularity of this god, in fact, ushered in the first monotheistic religious movement in Egypt under Akhenaten (1353-1336 BCE) who banned polytheistic worship and established the state religion of the one true god Aten.

statement.id: Popularitas Amun justru mengantar gerakan keagamaan monoteistik pertama di Mesir di bawah Akhenaten (1353-1336 SM), yang melarang pemujaan banyak dewa dan menetapkan Aten sebagai satu-satunya dewa sejati.
statement.en: Amun's popularity ushered in Egypt's first monotheistic movement under Akhenaten (1353-1336 BCE), who banned polytheistic worship and established Aten as the one true god.

claims.quote: Queen Hatshepsut (1479-1458 BCE) had once claimed Amun was her father and thereby legitimized her reign.

statement.id: Ratu Hatshepsut (1479-1458 SM) pernah menyatakan Amun sebagai ayahnya dan dengan demikian mengesahkan pemerintahannya.
statement.en: Queen Hatshepsut (1479-1458 BCE) claimed Amun as her father, thereby legitimizing her reign.

claims.quote: Alexander the Great would do the same in 331 BCE at the Siwa Oasis, proclaiming himself a son of the god Zeus-Ammon, the Greek version of the god.

statement.id: Aleksander Agung melakukan hal serupa pada 331 SM di Oasis Siwa, menyatakan dirinya putra dewa Zeus-Ammon, versi Yunani dari dewa itu.
statement.en: Alexander the Great did the same in 331 BCE at the Siwa Oasis, proclaiming himself a son of Zeus-Ammon, the Greek version of the god.

claims.quote: In Greece, Zeus-Ammon was depicted as the full-bearded Zeus with the ram's horns of Amun and associated with power and virility through imagery including the bull and the ram.

statement.id: Di Yunani, Zeus-Ammon digambarkan sebagai Zeus berjanggut penuh dengan tanduk domba milik Amun, dikaitkan dengan kekuatan dan keperkasaan lewat citra banteng dan domba.
statement.en: In Greece Zeus-Ammon was depicted as the full-bearded Zeus with Amun's ram's horns, associated with power and virility through bull and ram imagery.

claims.quote: A custom elevated by Ahmose I was the consecration of royal women as "divine wives of Amun" who would officiate at festivals and ceremonies.

statement.id: Ahmose I mengangkat kebiasaan menahbiskan perempuan kerajaan sebagai "istri ilahi Amun" yang memimpin festival dan upacara.
statement.en: Ahmose I elevated the custom of consecrating royal women as "divine wives of Amun" who officiated at festivals and ceremonies.

claims.quote: The main Temple of Amun at Karnak is still the largest religious structure ever built and was connected to the Southern Sanctuary of the Luxor Temple.

statement.id: Kuil utama Amun di Karnak masih merupakan bangunan keagamaan terbesar yang pernah dibangun dan terhubung dengan Tempat Suci Selatan Kuil Luxor.
statement.en: The main Temple of Amun at Karnak is still the largest religious structure ever built and was connected to the Southern Sanctuary of the Luxor Temple.

claims.quote: Amun's Barque was known to the Egyptians as Userhetamon, "Mighty of Brow is Amun," and was a gift to the city from Ahmose I following his victory over the Hyksos and ascension to the throne.

statement.id: Perahu Amun dikenal sebagai Userhetamon, "Perkasa Dahinya Amun", dan merupakan hadiah Ahmose I kepada kota itu setelah ia mengalahkan Hyksos dan naik takhta.
statement.en: Amun's Barque was known as Userhetamon, "Mighty of Brow is Amun", a gift to the city from Ahmose I after his victory over the Hyksos and accession.

claims.quote: His cult took hold especially in the region of the Sudan where, as in Egypt, his priests became powerful and wealthy enough to enforce their will on the kings of Meroe.

statement.id: Kultus Amun mengakar terutama di wilayah Sudan, tempat para imamnya, seperti di Mesir, menjadi cukup kuat dan kaya untuk memaksakan kehendak pada raja-raja Meroe.
statement.en: Amun's cult took hold especially in Sudan, where, as in Egypt, his priests became powerful and wealthy enough to enforce their will on the kings of Meroe.

claims.quote: King Ergamenes of Meroe could no longer tolerate the power of the priests of Amun in his country and had them massacred c. 285 BCE

statement.id: Raja Ergamenes dari Meroe tak lagi tahan akan kekuasaan para imam Amun dan membantai mereka sekitar 285 SM.
statement.en: King Ergamenes of Meroe, no longer tolerating the priests of Amun's power, had them massacred c. 285 BCE.

claims.quote: AMMON, the Graecized name of an Egyptian deity, in the native language Amūn, connected by the priests with a root meaning “conceal.”

statement.id: Britannica 1911 menyebut Ammon sebagai nama Yunani bagi dewa Mesir yang dalam bahasa aslinya Amūn, oleh para imam dikaitkan dengan akar kata yang berarti "menyembunyikan".
statement.en: Britannica 1911 calls Ammon the Graecized name of an Egyptian deity, in the native language Amūn, connected by the priests with a root meaning "conceal".

claims.quote: He was, to begin with, the local deity of Thebes, when it was an unimportant town on the east bank of the river

statement.id: Pada mulanya Amun hanyalah dewa lokal Thebes ketika kota itu masih kecil dan tidak penting di tepi timur sungai.
statement.en: To begin with Amun was merely the local deity of Thebes, then an unimportant town on the river's east bank.

claims.quote: Ammon is figured of human form, wearing on his head a plain deep circlet from which rise two straight parallel plumes, perhaps representing the tail feathers of a hawk.

statement.id: Amun digambarkan berwujud manusia dengan lingkaran polos di kepala yang ditumbuhi dua bulu lurus sejajar, mungkin melambangkan bulu ekor elang.
statement.en: Amun is figured in human form wearing a plain deep circlet from which rise two straight parallel plumes, perhaps representing a hawk's tail feathers.

claims.quote: his most frequent and celebrated incarnation was the woolly sheep with curved (“Ammon”) horns

statement.id: Perwujudan Amun yang paling sering dan terkenal adalah domba berbulu wol dengan tanduk melengkung.
statement.en: Amun's most frequent and celebrated incarnation was the woolly sheep with curved horns.

claims.quote: The Egyptian goose (chenalopex) is figured in the XVIIIth dynasty as sacred to Ammon

statement.id: Pada Dinasti ke-18, angsa Mesir digambarkan sebagai hewan suci bagi Amun.
statement.en: In the 18th Dynasty the Egyptian goose is figured as sacred to Amun.

claims.quote: Ammon was entitled “lord of the thrones of the two lands,” or, more proudly still, “king of the gods.”

statement.id: Amun bergelar "penguasa takhta dua negeri" atau, lebih megah lagi, "raja para dewa".
statement.en: Amun was entitled "lord of the thrones of the two lands" or, more proudly still, "king of the gods".

claims.quote: As king of the gods Ammon was identified by the Greeks with Zeus and his consort Mūt with Hera.

statement.id: Sebagai raja para dewa, Amun disamakan orang Yunani dengan Zeus, dan pasangannya Mūt dengan Hera.
statement.en: As king of the gods Amun was identified by the Greeks with Zeus and his consort Mūt with Hera.

claims.quote: His consort was sometimes called Amaune (feminine of Amūn), but more usually Mūt, “mother”

statement.id: Pasangan Amun kadang disebut Amaune, bentuk feminin Amūn, tetapi lebih sering Mūt, "ibu".
statement.en: Amun's consort was sometimes called Amaune (feminine of Amūn) but more usually Mūt, "mother".

claims.quote: The god was taken to Rome as Jupiter-Ammon where he was venerated for the same reasons as elsewhere.

statement.id: Dewa ini dibawa ke Roma sebagai Jupiter-Ammon dan dipuja karena alasan yang sama seperti di tempat lain.
statement.en: The god was taken to Rome as Jupiter-Ammon, where he was venerated for the same reasons as elsewhere.

claims.quote: Although Amun took on many of Atum's attributes and more or less replaced him, the two remained distinct deities and Atum continued to be venerated.

statement.id: Meskipun Amun mengambil banyak sifat Atum dan nyaris menggantikannya, keduanya tetap dewa yang berbeda dan Atum terus dipuja.
statement.en: Although Amun took on many of Atum's attributes and more or less replaced him, the two remained distinct deities and Atum continued to be venerated.

summary.id: Dalam triad Thebes, pasangan Amun adalah Mut yang menggantikan Amaunet.
summary.en: In the Theban triad Amun's consort is Mut, who replaced Amaunet.

summary.id: Britannica 1911: pasangannya kadang disebut Amaune, tetapi lebih sering Mūt.
summary.en: Britannica 1911: his consort was sometimes called Amaune but more usually Mūt.

summary.id: Pada awalnya Amun tidak dianggap lebih berkuasa daripada anggota Ogdoad lain.
summary.en: At first Amun was considered no more powerful than the other members of the Ogdoad.

summary.id: Pada awalnya Amun hanyalah dewa lokal Thebes yang kecil dan tidak penting.
summary.en: At first Amun was merely the local god of an unimportant Thebes.

text.id: Kepercayaan akan demon kemungkinan berasal dari zaman Paleolitikum; kata demon dalam bahasa Inggris sudah ada sekurang-kurangnya sejak sekitar tahun 825.
text.en: Belief in demons probably goes back to the Paleolithic age; the English word demon goes back at least to about 825.

short_description.id: Demon adalah sebutan lintas tradisi untuk entitas adikodrati yang kini sering dianggap jahat, tetapi dalam tradisi kuno maknanya lebih beragam: roh yang bisa baik atau buruk.
short_description.en: Demon is a cross-tradition term for a supernatural being now usually seen as evil, though in ancient traditions its meaning was more varied: a spirit that could be good or bad.

long_description.id: Demon adalah entitas adikodrati yang biasanya dipandang jahat. Kata itu diterjemahkan dari daimon Yunani yang berarti roh, yang bisa baik atau buruk. Kata Yunani itu mulanya tidak bermakna negatif; makna negatif pertama muncul dalam terjemahan Septuaginta Alkitab Ibrani. Dalam pemakaian Alkitab, demon menunjuk pada roh jahat, dan dalam bahasa Inggris kata ini sudah dipakai sebagai padanan iblis sejak sekitar tahun 825. Menurut salah satu ensiklopedia, δαίμων semula berarti makhluk ilahi yang biasanya dianggap baik, lalu dipakai bagi roh yang lebih rendah seperti roh pelindung, dan kemudian δαιμόνιον dipakai bagi roh jahat. Britannica 1911 mencatat bahwa menurut Hesiod manusia ras emas menjadi pelindung manusia fana setelah mati.
long_description.en: A demon is a supernatural entity usually regarded as evil. The word translates the Greek daimon, meaning a spirit that could be good or bad. The Greek word was at first not negative; the negative sense first appears in the Septuagint translation of the Hebrew Bible. In biblical usage a demon is an evil spirit, and in English the word has been used as a synonym for devils since about 825. One encyclopedia says δαίμων first meant a divine being normally regarded as good, was then used of lesser spirits such as guardian spirits, and later δαιμόνιον was applied to evil spirits. Britannica 1911 notes that, according to Hesiod, the men of the golden race became guardians over mortals after death.

long_description.id: Dalam banyak tradisi, demon bekerja sendiri-sendiri dan masing-masing menimbulkan jenis keburukan berbeda, misalnya penyakit tertentu atau bencana alam, sedangkan setan yang menjadi bawahan Iblis lebih sering muncul dalam kerangka teologis. Dalam agama Timur Dekat kuno dan agama Abrahamik, demon dianggap entitas yang merugikan dan dapat merasuki manusia sehingga perlu diusir. Demon masih ditakuti terutama karena kuasa yang dikaitkan kepadanya untuk merasuki makhluk hidup. Britannica 1911 membatasi istilah demon pada roh yang dipercaya menjalin hubungan dengan manusia.
long_description.en: In many traditions demons are independent operators, each causing a different kind of evil, such as specific diseases or destructive natural phenomena, whereas devils serving the Devil appear more often within a theological framework. In ancient Near Eastern and Abrahamic religions a demon is a harmful entity that may possess people and call for exorcism. Demons are still feared largely for their alleged power to possess living creatures. Britannica 1911 limits the term demon to spirits believed to enter into relations with the human race.

long_description.id: Di Mesopotamia kuno, demon umumnya roh bermusuhan yang lebih lemah daripada dewa, tetapi tidak selalu jahat: Pazuzu, misalnya, mampu berbuat baik dan dipasang sebagai pelindung dari Lamashtu. Menurut The Met, makhluk gaib dalam sumber-sumber kuno tampak sebagian besar amoral. Demon Mesopotamia mencakup galla yang menyeret manusia ke dunia bawah, dan Lamaštu yang dalam kisah Banjir Besar ditugaskan membunuh manusia. Orang melindungi diri dengan jimat, sihir, atau berlindung pada demon atau dewa lain. Britannica 1911 menyebut demonologi Babilonia kuno sangat rumit: gangguan kecil seperti jatuh mendadak atau sakit kepala dianggap ulah makhluk jahat.
long_description.en: In ancient Mesopotamia demons were generally hostile spirits weaker than gods, but not always evil: Pazuzu, for example, was capable of good and was set up as a shield against Lamashtu. According to the Met, supernatural beings in ancient sources seem largely amoral. Mesopotamian demons include the galla who drag mortals to the underworld and Lamaštu, who in the Great Flood tale is tasked with killing humans. People protected themselves with amulets, magic, or refuge with another demon or deity. Britannica 1911 calls ancient Babylonian demonology especially complicated: petty annoyances such as a sudden fall or a headache were set down to fiends.

long_description.id: Dalam demonologi Mesir kuno, demon dibagi menjadi "penjaga" yang terikat pada tempat tertentu dan "pengembara" yang dikaitkan dengan perasukan, penyakit jiwa, kematian, dan wabah. Dalam Avesta Muda, demon menyebabkan penyakit dan kematian, tetapi dapat ditangkal dengan penyucian ritual dan doa suci. Dalam Kekristenan abad pertengahan, demon umumnya dianggap malaikat yang jatuh, sedangkan dalam budaya Islam mereka menyerupai jin tetapi dipandang jahat. Pesulap upacara memakai grimoire yang memuat nama dan kemampuan demon.
long_description.en: In ancient Egyptian demonology demons are divided into "guardians" tied to a specific place and "wanderers" associated with possession, mental illness, death, and plagues. In the Younger Avesta demons cause disease and death but can be warded off by ritual purification and sacred prayers. In medieval Christianity demons were generally considered fallen angels, while in Islamic culture they resemble the jinn but are seen as malign. Ceremonial magicians used grimoires listing the names and abilities of demons.

long_description.id: Pada bagian akhir kitab-kitab Perjanjian Lama dan tulisan rabinik, demon dianggap bukan hanya mencelakai manusia tetapi juga menggoda mereka berbuat jahat, sehingga dipandang musuh Allah; menurut spekulasi Yahudi, mereka adalah malaikat jatuh. Dalam seni rakyat, demon umumnya digambarkan dengan sayap kelelawar, tanduk, ekor runcing, dan cakar seperti burung. Penggambaran demon dalam seni Barat Kristen baru dimulai pada abad ke-12, dan pada Abad Pertengahan demon dilukiskan dalam rupa paling mengerikan, terutama menyiksa orang terkutuk di neraka. Britannica 1911 juga menyebut incubi dan succubi sebagai kelas demon malam yang konon bersetubuh dengan manusia dalam tidurnya.
long_description.en: In the late Old Testament books and rabbinical writings demons were regarded as harming people and also seducing them to evil, and so as God's enemies; according to Jewish speculation they were fallen angels. Folk art commonly gave demons bat wings, horns, a pointed tail, and birdlike claws. Representations in Christian Western art began only in the 12th century, and in the Middle Ages demons were shown in the most horrible forms, especially tormenting the damned in hell. Britannica 1911 also names incubi and succubi as nocturnal demons said to consort with people in their sleep.

cultural_context.id: Menurut Britannica 1911, anggapan bahwa dunia roh itu jahat tidak bersifat universal, dan kadang dewa-dewa agama lama merosot menjadi demon dalam kepercayaan yang menggantikannya.
cultural_context.en: According to Britannica 1911, ascribing malevolence to the spirit world is not universal, and the gods of an older religion sometimes degenerate into the demons of the belief that supersedes it.

text.id: Hesiod adalah penulis paling awal yang menyebutnya; dalam seni Yunani ia digambarkan sejak abad ke-6 SM.
text.en: Hesiod is the earliest author to mention him; in Greek art he is depicted from the 6th century BCE.

short_description.id: Eros adalah dewa cinta dan hasrat dalam mitologi Yunani, digambarkan sebagai dewa purba penciptaan atau sebagai putra Aphrodite yang bersenjata busur dan panah.
short_description.en: Eros is the Greek god of love and desire, portrayed either as a primordial god of creation or as Aphrodite's son armed with bow and arrows.

long_description.id: Eros adalah dewa cinta Yunani, lebih tepatnya hasrat yang bergairah dan jasmani. Menurut Hesiod ia salah satu dewa purba yang bersama Chaos dan Gaia bertanggung jawab atas penciptaan; sumber lain menyebutnya dewa purba prokreasi yang muncul dengan sendirinya, dan kaum Orfik menamainya Phanes. Dalam tradisi lain ia lahir dari telur: kosmogoni Orfik menyebutnya hermafrodit dari telur yang diletakkan Chronos, dan Aristophanes memakai gagasan serupa dengan telur perak yang dikeluarkan Nyx dan Aither.
long_description.en: Eros was the Greek god of love, specifically the kind of desire that is passionate and bodily. According to Hesiod he was one of the primeval gods who, with Chaos and Gaia, was responsible for the Creation; another source calls him the primordial god of procreation who emerged self-formed, and the Orphics named him Phanes. In other traditions he is born from an egg: the Orphic cosmogonies make him a hermaphrodite from an egg put by Chronos, and Aristophanes uses a similar idea with a silver egg laid by Nyx and Aither.

long_description.id: Eros yang lebih muda adalah putra Aphrodite, anak nakal yang bersenjata busur dan panah; dalam satu silsilah ayahnya adalah Ares. Tradisi lain memberinya orang tua berbeda, misalnya Iris dan Zephyros, atau Aphrodite dan Ouranos. Ia sering digambarkan sebagai anak Aphrodite yang tidak penurut tetapi sangat setia, dan dalam beberapa tradisi ia punya adik bernama Anteros, sosok lebih gelap yang membalas cinta tak berbalas.
long_description.en: The younger Eros is the son of Aphrodite, a mischievous godling armed with bow and arrows; in one genealogy his father is Ares. Other traditions give him different parents, such as Iris and Zephyros, or Aphrodite and Ouranos. He is often portrayed as Aphrodite's disobedient but fiercely loyal child, and in some traditions he has a younger brother, Anteros, a darker figure who avenges unrequited love.

long_description.id: Eros memilih sasarannya tanpa peringatan dan menyerang hati mereka, membawa kebingungan dan perasaan yang tak tertahankan. Panah Eros dikisahkan membuat manusia, pahlawan, dan dewa jatuh cinta, dan tak seorang pun kebal. Dalam satu kisah ia memiliki dua panah berlawanan: ujung emas membangkitkan cinta, ujung timbal yang tumpul menolaknya. Ia membuat Apollo jatuh cinta pada Daphne dan Medea pada Jason. Ia sendiri tidak kebal: ia jatuh cinta dan menikahi Psyche meski ditentang Aphrodite. Satu sumber menyebutnya menjinakkan singa dan harimau, mematahkan petir Zeus, dan merampas senjata Heracles; dalam kisah lain ia dan Aphrodite berubah menjadi ikan untuk lolos dari Typhon.
long_description.en: Eros picks his targets without warning and strikes at their hearts, bringing confusion and irrepressible feelings. Eros's arrows were said to make humans, heroes, and gods fall in love, and no one was immune. In one tale he holds two opposing arrows: a gold point rouses love and a blunt point of lead routs it. He made Apollo fall in love with Daphne and Medea with Jason. He was not himself immune: he fell for and married Psyche against Aphrodite's wishes. One source says he tames lions and tigers, breaks Zeus's thunderbolts, and deprives Heracles of his arms; in another tale he and Aphrodite turned into fishes to escape Typhon.

long_description.id: Eros menerima pemujaan di Thespiae (dengan festival Erotidia), Athena, Megara, Philadelphia, Leuctra, Velia, dan Parium, dan altarnya ada di Akademi Athena serta gimnasium Elis. Dalam seni Yunani ia paling sering digambarkan sebagai pemuda tampan yang riang, bermahkota bunga, terutama mawar. Sejak abad ke-6 SM ia biasanya remaja bersayap yang sering membawa karangan bunga kemenangan, dan kadang muncul berdua atau bertiga sebagai Erotes, lambang berbagai bentuk cinta; ia baru sering membawa busur sejak abad ke-4 SM. Seni klasik menampilkannya sebagai pemuda bersayap, seni Helenistik juga sebagai bayi, dan dalam seni Romawi kemudian, dengan nama Cupid, sebagai bayi montok. Praxiteles dikatakan menyempurnakan citranya sebagai pemuda dewasa yang sangat rupawan.
long_description.en: Eros received cult worship at Thespiae (with its Erotidia festival), Athens, Megara, Philadelphia, Leuctra, Velia, and Parium, and had altars at the Academy of Athens and the gymnasium at Elis. In Greek art he is most often a carefree, beautiful youth crowned with flowers, especially roses. From the 6th century BCE he is usually a winged adolescent often carrying a victory wreath, and he sometimes appears in twos or threes as Erotes, symbolizing the different forms of love; he is shown with a bow with any frequency only from the 4th century BCE. Classical art shows him as a winged youth, Hellenistic art also as a baby, and later Roman art, under the name Cupid, as a chubby baby. Praxiteles is said to have perfected his image as a full-grown youth of great beauty.

long_description.id: Mitos Yunani mengaitkan Eros terutama dengan kesuburan, hasrat, dan cinta seksual, dan karena gairah itu sulit dikendalikan, ia dianggap semacam penipu yang licik: kadang jahil tanpa bahaya, kadang kejam dengan serangan mendadak. Ia tidak pernah dianggap salah satu dari 12 dewa Olimpus, dan dianggap pelindung khusus cinta sesama jenis. Dalam salah satu dialog filsafat Yunani, seorang pembicara menyebut Cinta sebagai dewa tertua. Hal-hal yang suci baginya dan sering menyertainya dalam seni mencakup mawar, binatang buas yang dijinakkan, kelinci, ayam jantan, dan domba jantan. Padanannya dalam tradisi Romawi adalah Cupid.
long_description.en: Myths tied Eros chiefly to fertility, desire and sexual love, and since such passions were hard to master he was seen as something of a cunning trickster: sometimes harmlessly mischievous, sometimes cruel in his surprise attacks. He was never counted among the 12 Olympian gods, and was seen as the particular protector of homosexual love. One speaker in a Greek philosophical dialogue calls Love the most ancient of the gods. Things sacred to him that often accompany him in art include the rose, tamed wild beasts, the hare, the cock, and the ram. His Roman counterpart is Cupid.

cultural_context.id: Menurut sumbernya, kurangnya disiplin dan ketidakandalan Eros mungkin menjelaskan mengapa ia tak pernah dianggap salah satu dari 12 dewa Olimpus; ia juga dianggap pelindung khusus cinta sesama jenis.
cultural_context.en: According to the source, Eros's lack of discipline and unreliability may explain why he was never counted among the 12 Olympian gods; he was also considered the specific protector of homosexual love.
