claims.quote: Eros was the Greek god of love, or more precisely, passionate and physical desire.

statement.id: Eros adalah dewa Yunani yang berkaitan dengan cinta dan hasrat.
statement.en: Eros is the Greek god of love and passionate desire.

claims.quote: EROS was the primordial god (protogenos) of procreation who emerged self-formed at the dawn of creation.

statement.id: Satu tradisi menggambarkan Eros sebagai dewa purba yang muncul pada awal penciptaan.
statement.en: One tradition describes Eros as a primordial god emerging at creation.

claims.quote: The younger Eros, a mischievous godling armed with bow and arrows, was a son of the goddess Aphrodite.

statement.id: Dalam tradisi lain, Eros muda adalah putra Aphrodite yang membawa busur dan panah.
statement.en: In another tradition, the younger Eros is Aphrodite's son carrying bow and arrows.

claims.quote: He was also sometimes regarded as the child of Aphrodite, with Ares, the god of war, as his father

statement.id: Salah satu silsilah menyebut Eros putra Aphrodite dan Ares.
statement.en: One genealogy makes Eros the son of Aphrodite and Ares.

claims.quote: It was thought that Eros' arrows, often randomly aimed, made people, heroes, and gods fall in love - no one was immune.

statement.id: Panah Eros dikisahkan membuat manusia, pahlawan, dan dewa jatuh cinta.
statement.en: Eros's arrows were said to make humans, heroes, and gods fall in love.

claims.quote: Eros was not himself immune to the powers of love, and he famously fell for and married Psyche against the wishes of his mother Aphrodite.

statement.id: Eros jatuh cinta dan menikahi Psyche meskipun Aphrodite menentangnya.
statement.en: Eros fell in love with and married Psyche despite Aphrodite's opposition.

claims.quote: In Greek religion, Eros was the subject of cult worship in Thespiae (with its sporting and artistic festival, the Erotidia) and at Athens, Megara, Philadelphia, Leuctra, Velia, and Parium.

statement.id: Eros dipuja antara lain di Thespiae, Athena, dan Megara.
statement.en: Eros received cult worship at Thespiae, Athens, Megara, and other places.

claims.quote: In Classical art he is usually represented as a beautiful winged youth.

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani klasik, Eros lazim digambarkan sebagai pemuda bersayap.
statement.en: Classical art usually portrays Eros as a winged youth.

claims.quote: During the Hellenistic period (323–31 B.C.) a new image of the god as a baby took hold.

statement.id: Pada zaman Helenistik, gambaran Eros sebagai bayi mulai menonjol.
statement.en: In the Hellenistic period, depiction of Eros as a baby became common.

claims.quote: Eros is the Greek god of love and Cupid is his Roman equivalent.

statement.id: Cupid adalah padanan Romawi Eros.
statement.en: Cupid is the Roman counterpart of Eros.

claims.quote: Without warning Eros selects his targets and forcefully strikes at their hearts, bringing confusion and irrepressible feelings.

statement.id: Tanpa peringatan Eros memilih sasarannya dan menyerang hati mereka dengan keras, membawa kebingungan dan perasaan yang tak tertahankan.
statement.en: Eros picks his targets without warning and strikes their hearts, causing confusion and overwhelming feelings.

claims.quote: Eros is most often represented in Greek art as a carefree and beautiful youth, crowned with flowers, especially of roses which were closely associated with the god.

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani Eros paling sering digambarkan sebagai pemuda tampan yang riang, bermahkota bunga, terutama mawar yang erat dikaitkan dengan sang dewa.
statement.en: In Greek art Eros is most often shown as a carefree, beautiful youth crowned with flowers, especially roses, which were closely associated with him.

claims.quote: According to Hesiod in his Theogony, Eros was one of the primaeval gods who, along with Chaos and Gaia (Earth), was responsible for the Creation.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod dalam Theogony, Eros adalah salah satu dewa purba yang bersama Chaos dan Gaia (Bumi) bertanggung jawab atas penciptaan.
statement.en: According to Hesiod's Theogony, Eros was one of the primeval gods who, with Chaos and Gaia (Earth), was responsible for the Creation.

claims.quote: In other traditions, such as the Orphic cosmogonies, Eros is born a hermaphrodite from an egg which was put by the Titan Chronos (who represents Time) into the womb of Chaos.

statement.id: Dalam tradisi lain seperti kosmogoni Orfik, Eros lahir sebagai hermafrodit dari telur yang diletakkan Titan Chronos (Waktu) ke dalam rahim Chaos.
statement.en: In other traditions such as the Orphic cosmogonies, Eros is born a hermaphrodite from an egg put by the Titan Chronos (Time) into the womb of Chaos.

claims.quote: The Greek comic playwright Aristophanes (c. 460 - c. 380 BCE) uses the same idea but has Eros hatch out from a silver egg laid by Nyx (Night) and Aither (Wind).

statement.id: Penulis komedi Yunani Aristophanes (sekitar 460-380 SM) memakai gagasan serupa tetapi membuat Eros menetas dari telur perak yang dikeluarkan Nyx (Malam) dan Aither (Angin).
statement.en: The comic playwright Aristophanes (c. 460-c. 380 BCE) uses the same idea but has Eros hatch from a silver egg laid by Nyx (Night) and Aither (Wind).

claims.quote: In some traditions, Eros also had a younger brother - Anteros - who was a much darker figure and an avenger of unrequited love.

statement.id: Dalam beberapa tradisi, Eros punya adik bernama Anteros, sosok yang jauh lebih gelap dan pembalas cinta yang tak berbalas.
statement.en: In some traditions Eros had a younger brother, Anteros, a much darker figure and an avenger of unrequited love.

claims.quote: In the Greek myths, Eros was associated above all with fertility, desire and sexual love, and because such passions could prove very difficult to control, the god was considered something of a cunning trickster.

statement.id: Dalam mitos Yunani, Eros terutama dikaitkan dengan kesuburan, hasrat, dan cinta seksual; karena gairah itu sulit dikendalikan, sang dewa dianggap semacam penipu yang licik.
statement.en: In Greek myth Eros was associated above all with fertility, desire and sexual love, and because such passions were hard to control he was considered something of a cunning trickster.

claims.quote: Sometimes the god is playful and harmlessly mischievous but at other times he is cruel with his surprise attacks that bring only reckless passion and confusion

statement.id: Kadang sang dewa bermain-main dan jahil tanpa bahaya, tetapi di waktu lain ia kejam dengan serangan mendadak yang hanya membawa nafsu gegabah dan kebingungan.
statement.en: Sometimes the god is playful and harmlessly mischievous, but at other times cruel with surprise attacks that bring only reckless passion and confusion.

claims.quote: The lack of discipline and general unreliability of Eros may explain why he was never considered one of the 12 Olympian Gods.

statement.id: Menurut penulis sumber ini, kurangnya disiplin dan ketidakandalan Eros mungkin menjelaskan mengapa ia tak pernah dianggap salah satu dari 12 dewa Olimpus.
statement.en: According to the source, Eros's lack of discipline and general unreliability may explain why he was never counted among the 12 Olympian gods.

claims.quote: Finally, Eros was considered the specific protector of homosexual love.

statement.id: Eros juga dianggap pelindung khusus cinta sesama jenis.
statement.en: Eros was also considered the specific protector of homosexual love.

claims.quote: One of the most famous episodes involving this trick was when Apollo ridiculed the skills of Eros as an archer and the latter fired one of his arrows at the great god, making him fall in love with the nymph Daphne.

statement.id: Salah satu kisah terkenal: Apollo mengejek kemampuan Eros memanah, lalu Eros menembakkan panah ke dewa besar itu sehingga ia jatuh cinta pada nimfa Daphne.
statement.en: In one famous episode Apollo ridiculed Eros's skill as an archer, and Eros shot one of his arrows at the great god, making him fall in love with the nymph Daphne.

claims.quote: Another such instance of Eros using his love-carrying arrows was when he made Medea fall in love with the great hero Jason, he who grabbed the Golden Fleece.

statement.id: Contoh lain: Eros membuat Medea jatuh cinta pada pahlawan besar Jason, pengambil Bulu Domba Emas.
statement.en: Another instance: Eros made Medea fall in love with the great hero Jason, who seized the Golden Fleece.

claims.quote: Altars to Eros were placed at both the Academy of Athens and the gymnasium at Elis

statement.id: Altar bagi Eros didirikan di Akademi Athena dan di gimnasium Elis.
statement.en: Altars to Eros were placed at the Academy of Athens and at the gymnasium at Elis.

claims.quote: In ancient Greek art from the 6th century BCE, Eros is usually depicted as an adolescent with wings and he often carries a wreath of victory.
claims.locator: How is Eros Represented in Art?

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani kuno sejak abad ke-6 SM, Eros biasanya digambarkan sebagai remaja bersayap yang sering membawa karangan bunga kemenangan.
statement.en: In ancient Greek art from the 6th century BCE Eros is usually depicted as a winged adolescent who often carries a victory wreath.

claims.quote: Surprisingly, he is only depicted carrying a bow with any great frequency from the 4th century BCE, although the first literary reference is much earlier and found in the tragedian Euripides' Iphigenia in Aulis (c. 406 BCE).
claims.locator: How is Eros Represented in Art?

statement.id: Eros baru sering digambarkan membawa busur sejak abad ke-4 SM, meski rujukan sastra pertamanya jauh lebih awal, dalam Iphigenia in Aulis karya Euripides (sekitar 406 SM).
statement.en: Eros is shown carrying a bow with any frequency only from the 4th century BCE, though the first literary reference is much earlier, in Euripides' Iphigenia in Aulis (c. 406 BCE).

claims.quote: Figures of Eros can also appear in twos or threes, when they are referred to as Erotes, symbolic of the different forms love can take.
claims.locator: How is Eros Represented in Art?

statement.id: Sosok Eros juga dapat muncul berdua atau bertiga, disebut Erotes, yang melambangkan berbagai bentuk cinta.
statement.en: Figures of Eros can also appear in twos or threes, called Erotes, symbolizing the different forms love can take.

claims.quote: It is only in later Roman art that Eros, under his new name Cupid, is commonly portrayed rather unflatteringly as a chubby and mischievous baby.
claims.locator: How is Eros Represented in Art?

statement.id: Baru dalam seni Romawi kemudian Eros, dengan nama barunya Cupid, lazim digambarkan sebagai bayi montok dan jahil.
statement.en: Only in later Roman art is Eros, under his new name Cupid, commonly portrayed as a chubby, mischievous baby.

claims.quote: Therefore I say Love is the most ancient of the gods, the most honoured, and the most powerful in helping men gain virtue and blessedness.

statement.id: Dalam Symposium karya Plato, tokoh yang berbicara menyebut Cinta sebagai dewa tertua, paling dihormati, dan paling berkuasa dalam membantu manusia meraih keutamaan dan kebahagiaan.
statement.en: In Plato's Symposium a speaker calls Love the most ancient of the gods, the most honoured, and the most powerful in helping men gain virtue and blessedness.

claims.quote: he is present, too, on the east frieze of the Parthenon, shown as a child next to Aphrodite.
claims.locator: How is Eros Represented in Art?

statement.id: Eros juga hadir pada friso timur Parthenon, digambarkan sebagai anak di samping Aphrodite.
statement.en: Eros is also present on the east frieze of the Parthenon, shown as a child next to Aphrodite.

claims.quote: He was the driving force behind the generation of new life in the cosmos. The Orphics named him Phanes, a primal being hatched from the world-egg.

statement.id: Eros adalah daya pendorong lahirnya kehidupan baru di kosmos; kaum Orfik menamainya Phanes, makhluk purba yang menetas dari telur dunia.
statement.en: Eros was the driving force behind the generation of new life in the cosmos; the Orphics named him Phanes, a primal being hatched from the world-egg.

claims.quote: and Eros (Love) [Procreation], fairest among the deathless gods, who unnerves the limbs and overcomes the mind and wise counsels of all gods and all men within them.
claims.locator: Eros & the Birth of the Cosmos

statement.id: Dalam Theogony, Eros adalah yang tertampan di antara para dewa abadi, yang melemahkan anggota tubuh dan menaklukkan pikiran serta nasihat bijak semua dewa dan manusia.
statement.en: In Hesiod's Theogony Eros is fairest among the deathless gods, who unnerves the limbs and overcomes the mind and wise counsels of all gods and all men.

claims.quote: Firstly, black-winged Nyx (Night) laid a germless egg in the bosom of the infinite deeps of Erebos (Darkness), and from this, after the revolution of long ages, sprang the graceful Eros [the primordial Eros] with his glittering golden wings
claims.locator: Eros & the Birth of the Cosmos

statement.id: Dalam Birds karya Aristophanes, Nyx bersayap hitam bertelur dalam kedalaman Erebos, dan setelah zaman-zaman panjang lahirlah Eros yang anggun dengan sayap emas berkilau.
statement.en: In Aristophanes' Birds black-winged Nyx lays an egg in the deeps of Erebos, and after long ages the graceful Eros springs from it with glittering golden wings.

claims.quote: Translation Sexual Desire (eros)

statement.id: Theoi mengartikan nama Eros sebagai "hasrat seksual".
statement.en: Theoi translates the name Eros as "sexual desire".

claims.quote: It was he who lit the flame of love in the hearts of the gods and men, armed with either a bow and arrows or a flaming torch.

statement.id: Dialah yang menyalakan api cinta di hati para dewa dan manusia, bersenjatakan busur dan panah atau obor menyala.
statement.en: It was he who lit the flame of love in the hearts of gods and men, armed with either a bow and arrows or a flaming torch.

claims.quote: Eros was often portrayed as the disobedient but fiercely loyal child of Aphrodite.

statement.id: Eros sering digambarkan sebagai anak Aphrodite yang tidak penurut tetapi sangat setia.
statement.en: Eros was often portrayed as the disobedient but fiercely loyal child of Aphrodite.

claims.quote: one shaft that rouses love and one that routs it. The first gleams bright with piercing point of gold; the other, cull and blunt is tipped with lead.
claims.locator: Eros & the Loves of the Gods

statement.id: Dalam Metamorphoses karya Ovid, Eros memiliki dua panah berlawanan: satu membangkitkan cinta dengan ujung emas runcing, satu lagi mengusirnya dengan ujung timbal yang tumpul.
statement.en: In Ovid's Metamorphoses Eros has two opposing arrows: one rouses love with a piercing gold point, the other routs it with a blunt tip of lead.

claims.quote: Most men consider Eros to be the youngest of the gods and the son of Aphrodite.

statement.id: Menurut Pausanias, kebanyakan orang menganggap Eros dewa termuda dan putra Aphrodite.
statement.en: According to Pausanias, most men consider Eros the youngest of the gods and the son of Aphrodite.

claims.quote: Alkaios (Alcaeus) [Greek poet C6th B.C.] said Eros was the child of Iris (Rainbow) and Zephyros (West Wind); Sappho [Greek poet C6th B.C.] made him the child of Aphrodite and Ouranos (Uranus, Heaven).

statement.id: Menurut sebuah scholion, Alkaios menyebut Eros anak Iris dan Zephyros, sedangkan Sappho menjadikannya anak Aphrodite dan Ouranos.
statement.en: According to a scholion, Alcaeus said Eros was the child of Iris and Zephyros, while Sappho made him the child of Aphrodite and Ouranos.

claims.quote: conceived Eros (Love), who partly because he is naturally a lover of the beautiful, and because Aphrodite is herself beautiful, and also because he was born on her birthday, is her follower and attendant.

statement.id: Dalam Symposium, Eros dikandung (oleh Penia) dan, karena mencintai keindahan serta lahir pada hari ulang tahun Aphrodite, ia menjadi pengikut dan pelayannya.
statement.en: In the Symposium Eros is conceived (by Penia) and, being a lover of beauty and born on Aphrodite's birthday, becomes her follower and attendant.

claims.quote: he tames lions and tigers, breaks the thunderbolts of Zeus, deprives Heracles of his arms, and carries on his sport with the monsters of the sea.

statement.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, Eros menjinakkan singa dan harimau, mematahkan petir Zeus, merampas senjata Heracles, dan bermain dengan monster laut.
statement.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, Eros tames lions and tigers, breaks Zeus's thunderbolts, deprives Heracles of his arms, and sports with sea monsters.

claims.quote: Among the things sacred to Eros, and which frequently appear with him in works of art, we may mention the rose, wild beasts which are tamed by him, the hare, the cock, and the ram.

statement.id: Hal-hal yang suci bagi Eros dan sering menyertainya dalam karya seni mencakup mawar, binatang buas yang ia jinakkan, kelinci, ayam jantan, dan domba jantan.
statement.en: Things sacred to Eros that often accompany him in art include the rose, wild beasts he tames, the hare, the cock, and the ram.

claims.quote: Eros was a favourite subject with the ancient statuaries, but his representation seems to have been brought to perfection by Praxiteles, who conceived him as a full-grown youth of the most perfect beauty.

statement.id: Eros adalah subjek favorit para pematung kuno, dan penggambarannya tampaknya disempurnakan oleh Praxiteles, yang membayangkannya sebagai pemuda dewasa berparas paling sempurna.
statement.en: Eros was a favourite subject of ancient sculptors, and his image seems to have been perfected by Praxiteles, who conceived him as a full-grown youth of perfect beauty.

claims.quote: Homer does not mention Eros, and Hesiod, the earliest author that mentions him, describes him as the cosmogonic Eros.

statement.id: Homer tidak menyebut Eros; Hesiod, penulis paling awal yang menyebutnya, menggambarkannya sebagai Eros kosmogonik.
statement.en: Homer does not mention Eros; Hesiod, the earliest author to mention him, describes him as the cosmogonic Eros.

claims.quote: once Venus [Aphrodite] and her son Cupid [Eros] came in Syria to the river Euphrates. There Typhon [Typhoeus], of whom we have already spoken, suddenly appeared. Venus [Aphrodite] and her son threw themselves into the river and there changed their forms to fishes, and by so doing this escaped danger.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Hyginus, ketika Typhon muncul di tepi Efrat, Venus (Aphrodite) dan putranya Cupid (Eros) terjun ke sungai dan berubah wujud menjadi ikan sehingga selamat.
statement.en: In Hyginus's tale, when Typhon appeared at the Euphrates, Venus (Aphrodite) and her son Cupid (Eros) threw themselves into the river and changed into fishes, escaping danger.

claims.quote: Once, when Venus' [Aphrodite's] son [Eros] was kissing her, his quiver dangling down, a jutting arrow, unbeknown, had grazed her breast.
claims.locator: Eros & the Loves of the Gods

statement.id: Dalam Metamorphoses karya Ovid, ketika Eros mencium ibunya, sebuah panah dari tabungnya tanpa sengaja menggores dada Aphrodite.
statement.en: In Ovid's Metamorphoses, as Eros kissed his mother, an arrow from his quiver unknowingly grazed Aphrodite's breast.

claims.quote: Eros (Love), and comely Himeros (Desire) followed her [Aphrodite] at her birth at the first and as she went into the assembly of the gods.

statement.id: Dalam Theogony, Eros dan Himeros (Hasrat) mengikuti Aphrodite sejak kelahirannya dan ketika ia memasuki majelis para dewa.
statement.en: In Hesiod's Theogony Eros and comely Himeros (Desire) followed Aphrodite at her birth and as she went into the assembly of the gods.

claims.quote: [When the monster Typhoeus besieged Olympos :] ... for bold Eros has flown in panic, leaving behind his generative arrows

statement.id: Dalam Dionysiaca karya Nonnus, ketika Typhoeus mengepung Olimpus, Eros yang berani lari panik dengan meninggalkan panah-panahnya.
statement.en: In Nonnus's Dionysiaca, when Typhoeus besieged Olympos, bold Eros fled in panic, leaving his arrows behind.

claims.quote: Sprung as I am from Zeus, I have never felt the arrows of the Boy [i.e. Eros], and of love-charms I know nothing.
claims.locator: Eros & the Loves of the Gods

statement.id: Dalam Argonautica karya Apollonius, Athena menyatakan bahwa ia, yang lahir dari Zeus, tak pernah merasakan panah sang Anak (Eros).
statement.en: In Apollonius's Argonautica, Athena says that, sprung from Zeus, she has never felt the arrows of the Boy (Eros).

claims.quote: OFFSPRING [1.1] HEDONE (by Psykhe) (Apuleius 6.24)

statement.id: Theoi mencatat Hedone sebagai anak Eros dan Psyche menurut Apuleius.
statement.en: Theoi lists Hedone as Eros's offspring by Psyche, citing Apuleius.

claims.quote: The scene was particular popular in ancient art where the godlings flutter about the goddess as she reclines inside a conch-shell.

statement.id: Adegan Eros dan Himeros mengiringi Aphrodite sangat populer dalam seni kuno; para dewa kecil itu beterbangan di sekitar sang dewi yang bersandar dalam cangkang kerang.
statement.en: The scene of Eros and Himeros accompanying Aphrodite was particularly popular in ancient art, the godlings fluttering about the goddess reclining in a conch-shell.

short_description.id: Hanuman adalah dewa berwujud kera dalam mitologi India, pendamping setia Rama yang terkenal karena kekuatan, kecepatan, kemampuan mengubah wujud, dan baktinya.
short_description.en: Hanuman is a monkey-bodied deity of Indian mythology, Rama's devoted companion known for strength, speed, shape-changing and devotion.

long_description.id: Hanuman adalah satu-satunya tokoh berwujud hewan sepenuhnya yang dipuja sebagai dewa di India masa kini. Teks mitos menyebutnya anak kera Dewa Angin yang sangat kuat, cerdas, dan menguasai Weda; ia pengikut Rama yang tak ragu dan dapat mengambil rupa apa pun. Dari ayahnya ia mewarisi kekuatan dan kecepatan, dan ia dapat membesar atau mengecil sesuka hati. Epos menggambarkannya berwajah menyenangkan, berbicara santun, dan menguasai tiga Weda.
long_description.en: Hanuman is the only wholly animal figure revered as a god in India today. Mythic texts describe him as the very strong, keen-minded monkey child of the Wind God, learned in the Vedas; he is Rama's unquestioning devotee and can take on any form. From his father he inherits might and speed, and he can grow or shrink at will. The epic describes him as pleasant of face, courteous in speech and learned in the three Vedas.

long_description.id: Dalam Ramayana, Hanuman terbang melintasi samudra, menemukan tempat Sita ditawan, dan menyampaikannya kepada Rama. Di benteng Rahwana ia membakar seluruh tempat itu dan memperingatkan Rahwana. Dalam pertempuran, ia membunuh beberapa jenderal iblis, menghidupkan kembali saudara Rama, dan karena tak mengenali ramuan yang diminta, ia mencabut seluruh gunung dan membawanya ke medan perang. Pasukan kera itu membantu Rama membangun jembatan menyeberangi laut dan menyerbu benteng iblis. Terjemahan Griffith memuat bayangannya yang meluncur di atas samudra seperti kapal diterpa angin saat ia melompat.
long_description.en: In the Ramayana, Hanuman flies across the ocean, finds where Sita is imprisoned and brings word to Rama. Inside Ravana's fort he sets the whole place on fire and warns Ravana. In the battle he kills several demon generals, brings Rama's brother back to life, and, unable to identify the herbs required, uproots a whole mountain and carries it to the battlefield. The monkey army helped Rama build a bridge across the sea and storm the demon stronghold. Griffith's translation describes his shadow flying over the ocean like a ship before the gale as he leaps.

long_description.id: Menurut Purana, Hanuman adalah anak Dewa Angin dan putri Anjana, lahir dari aspek Shiva melalui perantaraan Dewa Angin. Saat bayi ia menyangka matahari buah matang dan melompat untuk menyambarnya; petir sang raja dewa mengenai dagunya, dan dari sinilah namanya berasal. Dalam terjemahan Griffith, Dewa Angin berjanji bahwa anaknya akan kuat, berani, dan bijak. Surya mengajarinya Weda. Dalam Mahabharata, Bhima tak sanggup menggeser ekor seekor kera tua yang ternyata Hanuman, yang kemudian setuju tinggal di bendera kereta Arjuna.
long_description.en: The Puranas make Hanuman the offspring of the Wind God and the princess Anjana, born from an aspect of Shiva through the Wind God's agency. As an infant he mistook the sun for a ripe fruit and leapt to grab it; the thunderbolt of the king of the gods struck his chin, and his name comes from this. In Griffith's translation the Wind God promises that his child will be strong, brave and wise. Surya taught him the Vedas. In the Mahabharata, Bhima cannot move the tail of an old monkey who proves to be Hanuman, who later agrees to reside on Arjuna's chariot flag.

long_description.id: Hanuman dihormati di seluruh India karena kerendahan hati dan kesetiaannya, dan pemujanya percaya memuja Hanuman memberi tenaga fisik, keberanian, dan pencerahan batin. Jimat bergambar Hanuman dipercaya melindungi pemakainya. Kuil kecil Hanuman umum ditemukan di kantor polisi dan klub gulat; ia paling sering digambarkan dengan gada, dan dikenal pula di Indonesia, Thailand, dan Malaysia. Hanuman Chalisa karya Tulsidas masih dilantunkan ribuan orang dan memuliakan kekuatan, bakti, selibat, dan kebenaran.
long_description.en: Hanuman is venerated across India for his humility and loyalty, and devotees believe that worshipping him brings physical energy, fearlessness and mental enlightenment. Amulets bearing his image are believed to protect the wearer. Small shrines to him are common in police stations and wrestling clubs; he is most often depicted with a mace, and is also known in Indonesia, Thailand and Malaysia. Tulsidas's Hanuman Chalisa is still recited by thousands and celebrates strength, devotion, celibacy and righteousness.

literal_meaning.id: Menurut satu kisah, hanu berarti "dagu" dan man berarti "memiliki"; Hanuman berarti "yang berdagu [patah]".
literal_meaning.en: According to one story, hanu means "chin" and man "having"; Hanuman means "he of the [broken] chin".

description.en: Hanuman can take any form and increase or decrease his body size at will; in Griffith's translation he stands dilated in gigantic size before their eyes.

description.id: Hanuman memiliki kekuatan sangat besar dan mewarisi tenaga serta kecepatan dari Dewa Angin; ia mencabut seluruh gunung dan Bhima tak mampu menggeser ekornya.
description.en: Hanuman has enormous strength and inherits might and speed from the Wind God; he uproots a whole mountain and Bhima cannot move his tail.

description.id: Dalam terjemahan Griffith, Brahmá menganugerahkan bahwa tak seorang pun boleh membunuh putra Dewa Angin dengan baja dalam pertempuran, dan Indra bersumpah petirnya tak akan melukainya.
description.en: In Griffith's translation Brahmá grants that none should slay the Wind-God's son with steel in battle, and Indra swears his bolt shall never injure him.

claims.quote: Hanuman is one of several zoomorphic characters in Indian mythology, but is the only wholly animal figure who is revered as a god today.

statement.id: Hanuman adalah sosok mitologi India berwujud hewan yang dipuja sebagai dewa.
statement.en: Hanuman is an animal-formed figure in Indian mythology revered as a god.

claims.quote: a deity with the body of a monkey; a companion of the deity Rama and an exemplar of self-discipline and devotion.

statement.id: Hanuman adalah dewa bertubuh kera, pendamping Rama, dan teladan bakti.
statement.en: Hanuman is a monkey-bodied deity, Rama's companion, and an exemplar of devotion.

claims.quote: The mythic texts speak of him as a monkey child of the Wind God, as possessing enormous strength, keen intellect and a mastery over the Vedas and other branches of learning.

statement.id: Teks mitos menggambarkan Hanuman sebagai anak dewa angin yang kuat dan menguasai Weda.
statement.en: Mythic texts describe Hanuman as the Wind God's monkey child with strength and Vedic learning.

claims.quote: He is also an unquestioning devotee of Rama, the hero of the epic Ramayana, and has the ability to take on any form he wishes.

statement.id: Hanuman mengabdi kepada Rama dan dapat mengambil berbagai wujud.
statement.en: Hanuman is devoted to Rama and can assume any form.

claims.quote: He is the one who flies across the oceans (he is Wind's child), locates the exact place where Sita is imprisoned and brings this information back to Rama.

statement.id: Hanuman terbang menyeberangi lautan untuk menemukan Sita dan membawa kabar kepada Rama.
statement.en: Hanuman flies over the sea to locate Sita and report back to Rama.

claims.quote: Being unable to identify the exact four herbs that the physician had described, Hanuman uproots the entire mountain and carries it back to the battlefield.

statement.id: Ketika tidak bisa mengenali ramuan penyembuh, Hanuman membawa seluruh gunung ke medan perang.
statement.en: Unable to identify the healing herbs, Hanuman carries the whole mountain to the battlefield.

claims.quote: He is also a shapeshifter who can increase and decrease his body size at will.

statement.id: Hanuman dapat mengubah wujud dan ukuran tubuhnya.
statement.en: Hanuman can change form and alter his size.

claims.quote: Hanuman is worshipped as a god in several parts of India today.

statement.id: Hanuman masih dipuja sebagai dewa di berbagai wilayah India.
statement.en: Hanuman remains worshiped as a god in parts of India.

claims.quote: Hanuman is venerated across India on account of his humility and loyalty, and devotees believe worshipping him imbues them with physical energy, fearlessness, and mental enlightenment.

statement.id: Menurut The Met, umat memuja Hanuman atas kerendahan hati dan kesetiaannya serta mengharapkan kekuatan dan keberanian.
statement.en: The Met notes Hanuman's veneration for humility and loyalty, with devotees seeking strength and courage.

claims.quote: Amulets featuring large depictions of Hanuman protect the wearer, providing prosperity, peace, and good health.

statement.id: Jimat bergambar Hanuman dipercaya melindungi pemakainya dan membawa kesejahteraan.
statement.en: Hanuman amulets are believed to protect their wearers and bring well-being.

claims.quote: While within the demon fort on his quest for Sita, he sets the entire place on fire and warns Ravana about an impending attack unless Sita is returned unharmed.

statement.id: Saat berada di benteng para iblis untuk mencari Sita, Hanuman membakar seluruh tempat itu dan memperingatkan Rahwana tentang serangan yang akan datang kecuali Sita dikembalikan dengan selamat.
statement.en: While inside the demon fort searching for Sita, Hanuman sets the whole place on fire and warns Ravana of an impending attack unless Sita is returned unharmed.

claims.quote: During the Rama-Ravana battle, Hanuman not only kills several demon generals but also brings Rama's brother back to life.

statement.id: Dalam pertempuran Rama-Rahwana, Hanuman membunuh beberapa jenderal iblis dan juga menghidupkan kembali saudara Rama.
statement.en: In the Rama-Ravana battle Hanuman kills several demon generals and also brings Rama's brother back to life.

claims.quote: The catch? The battle is raging on in Lanka, across the southernmost tip of the country, while the Himalayas are far up north, and the herbs are needed within the next few hours, before the new day dawns. Hanuman leaps up into the air, flies northwards at lightning speed, and alights atop the Himalayas.

statement.id: Pertempuran berkecamuk di Lanka sementara Himalaya jauh di utara, dan ramuan dibutuhkan sebelum fajar; Hanuman melompat ke udara, terbang ke utara secepat kilat, dan mendarat di puncak Himalaya.
statement.en: The battle rages in Lanka while the Himalayas are far to the north and the herbs are needed before dawn; Hanuman leaps into the air, flies north at lightning speed and alights atop the Himalayas.

claims.quote: This monkey group was instrumental in giving Rama key information about Sita. They helped him build a bridge across the seas, and cross over with a monkey army that successfully stormed the demon stronghold and freed Sita.

statement.id: Kelompok kera itu membantu Rama membangun jembatan menyeberangi laut dan menyeberang bersama pasukan kera yang berhasil menyerbu benteng iblis dan membebaskan Sita.
statement.en: The group of monkeys helped Rama build a bridge across the sea and cross with a monkey army that stormed the demon stronghold and freed Sita.

claims.quote: From his father, the Wind God, he inherits his might and speed.

statement.id: Dari ayahnya, Dewa Angin, Hanuman mewarisi kekuatan dan kecepatannya.
statement.en: From his father, the Wind God, Hanuman inherits his might and speed.

claims.quote: Hanuman is described in the epic as one of extremely pleasant visage, perfect diction, elegant speech, and faultless manners. He is also described as being knowledgeable in the three Vedas.

statement.id: Dalam wiracarita itu Hanuman digambarkan berwajah sangat menyenangkan, berdiksi sempurna, bertutur santun, dan bersopan santun tanpa cela, serta menguasai tiga Weda.
statement.en: In the epic Hanuman is described as having an extremely pleasant face, perfect diction, elegant speech and faultless manners, and as knowing the three Vedas.

claims.quote: One of the princes in the Mahabharat is also a son of the Wind God and it is to him that Hanuman makes his only appearance in this epic. This prince, named Bhima, was as mighty as the wind ... he could not move even a whisker of the tail. It transpired that the monkey was none other than Hanuman, the mightiest being on earth.

statement.id: Dalam Mahabharata, Bhima tak mampu menggeser sehelai pun ekor seekor kera tua yang ternyata adalah Hanuman, makhluk terkuat di bumi.
statement.en: In the Mahabharata, Bhima cannot move even a whisker of an old monkey's tail; the monkey turns out to be Hanuman, the mightiest being on earth.

claims.quote: As a mark of affection to Bhima, Hanuman agreed to reside on the flag of Bhima's younger brother Arjuna's chariot.

statement.id: Sebagai tanda kasih kepada Bhima, Hanuman setuju tinggal di bendera kereta Arjuna, adik Bhima.
statement.en: As a mark of affection to Bhima, Hanuman agreed to reside on the flag of the chariot of Bhima's younger brother Arjuna.

claims.quote: Hanuman is the child of the Wind God and the princess Anjana. He is referred to by his metronymic, Anjaneya, as often as his patronymic

statement.id: Hanuman adalah anak Dewa Angin dan putri Anjana; ia disebut dengan nama ibunya, Anjaneya, sesering nama ayahnya.
statement.en: Hanuman is the child of the Wind God and the princess Anjana; he is called by his mother's name, Anjaneya, as often as by his father's.

claims.quote: The various Puranas say that Anjana was married to the monkey chief Kesari. The couple prayed to Shiva for a son, and Hanuman was born to them from an aspect of Shiva, through the agency of the Wind God.

statement.id: Menurut Purana, pasangan itu berdoa kepada Shiva memohon seorang putra, dan Hanuman lahir dari aspek Shiva melalui perantaraan Dewa Angin.
statement.en: According to the Puranas, the couple prayed to Shiva for a son, and Hanuman was born from an aspect of Shiva through the agency of the Wind God.

claims.quote: Thus, Hanuman has two patronyms: Vayu-putra (Wind's son) as well as Kesari-nandan (Kesari's son).

statement.id: Hanuman memiliki dua nama keturunan: Vayu-putra (putra Angin) dan Kesari-nandan (putra Kesari).
statement.en: Hanuman has two patronyms: Vayu-putra (Wind's son) and Kesari-nandan (Kesari's son).

claims.quote: Hanuman mistook the sun itself to be a ripe fruit and leapt up in the air to grab it.

statement.id: Hanuman mengira matahari adalah buah matang dan melompat ke udara untuk menyambarnya.
statement.en: Hanuman mistook the sun for a ripe fruit and leapt into the air to grab it.

claims.quote: the infallible thunderbolt hit its target, the monkey child got his chin disfigured, and came to be known as Hanuman (hanu = chin; man = of, with, bearing, having; hanu+man=he of [broken] chin).

statement.id: Menurut kisah ini petir mengenai sasarannya, dagu anak kera itu cacat, dan ia dikenal sebagai Hanuman (hanu = dagu; man = memiliki), yakni "yang berdagu [patah]".
statement.en: According to this story the thunderbolt hit its target, the monkey child's chin was disfigured, and he came to be known as Hanuman (hanu = chin; man = having), "he of the [broken] chin".

claims.quote: Do you not know, King, that I am unslayable? I am born of Shiva, how can your thunderbolt do anything to me?

statement.id: Dalam kisah ini, Hanuman berseru kepada raja para dewa bahwa ia tak dapat dibunuh karena lahir dari Shiva.
statement.en: In this story Hanuman tells the king of the gods that he is unslayable, being born of Shiva.

claims.quote: The Puranas also tell us that Hanuman was taught the Vedas and all other branches of learning by Sun God himself, Surya. He learnt his lessons by trotting alongside the Sun's chariot as it moved across the sky.

statement.id: Purana juga menyebut Surya, dewa Matahari, mengajarkan Weda dan segala cabang ilmu kepada Hanuman, yang belajar sambil berlari di samping kereta Matahari.
statement.en: The Puranas also say Surya, the Sun God, taught Hanuman the Vedas and all other branches of learning, which he learnt by trotting alongside the Sun's chariot.

claims.quote: During the 16th CE, a poet called Tulsidas retold the Ramayana in the vernacular Awadhi language (rather than the academic Sanskrit) and also composed several hymns to the gods. One such hymn, the Hanuman Chalisa, continues to be recited today by thousands of people.

statement.id: Pada abad ke-16 M, penyair Tulsidas menceritakan ulang Ramayana dalam bahasa Awadhi dan menggubah beberapa himne, termasuk Hanuman Chalisa yang masih dilantunkan ribuan orang.
statement.en: In the 16th century CE the poet Tulsidas retold the Ramayana in Awadhi and composed several hymns, including the Hanuman Chalisa, still recited by thousands today.

claims.quote: This canticle of about 40 verses celebrates all of the qualities that Hanuman came to signify over the centuries: strength, devotion, celibacy, and righteousness.

statement.id: Kidung sekitar 40 bait itu memuliakan sifat-sifat yang dilambangkan Hanuman selama berabad-abad: kekuatan, bakti, selibat, dan kebenaran.
statement.en: The canticle of about 40 verses celebrates the qualities Hanuman came to signify over the centuries: strength, devotion, celibacy and righteousness.

claims.quote: In an extract from the Hanuman Chalisa ... Demons and ghosts do not come near If they hear the mighty one's name Diseases die, sorrows disappear If one constantly chants Hanuman's name

statement.id: Dalam terjemahan petikan Hanuman Chalisa, setan dan hantu tidak mendekat bila mendengar nama sang perkasa, penyakit lenyap dan duka sirna bagi yang terus melafalkan nama Hanuman.
statement.en: In the translated extract of the Hanuman Chalisa, demons and ghosts do not come near when they hear the mighty one's name, and diseases die and sorrows disappear for one who constantly chants Hanuman's name.

claims.quote: It is almost de rigueur to find a small shrine to him in police stations and wrestling clubs across the country, especially in the north. Outside of India, Hanuman is known in countries which were influenced by the Hindu culture such as Indonesia, Thailand, and Malaysia.

statement.id: Kuil kecil Hanuman hampir selalu ada di kantor polisi dan klub gulat di India, terutama di utara; di luar India ia dikenal di negara yang dipengaruhi budaya Hindu seperti Indonesia, Thailand, dan Malaysia.
statement.en: A small shrine to Hanuman is almost de rigueur in police stations and wrestling clubs across India, especially the north; outside India he is known in Hindu-influenced countries such as Indonesia, Thailand and Malaysia.

claims.quote: He is most often depicted with his favourite weapon, the mace. He is also often depicted as flying across the skies, one hand holding aloft the mountain of herbs and the other a mace.

statement.id: Hanuman paling sering digambarkan dengan senjata kesayangannya, gada, dan juga sering digambarkan terbang di langit dengan satu tangan mengangkat gunung ramuan dan tangan lain memegang gada.
statement.en: Hanuman is most often depicted with his favourite weapon, the mace, and often flying across the sky with one hand holding up the mountain of herbs and the other a mace.

claims.quote: Hanuman is a recurring figure in the panels and motifs of the Ramayana that adorn the temples that were built over the centuries in India.

statement.id: Hanuman adalah tokoh yang berulang pada panel dan motif Ramayana yang menghiasi candi-candi di India.
statement.en: Hanuman is a recurring figure in the Ramayana panels and motifs that adorn temples built over the centuries in India.

claims.quote: So strong and brave and wise shall be The glorious child I give to thee. Might shall be his that naught can tire, And limbs to spring as springs his sire.

statement.id: Dalam terjemahan Griffith, Dewa Angin berjanji bahwa anak yang diberikannya akan kuat, berani, dan bijak, bertenaga tak kenal lelah, dengan anggota tubuh yang melompat seperti ayahnya.
statement.en: In Griffith's translation the Wind God promises that the child he gives will be strong, brave and wise, with untiring might and limbs that spring as his sire's do.

claims.quote: Up leapt the child, a wondrous bound, Three hundred leagues above the ground

statement.id: Dalam Ramayana versi Griffith, si anak melompat tiga ratus league di atas tanah untuk meraih apa yang disangkanya buah.
statement.en: In Griffith's Ramayana the child leapt three hundred leagues above the ground after what seemed fruit.

claims.quote: And Brahmá's self the boon bestowed That in the brunt of battle none Should slay with steel the Wind-God's son.

statement.id: Brahmá menganugerahkan anugerah bahwa dalam pertempuran tak seorang pun boleh membunuh putra Dewa Angin dengan baja.
statement.en: Brahmá bestowed the boon that in the brunt of battle none should slay the Wind-God's son with steel.

claims.quote: Lord Indra, sovereign of the skies, Bent on thee all his thousand eyes, And swore that ne'er the bolt which he Hurls from the heaven should injure thee.

statement.id: Indra bersumpah bahwa petir yang dilemparkannya dari langit tak akan pernah melukai Hanuman.
statement.en: Indra swore that the bolt he hurls from heaven should never injure him.

claims.quote: Then from the hand of Indra came A red bolt winged with wrath and flame. The child fell smitten on a rock, His cheek was shattered by the shock

statement.id: Dalam Ramayana versi Griffith, petir Indra menghantam si anak sehingga ia jatuh ke batu dan pipinya remuk.
statement.en: In Griffith's Ramayana Indra's bolt struck the child, who fell on a rock and had his cheek shattered.

claims.quote: A thousand times with airy leap Can circle loftiest Meru's steep: With my fierce arms can stir the sea Till from their bed the waters flee

statement.id: Dalam pidatonya, Hanumán mengaku dapat mengelilingi puncak Meru seribu kali dengan lompatan di udara dan mengaduk laut dengan lengannya hingga airnya meninggalkan dasarnya.
statement.en: In his speech Hanumán claims he can circle Meru a thousand times with airy leaps and stir the sea with his arms until its waters flee their bed.

claims.quote: I through the fields of air can spring Far swifter than the feathered King

statement.id: Hanumán menyatakan dapat melesat di udara jauh lebih cepat daripada Raja Burung.
statement.en: Hanumán declares he can spring through the air far swifter than the feathered King.

claims.quote: He ceased; and mustering his might Sprang downward from the mountain height, While, shattered by each mighty limb, The trees unrooted followed him.

statement.id: Dalam Ramayana versi Griffith, Hanumán mengerahkan tenaganya dan melompat dari puncak gunung, pepohonan tercabut mengikutinya.
statement.en: In Griffith's Ramayana Hanumán musters his might and springs from the mountain height, uprooted trees following him.

claims.quote: The shadow on the ocean cast By his vast form, as on he passed, Flew like a ship before the gale When the strong breeze has filled the sail, And where his course the Vánar held The sea beneath him raged and swelled.

statement.id: Bayangan tubuh raksasa Hanumán di atas samudra meluncur seperti kapal diterpa angin, dan laut di bawah jalurnya bergolak serta menggelembung.
statement.en: The shadow of Hanumán's vast form on the ocean flew like a ship before the gale, and the sea beneath his course raged and swelled.

claims.quote: and stood before their joyous eyes Dilated in gigantic size.

statement.id: Hanumán, jiwanya terdorong untuk berupaya keras, berdiri di depan mata mereka yang bersukacita dengan tubuh membesar hingga ukuran raksasa.
statement.en: Hanumán, his soul stirred to vigorous effort, stood before their joyous eyes dilated in gigantic size.

topic.id: Petir Indra dan akibatnya pada Hanuman kecil
topic.en: Indra's thunderbolt and its effect on the infant Hanuman

summary.id: Menurut satu kisah: Hanuman berseru bahwa ia tak dapat dibunuh dan membiarkan senjata itu menggores dagunya agar kehormatan Indra terjaga.
summary.en: In one story, Hanuman declares he is unslayable and lets the weapon scratch his chin so Indra's honour is kept.

summary.id: Ramayana terjemahan Griffith: petir Indra menghantam si anak sehingga ia jatuh ke batu dan pipinya remuk, baru kemudian Indra bersumpah petirnya tak akan melukainya.
summary.en: Griffith's Ramayana: Indra's bolt strikes the child, who falls on a rock and has his cheek shattered, and only afterwards does Indra swear his bolt shall never injure him.

text.id: Dikenal sejak masa Arabia pra-Islam
text.en: Known since pre-Islamic Arabia

short_description.id: Jin adalah makhluk gaib dalam agama Arabia kuno, cerita rakyat Arab, dan Islam; Al-Qur'an menyebut mereka diciptakan dari api tanpa asap dan dapat beriman atau ingkar.
short_description.en: Jinn are supernatural beings in ancient Arabian religion, Arabic folklore, and Islam; the Quran says they were created from smokeless fire and may be believers or unbelievers.

long_description.id: Jin adalah makhluk gaib dalam Islam, agama Arabia kuno, serta cerita rakyat dan mitologi Arab. Dalam mitologi Arab pra-Islam, jin sering disalahkan atas kemalangan dan penyakit manusia, dan sudah disembah oleh banyak orang Arab. Para sarjana berbeda pendapat tentang asal mereka: ada yang menyebut roh jahat penghuni gurun, ada pula yang menyebut dewa alam kafir yang tersisih.
long_description.en: Jinn figure in Islam, in ancient Arabian religion, and in Arabic folklore and mythology as supernatural beings. In pre-Islamic Arabic mythology, jinn were often blamed for human misfortune and disease, and many Arabs already worshipped them. Scholars differ on their origin: some describe malevolent desert spirits, others marginalized pagan nature deities.

long_description.id: Al-Qur'an menyebut jin diciptakan dari api tanpa asap dan sudah ada lebih dahulu. Jin dan manusia dikaruniai kehendak bebas serta diciptakan untuk beribadah kepada Tuhan. Jin disebut sekitar 29 kali dalam Al-Qur'an, antara lain dalam Surah Al-Jinn, ketika sekelompok jin mendengarkan bacaan Al-Qur'an dan para jin menyatakan bahwa di antara mereka ada yang saleh dan ada yang kurang saleh.
long_description.en: The Quran says jinn were created earlier from smokeless fire. Jinn and humans have free will and were created to worship God. Jinn are mentioned about 29 times in the Quran, including in Surah Al-Jinn, where a group of jinn listens to the Quran and the jinn say that some among them are righteous and others less so.

long_description.id: Dalam penuturan lain, jin tak terlihat, bertubuh halus, dan dapat berubah wujud menjadi ular, kalajengking, kadal, atau manusia. Mereka disebut membalas bila diganggu manusia, bahkan dapat merasuki tubuh penyerangnya. Sumber tertentu menggolongkan jin menjadi beberapa jenis, seperti Syaitan yang dipimpin Iblis, Ifrit yang kuat dan terkait api, dan Marid yang terkait air; menurut Al-Qur'an, Iblis termasuk golongan jin.
long_description.en: In other accounts, jinn are invisible, subtle-bodied, and able to take the form of snakes, scorpions, lizards, or humans. They are said to retaliate when disturbed by humans and may even possess an assailant's body. Some sources distinguish types of jinn, such as the Shaitan led by Iblis, the powerful fire-associated Ifrit, and the water-associated Marid; according to the Quran, Iblis was one of the jinn.

long_description.id: Menurut sumber modern, jin dalam cerita rakyat dipandang sebagai golongan ketiga makhluk tak terlihat yang sering netral atau ambigu secara moral, sedangkan sejak zaman modern jin sering digambarkan lebih negatif. Sejak 2004, jin menjadi tokoh yang lazim dalam film horor Timur Tengah.
long_description.en: According to modern scholarship, folklore treated jinn as a third class of invisible beings, often neutral or morally ambiguous, while since modern times they have often been portrayed more negatively. Middle Eastern horror films have made jinn a common trope since 2004.

cultural_context.id: Kepercayaan kepada jin tidak termasuk dalam enam rukun iman seperti kepercayaan kepada malaikat. Dalam penuturan lain, jin tidak dengan sendirinya dianggap jahat atau baik, dan jin dipandang sebagai golongan ketiga makhluk tak terlihat yang sering netral atau ambigu secara moral.
cultural_context.en: Unlike belief in angels, belief in jinn is not one of the six articles of Islamic faith. In other accounts, jinn are regarded as neither innately evil nor good, and as a third class of invisible beings, often neutral or morally ambiguous.

literal_meaning.en: from the Semitic root jnn, whose primary meaning is "to hide" or "to adapt"

statement.en: Ifrits are described as among the most powerful types of jinn, strongly associated with fire and the underworld, with immense physical strength and great mastery of magic.

claims.quote: Marids are often considered the most powerful type of jinn in all of Arab-Islamic mythology, traditionally associated with the element of water, the sea, and vast oceans.

statement.id: Marid sering dianggap jenis jin terkuat dalam mitologi Arab-Islam dan secara tradisional dikaitkan dengan air, laut, dan samudra luas.
statement.en: Marids are often considered the most powerful type of jinn in Arab-Islamic mythology, traditionally associated with water, the sea, and vast oceans.

claims.quote: Led by Iblis (the equivalent of Satan), and unlike other jinn, who can choose between good and evil, the Shaitan are exclusively malevolent

statement.id: Syaitan, dipimpin Iblis, disebut jenis jin yang semata-mata jahat, berbeda dari jin lain yang dapat memilih antara baik dan jahat.
statement.en: The Shaitan, led by Iblis, are described as exclusively malevolent, unlike other jinn, who can choose between good and evil.

claims.quote: Jinn are mentioned approximately 29 times in the Quran

statement.id: Jin disebut sekitar 29 kali dalam Al-Qur'an.
statement.en: Jinn are mentioned approximately 29 times in the Quran.

claims.quote: since 2004 jinn have become a common trope in Middle Eastern horror movies.

statement.id: Sejak 2004, jin menjadi tokoh yang lazim dalam film horor Timur Tengah.
statement.en: Since 2004, jinn have become a common trope in Middle Eastern horror movies.

claims.quote: Some scholars of the Middle East hold that they originated as malevolent spirits residing in deserts and unclean places, who often took the forms of animals; others hold that they were originally pagan nature deities who gradually became marginalized as other deities took greater importance.

statement.id: Sebagian sarjana menyatakan jin berasal dari roh jahat penghuni gurun dan tempat tak bersih yang sering berwujud hewan; sebagian lain menyatakan mereka semula dewa alam kafir yang tersisih.
statement.en: Some scholars hold that jinn originated as malevolent spirits of deserts and unclean places that often took animal forms; others that they were originally pagan nature deities who became marginalized.

claims.quote: Jinn are generally weak and fragile beings, whose potencies derive mostly from people attributing powers to them.

statement.id: Dalam uraian ini, jin umumnya makhluk lemah dan rapuh, yang kekuatannya sebagian besar berasal dari anggapan manusia.
statement.en: In this account, jinn are generally weak and fragile beings whose potency derives mostly from people attributing powers to them.

claims.quote: Although the powers of jinn usually exceed those of humans, it is conceivable a man could kill a jinni in single combat, but they are feared for attacking without being seen.

statement.id: Dalam uraian ini, kekuatan jin biasanya melebihi manusia, tetapi seorang manusia mungkin dapat membunuh jin dalam duel, dan jin ditakuti karena menyerang tanpa terlihat.
statement.en: In this account, the powers of jinn usually exceed those of humans, though a man could conceivably kill a jinni in single combat, and jinn are feared for attacking unseen.

claims.quote: also romanized as djinn or anglicized as genies, are supernatural beings in Islam, ancient Arabian religion and Arabic folklore and mythology.

statement.id: Jinn juga ditulis djinn atau dianglikan menjadi genie, adalah makhluk gaib dalam Islam, agama Arabia kuno, serta cerita rakyat dan mitologi Arab.
statement.en: Jinn, also romanized as djinn or anglicized as genies, are supernatural beings in Islam, ancient Arabian religion and Arabic folklore and mythology.

claims.quote: Belief in jinn is not included among the six articles of Islamic faith, as belief in angels is.

statement.id: Kepercayaan kepada jin tidak termasuk dalam enam rukun iman, tidak seperti kepercayaan kepada malaikat.
statement.en: Belief in jinn is not included among the six articles of Islamic faith, as belief in angels is.

claims.quote: Julius Wellhausen observed that jinn were often thought to "inhabit or haunt desolate, dark and dingy places in the desert".

statement.id: Julius Wellhausen mengamati bahwa jin sering dianggap mendiami atau menghantui tempat sunyi, gelap, dan kumuh di gurun.
statement.en: Julius Wellhausen observed that jinn were often thought to inhabit or haunt desolate, dark and dingy places in the desert.

claims.quote: Therefore, jinn were considered a third class of invisible beings, often neutral or morally ambiguous, not consequently equated with devils.

statement.id: Karena itu jin dipandang sebagai golongan ketiga makhluk tak terlihat, sering netral atau secara moral ambigu, dan tidak otomatis disamakan dengan setan.
statement.en: Jinn were therefore considered a third class of invisible beings, often neutral or morally ambiguous, not necessarily equated with devils.

claims.quote: Since modern times, jinn have often been portrayed in a more negative light.
claims.locator: Modern and post-modern era: Prevalence of belief

statement.id: Sejak zaman modern, jin sering digambarkan secara lebih negatif.
statement.en: Since modern times, jinn have often been portrayed in a more negative light.

claims.quote: The cave chamber Majlis al Jinn, believed to be a gathering place of the jinn in Omani lore

statement.id: Ruang gua Majlis al Jinn dipercaya sebagai tempat berkumpul jin dalam cerita rakyat Oman.
statement.en: The cave chamber Majlis al Jinn is believed to be a gathering place of the jinn in Omani lore.

text.id: dewa utama agama negara Romawi pada zaman Republik dan Kekaisaran
text.en: chief deity of Roman state religion in the Republican and Imperial eras

short_description.id: Jupiter adalah dewa langit dan guntur serta pemimpin para dewa dalam agama Romawi kuno, dengan petir dan elang sebagai lambangnya.
short_description.en: Jupiter is the sky and thunder god and king of the gods in ancient Roman religion, with the thunderbolt and eagle as his emblems.

long_description.id: Jupiter adalah dewa utama agama negara Romawi. Ia dikaitkan dengan langit, guntur, kilat, dan badai; petir serta elang menjadi lambang utamanya, dan ia dipandang sebagai pemegang kilat dan penguasa cuaca. Ia dipercaya melindungi Roma saat perang dan menjaga kesejahteraan ketika damai, serta menjadi pelindung sumpah dan perjanjian dan penghukum pemberi sumpah palsu. Dalam penggambaran yang dicatat sumber, ia berjanggut putih dan membawa tongkat berlambang elang.
long_description.en: Jupiter was the leading deity of Roman state religion. He was associated with sky, thunder, lightning, and storms, with the thunderbolt and eagle as his emblems, and he is seen as wielder of lightning and master of weather. He was believed to protect Rome in war and maintain its welfare in peace, and was patron of oaths and treaties and punisher of perjurers. One description depicts him with a white beard and an eagle-topped scepter.

long_description.id: Menurut sumber, warga awal Roma menambahkan triad dewa yang terdiri atas Mars, Quirinus, dan Jupiter. Pada masa Republik, dua anggota triad lama diganti dengan Juno dan Minerva; dalam Triad Capitolium ia menjadi pelindung utama negara, dan pohon sucinya adalah pohon ek. Sekitar 509 SM sebuah kuil megah untuk mereka didirikan di Bukit Capitolium. Jupiter juga digelari Imperator, Invictus, dan Triumphator, dan jenderal yang menang berarak ke kuilnya untuk berkurban. Ia dihormati dengan sapaan Jupiter Optimus Maximus, yang menegaskan kedudukannya sebagai dewa tertinggi.
long_description.en: According to the sources, the early citizens of Rome added a triad of gods made up of Mars, Quirinus, and Jupiter. By the Republic two members of the old triad were replaced by Juno and Minerva; within the Capitoline Triad he served as the state's chief protector, and the oak was his sacred tree. Around 509 BCE a magnificent temple for them was built on Capitoline Hill. Jupiter was also titled Imperator, Invictus, and Triumphator, and victorious generals marched to his temple to sacrifice. The title Jupiter Optimus Maximus expressed his supreme position.

long_description.id: Kisah-kisah Romawi menampilkan Jupiter sebagai dewa yang menjawab doa dan menghukum. Dalam kisah Livius, Romulus memohon Jupiter menahan pasukan yang lari dan berjanji mendirikan kuil bagi Jupiter Stator, sedangkan Tullus Hostilius dibakar dengan petir setelah salah melaksanakan ritual untuk Jupiter Elicius. Dalam Metamorphoses Ovidius, Jupiter menghancurkan kediaman Lycaon dengan petir. Tradisi Romawi juga mengisahkan perundingannya dengan Numa Pompilius.
long_description.en: Roman accounts present Jupiter as a god who answers prayers and punishes. In Livy, Romulus asks Jupiter to halt the fleeing army and vows a temple to Jupiter Stator, while Tullus Hostilius is burnt by lightning after performing the rites for Jupiter Elicius wrongly. In Ovid's Metamorphoses Jupiter destroys Lycaon's dwelling with thunderbolts. Roman tradition also tells of his negotiation with Numa Pompilius.

long_description.id: Orang Romawi memandang Jupiter sebagai padanan Zeus dari Yunani; dalam tradisi yang dipengaruhi Yunani ia saudara Neptunus dan Pluto, dan Tinia dianggap padanan Jupiter dalam tradisi Etruscan. Sebuah benda kuno menunjukkan penyamaan Jupiter dengan Ammon dari Afrika Utara sebagai Jupiter Ammon. Para sarjana berbeda pendapat tentang apakah Jupiter dewa perang dan pertanian. Pada masa kemudian Kaisar Elagabalus untuk sementara menggantikannya dengan Elagabal, dewa Siria.
long_description.en: The Romans regarded Jupiter as the equivalent of Greek Zeus; in the Greek-influenced tradition he is brother of Neptune and Pluto, and Tinia is regarded as his Etruscan counterpart. An ancient object attests his identification with North African Ammon as Jupiter Ammon. Scholars differ on whether Jupiter is a god of war and agriculture. At a later time Emperor Elagabalus temporarily replaced him with Elagabal, a Syrian god.

cultural_context.id: Orang Romawi percaya Jupiter memberi mereka supremasi karena mereka menghormatinya lebih daripada bangsa lain. Para konsul bersumpah jabatan atas nama Jupiter, dan Senat tidak mengizinkan pernyataan perang tanpa restunya. Ludi Romani, permainan utama bulan September, diadakan untuk menghormatinya.
cultural_context.en: The Romans believed Jupiter granted them supremacy because they honoured him more than any other people. The consuls swore their oath of office in his name, and the Senate would not allow a declaration of war without his blessing. The Ludi Romani, the chief games of September, honored him.

who.id: Jupiter adalah dewa langit dan guntur serta pemimpin para dewa dalam agama Romawi.

origin.id: Ia dewa utama agama negara Romawi sepanjang zaman Republik dan Kekaisaran.
origin.en: He led Roman state religion in both the Republican period and the Imperial period.

role.id: Ia dipercaya melindungi Roma saat perang dan menjaga kesejahteraan saat damai, serta menjadi pelindung sumpah dan perjanjian.

famous_for.en: He is best known as the wielder of the thunderbolt with the eagle as sacred animal, and as the counterpart of Zeus.

did_you_know.id: Nama Jupiter juga hidup dalam bahasa Inggris: Jove menjadi asal nama bentuk Latin untuk hari yang kini disebut Thursday (Iovis Dies).
did_you_know.en: Jupiter's name lives on in English: Jove was the original namesake of the Latin forms of the weekday now called Thursday (Iovis Dies).

name.en: Wielder of lightning and master of weather

description.id: Jupiter dipandang sebagai pemegang kilat dan penguasa cuaca. Petir menjadi lambang pengenalnya, dan dalam kisah-kisah Romawi ia menghukum dengan sambaran petir.
description.en: Jupiter is seen as wielder of lightning and master of weather. The thunderbolt is his identifying implement, and in Roman accounts he punishes with lightning.

name.id: Memberi isyarat melalui guntur dan terbang burung
name.en: Signs through thunder and bird flight

description.id: Jupiter berkomunikasi dengan manusia lewat guntur, kilat, dan terbang burung, yang disebut auspisianya; elang memegang kedudukan utama dalam pengambilan auspisia.
description.en: Jupiter communicates with people through thunder, lightning, and the flight of birds, called his auspices; the eagle held precedence in taking auspices.

description.id: Jupiter dapat menghukum manusia dengan petirnya, tetapi lebih dulu memberi peringatan dan biasanya bertindak dengan persetujuan dewa-dewa lain. Dalam Metamorphoses Ovidius ia menghancurkan kediaman Lycaon dengan petir.
description.en: Jupiter could punish people with his thunderbolts, but gave warning first and usually acted with the consent of other gods. In Ovid's Metamorphoses he destroys Lycaon's dwelling with thunderbolts.

tradition.en: Roman syncretism with North African Ammon

description.id: Orang Romawi menganggap orakel Ammon dari Afrika Utara sebagai perwujudan Jupiter dan menyebut dewa ganda sinkretik itu Jupiter Ammon.
description.en: The Romans considered the North African oracle Ammon an embodiment of Jupiter and called this syncretic dual divinity Jupiter Ammon.

role.id: Dewa yang dimohon menghentikan pasukan Romawi yang lari
role.en: The god petitioned to halt the fleeing Romans

summary.id: Menurut Livius, ketika pasukan Romawi lari, Romulus mengangkat tangan dan memohon Jupiter menghalau musuh serta berjanji mendirikan kuil bagi "Jove sang Penahan". Ia lalu berseru bahwa Jupiter Optimus Maximus memerintahkan orang Romawi bertahan dan melanjutkan pertempuran.
summary.en: According to Livy, as the Romans fled, Romulus raised his hands and asked Jupiter to drive back the enemy, vowing a temple to "Jove the Stayer". He then cried that Jupiter Optimus Maximus bade the Romans stand and renew the battle.

role.id: Dewa penerima rampasan raja musuh dan pemilik kuil pertama di Roma
role.en: Recipient of the spoils of an enemy king

summary.id: Menurut Livius, Romulus membawa rampasan musuh yang gugur ke Capitolium, menggantungnya pada pohon ek yang dianggap suci oleh para gembala, menandai lahan kuil Jupiter, lalu menyapa sang dewa sebagai Jupiter Feretrius dan menguduskan kuil untuk spolia opima.
summary.en: According to Livy, Romulus brought the spoils of his fallen foe to the Capitol, hung them on an oak the shepherds held sacred, marked out the site for a temple of Jupiter, then addressed the god as Jupiter Feretrius and dedicated a temple for the spolia opima.

summary.en: According to Livy, Tullus found secret rites for Jupiter Elicius but performed them wrongly. Jupiter was angered and burnt up the king and his house with lightning.

statement.en: Jupiter was seen as a god of light, protector in defeat, and giver of victory, with the titles Imperator, Invictus, and Triumphator.

claims.quote: As with Zeus, his reputation for violence often caused men to tremble in fear for he could easily punish them with one of his thunderbolts. Of course, he would give them a fair warning before the final, destructive bolt, and punishment was usually carried out only with the consent of the other gods.

statement.id: Jupiter dikenal keras: ia dapat menghukum manusia dengan petirnya, tetapi lebih dulu memberi peringatan, dan hukuman biasanya dijatuhkan dengan persetujuan dewa-dewa lain.
statement.en: Jupiter had a reputation for violence: he could punish people with a thunderbolt, but gave a warning first, and punishment was usually carried out with the consent of the other gods.

claims.quote: Around 509 BCE a magnificent temple, shared with Juno and Minerva, was erected on Capitoline Hill in Rome, a place where people could gather and make sacrifices. Aside from a large sculpture of Jupiter, the temple, the grandest of all in Rome, housed the Sibylline books

statement.id: Sekitar 509 SM sebuah kuil megah yang dipakai bersama Juno dan Minerva didirikan di Bukit Capitolium di Roma; kuil itu menyimpan arca besar Jupiter dan kitab-kitab Sibylla.
statement.en: Around 509 BCE a magnificent temple shared with Juno and Minerva was built on Capitoline Hill in Rome; it housed a large sculpture of Jupiter and the Sibylline books.

claims.quote: After returning from battle, victorious generals would lead a procession called a triumph through the streets of Rome to Jupiter's temple. ... After arriving at the temple, he would make a sacrifice, being sure to donate a portion of his booty to Jupiter, thanking Jupiter for his victory in battle.

statement.id: Jenderal yang menang berbaris dalam perarakan triumf menuju kuil Jupiter, lalu berkurban dan menyerahkan sebagian rampasan kepada Jupiter sebagai tanda terima kasih atas kemenangan.
statement.en: Victorious generals led a triumph procession to Jupiter's temple, made a sacrifice, and donated part of their booty to Jupiter in thanks for victory.

claims.quote: The Senate would not allow a declaration of war without the blessing of Jupiter. He was the patron of oaths and treaties and the punisher of perjurers.

statement.id: Senat tidak mengizinkan pernyataan perang tanpa restu Jupiter, dan ia menjadi pelindung sumpah serta perjanjian sekaligus penghukum pemberi sumpah palsu.
statement.en: The Senate would not permit a declaration of war without Jupiter's blessing, and he was patron of oaths and treaties and punisher of perjurers.

claims.quote: No political action was begun or completed without his judgment. The chief games celebrated in September, the Ludi Romani, were observed in his honor.

statement.id: Menurut sumber ini, tak ada tindakan politik yang dimulai atau diselesaikan tanpa pertimbangannya, dan Ludi Romani yang dirayakan pada bulan September diadakan untuk menghormatinya.
statement.en: No political action was begun or completed without his judgment, and the Ludi Romani, the chief games held in September, honored him.

claims.quote: Emperor Elagabalus temporarily replaced Jupiter with Elagabal, a Syrian god.

statement.id: Kaisar Elagabalus untuk sementara menggantikan Jupiter dengan Elagabal, dewa Siria.
statement.en: Emperor Elagabalus temporarily replaced Jupiter with Elagabal, a Syrian god.

claims.quote: In the Capitoline Triad, he was the central guardian of the state with Juno and Minerva. His sacred tree was the oak.

statement.id: Dalam Triad Capitolium ia menjadi pelindung utama negara bersama Juno dan Minerva; pohon sucinya adalah pohon ek.
statement.en: In the Capitoline Triad he was the central guardian of the state with Juno and Minerva; his sacred tree was the oak.

claims.quote: In the Greek-influenced tradition, Jupiter was the brother of Neptune and Pluto, the Roman equivalents of Poseidon and Hades respectively. Each presided over one of the three realms of the universe: sky, the waters, and the underworld.

statement.id: Dalam tradisi yang dipengaruhi Yunani, Jupiter adalah saudara Neptunus dan Pluto; masing-masing menguasai satu dari tiga ranah alam semesta: langit, perairan, dan dunia bawah.
statement.en: In the Greek-influenced tradition Jupiter was brother of Neptune and Pluto, each presiding over one of the three realms of the universe: sky, waters, and underworld.

claims.quote: Iūpiter or Iuppiter, from Proto-Italic *djous "day, sky" + *patēr "father", thus "sky father"

statement.id: Nama Latin Iūpiter atau Iuppiter berasal dari bentuk Proto-Italik *djous "hari, langit" ditambah *patēr "bapak", sehingga berarti "bapak langit".
statement.en: The Latin name Iūpiter or Iuppiter derives from Proto-Italic *djous "day, sky" plus *patēr "father", thus "sky father".

claims.quote: Jove is a less common English formation based on Iov-, the stem of oblique cases of the Latin name.

statement.id: Jove adalah bentuk bahasa Inggris yang lebih jarang, dibentuk dari Iov-, pangkal kasus oblik nama Latinnya.
statement.en: Jove is a less common English formation based on Iov-, the stem of the oblique cases of the Latin name.

claims.quote: Jupiter assumed atmospheric qualities; he is the wielder of lightning and the master of weather.

statement.id: Jupiter bersifat atmosferik: ia pemegang kilat dan penguasa cuaca.
statement.en: Jupiter took on atmospheric qualities: he is the wielder of lightning and master of weather.

claims.quote: he is in continual communication with man by means of thunder, lightning and the flight of birds (his auspices). Through his vigilant watch, he is also the guardian of public oaths and compacts and the guarantor of good faith in the State cult.

statement.id: Jupiter terus berkomunikasi dengan manusia melalui guntur, kilat, dan terbang burung (auspisia-nya), serta menjaga sumpah dan perjanjian publik dan menjamin itikad baik dalam kultus negara.
statement.en: Jupiter communicates with people through thunder, lightning, and the flight of birds (his auspices), and guards public oaths and compacts and guarantees good faith in the state cult.

claims.quote: Wissowa considered Jupiter also a god of war and agriculture, in addition to his political role as guarantor of good faith

statement.id: Wissowa menganggap Jupiter juga dewa perang dan pertanian, di samping perannya sebagai penjamin itikad baik.
statement.en: Wissowa considered Jupiter also a god of war and agriculture, besides his political role as guarantor of good faith.

claims.quote: Dumézil maintains that Jupiter is not himself a god of war and agriculture, although his actions and interests may extend to these spheres of human endeavour.

statement.id: Dumézil berpendapat Jupiter sendiri bukan dewa perang dan pertanian, meski tindakan dan kepentingannya dapat menjangkau bidang-bidang itu.
statement.en: Dumézil maintains that Jupiter is not himself a god of war and agriculture, although his actions and interests may extend to those spheres.

claims.quote: The Romans believed that Jupiter granted them supremacy because they had honoured him more than any other people had.

statement.id: Orang Romawi percaya Jupiter memberi mereka supremasi karena mereka menghormatinya lebih daripada bangsa lain.
statement.en: The Romans believed Jupiter granted them supremacy because they had honoured him more than any other people had.

claims.quote: The consuls swore their oath of office in Jupiter's name, and honoured him on the annual feriae of the Capitol in September. To thank him for his help, and to secure his continued support, they sacrificed a white ox (bos mas) with gilded horns.

statement.id: Para konsul bersumpah jabatan atas nama Jupiter dan menghormatinya pada feriae tahunan Capitolium di bulan September, dengan mengurbankan seekor lembu putih bertanduk sepuh.
statement.en: The consuls swore their oath of office in Jupiter's name and honoured him at the annual feriae of the Capitol in September, sacrificing a white ox with gilded horns.

claims.quote: Jove was the original namesake of Latin forms of the weekday now known in English as Thursday (originally called Iovis Dies in Latin).

statement.id: Jove adalah asal nama bentuk-bentuk Latin untuk hari yang dalam bahasa Inggris kini disebut Thursday (semula Iovis Dies dalam bahasa Latin).
statement.en: Jove was the original namesake of the Latin forms of the weekday now called Thursday in English (originally Iovis Dies in Latin).

claims.quote: Tinia is usually regarded as his Etruscan counterpart.

statement.id: Tinia umumnya dianggap sebagai padanan Jupiter dalam tradisi Etruscan.
statement.en: Tinia is usually regarded as his Etruscan counterpart.

claims.quote: In Roman mythology, he negotiates with Numa Pompilius, the second king of Rome, to establish principles of Roman religion such as offering, or sacrifice.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Romawi, Jupiter berunding dengan Numa Pompilius, raja kedua Roma, untuk menetapkan asas agama Romawi seperti persembahan atau kurban.
statement.en: In Roman mythology he negotiates with Numa Pompilius, the second king of Rome, to establish principles of Roman religion such as offering or sacrifice.

claims.quote: found there a description of certain secret sacrificial rites paid to Jupiter Elicius ... the anger of Jupiter was roused by the false worship rendered to him, and he burnt up the king and his house by a stroke of lightning. Tullus had achieved great renown in war

statement.id: Menurut Livius, Tullus Hostilius menemukan tata cara rahasia untuk Jupiter Elicius, tetapi ia keliru melaksanakannya; Jupiter murka dan membakar sang raja beserta rumahnya dengan sambaran petir.
statement.en: According to Livy, Tullus found secret rites for Jupiter Elicius but performed them wrongly; Jupiter was angered and burnt up the king and his house with a stroke of lightning.

claims.quote: Even Romulus was being swept away by the crowd of fugitives, and lifting up his hands to heaven he exclaimed: ‘Jupiter, it was thy omen ... Here do I vow a temple to thee, ‘Jove the Stayer,’ as a memorial for the generations to come that it is through thy present help that the City has been saved.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Livius, Romulus berjanji mendirikan kuil bagi "Jove sang Penahan" (Jupiter Stator) sebagai pengingat bahwa kota itu selamat berkat pertolongan Jupiter.
statement.en: In Livy's account Romulus vows a temple to "Jove the Stayer" (Jupiter Stator) as a memorial that the City was saved through Jupiter's help.

claims.quote: Then, as though he had become aware that his prayer had been heard, he cried, ‘Back, Romans! Jupiter Optimus Maximus bids you stand and renew the battle.

statement.id: Romulus lalu berseru kepada orang Romawi bahwa Jupiter Optimus Maximus memerintahkan mereka bertahan dan melanjutkan pertempuran.
statement.en: Romulus then cries out that Jupiter Optimus Maximus bids the Romans stand and renew the battle.

claims.quote: after leading his victorious army home, he mounted to the Capitol with the spoils of his dead foe borne before him on a frame constructed for the purpose. He hung them there on an oak, which the shepherds looked upon as a sacred tree, and at the same time marked out the site for the temple of Jupiter

statement.id: Dalam kisah Livius, setelah membawa pasukannya pulang dengan kemenangan, sang pemimpin mendaki Capitolium membawa rampasan dari musuh yang gugur, menggantungnya pada pohon ek yang dianggap suci oleh para gembala, dan menandai lahan kuil Jupiter.
statement.en: In Livy's account, after leading his victorious army home, the leader mounted to the Capitol with the spoils of his dead foe, hung them on an oak the shepherds held sacred, and marked out the site for Jupiter's temple.

claims.quote: addressing the god by a new title, uttered the following invocation: ‘Jupiter Feretrius! ... these arms taken from a king, I, Romulus a king and conqueror, bring to thee, and on this domain, whose bounds I have in will and purpose traced, I dedicate a temple to receive the spolia opima

statement.id: Dalam kisah Livius, Romulus menyapa sang dewa dengan gelar baru, Jupiter Feretrius, mempersembahkan senjata seorang raja musuh, dan menguduskan sebuah kuil untuk menerima spolia opima.
statement.en: In Livy's account Romulus addresses the god by a new title, Jupiter Feretrius, offers the arms taken from a king, and dedicates a temple to receive the spolia opima.

claims.quote: Jove once again broke the deep silence with imperial words; ... this Lycaon mocked their pious vows ... I destroyed his dwelling and his worthless Household Gods, with thunder bolts avenging.

statement.id: Dalam Metamorphoses karya Ovidius, Jupiter menghancurkan kediaman Lycaon dengan petir sebagai pembalasan.
statement.en: In Ovid's Metamorphoses Jupiter destroys Lycaon's dwelling with thunderbolts as vengeance.
