text.id: Kuilnya dibangun sekitar 495 SM; agama Romawi menyinkretiskannya dengan Yunani mulai sekitar abad ke-4 SM
text.en: His temple was built around 495 BCE; Roman religion syncretized him with Greek religion starting around the 4th century BCE

short_description.id: Mercury adalah dewa Romawi perdagangan dan perantara antara dewa dan manusia, pelindung pedagang dan pelancong, pemandu arwah ke dunia bawah, serta dikenal licik dan suka mengerjai.
short_description.en: Mercury is a Roman god of commerce and mediator between gods and mortals, protector of merchants and travelers, guide of souls to the underworld, and known as a cunning prankster.

long_description.id: Mercury (Mercurius) adalah dewa perdagangan Romawi yang kerap menjadi perantara antara dewa dan manusia, dan sayap di kakinya memberinya kecepatan. Ia melindungi pedagang, terutama pedagang gandum, serta pelancong, dan dikatakan putra Jupiter dan Maia. Ia sering dipadankan dengan Hermes dari Yunani; satu sumber menyebut Hermes diperkenalkan ke Roma dengan nama Mercurius pada 495 SM sebagai pelindung perdagangan gandum, sedangkan sumber lain menekankan sinkretisme bertahap sejak abad ke-4 SM. Namanya mungkin berkaitan dengan kata merx, "barang dagangan"; ia juga dipandang sebagai dewa kelimpahan dan keberhasilan dagang, terutama di Galia.
long_description.en: Mercury (Mercurius) was the Roman god of commerce, often a mediator between gods and mortals, whose winged feet gave him speed. He protected merchants, especially those dealing in grain, and travelers, and was said to be the son of Jupiter and Maia. He is often equated with the Greek Hermes; one source says Hermes was introduced to Rome as Mercurius in 495 BCE as protector of the grain trade, while another stresses a gradual syncretism starting in the 4th century BCE. His name is possibly related to the word merx, "merchandise"; in Gaul in particular he was also seen as a god of abundance and business success.

long_description.id: Dalam ikonografi, Mercury memegang caduceus, tongkat untuk mendamaikan pertikaian, dan bersandal bersayap; ia juga mengenakan topi lebar Petasus dan membawa pundi-pundi lambang perdagangan. Tongkat itu diberikan Apollo, dan patung perunggu Romawi sering menampilkannya memegang tongkat dan pundi-pundi. Ia kadang ditemani ayam jantan, domba atau kambing, dan kura-kura. Ia dipandang sebagai dewa batas, perdagangan, komunikasi, kefasihan, keberuntungan, pencuri, pelancong, dan tipu daya.
long_description.en: In iconography Mercury holds the caduceus, a wand used to reconcile conflicts, and wears winged sandals; he also wears the broad-brimmed Petasus hat and carries a purse symbolizing commerce. The wand was given by Apollo, and Roman bronze statuettes often show him holding a staff and a purse. He was sometimes accompanied by a rooster, a ram or goat, and a tortoise. He was regarded as god of boundaries, commerce, communication, eloquence, luck, thieves, travelers and trickery.

long_description.id: Mercury dikenal licik dan cerdik, sering mengerjai orang terutama Apollo, dan menjadi pelindung gembala, penipu, dan pencuri. Dalam kisah yang dituturkan Ovidius ia mengubah Battus menjadi batu, memenggal Argus setelah membuatnya tertidur demi membebaskan Io, dan membawa mimpi kepada manusia yang tidur. Ia juga mengantar arwah ke dunia bawah, termasuk Proserpina, dan dalam kisah Aeneas ia mengingatkan sang pahlawan agar meninggalkan Carthage. Kisah-kisahnya sering bercampur dengan kisah Hermes.
long_description.en: Mercury was known as cunning and shrewd, often pranking others especially Apollo, and was patron of shepherds, cheats and thieves. In stories told by Ovid he turns Battus to stone, beheads Argus after putting him to sleep to free Io, and carries dreams to sleeping humans. He also escorts the dead to the underworld, including Proserpina, and in the Aeneas story he reminds the hero to leave Carthage. His stories often blend with those of Hermes.

long_description.id: Hari rayanya, 15 Mei, memperingati berdirinya kuilnya; pada hari itu para pemilik toko menimba air dari mata air yang dipersembahkan kepadanya dekat Porta Capena. Kultusnya ada di Campania, Latium, Galia, dan Britania, dan bukti dari Pompeii menunjukkan ia termasuk dewa Romawi yang paling populer.
long_description.en: His festival day, 15 May, commemorated the founding of his temple; on that day shopkeepers drew water from a spring dedicated to him near the Porta Capena. His cult existed in Campania, Latium, Gaul and Britain, and evidence from Pompeii suggests he was among the most popular Roman gods.

cultural_context.id: Para pedagang berdoa kepada Mercury untuk memohon keuntungan dan perlindungan dagangan; ia diperkenalkan sebagai pelindung perdagangan gandum lalu menjadi dewa jual beli pada umumnya, dengan kapel kecil di jalan-jalan toko. Pada 15 Mei pedagang memohon agar ia menghapus kesalahan tipuan mereka, dan kata mercurialis dipakai secara populer untuk "penipu".
cultural_context.en: Merchants prayed to Mercury for profit and protection of their goods; he was introduced as protector of the grain trade and became the god of buying and selling in general, with little chapels in shop streets. On 15 May merchants asked him to remove the guilt of their deceits, and the word mercurialis was popularly used for "cheat".

literal_meaning.id: Mungkin berkaitan dengan merx "barang dagangan", mercari "berdagang", dan merces "upah".
literal_meaning.en: Possibly related to merx "merchandise", mercari "to trade" and merces "wages".

who.id: Mercury adalah dewa perdagangan Romawi dan perantara antara dewa dan manusia.
who.en: Mercury is the Roman god of commerce and mediator between gods and mortals.

origin.id: Ia dikaitkan dengan Hermes dari Yunani dan diperkenalkan ke Roma pada 495 SM sebagai pelindung perdagangan gandum.
origin.en: He is associated with the Greek Hermes and was introduced to Rome in 495 BCE as protector of the grain trade.

role.id: Ia melindungi pedagang dan pelancong serta mengantar arwah ke dunia bawah.
role.en: He protected merchants and travelers and escorted the dead to the underworld.

famous_for.id: Ia dikenal lewat caduceus dan sandal bersayapnya, serta kelicikannya.
famous_for.en: He is known for his caduceus and winged sandals, and for his cunning.

did_you_know.id: Para pedagang Romawi memercikkan air dari mata air suci Mercury ke kepala dan barang dagangan sambil memohon agar ia menghapus kesalahan semua tipuan mereka.
did_you_know.en: Roman shopkeepers sprinkled water from Mercury's sacred spring over their heads and goods, asking him to remove the guilt of all their deceits.

description.id: Mercury menjadi perantara dewa dan manusia; sandal bersayapnya membawa pesan para dewa dengan cepat dan caduceus-nya dipakai untuk mendamaikan pertikaian.
description.en: Mercury mediates between gods and mortals; his winged sandals carry the gods' messages quickly and his caduceus is used to reconcile conflicts.

description.id: Seperti Hermes, Mercury mengantar orang mati ke dunia bawah.
description.en: Like Hermes, Mercury escorts the dead to the underworld.

description.id: Dalam kisah Ovidius tentang Battus, Mercury yang marah mengubah lelaki itu menjadi batu.
description.en: In Ovid's story of Battus, an angry Mercury turns the man into stone.

description.id: Untuk membebaskan Io, Mercury menceritakan kisah-kisah membosankan kepada Argus sampai tertidur, lalu memenggalnya.
description.en: To free Io, Mercury told Argus boring stories until he fell asleep, then beheaded him.

description.id: Menurut Ovidius, Mercury membawa mimpi-mimpi Morpheus dari lembah Somnus kepada manusia yang tidur.
description.en: According to Ovid, Mercury carried Morpheus's dreams from the valley of Somnus to sleeping humans.

description.id: Mercury dikenal licik, sering mengerjai Apollo, dan dalam kisah Ovidius ia pencuri ulung yang mencuri kawanan sapi.
description.en: Mercury is known for cunning, often pranks Apollo, and in Ovid's story is a master thief who steals a herd of cattle.

tradition.id: Sinkretisme Romawi di Galia dan Britania
tradition.en: Roman syncretism in Gaul and Britain

description.id: Dalam sinkretisme Romawi, Mercury disamakan dengan dewa Kelt Lugus dan biasanya ditemani dewi Rosmerta.
description.en: In Roman syncretism Mercury was equated with the Celtic god Lugus and commonly accompanied by the goddess Rosmerta.

tradition.id: Pandangan Romawi terhadap dewa bangsa Jermanik
tradition.en: Roman view of the Germanic peoples' god

description.id: Orang Romawi mengaitkan Mercury dengan dewa Jermanik Wotan; kaitan itu terlihat pada nama hari Wednesday dan Mercredi.
description.en: The Romans associated Mercury with the Germanic god Wotan; the link is seen in the day-names Wednesday and Mercredi.

role.id: Pencuri yang menghukum saksi yang membocorkan rahasianya.
role.en: The thief who punishes the witness who gives away his secret.

summary.id: Menurut Ovidius, Battus menjaga kawanan kuda betina ketika melihat Mercury mencuri ternak. Setelah dijanjikan seekor sapi dara dan seekor banteng, lelaki tua itu membocorkan semuanya, dan Mercury yang marah mengubahnya menjadi batu.
summary.en: According to Ovid, Battus was watching a herd of mares when he saw Mercury steal cattle. After being promised a heifer and a bull, the old man revealed everything, and an angry Mercury turned him into stone.

role.id: Penyelamat Io yang menidurkan dan memenggal Argus.
role.en: The rescuer of Io who lulls Argus to sleep and beheads him.

summary.id: Untuk membebaskan Io, Mercury menceritakan kisah-kisah membosankan kepada Argus sampai ia tertidur, lalu memenggalnya.
summary.en: To free Io, Mercury told Argus boring stories until he fell asleep, then beheaded him.

role.id: Utusan yang mengingatkan Aeneas pada takdirnya.
role.en: The messenger who reminds Aeneas of his destiny.

summary.id: Mercury diutus untuk mengingatkan Aeneas agar meninggalkan Ratu Dido dan Carthage dan menunaikan takdirnya mendirikan Roma.
summary.en: Mercury was sent to remind Aeneas to leave Queen Dido and Carthage and achieve his destiny of founding Rome.

role.id: Pemandu yang mengantar Proserpina ke dunia bawah.
role.en: The guide who escorts Proserpina to the underworld.

summary.id: Dalam mitologi Romawi, Mercury yang mengantar Proserpina, putri Ceres, ke dunia bawah untuk bersama Pluto.
summary.en: In Roman mythology Mercury escorts Proserpina, daughter of Ceres, to the underworld to be with Pluto.

title.en: The infant Mercury and Apollo's oxen

role.id: Anak yang mencuri sapi Apollo (lebih sering dikaitkan dengan Hermes).
role.en: The child who steals Apollo's oxen (more often attributed to Hermes).

summary.id: Kisah ini lebih sering dikaitkan dengan Hermes: Mercury kecil membuat kecapi dari cangkang kura-kura, lalu menyelinap dari ibunya dan mencuri sapi-sapi Apollo.
summary.en: More often attributed to Hermes: the infant Mercury built a lyre from a tortoiseshell, then slipped away from his mother and stole Apollo's oxen.

name.en: Temple of Mercury at the Circus Maximus

description.id: Kuil Mercury di Roma terletak di Circus Maximus, di antara Bukit Aventine dan Palatine, dan dibangun pada 495 SM.
description.en: Mercury's temple in Rome stood in the Circus Maximus, between the Aventine and Palatine Hills, and was built in 495 BC.

name.id: Mata air Mercury dekat Porta Capena
name.en: Mercury's spring near the Porta Capena

description.id: Sebuah mata air dipersembahkan kepada Mercury di antara kuilnya dan Porta Capena; pada 15 Mei para pemilik toko menimba air darinya.
description.en: A spring was dedicated to Mercury between his temple and the Porta Capena; on 15 May shopkeepers drew water from it.

description.id: Bukti arkeologi dari Pompeii menunjukkan Mercury termasuk dewa Romawi paling populer.
description.en: Archaeological evidence from Pompeii suggests Mercury was among the most popular Roman gods.

description.id: Kultus Mercury ada di luar kota Roma di Campania dan Latium serta di Galia dan Britania.
description.en: A cult of Mercury existed outside Rome in Campania and Latium as well as in Gaul and Britain.

description.id: Kuil Mercury dibangun sekitar 495 SM dan hari rayanya diperingati pada 15 Mei.
description.en: Mercury's temple was built around 495 BCE and his festival day was celebrated on 15 May.

description.id: Menurut satu sumber, pada 495 SM Hermes diperkenalkan ke Roma dengan nama Mercurius sebagai pelindung perdagangan gandum.
description.en: According to one source, in 495 BCE Hermes was introduced to Rome as Mercurius, protector of the grain trade.

description.id: Mercury menyerap Dei Lucrii yang lebih tua ketika agama Romawi disinkretiskan dengan agama Yunani pada masa Republik.
description.en: Mercury subsumed the earlier Dei Lucrii as Roman religion was syncretized with Greek religion during the Republic.

note.id: Hermes adalah padanan Mercury dalam tradisi Yunani; kisah keduanya sering bercampur.
note.en: Mercury's Greek counterpart; their stories often blend.

note.id: Ayah Mercury menurut kisah Romawi.
note.en: Mercury's father in Roman stories.

note.id: Ibu Mercury; putri Titan Atlas menurut satu sumber, dan dipuja bersama Mercury pada 15 Mei.
note.en: Mercury's mother; daughter of the Titan Atlas according to one source, and worshipped with Mercury on 15 May.

note.id: Apollo memberi Mercury tongkat caduceus, dan Mercury sering mengerjainya.
note.en: Apollo gave Mercury the caduceus wand, and Mercury often pranks him.

note.id: Menurut penuturan, si kembar Lares, dewa penjaga Roma, adalah anak Mercury.
note.en: According to one account the twin Lares, guardian gods of Rome, are Mercury's children.

note.id: Dewa Etruria yang tampaknya berkerabat dengan Mercury dalam bentuk paling awalnya.
note.en: Etruscan deity to which Mercury appears related in his earliest forms.

note.id: Dewa Kelt yang disamakan dengan Mercury dalam sinkretisme Romawi.
note.en: Celtic god equated with Mercury in Roman syncretism.

note.id: Dewi Kelt yang biasanya menemani Mercury dalam wujud sebagai Lugus.
note.en: Celtic goddess who commonly accompanied Mercury in his Lugus aspect.

note.id: Dewa Jermanik yang dihubungkan orang Romawi dengan Mercury.
note.en: Germanic god the Romans associated with Mercury.

note.id: Mercury diutus mengingatkan Aeneas pada takdirnya.
note.en: Mercury was sent to remind Aeneas of his destiny.

note.id: Raksasa berbilang mata yang dibuat tertidur dan dipenggal Mercury.
note.en: The many-eyed guard whom Mercury put to sleep and beheaded.

note.id: Mercury membebaskan Io dengan mengalahkan Argus.
note.en: Mercury freed Io by defeating Argus.

note.id: Penjaga kuda betina yang membocorkan rahasia Mercury dan diubah menjadi batu.
note.en: The mare-watcher who gave away Mercury's secret and was turned to stone.

note.id: Dalam mitologi Romawi, Mercury mengantar Proserpina ke dunia bawah.
note.en: In Roman mythology Mercury escorts Proserpina to the underworld.

description.id: Mercury muncul dalam kisah komik pertama Jack Kirby yang diterbitkan, di Red Raven Comics 1.
description.en: Mercury features in Jack Kirby's first published comic book story, in Red Raven Comics 1.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa dewa perdagangan juga dikenal sebagai penipu dan pencuri?
learning_questions.en: Why is the god of commerce also known as a cheat and a thief?

learning_questions.id: Apa yang berubah ketika orang Romawi menyamakan Mercury dengan dewa Kelt dan Jermanik?
learning_questions.en: What changed when the Romans equated Mercury with Celtic and Germanic gods?

claims.quote: Mercury (Mercurius) was the Roman god of commerce, often serving as a mediator between the gods and mortals

statement.id: Mercury adalah dewa perdagangan Romawi dan perantara dewa dengan manusia.
statement.en: Mercury is the Roman god of commerce and mediator between gods and mortals.

claims.quote: Mercury protected both merchants, especially those dealing in grains, and travelers.

statement.id: Mercury melindungi pedagang dan pelancong.
statement.en: Mercury protected merchants and travelers.

claims.quote: Mercury was the son of the king of the gods Jupiter and purportedly Maia, goddess of the plains.

statement.id: Mercury disebut putra Jupiter dan Maia.
statement.en: Mercury was said to be the son of Jupiter and Maia.

claims.quote: he is often associated with his Greek counterpart Hermes. His Roman name Mercurius is probably derived from the Latin word for merchandise (merx).

statement.id: Mercury dipadankan dengan Hermes; nama Mercurius mungkin berasal dari merx.
statement.en: Mercury is associated with Hermes; Mercurius may derive from merx.

claims.quote: Like Hermes, he escorted the dead to the underworld.

statement.id: Mercury mengantar arwah ke dunia bawah.
statement.en: Mercury escorted the dead to the underworld.

claims.quote: The god is frequently depicted holding the caduceus, a wand used to reconcile conflicts, and winged sandals for quickly carrying messages for the gods.

statement.id: Mercury digambarkan membawa caduceus dan mengenakan sandal bersayap.
statement.en: Mercury is depicted with a caduceus and winged sandals.

claims.quote: Mercury's festival day was celebrated on May 15 in commemoration of the founding of his temple.

statement.id: Hari raya Mercury diperingati pada 15 Mei.
statement.en: Mercury's festival day was May 15.

claims.quote: It was Mercury who was sent to remind the Trojan Aeneas to leave his beloved Queen Dido and Carthage and achieve his destiny to found Rome.

statement.id: Mercury mengingatkan Aeneas untuk meninggalkan Dido dan Carthage.
statement.en: Mercury reminded Aeneas to leave Dido and Carthage.

claims.quote: Roman statuettes of bronze, in which Mercury is represented, like the Greek Hermes, standing holding the caduceus or staff in the one hand and a purse in the other

statement.id: Patung Romawi menggambarkan Mercury dengan tongkat dan pundi-pundi.
statement.en: Roman statuettes show Mercury holding a staff and purse.

claims.quote: Allegedly, while escorting the nymph Lara to Pluto's realm, he fathered the twin Lares, guardian gods of Rome.

statement.id: Konon, ketika mengantar nimfa Lara ke dunia Pluto, ia menjadi ayah si kembar Lares, dewa penjaga Roma.
statement.en: Allegedly, while escorting the nymph Lara to Pluto's realm, he fathered the twin Lares, guardian gods of Rome.

claims.quote: A temple honoring him was built around 495 BCE and stood on the southwest slope of Aventine Hill near the Circus Maximus of Rome.

statement.id: Kuil untuknya dibangun sekitar 495 SM dan berdiri di lereng barat daya Bukit Aventine dekat Circus Maximus, Roma.
statement.en: A temple honoring him was built around 495 BCE on the southwest slope of the Aventine Hill near the Circus Maximus of Rome.

claims.quote: A cult paying homage to him existed outside the city of Rome in Campania and Latium as well as in Gaul and Britain.

statement.id: Kultus untuknya ada di luar kota Roma, di Campania dan Latium, serta di Galia dan Britania.
statement.en: A cult honoring him existed outside the city of Rome in Campania and Latium, as well as in Gaul and Britain.

claims.quote: Besides the wand and sandals, he also wore a broad-brimmed hat, the Petasus, and carried a purse, a symbol of his duties as the god of commerce and profits.

statement.id: Selain tongkat dan sandal, ia mengenakan topi lebar bernama Petasus dan membawa pundi-pundi, lambang tugasnya sebagai dewa perdagangan dan keuntungan.
statement.en: Besides the wand and sandals, he wore a broad-brimmed hat, the Petasus, and carried a purse, a symbol of his duties as god of commerce and profits.

claims.quote: However, to many, he was also known for being cunning and shrewd as well as a deceiver, often pulling pranks on the unsuspecting, especially the god Apollo.

statement.id: Bagi banyak orang ia juga dikenal licik dan cerdik sekaligus penipu yang sering mengerjai orang yang lengah, terutama dewa Apollo.
statement.en: To many he was also known as cunning and shrewd as well as a deceiver, often pulling pranks on the unsuspecting, especially the god Apollo.

claims.quote: Besides the god of commerce, Mercury was also the patron of shepherds, cheats and thieves. Ovid relays a story of Mercury who was a master thief himself.

statement.id: Selain dewa perdagangan, Mercury juga pelindung gembala, penipu, dan pencuri; Ovidius menuturkan kisah Mercury sebagai pencuri ulung.
statement.en: Besides being the god of commerce, Mercury was patron of shepherds, cheats and thieves; Ovid relays a story of Mercury as a master thief himself.

claims.quote: After being promised a heifer and a bull if he talked, the old man revealed all. Angry, Mercury turned him into stone.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Ovidius tentang Battus, setelah dijanjikan seekor sapi dara dan seekor banteng, lelaki tua itu membocorkan semuanya; Mercury yang marah mengubahnya menjadi batu.
statement.en: In Ovid's story of Battus, after being promised a heifer and a bull, the old man revealed everything; an angry Mercury turned him into stone.

claims.quote: In order to free Io Mercury told Argus boring stories until he finally fell asleep. After Mercury beheaded Argus, Io was freed.

statement.id: Untuk membebaskan Io, Mercury menceritakan kisah-kisah membosankan kepada Argus sampai ia tertidur; setelah Mercury memenggal Argus, Io bebas.
statement.en: To free Io, Mercury told Argus boring stories until he fell asleep; after Mercury beheaded Argus, Io was freed.

claims.quote: In Roman Mythology it is Mercury who escorts the young Proserpina, daughter of Ceres, to the underworld to be with Pluto (the Greek Hades).

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Romawi, Mercury yang mengantar Proserpina muda, putri Ceres, ke dunia bawah untuk bersama Pluto (Hades dalam tradisi Yunani).
statement.en: In Roman mythology it is Mercury who escorts the young Proserpina, daughter of Ceres, to the underworld to be with Pluto (the Greek Hades).

claims.quote: One last story tells of the adventuresome Mercury as a small child - again it is an episode more often attributed to Hermes. Although a talented child - he built a lyre out of a tortoiseshell - one night he slipped away from his mother and, spying Apollo's oxen grazing in a field, stole them.

statement.id: Satu kisah menampilkan Mercury kecil, meski lebih sering dikaitkan dengan Hermes: ia membuat kecapi dari cangkang kura-kura, lalu pada suatu malam menyelinap dari ibunya dan mencuri sapi-sapi Apollo.
statement.en: One story shows Mercury as a small child, though it is more often attributed to Hermes: he built a lyre from a tortoiseshell, then one night slipped away from his mother and stole Apollo's oxen.

claims.quote: The wand had been given to him by Apollo in Greek mythology.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Yunani, tongkat itu diberikan kepadanya oleh Apollo.
statement.en: In Greek mythology the wand had been given to him by Apollo.

claims.quote: As with many stories in Roman mythology, narratives about Mercury became intertwined with those of Hermes, so it is often difficult to separate the two.

statement.id: Seperti banyak kisah mitologi Romawi, kisah Mercury menjadi bercampur dengan kisah Hermes sehingga sulit dipisahkan.
statement.en: As with many Roman myths, narratives about Mercury became intertwined with those of Hermes, so it is often difficult to separate the two.

claims.quote: Merchants would pray to him for high profits and protection of their trade goods.

statement.id: Para pedagang berdoa kepadanya untuk memohon keuntungan besar dan perlindungan barang dagangan.
statement.en: Merchants would pray to him for high profits and protection of their trade goods.

claims.quote: in 495 the Greek god Hermes was introduced into Rome under the Italian name of Mercurius (Livy ii. 21, 27), as protector of the grain trade, especially with Sicily.

statement.id: Pada 495 SM dewa Yunani Hermes diperkenalkan ke Roma dengan nama Italia Mercurius, sebagai pelindung perdagangan gandum, terutama dengan Sisilia.
statement.en: In 495 the Greek god Hermes was introduced into Rome under the Italian name Mercurius, as protector of the grain trade, especially with Sicily.

claims.quote: every shopman drew water from this spring on the 15th of May, and sprinkled it with a laurel twig over his head and over his goods, at the same time entreating Mercury to remove from his head and his goods the guilt of all his deceits

statement.id: Pada 15 Mei setiap pemilik toko mengambil air dari mata air itu dan memercikkannya dengan ranting salam ke kepala dan barangnya sambil memohon Mercury menghapus kesalahan semua tipuannya.
statement.en: On the 15th of May every shopman drew water from this spring and sprinkled it with a laurel twig over his head and goods, entreating Mercury to remove the guilt of all his deceits.

claims.quote: The word mercurialis was popularly used as equivalent to “cheat.”

statement.id: Kata mercurialis dipakai secara populer sebagai padanan "penipu".
statement.en: The word mercurialis was popularly used as equivalent to "cheat".

claims.quote: The 15th of May was chosen as the feast of Mercury, obviously because Maia was the mother of Hermes, that is of Mercury; and she was worshipped along with her son by the mercuriales on this day.

statement.id: Tanggal 15 Mei dipilih sebagai pesta Mercury karena Maia ibu Hermes, yaitu Mercury; pada hari itu ia dipuja bersama putranya oleh para mercuriales.
statement.en: The 15th of May was chosen as Mercury's feast because Maia was the mother of Hermes, that is, of Mercury; on this day she was worshipped with her son by the mercuriales.

claims.quote: MERCURY (Mercurius), in Roman mythology, the god of merchandise (merx) and merchants; later identified with the Greek Hermes.

statement.id: Mercury (Mercurius) dalam mitologi Romawi adalah dewa barang dagangan (merx) dan pedagang, yang kemudian diidentifikasi dengan Hermes dari Yunani.
statement.en: Mercury (Mercurius), in Roman mythology, was the god of merchandise (merx) and merchants, later identified with the Greek Hermes.

claims.quote: He is the god of boundaries, commerce, communication (including divination), eloquence, financial gain, languages, luck, thieves, travelers, and trickery; he is also the guide of souls to the underworld.

statement.id: Ia dewa batas, perdagangan, komunikasi (termasuk ramalan), kefasihan, keuntungan finansial, bahasa, keberuntungan, pencuri, pelancong, dan tipu daya, serta pemandu jiwa ke dunia bawah.
statement.en: He is the god of boundaries, commerce, communication (including divination), eloquence, financial gain, languages, luck, thieves, travelers and trickery, and the guide of souls to the underworld.

claims.quote: In Roman mythology, he was the son of Maia, daughter of the Titan Atlas, and Jupiter. In his earliest forms, he appears to have been related to the Etruscan deity Turms

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Romawi ia putra Maia, putri Titan Atlas, dan Jupiter; dalam bentuk paling awalnya ia tampaknya berkerabat dengan dewa Etruria Turms.
statement.en: In Roman mythology he was the son of Maia, daughter of the Titan Atlas, and Jupiter; in his earliest forms he appears related to the Etruscan deity Turms.

claims.quote: He was often accompanied by a rooster, herald of the new day, a ram or goat, symbolizing fertility, and a tortoise, referring to Mercury's legendary invention of the lyre from a tortoise shell.

statement.id: Ia sering ditemani ayam jantan, pewarta hari baru, domba jantan atau kambing, lambang kesuburan, dan kura-kura yang merujuk pada penemuan kecapi dari cangkangnya.
statement.en: He was often accompanied by a rooster, herald of the new day, a ram or goat symbolizing fertility, and a tortoise referring to his legendary invention of the lyre from a tortoise shell.

claims.quote: Mercury did not appear among the numinous di indigetes of early Roman religion. Rather, he subsumed the earlier Dei Lucrii as Roman religion was syncretized with Greek religion during the time of the Roman Republic, starting around the 4th century BC.

statement.id: Mercury tidak termasuk di indigetes awal agama Romawi; ia menyerap Dei Lucrii yang lebih tua ketika agama Romawi disinkretiskan dengan agama Yunani pada masa Republik, mulai sekitar abad ke-4 SM.
statement.en: Mercury was not among the di indigetes of early Roman religion; he subsumed the earlier Dei Lucrii as Roman religion was syncretized with Greek religion under the Republic, starting around the 4th century BC.

claims.quote: Julius Caesar wrote of Mercury being the most popular god in Britain and Gaul, regarded as the inventor of all the arts. This is probably because, in the Roman syncretism, Mercury was equated with the Celtic god Lugus, and in this aspect was commonly accompanied by the Celtic goddess Rosmerta.

statement.id: Julius Caesar menulis bahwa Mercury adalah dewa terpopuler di Britania dan Galia, dipandang sebagai penemu segala seni; dalam sinkretisme Romawi ia disamakan dengan dewa Kelt Lugus dan biasanya ditemani dewi Rosmerta.
statement.en: Julius Caesar wrote that Mercury was the most popular god in Britain and Gaul, regarded as inventor of all the arts; in Roman syncretism he was equated with the Celtic god Lugus and commonly accompanied by the goddess Rosmerta.

claims.quote: Romans associated Mercury with the Germanic god Wotan ... 1st-century Roman writer Tacitus identifies him as the chief god of the Germanic peoples. This association of Mercury and Wotan is seen in the English language day-name Wednesday and the French Mercredi.

statement.id: Orang Romawi menghubungkan Mercury dengan dewa Jermanik Wotan; Tacitus menyebutnya dewa utama bangsa Jermanik, dan kaitan itu terlihat pada nama hari Wednesday dan Mercredi.
statement.en: The Romans associated Mercury with the Germanic god Wotan; Tacitus identifies him as the chief god of the Germanic peoples, and the link is seen in the day-names Wednesday and Mercredi.

claims.quote: There was a spring dedicated to Mercury between his temple and the Porta Capena; every shopman drew water from this spring on the 15th of May

statement.id: Ada mata air yang dipersembahkan kepada Mercury di antara kuilnya dan Porta Capena; pada 15 Mei setiap pemilik toko menimba air dari mata air itu.
statement.en: There was a spring dedicated to Mercury between his temple and the Porta Capena; every shopman drew water from it on the 15th of May.

claims.quote: Archeological evidence from Pompeii suggests that Mercury was among the most popular of Roman gods.

statement.id: Bukti arkeologi dari Pompeii menunjukkan Mercury termasuk dewa Romawi yang paling populer.
statement.en: Archaeological evidence from Pompeii suggests that Mercury was among the most popular Roman gods.

claims.quote: Mercury features in the first published comic book story of Jack Kirby, Mercury in the 20th Century, published in Red Raven Comics 1, 1940.

statement.id: Mercury muncul dalam kisah komik pertama Jack Kirby yang diterbitkan, "Mercury in the 20th Century", di Red Raven Comics 1 tahun 1940.
statement.en: Mercury features in Jack Kirby's first published comic book story, "Mercury in the 20th Century", in Red Raven Comics 1, 1940.

claims.quote: Mercury's temple in Rome was situated in the Circus Maximus, between the Aventine and Palatine Hills, and was built in 495 BC.

statement.id: Kuil Mercury di Roma terletak di Circus Maximus, di antara Bukit Aventine dan Palatine, dan dibangun pada 495 SM.
statement.en: Mercury's temple in Rome stood in the Circus Maximus, between the Aventine and Palatine Hills, and was built in 495 BC.

claims.quote: Mercury became the god, not only of the mercatores and of the grain trade, but of buying and selling in general; and it appears that, at least in the streets where shops were common, little chapels and images of the god were erected.

statement.id: Mercury menjadi dewa bukan hanya para mercatores dan perdagangan gandum, tetapi jual beli pada umumnya; di jalan-jalan yang banyak tokonya tampaknya didirikan kapel kecil dan patung sang dewa.
statement.en: Mercury became the god not only of the mercatores and the grain trade but of buying and selling in general; in streets with many shops, little chapels and images of the god appear to have been erected.

claims.quote: The name "Mercury" is possibly related to the Latin words merx ("merchandise"; cf. merchant, commerce, etc.), mercari (to trade), and merces (wages)

statement.id: Nama Mercury mungkin berkaitan dengan kata Latin merx ("barang dagangan"), mercari (berdagang), dan merces (upah).
statement.en: The name Mercury is possibly related to the Latin words merx ("merchandise"), mercari (to trade) and merces (wages).

claims.quote: Similar to his Greek equivalent Hermes, he was awarded a magic wand by Apollo, which later turned into the caduceus, the staff with intertwined snakes.

statement.id: Seperti padanannya Hermes, ia diberi tongkat sihir oleh Apollo yang kemudian menjadi caduceus, tongkat dengan ular yang berjalin.
statement.en: Like his Greek equivalent Hermes, he was given a magic wand by Apollo, which later became the caduceus, the staff with intertwined snakes.

claims.quote: Additionally, Ovid wrote that Mercury carried Morpheus's dreams from the valley of Somnus to sleeping humans.

statement.id: Ovidius menulis bahwa Mercury membawa mimpi-mimpi Morpheus dari lembah Somnus kepada manusia yang tidur.
statement.en: Ovid wrote that Mercury carried Morpheus's dreams from the valley of Somnus to sleeping humans.

claims.quote: is known to the Romans as Mercurius and occasionally in earlier writings as Merqurius, Mirqurios or Mircurios

statement.id: Bagi orang Romawi ia dikenal sebagai Mercurius, dan kadang dalam tulisan lebih awal sebagai Merqurius, Mirqurios, atau Mircurios.
statement.en: He is known to the Romans as Mercurius and occasionally in earlier writings as Merqurius, Mirqurios or Mircurios.

claims.quote: Mercury was also considered a god of abundance and commercial success, particularly in Gaul, where he was said to have been particularly revered.

statement.id: Mercury juga dipandang sebagai dewa kelimpahan dan keberhasilan dagang, terutama di Galia tempat ia konon sangat dihormati.
statement.en: Mercury was also considered a god of abundance and commercial success, particularly in Gaul, where he was said to be especially revered.

summary.en: Mercury subsumed the Dei Lucrii as Roman religion was syncretized with Greek religion, starting around the 4th century BC.

summary.id: Putra Jupiter dan, konon, Maia, dewi dataran.
summary.en: Son of Jupiter and, purportedly, Maia, goddess of the plains.

summary.id: Putra Maia, putri Titan Atlas, dan Jupiter.
summary.en: Son of Maia, daughter of the Titan Atlas, and Jupiter.

short_description.id: Saturnus adalah dewa Romawi pertanian, waktu, dan kelimpahan, yang dipadankan dengan Cronus dari Yunani dan dihormati dalam perayaan Saturnalia.
short_description.en: Saturn is the Roman god of agriculture, time, and abundance, associated with the Greek Cronus and honored at the festival of Saturnalia.

long_description.id: Saturnus adalah dewa Romawi yang dihubungkan dengan Cronus dari mitologi Yunani. Ia digambarkan sebagai dewa waktu, generasi, peluruhan, kelimpahan, kekayaan, pertanian, pembaruan berkala, dan pembebasan, dan dalam seni sering tampil membawa sabit. Wikipedia mencatat bahwa ia juga digambarkan berkerudung, misalnya pada lukisan dinding dari Pompeii, sedangkan Virgil menyebut Saturnus tua dengan sabit bengkoknya di antara para leluhur yang berbaris.
long_description.en: Saturn is a Roman god associated with Cronus of Greek mythology. Sources describe him as a god of time, generation, dissolution, abundance, wealth, agriculture, renewal and liberation, and in art he is often shown with a scythe. Wikipedia notes that he was also represented veiled, for example in a wall painting from Pompeii, while Virgil mentions old Saturn with his crooked scythe among ranked ancestors.

long_description.id: Menurut legenda Romawi, Saturnus menetap di Latium dan memerintah dengan bijak pada zaman keemasan yang damai dan makmur. Ia mengajarkan prinsip dasar bertani dan menanam anggur serta membantu penduduk meninggalkan adat 'barbar'. Dalam Aeneid karya Virgil (terjemahan Dryden), ia datang setelah melarikan diri dari kuasa Jove dan membawa hukum serta adat sipil bagi orang-orang yang tersebar di bukit.
long_description.en: According to Roman legend, Saturn settled in Latium and ruled wisely during a golden age of peace and prosperity. He taught the basic principles of farming and viticulture and helped the locals give up their 'barbaric' customs. In Virgil's Aeneid (Dryden's translation), he came after fleeing the power of Jove and brought laws and civil customs to men scattered over the hills.

long_description.id: Tradisi mengenai asal Saturnus berbeda-beda. Menurut satu tradisi ia dewa pendatang yang diterima Janus setelah digulingkan putranya, Jupiter, dan diusir dari Yunani; menurut mitos lain ia penguasa asli Capitolium. Kuil Saturnus di kaki Bukit Capitoline menyimpan kas negara dan catatan Senat. Posisi perayaannya dalam kalender Romawi membuatnya dikaitkan dengan konsep waktu, terutama peralihan Tahun Baru.
long_description.en: Traditions about Saturn's origin differ. According to one tradition he was an immigrant god received by Janus after being usurped by his son Jupiter and expelled from Greece; according to another myth he was the original ruler of the Capitolium. His temple at the foot of the Capitoline Hill housed the state treasury and the Senate's records. The festival's place in the Roman calendar tied him to concepts of time, especially the turn of the New Year.

long_description.id: Saturnalia, perayaan yang dinamai menurut namanya, dirayakan pada Desember dan menjadi hari libur paling populer dalam tahun Romawi. Pada perayaan itu orang bertukar hadiah berupa lilin atau patung tanah liat kecil, dan budak serta tuan bertukar peran untuk sementara. Perayaan itu bertahan ke era Kristen dengan nama Brumalia.
long_description.en: The Saturnalia, the festival named after him, was held in December and was the most popular holiday of the Roman year. People exchanged gifts, usually candles or pottery figurines, and slaves and masters temporarily reversed roles. The festival survived into the Christian era under the name Brumalia.

cultural_context.id: Saturnalia adalah perayaan saat pembatasan sosial dilonggarkan, dan arca Saturnus yang kakinya diikat wol sepanjang tahun dilepaskan pada perayaan itu sebagai lambang pembebasan sang dewa. Menurut H. S. Versnel, ketidakkonsistenan seperti menjadi pendatang tetapi memiliki salah satu tempat suci tertua Roma, atau menjadi dewa pembebasan yang dibelenggu sepanjang tahun, menunjukkan kemampuan Saturnus mengaburkan pembedaan sosial.
cultural_context.en: The Saturnalia was a festival at which social restrictions were relaxed, and the statue of Saturn, whose feet were bound in wool through the year, was loosened on the festival as a symbol of the god's liberation. H. S. Versnel reads contradictions in the god, being a foreigner yet holding one of Rome's oldest sanctuaries and being a god of liberation kept in fetters for most of the year, as signs of his capacity to blur social distinctions.

literal_meaning.id: Menurut Varro berasal dari satus, 'penaburan'; etimologi lain mengaitkannya dengan dewa Etruria Satre atau menafsirkannya sebagai 'kenyang' oleh tahun.
literal_meaning.en: According to Varro from satus, 'sowing'; other etymologies link it with the Etruscan god Satre or read it as 'sated' with years.

summary.id: Saturnus menetap di Latium, disambut Janus, mendirikan kota Saturnia, dan memerintah dengan bijak pada zaman keemasan yang damai. Dalam Aeneid Virgil, ia menghimpun orang yang tersebar di bukit ke dalam kota dan menamai tanah tempatnya bersembunyi Latium.
summary.en: Saturn settled in Latium, was welcomed by Janus, founded the city of Saturnia, and ruled wisely in a peaceful golden age. In Virgil's Aeneid he brought the men scattered on the hills into towns and named the land where he hid Latium.

role.id: Saturnus (atau Cronus) digulingkan lalu mengungsi.
role.en: Saturn (or Cronus) is overthrown and flees.

summary.id: Menurut tradisi yang dicatat Wikipedia, Saturnus digulingkan putranya, Jupiter, diusir dari Yunani, lalu diterima Janus. Virgil menggambarkannya melarikan diri dari kuasa Jove. Sumber lain mencatat Cronus diusir dari Gunung Olympus setelah Zeus dan saudara-saudaranya mengalahkan para Titan.
summary.en: According to a tradition recorded by Wikipedia, Saturn was usurped by his son Jupiter, expelled from Greece, and received by Janus. Virgil describes him fleeing the power of Jove. Another source records that Cronus was expelled from Mt. Olympus after Zeus and his brothers defeated the Titans.

role.id: Perayaan yang dinamai menurut Saturnus.
role.en: The festival named after Saturn.

summary.id: Saturnalia dirayakan pada Desember dari tanggal 17 sampai 23, dengan kurban di kuil, perjamuan umum, lectisternium, pertukaran hadiah, dan pembalikan peran antara budak dan tuan. Perayaan dipimpin raja tiruan, Raja Kekacauan.
summary.en: The Saturnalia ran through December, from the 17th until the 23rd, with sacrifice at the temple, a public banquet, a lectisternium, gift exchange, and a reversal of roles between slaves and masters. A mock king, the King of Misrule, presided.

claims.quote: Saturn (Saturnus) was a Roman god with a similar history to Cronus from Greek mythology.

statement.id: Saturnus adalah dewa Romawi yang berkaitan dengan Cronus dalam mitologi Yunani.
statement.en: Saturnus is a Roman god associated with Greek Cronus.

claims.quote: Often depicted in art wielding a scythe he was considered an agricultural god, especially associated with seed-corn.

statement.id: Saturn adalah dewa pertanian yang sering digambarkan membawa sabit.
statement.en: Saturn is an agricultural god often shown with a scythe.

claims.quote: According to Roman legend, Saturn settled in Latium on the future site of Rome.

statement.id: Legenda Romawi menempatkan Saturn di Latium.
statement.en: Roman legend places Saturn in Latium.

claims.quote: According to ancient myth, Saturn ruled Latium wisely during its golden age, a time of great prosperity and peace.

statement.id: Saturn memerintah Latium pada zaman keemasan yang makmur dan damai.
statement.en: Saturn ruled Latium during a prosperous and peaceful golden age.

claims.quote: He instructed the people on the basic principles of farming and viticulture (the production of grapes).

statement.id: Saturn mengajarkan pertanian dan penanaman anggur.
statement.en: Saturn taught farming and viticulture.

claims.quote: His temple, built around 498 BCE, was located at the foot of Capitoline Hill and housed the Roman treasury as well as the records and decrees of the Roman Senate.

statement.id: Kuil Saturn di kaki Bukit Capitoline menampung kas negara dan catatan Senat Romawi.
statement.en: Saturn's temple at the Capitoline Hill housed the Roman treasury and Senate records.

claims.quote: Saturnus, the god of seed and sowing (Latin satus) was honored with a festival. The Saturnalia officially was celebrated on December 17

statement.id: Saturnus, dewa benih dan penaburan, dihormati dalam perayaan Saturnalia pada 17 Desember.
statement.en: Saturnus, god of seed and sowing, was honored at Saturnalia on December 17.

claims.quote: Gifts were exchanged, usually candles or pottery figurines.

statement.id: Orang saling memberikan lilin atau patung kecil dalam perayaan Saturnalia.
statement.en: People exchanged candles or small figurines at Saturnalia.

claims.quote: Slaves gave orders to the masters, and masters waited on slaves.

statement.id: Dalam Saturnalia, budak dan tuan membalik peran untuk sementara.
statement.en: Saturnalia temporarily reversed the roles of slaves and masters.

claims.quote: Some authors believe Saturn existed in Roman mythology long before the “invasion” of Greek religion and associate him with the Etruscan god Satre; however, whether this is true or not is entirely speculative.

statement.id: Sebagian penulis meyakini Saturnus sudah ada dalam mitologi Romawi jauh sebelum 'invasi' agama Yunani dan mengaitkannya dengan dewa Etruria Satre, tetapi hal itu sepenuhnya spekulatif.
statement.en: Some authors believe Saturn existed in Roman mythology long before the 'invasion' of Greek religion and link him to the Etruscan god Satre, but this is entirely speculative.

claims.quote: became more closely associated with the Greek god Cronus, the lord of the universe and the god who devoured his own children. He was son of Uranus (sky) and Gaea (earth). After Zeus and his brothers (Poseidon and Hades) became victorious over the Titans, Cronus was expelled from the home of the Greek gods, Mt. Olympus.

statement.id: Cronus, tokoh Yunani yang dipadankan dengan Saturnus, adalah putra Uranus dan Gaea; setelah Zeus dan saudara-saudaranya mengalahkan para Titan, Cronus diusir dari Gunung Olympus.
statement.en: Cronus, the Greek figure associated with Saturn, was the son of Uranus and Gaea; after Zeus and his brothers defeated the Titans, Cronus was expelled from Mt. Olympus.

claims.quote: His arrival was welcomed by the Roman god Janus, the two-faced deity, the god of the beginnings and ends. Saturn quickly established himself there, even founding the nearby city of Saturnia.

statement.id: Kedatangan Saturnus disambut dewa Romawi Janus, dewa berwajah dua, dewa awal dan akhir; Saturnus segera mapan di sana dan bahkan mendirikan kota Saturnia di dekatnya.
statement.en: Saturn's arrival was welcomed by the Roman god Janus, the two-faced god of beginnings and ends; he quickly established himself and even founded the nearby city of Saturnia.

claims.quote: He also helped the locals to rid themselves of their “barbaric” customs and instead adopted a more civic and moral lifestyle.

statement.id: Ia juga membantu penduduk setempat meninggalkan adat 'barbar' mereka dan menjalani hidup yang lebih beradab dan bermoral.
statement.en: He also helped the locals rid themselves of their 'barbaric' customs and adopt a more civic and moral lifestyle.

claims.quote: housed the Roman treasury as well as the records and decrees of the Roman Senate. Falling into disrepair, it would be rebuilt during the reign of Emperor Augustus.

statement.id: Kuil Saturnus yang rusak kemudian dibangun kembali pada masa pemerintahan Kaisar Augustus.
statement.en: The temple fell into disrepair and was rebuilt during the reign of Emperor Augustus.

claims.quote: His festival, the Saturnalia, was celebrated in December from the 17th to the 23rd and was connected to the winter grain sowing.

statement.id: Saturnalia dirayakan pada Desember dari tanggal 17 sampai 23 dan dikaitkan dengan penaburan biji-bijian musim dingin.
statement.en: The Saturnalia was celebrated in December from the 17th to the 23rd and was connected to the winter grain sowing.

claims.quote: His festival, the Saturnalia, was celebrated in December from the 17th to the 23rd ... As part of the calendar of Numa, the second king of Rome, the festival immediately preceded the festival of Ops, Saturn's partner or consort and the goddess of the harvest - she became associated with the Greek goddess Rhea.

statement.id: Saturnalia langsung mendahului perayaan Ops, pasangan Saturnus dan dewi panen, yang dikaitkan dengan dewi Yunani Rhea.
statement.en: The Saturnalia immediately preceded the festival of Ops, Saturn's partner or consort and the goddess of the harvest, who became associated with the Greek goddess Rhea.

claims.quote: Presiding over the festival was a mock king, the King of Misrule, or Saturnalicius princeps.

statement.id: Perayaan dipimpin oleh raja tiruan, 'Raja Kekacauan' atau Saturnalicius princeps.
statement.en: The festival was presided over by a mock king, the King of Misrule or Saturnalicius princeps.

claims.quote: The festival would endure into the Christian era when it would assume a new identity and name - Brumalia.

statement.id: Perayaan itu bertahan hingga era Kristen dan memperoleh identitas serta nama baru, Brumalia.
statement.en: The festival survived into the Christian era, taking on a new identity and the name Brumalia.

claims.quote: Saturn was also linked to another ancient Italian deity, Lua.

statement.id: Saturnus juga dikaitkan dengan dewa Italia kuno lain, Lua.
statement.en: Saturn was also linked to another ancient Italian deity, Lua.

claims.quote: We remember Saturn in two ways, for one he ends our busy work week - Saturday. And, as we look to the sky, on occasion, we can see the sixth planet from the sun - Saturn.

statement.id: Saturnus dikenang lewat hari Sabtu (Saturday) dan lewat planet keenam dari Matahari yang menyandang namanya.
statement.en: Saturn is remembered through Saturday and through the sixth planet from the sun, which bears his name.

claims.quote: His temple, built around 498 BCE, was located at the foot of Capitoline Hill and housed the Roman treasury as well as the records and decrees of the Roman Senate.

statement.id: Kuilnya, dibangun sekitar 498 SM, berada di kaki Bukit Capitoline dan menyimpan kas negara serta catatan dan keputusan Senat.
statement.en: His temple, built around 498 BCE, stood at the foot of Capitoline Hill and housed the Roman treasury and the records and decrees of the Senate.

claims.quote: Saturn, himself, was identified with Kronos, and sacrificed to according to Greek ritual, with the head uncovered.

statement.id: Saturnus diidentifikasi dengan Kronos dan dipersembahi kurban menurut ritus Yunani, dengan kepala tidak ditutup.
statement.en: Saturn was identified with Kronos and received sacrifice according to Greek ritual, with the head uncovered.

claims.quote: The Temple of Saturn, the oldest temple recorded by the pontiffs, had been dedicated on the Saturnalia, and the woolen bonds which fettered the feet of the ivory cult statue within were loosened on that day to symbolize the liberation of the god.

statement.id: Kuil Saturnus, kuil tertua yang dicatat para pontifeks, didedikasikan pada hari Saturnalia, dan ikatan wol pada kaki arca gadingnya dilonggarkan pada hari itu sebagai lambang pembebasan sang dewa.
statement.en: The Temple of Saturn, the oldest temple recorded by the pontiffs, was dedicated on the Saturnalia, and the woolen bonds on the feet of its ivory cult statue were loosened that day to symbolize the god's liberation.

claims.quote: After sacrifice at the temple, there was a public banquet, as well as a lectisternium (in which an image of the god was placed as if in attendance), which Livy says was introduced in 217 BC.

statement.id: Setelah kurban di kuil ada perjamuan umum dan lectisternium (citra sang dewa diletakkan seolah menghadiri jamuan), yang menurut Livy diperkenalkan pada 217 SM.
statement.en: After the sacrifice at the temple there was a public banquet and a lectisternium (an image of the god placed as if in attendance), which Livy says was introduced in 217 BC.

claims.quote: The original day was given over to the Opalia, honoring Ops, who personified abundance and the fruits of the earth, and was the consort of Saturn.

statement.id: Hari asli perayaan itu diperuntukkan bagi Opalia, yang menghormati Ops, personifikasi kelimpahan dan hasil bumi serta pasangan Saturnus.
statement.en: The original day was given over to the Opalia, honoring Ops, who personified abundance and the fruits of the earth and was Saturn's consort.

claims.quote: Augustus limited the holiday to three days, so the civil courts would not have to be closed any longer than necessary

statement.id: Augustus membatasi perayaan itu menjadi tiga hari agar pengadilan sipil tidak ditutup lebih lama dari yang perlu.
statement.en: Augustus limited the holiday to three days so that the civil courts would not have to be closed longer than necessary.

claims.quote: The Saturnalia was the most popular holiday of the Roman year.

statement.id: Saturnalia adalah hari libur paling populer dalam tahun Romawi.
statement.en: The Saturnalia was the most popular holiday of the Roman year.

claims.quote: He was described as a god of time, generation, dissolution, abundance, wealth, agriculture, periodic renewal and liberation.

statement.id: Saturnus digambarkan sebagai dewa waktu, generasi, peluruhan, kelimpahan, kekayaan, pertanian, pembaruan berkala, dan pembebasan.
statement.en: Saturn was described as a god of time, generation, dissolution, abundance, wealth, agriculture, periodic renewal and liberation.

claims.quote: Saturn's consort was his sister Ops, with whom he fathered Jupiter, Neptune, Pluto, Juno, Ceres and Vesta.

statement.id: Pasangan Saturnus adalah saudarinya, Ops, dan dari Ops ia menjadi ayah Jupiter, Neptune, Pluto, Juno, Ceres, dan Vesta.
statement.en: Saturn's consort was his sister Ops, with whom he fathered Jupiter, Neptune, Pluto, Juno, Ceres and Vesta.

claims.quote: The Temple of Saturn in the Roman Forum housed the state treasury and archives (aerarium) of the Roman Republic and the early Roman Empire.

statement.id: Kuil Saturnus di Forum Romawi menyimpan kas negara dan arsip (aerarium) Republik Romawi dan Kekaisaran Romawi awal.
statement.en: The Temple of Saturn in the Roman Forum housed the state treasury and archives (aerarium) of the Roman Republic and early Roman Empire.

claims.quote: According to Varro, Saturn's name was derived from satus, meaning  "sowing".

statement.id: Menurut Varro, nama Saturnus diturunkan dari satus, 'penaburan'.
statement.en: According to Varro, Saturn's name derives from satus, meaning 'sowing'.

claims.quote: Perhaps a more probable etymology connects the name with the Etruscan god Satre and placenames such as Satria, an ancient town of Latium, and Saturae palus, a marsh also in Latium.

statement.id: Etimologi yang mungkin lebih masuk akal menghubungkan nama itu dengan dewa Etruria Satre dan nama tempat seperti Satria, kota kuno di Latium, dan Saturae palus, rawa di Latium.
statement.en: A perhaps more probable etymology links the name with the Etruscan god Satre and place names such as Satria, an ancient town of Latium, and Saturae palus, a marsh in Latium.

claims.quote: Saturn for his part got his name because he was "sated" with years

statement.id: Menurut satu tafsiran, Saturnus mendapat namanya karena ia 'kenyang' oleh tahun-tahun.
statement.en: One interpretation holds that Saturn got his name because he was 'sated' with years.

claims.quote: Saturn himself, however, was represented as veiled (involutus), as for example in a wall painting from Pompeii that shows him holding a sickle and covered with a white veil.

statement.id: Saturnus sendiri digambarkan berkerudung (involutus), misalnya pada lukisan dinding dari Pompeii yang menunjukkannya memegang sabit dan berselubung kerudung putih.
statement.en: Saturn himself was represented as veiled (involutus), for example in a wall painting from Pompeii showing him holding a sickle and covered with a white veil.

claims.quote: In Roman and Etruscan reckoning Saturn is a wielder of lightning; no other agricultural god (in the sense of specialized human activity) is one.

statement.id: Dalam perhitungan Romawi dan Etruria, Saturnus adalah pemegang petir; tidak ada dewa pertanian lain yang demikian.
statement.en: In Roman and Etruscan reckoning Saturn is a wielder of lightning; no other agricultural god is one.

claims.quote: The identification with Ba'al Hammon later gave rise to the African Saturn, a cult that enjoyed great popularity until the 4th century.

statement.id: Identifikasi dengan Ba'al Hammon kemudian melahirkan 'Saturnus Afrika', sebuah kultus yang sangat populer sampai abad ke-4.
statement.en: The identification with Ba'al Hammon later gave rise to the African Saturn, a cult that enjoyed great popularity until the 4th century.

claims.quote: The figure of Saturn, kept during the year with its legs bound in wool, was released from its bindings for the period of the festival.

statement.id: Arca Saturnus, yang sepanjang tahun kakinya diikat wol, dilepaskan dari ikatannya selama perayaan.
statement.en: The figure of Saturn, kept bound in wool during the year, was released from its bindings for the festival.

claims.quote: At the same time, there was a tradition that Saturn had been an immigrant god, received by Janus after he was usurped by his son Jupiter and expelled from Greece.

statement.id: Ada pula tradisi bahwa Saturnus adalah dewa pendatang yang diterima Janus setelah ia digulingkan putranya, Jupiter, dan diusir dari Yunani.
statement.en: There was also a tradition that Saturn was an immigrant god received by Janus after he was usurped by his son Jupiter and expelled from Greece.

claims.quote: In the myth Saturn was the original and autochthonous ruler of the Capitolium, which had thus been called the Mons Saturnius in older times and on which once stood the town of Saturnia.

claims.quote: But Saturn also had a less benevolent aspect, as indicated by the blood shed in his honor during gladiatorial munera.

text.id: Catatan tertulis legenda Tibet sejak abad ke-12; laporan Barat sejak 1832
text.en: Written Tibetan legend since the twelfth century; Western reports since 1832

short_description.id: Yeti adalah makhluk mirip kera atau manusia berbulu dalam cerita Himalaya dan Tibet, digambarkan dengan rupa beragam; sampel yang diuji sebagai Yeti berkaitan dengan beruang setempat.
short_description.en: The yeti is a hairy ape- or human-like creature in Himalayan and Tibetan lore, depicted in varied ways; tested purported yeti samples matched local bears.

long_description.id: Catatan tertulis legenda Tibet tentang Yeti telah ada sejak abad ke-12. Yeti dikatakan menghuni pegunungan Himalaya, dan sebagian kisah menggambarkannya mirip kera, berjalan dengan dua kaki, dan berbulu cokelat kemerahan; sumber lain menyebut bulunya cokelat, abu-abu, atau putih. Tradisi Tibet mengenal bentuk yang lebih besar yang berjalan dengan empat kaki dan memangsa ternak, serta tiga jenis bernama nyalmo, chuti, dan rang shim bombo. Dalam kisah, Yeti dikaitkan dengan hutan alpin di bawah garis salju dan dapat terdengar bersiul pada malam hari.
long_description.en: Written Tibetan yeti lore dates back to the twelfth century. The yeti is said to inhabit the Himalayan mountain range, and some stories describe a reddish-brown-haired, ape-like biped, while other sources give brown, grey or white hair. Tibetan tradition also knows a larger four-legged livestock predator, and three named varieties: the nyalmo, chuti and rang shim bombo. The creature is associated in stories with alpine forest below the snow line and nocturnal whistling.

long_description.id: Menurut H. Siiger, yeti merupakan bagian dari kepercayaan pra-Buddhis beberapa bangsa Himalaya, dan penganut Bön dahulu percaya darah "Mi rgod" atau "manusia liar" berguna dalam upacara tertentu. Dalam Buddhisme Tibet, yeti dianggap hewan bukan manusia yang kadang dapat mengikuti Dharma; beberapa kisah menjadikannya pembantu atau murid tokoh agama, dan gambarnya diarak sebagai pelindung dari roh jahat. Kisah Buddhis Tibet menggambarkan yeti sebagai sosok yang baik maupun jahat, dan melihatnya sering dianggap pertanda buruk.
long_description.en: According to H. Siiger, the yeti was part of the pre-Buddhist beliefs of several Himalayan peoples, and followers of Bön once believed the blood of the "Mi rgod" or "wild man" was used in certain ceremonies. In Tibetan Buddhism the yeti is considered a nonhuman animal that can sometimes follow Dharma; some stories make it a helper or disciple of religious figures, and its images are paraded as guardians against evil spirits. Tibetan Buddhist stories portray yetis as both kind and malevolent, and seeing one is often considered a bad omen.

long_description.id: Pelaporan Barat tercatat sejak 1832, ketika pemandu B. H. Hodgson di Nepal utara melihat makhluk tinggi berbulu gelap yang ia simpulkan sebagai orangutan. Nama "abominable snowman" diciptakan pada 1921 dan lahir dari salah terjemah kata "metoh". Minat Barat memuncak pada 1950-an setelah pendaki Everest melaporkan jejak, dan Pemerintah Nepal mengeluarkan aturan bagi ekspedisi pencarian. Gambaran populer berbulu putih tidak tercatat dalam cerita rakyat sebelum abad ke-20.
long_description.en: Western reports date from 1832, when guides of B. H. Hodgson in northern Nepal spotted a tall dark-haired creature that he concluded was an orangutan. The name "abominable snowman" was coined in 1921 and arose from a mistranslation of the word "metoh". Western interest peaked in the 1950s after Everest climbers reported footprints, and the government of Nepal issued regulations for expeditions. The familiar white-furred image lacks folkloric support before the twentieth century.

long_description.id: Sebagian peneliti mengaitkan yeti dengan beruang setempat. Analisis DNA mitokondria sampel yang diklaim sebagai yeti mendukung identifikasinya sebagai beruang lokal, dan Reinhold Messner menyatakan pada 1986 bahwa yeti adalah beruang cokelat Himalaya. Para folklorist menelusuri asalnya ke cerita rakyat Sherpa dan fauna yang salah dikenali. Para peneliti menyebut identitas sosok mirip manusia dalam kisah itu masih menjadi teka-teki.
long_description.en: Some researchers associate the yeti with local bears. Mitochondrial DNA analysis of purported yeti samples supported identifying them as local bears, and Reinhold Messner claimed in 1986 that the yeti is the Himalayan brown bear. Folklorists trace its origin to Sherpa folklore and misidentified fauna. The researchers noted that the identity of the humanoid figures in the wider lore remains uncertain.

cultural_context.id: Tradisi Tibet mengarak gambar yeti dan kadang memuliakannya sebagai pelindung dari roh jahat; namun karena yeti dapat menegakkan Dharma, bertemu dengannya sering dianggap pertanda buruk.
cultural_context.en: Tibetan tradition parades images of yetis and sometimes venerates them as protectors against evil spirits; yet since yetis may enforce Dharma, encountering one is often taken as a bad omen.

statement.en: Tibetan lore describes three main varieties of yeti: the black-furred nyalmo, the largest and fiercest (about fifteen feet tall); the chuti (about eight feet tall) living at 8,000-10,000 ft; and the reddish-brown rang shim bombo, only 3-5 ft tall.

claims.quote: The name abominable snowman was coined in 1921, the year Lieutenant-Colonel Charles Howard-Bury led the 1921 British Mount Everest reconnaissance expedition

statement.id: Nama "abominable snowman" diciptakan pada 1921, tahun Letnan Kolonel Charles Howard-Bury memimpin ekspedisi pengintaian Gunung Everest Inggris.
statement.en: The name "abominable snowman" was coined in 1921, the year Lieutenant-Colonel Charles Howard-Bury led the British Mount Everest reconnaissance expedition.

claims.quote: The use of "abominable snowman" began when Henry Newman, a longtime contributor to The Statesman in Calcutta, writing under the pen name "Kim", interviewed the porters of the "Everest Reconnaissance Expedition" on their return to Darjeeling. Newman mistranslated the word "Metoh" as "filthy"

statement.id: Istilah "abominable snowman" bermula ketika Henry Newman mewawancarai para porter ekspedisi sepulang ke Darjeeling dan salah menerjemahkan kata "metoh" sebagai "kotor".
statement.en: The term "abominable snowman" began when Henry Newman interviewed the expedition's porters on their return to Darjeeling and mistranslated the word "metoh" as "filthy".

claims.quote: "Metoh" translates as "man-bear" and "kang-mi" translates as "snowman".

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, "metoh" berarti "manusia-beruang" dan "kang-mi" berarti "manusia salju".
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, "metoh" translates as "man-bear" and "kang-mi" as "snowman".

claims.quote: According to H. Siiger, the Yeti was a part of the pre-Buddhist beliefs of several Himalayan peoples.

statement.id: Menurut H. Siiger, yeti merupakan bagian dari kepercayaan pra-Buddhis beberapa bangsa Himalaya.
statement.en: According to H. Siiger, the yeti was part of the pre-Buddhist beliefs of several Himalayan peoples.

claims.quote: followers of the Bön religion once believed the blood of the "Mi rgod" or "wild man" had use in certain spiritual ceremonies. The being was depicted as an ape-like creature who carries a large stone as a weapon and makes a whistling swoosh sound.

statement.id: Penganut agama Bön dahulu percaya darah "Mi rgod" atau "manusia liar" berguna dalam upacara spiritual tertentu; makhluk itu digambarkan mirip kera, membawa batu besar sebagai senjata, dan menimbulkan suara desiran seperti bersiul.
statement.en: Followers of the Bön religion once believed the blood of the "Mi rgod" or "wild man" was used in certain spiritual ceremonies; the being was depicted as ape-like, carrying a large stone as a weapon and making a whistling swoosh.

claims.quote: Yeti was adopted into Tibetan Buddhism, where it is considered a nonhuman animal (tiragyoni) that is nonetheless human enough to sometimes be able to follow Dharma. Several stories feature yetis becoming helpers and disciples to religious figures.

statement.id: Yeti diserap ke dalam Buddhisme Tibet sebagai hewan bukan manusia yang cukup mirip manusia untuk kadang dapat mengikuti Dharma; beberapa kisah menampilkan yeti menjadi pembantu dan murid tokoh agama.
statement.en: The yeti was adopted into Tibetan Buddhism as a nonhuman animal human enough to sometimes follow Dharma; several stories feature yetis as helpers and disciples to religious figures.

claims.quote: In Tibet, images of Yetis are paraded and occasionally worshipped as guardians against evil spirits.

statement.id: Di Tibet, gambar yeti diarak dan kadang dipuja sebagai pelindung dari roh jahat.
statement.en: In Tibet, images of yetis are paraded and occasionally worshipped as guardians against evil spirits.

claims.quote: because Yetis sometimes act as enforcers of Dharma, hearing or seeing one is often considered a bad omen, for which the witness must accumulate merit.

statement.id: Karena yeti kadang bertindak sebagai penegak Dharma, mendengar atau melihatnya sering dianggap pertanda buruk, sehingga saksinya harus mengumpulkan pahala.
statement.en: Because yetis sometimes act as enforcers of Dharma, hearing or seeing one is often considered a bad omen for which the witness must accumulate merit.

claims.quote: In 1832, James Prinsep's Journal of the Asiatic Society of Bengal published trekker B. H. Hodgson's account of his experiences in northern Nepal. His local guides spotted a tall bipedal creature covered with long dark hair, which seemed to flee in fear. Hodgson concluded it was an orangutan.

statement.id: Pada 1832, jurnal Asiatic Society of Bengal menerbitkan catatan B. H. Hodgson tentang Nepal utara: pemandunya melihat makhluk tinggi berkaki dua berbulu panjang gelap yang tampak melarikan diri, yang menurut Hodgson adalah orangutan.
statement.en: In 1832 the Journal of the Asiatic Society of Bengal published B. H. Hodgson's account of northern Nepal: his guides spotted a tall bipedal creature with long dark hair that seemed to flee, which Hodgson concluded was an orangutan.

claims.quote: While attempting to scale Mount Everest in 1951, Eric Shipton took photographs of a number of large prints in the snow, at about 6,000 m (20,000 ft) above sea level.

statement.id: Pada 1951, saat mencoba mendaki Everest, Eric Shipton memotret sejumlah jejak besar di salju pada ketinggian sekitar 6.000 m.
statement.en: In 1951, while attempting to scale Mount Everest, Eric Shipton photographed a number of large prints in the snow at about 6,000 m.

claims.quote: In 1953, Sir Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay reported seeing large footprints while scaling Mount Everest. Hillary would later discount Yeti reports as unreliable.

statement.id: Pada 1953, Sir Edmund Hillary dan Tenzing Norgay melaporkan melihat jejak besar saat mendaki Everest; Hillary kemudian menganggap laporan yeti tidak dapat diandalkan.
statement.en: In 1953, Sir Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay reported seeing large footprints while scaling Everest; Hillary later discounted yeti reports as unreliable.

claims.quote: In 1986, South Tyrolean mountaineer Reinhold Messner claimed in his autobiography My Quest for the Yeti that the Yeti is actually the endangered Himalayan brown bear

statement.id: Pada 1986, pendaki Reinhold Messner menyatakan dalam otobiografinya My Quest for the Yeti bahwa yeti sebenarnya adalah beruang cokelat Himalaya yang terancam punah.
statement.en: In 1986, mountaineer Reinhold Messner claimed in his autobiography My Quest for the Yeti that the yeti is actually the endangered Himalayan brown bear.

claims.quote: The misidentification of Himalayan wildlife has been proposed as an explanation for some Yeti sightings, including the chu-teh, a langur monkey living at lower altitudes; the Tibetan blue bear; or the Himalayan brown bear or dzu-teh, also known as the Himalayan red bear.

statement.id: Kekeliruan mengenali satwa Himalaya diajukan sebagai penjelasan sebagian penampakan yeti, termasuk chu-teh (monyet langur dataran rendah), beruang biru Tibet, atau beruang cokelat Himalaya (dzu-teh).
statement.en: Misidentification of Himalayan wildlife has been proposed to explain some sightings, including the chu-teh (a lower-altitude langur monkey), the Tibetan blue bear, or the Himalayan brown bear (dzu-teh).

claims.quote: the Yeti is the mysterious humanoid creature reported by Western sources as early as 1832 as living in the Himalayan Mountains. It became well known following several expeditions to the area in the 1950s.

statement.id: Yeti adalah makhluk mirip manusia yang misterius, dilaporkan sumber Barat sejak 1832 hidup di pegunungan Himalaya, dan menjadi terkenal setelah beberapa ekspedisi pada 1950-an.
statement.en: The yeti is the mysterious humanoid creature reported by Western sources as early as 1832 as living in the Himalayas, and it became well known following several expeditions in the 1950s.

claims.quote: In 1960 Sir Edmund Hillary, who conquered Everest, called further attention to the Yeti in his attempts to debunk them.

statement.id: Pada 1960, Sir Edmund Hillary, penakluk Everest, makin menarik perhatian pada yeti lewat upayanya membantah keberadaannya.
statement.en: In 1960 Sir Edmund Hillary, who conquered Everest, called further attention to the yeti through his attempts to debunk them.

claims.quote: The Soviet Ministry of Culture established a group of "cryptozoologists" to locate the Yeti, according to a report of January 9, 1988, by TASS, the Soviet press agency.

statement.id: Menurut laporan TASS tanggal 9 Januari 1988, Kementerian Kebudayaan Soviet membentuk kelompok "kriptozoolog" untuk mencari yeti.
statement.en: According to a TASS report of January 9, 1988, the Soviet Ministry of Culture established a group of "cryptozoologists" to locate the yeti.

claims.quote: The term is recorded in English from the 1930s, and comes from Tibetan yeh-teh 'little manlike animal'.
claims.locator: Oxford Dictionary of Phrase and Fable

statement.id: Istilah ini tercatat dalam bahasa Inggris sejak 1930-an dan berasal dari bahasa Tibet yeh-teh, "hewan kecil mirip manusia".
statement.en: The term is recorded in English from the 1930s and comes from Tibetan yeh-teh, "little manlike animal".

claims.quote: native Sherpa (Tibetan) name of the Abominable Snowman, a subhuman animal supposed to leave tracks in the snow of the Himalayas.
claims.locator: Concise Oxford Dictionary of English Etymology

statement.id: Yeti adalah nama asli Sherpa (Tibet) bagi Abominable Snowman, hewan di bawah manusia yang konon meninggalkan jejak di salju Himalaya.
statement.en: Yeti is the native Sherpa (Tibetan) name of the Abominable Snowman, a subhuman animal supposed to leave tracks in the snow of the Himalayas.

claims.quote: a large hairy creature resembling a human or bear, said to live in the highest part of the Himalayas; it is informally known as the abominable snowman
claims.locator: Oxford Dictionary of Phrase and Fable

statement.id: Kamus Oxford menggambarkan yeti sebagai makhluk besar berbulu yang menyerupai manusia atau beruang, dikatakan hidup di bagian tertinggi Himalaya.
statement.en: The Oxford dictionary describes the yeti as a large hairy creature resembling a human or bear, said to live in the highest part of the Himalayas.

claims.quote: Bun manchi - Nepali for "jungle man" that is used outside Sherpa communities where Yeti is the common name.

statement.id: "Bun manchi" adalah bahasa Nepal untuk "manusia hutan", dipakai di luar komunitas Sherpa tempat "yeti" adalah nama umum.
statement.en: "Bun manchi" is Nepali for "jungle man", used outside Sherpa communities where "yeti" is the common name.

claims.quote: Local legend holds that "anyone who sees one dies or is killed".

statement.id: Legenda setempat menyebut bahwa "siapa pun yang melihatnya mati atau dibunuh".
statement.en: Local legend holds that "anyone who sees one dies or is killed".

claims.quote: Pranavananda states that the words "ti", "te" and "teh" are derived from the spoken word 'tre' (spelled "dred"), Tibetan for bear

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Pranavananda menyatakan bahwa kata "ti", "te", dan "teh" berasal dari kata lisan "tre" (ditulis "dred"), kata Tibet untuk beruang.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, Pranavananda states that the words "ti", "te" and "teh" derive from the spoken word "tre" (spelled "dred"), Tibetan for bear.

summary.id: Analisis DNA mitokondria mendukung bahwa sampel yang diklaim sebagai yeti berasal dari beruang setempat; Messner menyatakan yeti adalah beruang cokelat Himalaya.
summary.en: Mitochondrial DNA analysis supports purported yeti samples being local bears; Messner claimed the yeti is the Himalayan brown bear.

summary.id: Hodgson menyimpulkan makhluk yang dilihat pemandunya adalah orangutan.
summary.en: Hodgson concluded the creature his guides spotted was an orangutan.

summary.id: Para peneliti mengakui identitas sosok mirip manusia dalam folklor masih menjadi teka-teki.
summary.en: The researchers acknowledge the identity of the humanoid figures in folklore is still surrounded by mystery.

summary.id: Cokelat kemerahan (sebagian kisah) dan hitam (nyalmo).
summary.en: Reddish-brown (some accounts) and black (the nyalmo).

summary.id: Wikipedia: cokelat, abu-abu, atau putih; PBS: versi berbulu putih tidak didukung folklor sebelum abad ke-20.
summary.en: Wikipedia: brown, grey or white; PBS: the white-furred version lacks folklore support before the twentieth century.

summary.id: Kisah Buddhis Tibet menampilkan yeti baik maupun jahat dan sebagai pembantu tokoh agama.
summary.en: Tibetan Buddhist stories feature yetis as both kind and malevolent, and as helpers of religious figures.

summary.id: Menurut legenda setempat, siapa pun yang melihatnya mati atau dibunuh; melihatnya juga sering dianggap pertanda buruk.
summary.en: According to local legend, anyone who sees one dies or is killed; seeing one is also often considered a bad omen.

summary.id: Kamus Oxford: dari yeh-teh Tibet, "hewan kecil mirip manusia".
summary.en: Oxford dictionary: from Tibetan yeh-teh, "little manlike animal".

summary.id: Wikipedia mengutip Pranavananda: "ti", "te", dan "teh" berasal dari kata lisan "tre" (dred), kata Tibet untuk beruang.
summary.en: Wikipedia cites Pranavananda: "ti", "te" and "teh" derive from the spoken word "tre" (dred), Tibetan for bear.
