note.en: Neptune foiled Juno's storm at sea, irritated at her interference in his domain.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa satu dewi bisa memiliki begitu banyak julukan dengan peran berbeda?
learning_questions.en: Why could one goddess have so many epithets with different roles?

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana pengaruh Yunani mengubah cara orang membayangkan Juno?
learning_questions.en: How did Greek influence change the way Juno was imagined?

claims.quote: Juno was the Roman goddess who protected the nation as a whole but also kept special watch over all aspects of women's lives.

statement.id: Juno adalah dewi Romawi pelindung negara dan kehidupan perempuan.
statement.en: Juno is a Roman goddess who protected the nation and women's lives.

claims.quote: She is often thought of as the Roman version of the Greek goddess of love and marriage, Hera.

statement.id: Juno kerap dipadankan dengan Hera dari Yunani.
statement.en: Juno is often equated with the Greek goddess Hera.

claims.quote: Juno was the wife and sister of Jupiter, the chief Roman god, and the two of them were worshipped along with the goddess Minerva on the Quirinal in Rome.

statement.id: Juno adalah istri sekaligus saudari Jupiter dan dipuja bersama Minerva.
statement.en: Juno was Jupiter's wife and sister and was worshipped with Minerva.

claims.quote: Some ancient authors claim Juno arrived in Rome in the fifth century BCE from the Etruscan town of Veii north of Rome as Juno Regina, a word meaning queen.

statement.id: Sumber kuno mengaitkan Juno Regina dengan Veii; Regina berarti ratu.
statement.en: Ancient authors associate Juno Regina with Veii; Regina means queen.

claims.quote: She was Juno Lucina, a word meaning light, the goddess of childbirth.

statement.id: Sebagai Juno Lucina, ia adalah dewi kelahiran.
statement.en: As Juno Lucina she was a goddess of childbirth.

claims.quote: She was the protector of legally married women.

statement.id: Juno melindungi perempuan yang telah menikah secara sah.
statement.en: Juno protected legally married women.

claims.quote: Like many gods or goddesses, she had her own festival, on March 1, called the Matronalia, which was a time of renewal and the awakening of nature.

statement.id: Matronalia, perayaan Juno, jatuh pada 1 Maret.
statement.en: Juno's Matronalia festival fell on March 1.

claims.quote: The presence of the peacock identifies the figure as Juno, Jupiter’s wife and the goddess of marriage

statement.id: Merak menjadi penanda Juno dalam karya seni.
statement.en: A peacock identifies Juno in art.

claims.quote: Juno loved the city of Carthage and, according to prophecy, her beloved city would one day be destroyed by Rome, a city to be founded by Aeneas.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Aeneas, Juno mencintai Carthage yang diramalkan akan dihancurkan Roma.
statement.en: In Aeneas's story, Juno loved Carthage, which was prophesied to be destroyed by Rome.

claims.quote: Among other identities, she was known to many as Juno Sospita, the chief deity of Lanuvium, a city located in Latium southeast of Rome. She was the protector of one in confinement, often pictured wearing a goatskin, carrying a spear and shield.

statement.id: Sebagai Juno Sospita, ia dewa utama Lanuvium, kota di Latium tenggara Roma; ia pelindung orang yang terkurung dan sering digambarkan mengenakan kulit kambing serta membawa tombak dan perisai.
statement.en: As Juno Sospita she was the chief deity of Lanuvium, a city in Latium southeast of Rome; she protected those in confinement and was often pictured wearing a goatskin and carrying a spear and shield.

claims.quote: Lastly, she was Juno Moneta, the moon goddess, who was a personage unique to Rome.

statement.id: Sebagai Juno Moneta, ia disebut dewi bulan, tokoh yang khas Roma.
statement.en: As Juno Moneta she is called the moon goddess, a personage unique to Rome.

claims.quote: her primary temple or citadel was built on the Arx, the northern part of Capitoline Hill. This sanctuary was located next to the Roman mint; the word money comes from her name, Moneta.

statement.id: Kuil utamanya dibangun di Arx, bagian utara Bukit Capitoline, di samping percetakan uang Roma; kata "money" berasal dari namanya, Moneta.
statement.en: Her primary temple was built on the Arx, the northern part of Capitoline Hill, next to the Roman mint; the word "money" comes from her name, Moneta.

claims.quote: Her sacred geese were kept on the Capitoline and a legend is told that they gave warning to the Roman military under the leadership of Manlius Capitolinus when the invading Gauls tried to take Rome in 390 BCE.

statement.id: Angsa-angsa sucinya dipelihara di Capitoline; menurut legenda, angsa itu memperingatkan pasukan Romawi di bawah Manlius Capitolinus ketika bangsa Galia menyerbu Roma pada 390 SM.
statement.en: Her sacred geese were kept on the Capitoline, and legend says they warned the Roman military under Manlius Capitolinus when the invading Gauls tried to take Rome in 390 BCE.

claims.quote: No offering could be made at her temple unless all knots were untied because the presence of a belt could hinder the delivery of the woman's child.

statement.id: Di kuil Juno Lucina tidak boleh ada persembahan kecuali semua simpul dilepas, karena sabuk dapat menghambat kelahiran anak.
statement.en: At her temple no offering could be made unless all knots were untied, because a belt could hinder the delivery of the woman's child.

claims.quote: It was a day when husbands were expected to give presents to their wives. The day was supposedly in celebration of the birthday of her son Mars, the god of war.

statement.id: Pada hari Matronalia suami diharapkan memberi hadiah kepada istri; hari itu konon merayakan ulang tahun putranya, Mars, dewa perang.
statement.en: On the Matronalia husbands were expected to give presents to their wives; the day was supposedly celebrating the birthday of her son Mars, the god of war.

claims.quote: According to legend, there was a connection between Juno and the city of Carthage where she was identified with the goddess Tanit.

statement.id: Menurut legenda, Juno punya hubungan dengan kota Carthage, tempat ia diidentifikasi dengan dewi Tanit.
statement.en: According to legend Juno was connected with the city of Carthage, where she was identified with the goddess Tanit.

claims.quote: Next, a storm at sea, created by Juno, failed when Neptune interfered, not for the love of Aeneas, but owing to his irritation at Juno's interference in his domain.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Aeneas, badai di laut yang diciptakan Juno gagal ketika Neptunus ikut campur, bukan karena sayang kepada Aeneas melainkan karena kesal pada campur tangan Juno di wilayahnya.
statement.en: In the Aeneas story a storm at sea created by Juno failed when Neptune interfered, not out of love for Aeneas but out of irritation at Juno meddling in his domain.

claims.quote: Although her exact origin is unknown, Juno was one of the oldest of the Roman deities, that is, one of the three original gods — Jupiter, Juno, and Minerva — honored on the Quirinal (later on the Capitoline).

statement.id: Asal-usulnya tidak diketahui pasti, tetapi Juno termasuk dewa Romawi tertua, salah satu dari tiga dewa awal (Jupiter, Juno, Minerva) yang dihormati di Quirinal, kemudian di Capitoline.
statement.en: Her exact origin is unknown, but Juno was one of the oldest Roman deities, one of the three original gods (Jupiter, Juno, Minerva) honored on the Quirinal and later on the Capitoline.

claims.quote: By whatever name she was known, Juno presided over every aspect of a woman's life.

statement.id: Dengan nama apa pun ia dikenal, Juno menaungi setiap segi kehidupan perempuan.
statement.en: Under whatever name she was known, Juno presided over every aspect of a woman's life.

claims.quote: JUNO, the chief Roman and Latin goddess, and the special object of worship by women at all the critical moments of life.

statement.id: Juno adalah dewi utama Romawi dan Latin, dan objek pemujaan khusus perempuan pada semua saat penting dalam hidup.
statement.en: Juno was the chief Roman and Latin goddess and the special object of worship by women at all the critical moments of life.

claims.quote: That Juno was especially a deity of women, and represents in a sense the female principle of life, is seen in the fact that as every man had his genius, so every woman had her Juno

statement.id: Juno terutama dewi perempuan dan dalam arti tertentu mewakili prinsip kehidupan perempuan, terlihat dari kenyataan bahwa setiap laki-laki punya genius-nya dan setiap perempuan punya Juno-nya.
statement.en: Juno was especially a deity of women and in a sense represents the female principle of life, as shown by the fact that every man had his genius and every woman her Juno.

claims.quote: As Caprotina she was especially worshipped by female slaves on the 7th of July (Nonae Caprotinae); as Sospita she was invoked all over Latium as the saviour of women in their perils, and later as the saviour of the state

statement.id: Sebagai Caprotina ia dipuja terutama oleh budak perempuan pada 7 Juli (Nonae Caprotinae); sebagai Sospita ia dipanggil di seluruh Latium sebagai penyelamat perempuan dalam bahaya, dan kemudian sebagai penyelamat negara.
statement.en: As Caprotina she was worshipped especially by female slaves on 7 July (Nonae Caprotinae); as Sospita she was invoked all over Latium as the saviour of women in peril and later of the state.

claims.quote: But in historical times she was associated with Jupiter in the great temple on the Capitoline hill as Juno Regina, the queen of all Junones or queen of heaven

statement.id: Pada masa sejarah ia dipuja bersama Jupiter di kuil besar di Bukit Capitoline sebagai Juno Regina, ratu semua Junones atau ratu langit.
statement.en: In historical times she was associated with Jupiter in the great temple on the Capitoline hill as Juno Regina, queen of all the Junones or queen of heaven.

claims.quote: The etymology of the name is not certain, but it is usually taken as a shortened form of Jovino, answering to Jovis, from a root div, shining.

statement.id: Asal kata namanya tidak pasti, tetapi biasanya dianggap bentuk singkat dari Jovino, padanan Jovis, dari akar div yang berarti bersinar.
statement.en: The etymology of the name is uncertain, but it is usually taken as a shortened form of Jovino, answering to Jovis, from a root div meaning shining.

claims.quote: It was under Greek influence again that she became the wife of Jupiter, the mother of Mars; the true Roman had no such personal interest in his deities as to invent family relations for them.

statement.id: Menurut sumber ini, pengaruh Yunani juga yang menjadikannya istri Jupiter dan ibu Mars; orang Romawi sejati tidak berminat mengarang hubungan keluarga bagi dewa-dewanya.
statement.en: According to this source it was again under Greek influence that she became Jupiter's wife and Mars's mother; the true Roman had no such personal interest in his deities as to invent family relations for them.

claims.quote: Under Greek influence Juno was early identified with the Greek Hera, with whose cult and characteristics she has much in common; thus the Juno with whom we are familiar in Latin literature is not the true Roman deity.

statement.id: Karena pengaruh Yunani, Juno sejak dini diidentifikasi dengan Hera yang banyak kesamaan kultus dan wataknya; maka Juno dalam sastra Latin bukanlah dewi Romawi yang sejati.
statement.en: Under Greek influence Juno was early identified with Hera, with whom she shares much cult and character; thus the Juno familiar from Latin literature is not the true Roman deity.

claims.quote: A daughter of Saturn and Ops, she is the sister and wife of Jupiter and the mother of Mars, Vulcan, Bellona, Lucina and Juventas. Like Hera, her sacred animal is the peafowl. Her Etruscan counterpart is Uni, and she was said to also watch over the women of Rome.

statement.id: Juno putri Saturnus dan Ops, saudari sekaligus istri Jupiter, serta ibu Mars, Vulcanus, Bellona, Lucina, dan Juventas; seperti Hera, hewan sucinya adalah merak, dan padanannya dalam tradisi Etruria adalah Uni.
statement.en: Juno is the daughter of Saturn and Ops, sister and wife of Jupiter, and mother of Mars, Vulcan, Bellona, Lucina and Juventas; like Hera her sacred animal is the peafowl, and her Etruscan counterpart is Uni.

claims.quote: Juno's own warlike aspect among the Romans is apparent in her attire. She was often shown armed and wearing a goatskin cloak.

statement.id: Sisi perangnya di kalangan Romawi tampak pada pakaiannya; ia sering digambarkan bersenjata dan mengenakan jubah kulit kambing.
statement.en: Her warlike aspect among the Romans is apparent in her attire; she was often shown armed and wearing a goatskin cloak.

claims.quote: As the patron goddess of Rome and the Roman Empire, Juno was called Regina ("Queen") and is a member of the Capitoline Triad (Juno Capitolina), centered on the Capitoline Hill in Rome, which also includes Jupiter and Minerva, goddess of wisdom.

statement.id: Sebagai dewi pelindung Roma dan Kekaisaran Romawi, Juno disebut Regina ("Ratu") dan menjadi anggota Triad Capitoline (Juno Capitolina) bersama Jupiter dan Minerva, dewi kebijaksanaan.
statement.en: As patron goddess of Rome and the Roman Empire Juno was called Regina ("Queen") and belongs to the Capitoline Triad (Juno Capitolina) with Jupiter and Minerva, goddess of wisdom.

claims.quote: The view that she was also a Moon goddess though is no longer accepted by scholars, as such a role belongs to Diana Lucifera

statement.id: Pandangan bahwa ia juga dewi bulan tidak lagi diterima para sarjana, karena peran itu milik Diana Lucifera.
statement.en: The view that she was also a moon goddess is no longer accepted by scholars, as that role belongs to Diana Lucifera.

claims.quote: a derivation was later proposed from iuven- (as in Latin iuvenis, "youth"), through a syncopated form iūn- (as in iūnix, "heifer", and iūnior, "younger").

statement.id: Diusulkan pula turunan dari iuven- (seperti iuvenis, "pemuda") lewat bentuk iūn-.
statement.en: A derivation was later proposed from iuven- (as in iuvenis, "youth") through a syncopated form iūn-.

claims.quote: Juno is certainly the divine protectress of the community, who shows both a sovereign and a fertility character, often associated with a military one.

statement.id: Juno jelas pelindung ilahi komunitas yang memperlihatkan watak berdaulat dan kesuburan, sering dikaitkan dengan watak militer.
statement.en: Juno is certainly the divine protectress of the community, showing both a sovereign and a fertility character, often associated with a military one.

claims.quote: The epithet Lucina is particularly revealing since it reflects two interrelated aspects of the function of Juno: cyclical renewal of time in the waning and waxing of the moon and protection of delivery and birth

statement.id: Julukan Lucina mencerminkan dua segi fungsi Juno: pembaruan waktu yang berputar menurut bulan surut dan purnama, serta perlindungan persalinan dan kelahiran.
statement.en: The epithet Lucina reflects two interrelated aspects of Juno's function: the cyclical renewal of time in the waning and waxing moon, and protection of delivery and birth.

claims.quote: She is closely associated with Janus, the god of passages and beginnings, who is often named Iunonius after her.

statement.id: Juno berkaitan erat dengan Janus, dewa gerbang dan permulaan, yang sering disebut Iunonius menurut namanya.
statement.en: Juno is closely associated with Janus, the god of passages and beginnings, who is often named Iunonius after her.

claims.quote: According to Virgil, there was little love between Aeneas, the story's Trojan hero, and the Roman goddess.

statement.id: Menurut Vergilius, hanya ada sedikit kasih antara Aeneas, pahlawan Troya dalam kisah itu, dan sang dewi.
statement.en: According to Virgil, there was little love between Aeneas, the Trojan hero of the story, and the goddess.

claims.quote: Although Virgil used Juno as the story's antagonist (he was, of course, Roman), the name of Hera could just as easily be substituted.

statement.id: Vergilius menjadikan Juno antagonis kisah itu, meski nama Hera bisa dengan mudah menggantikannya.
statement.en: Virgil used Juno as the story's antagonist, although the name of Hera could just as easily be substituted.

claims.quote: She received a temple on the Aventine Hill and served as a civic deity, the protector of the state.

statement.id: Ia mendapat kuil di Bukit Aventine dan berperan sebagai dewi kota, pelindung negara.
statement.en: She received a temple on the Aventine Hill and served as a civic deity, the protector of the state.

claims.quote: on the 1st of March, the old Roman New Year's day, the matrons met and made offerings at her temple in a grove on the Esquiline; hence the day was known as the Matronalia.

statement.id: Pada 1 Maret, hari tahun baru Romawi lama, para matron berkumpul dan mempersembahkan sesaji di kuilnya di sebuah hutan kecil di Esquiline; karena itu hari itu disebut Matronalia.
statement.en: On 1 March, the old Roman New Year's day, the matrons met and made offerings at her temple in a grove on the Esquiline, hence the name Matronalia.

claims.quote: Some authors claim the festival actually celebrated the anniversary of the end of the Roman-Sabine War and honored the role women played.

statement.id: Sebagian penulis menyatakan festival itu sebenarnya merayakan berakhirnya Perang Romawi-Sabin dan menghormati peran perempuan.
statement.en: Some authors claim the festival actually celebrated the anniversary of the end of the Roman-Sabine War and honored the role women played.

claims.quote: Juno was the wife and sister of Jupiter, the chief Roman god, and the two of them were worshipped along with the goddess Minerva on the Quirinal in Rome.

statement.id: Juno adalah istri dan saudari Jupiter; keduanya dipuja bersama Minerva di Quirinal, Roma.
statement.en: Juno was the wife and sister of Jupiter, and the two were worshipped along with Minerva on the Quirinal in Rome.

claims.quote: and under the same title she was enticed from Veii after its capture in 392 B.C., and settled in a temple on the Aventine.

statement.id: Dengan gelar yang sama ia dibujuk keluar dari Veii setelah kota itu direbut pada 392 SM dan ditempatkan di sebuah kuil di Aventine.
statement.en: Under the same title she was enticed from Veii after its capture in 392 B.C. and settled in a temple on the Aventine.

topic.en: Arrival of Juno Regina in Rome

summary.id: Sumber lain menyebut ia dibujuk keluar dari Veii setelah kota itu direbut pada 392 SM.
summary.en: Another source says she was enticed from Veii after its capture in 392 B.C.

short_description.id: Lakshmi adalah dewi Hindu yang dikaitkan dengan kekayaan, keberuntungan, kemudaan, dan kecantikan, serta istri Vishnu.
short_description.en: Lakshmi is a Hindu goddess associated with prosperity, luck, youth, and beauty, and the wife of Vishnu.

long_description.id: Lakshmi (juga ditulis Laksmi) adalah dewi kekayaan, keberuntungan, kemudaan, dan kecantikan dalam tradisi Hindu. Ia istri Vishnu, dan keduanya kerap dipuja bersama sebagai Lakshmi-Narayana. Ia juga disebut Lokamata ("ibu dunia") dan Lola ("berubah-ubah"), merujuk pada cara ia membagikan keberuntungan yang tampak tak menentu.
long_description.en: Lakshmi (also written Laksmi) is a goddess of Hindu tradition linked with wealth, good fortune, youth, and beauty. She is the wife of Vishnu, and the two are often worshipped together as Lakshmi-Narayana. She is also called Lokamata ("mother of the world") and Lola ("fickle"), referring to her seemingly haphazard dispensation of good fortune.

long_description.id: Dalam Mahabharata, Lakshmi lahir dari pengadukan samudra susu purba oleh para dewa dan iblis. Setelah campur tangan Brahma dan Vishnu, ia muncul berbalut putih dan memancarkan kemudaan serta kecantikan, sehingga kadang disebut Ksirabdhitanaya. Ia segera berlindung kepada Vishnu dan dikatakan bersemayam di dada sang dewa, dari situ lahir nama Shrinivas. Sri, yang berarti kemakmuran, adalah salah satu nama Lakshmi.
long_description.en: In the Mahabharata, Lakshmi is born when the gods and demons stir the primeval milky ocean. After Brahma and Vishnu intervene, she appears clothed in white and radiating youth and beauty, which is why she is sometimes called Ksirabdhitanaya. She immediately places herself under Vishnu's protection and is said to dwell on his chest, which gave rise to the name Shrinivas. Sri, meaning prosperity, is one of Lakshmi's names.

long_description.id: Lakshmi lekat dengan bunga teratai dan kadang disebut Dewi Teratai; dalam wujud ini ia juga termasuk dalam jajaran dewa-dewi Buddha. Ia tidak memiliki kuil atas namanya, tetapi terutama dipuja pada Diwali, Festival Cahaya tahunan. Dalam seni ia digambarkan berdiri atau duduk di atas teratai besar, memegang kendi air dan teratai, memberi isyarat restu, dan menghujani pengikutnya dengan koin. Pada pahatan hias candi ia kerap tampil bersama Vishnu.
long_description.en: Lakshmi is closely tied to the lotus flower and is sometimes simply called the Lotus Goddess, a guise in which she also belongs to the Buddhist pantheon. No temples have been built in her name, yet she is especially honored at Diwali, the annual Festival of Lights. In art she is shown standing or seated on a large lotus, holding a water pot and a lotus, making a gesture of blessing and showering her followers with coins. In temple decorative sculpture she often appears beside Vishnu.

long_description.id: Vishnu Purana mengisahkan Sri muncul dari air, duduk di atas teratai mekar dan membawa teratai, lalu dimandikan oleh seekor gajah penjuru mata angin. Teks yang sama juga menyebut Sri sebagai putri Bhrigu dan Khyati yang kemudian keluar lagi dari lautan ketika diaduk. Di dalamnya Sri membantu Vishnu pada setiap penjelmaannya, antara lain menjadi Sita dan Rukhmini, dan kemiskinan dikatakan tidak menimpa mereka yang melantunkan himne untuknya.
long_description.en: The Vishnu Purana tells how Sri arose from the water seated on a blown lotus and carrying a lotus, and was bathed by an elephant of one of the cardinal points. The same text also names Sri as born to Bhrigu and Khyati, and then coming out of the Ocean again when it was churned. In it Sri assists Vishnu in each of his incarnations, becoming Sita and Rukhmini among others, and poverty is said never to beset those who chant the hymn to her.

long_description.id: Seni dari berbagai tempat menampilkan Lakshmi dengan ciri berbeda: di Kamboja berupa arca tunggal yang berdiri dengan tiara dan kuncup teratai, dalam seni Cham ia selalu duduk dan dapat memegang kerang, dan dalam seni Jawa ia memegang butir padi. Kamalamika, "wanita teratai [merah]", adalah wujud tantra Lakshmi, dan sebagai Gaja-Lakshmi ia paling sering digambarkan dimandikan gajah surgawi.
long_description.en: Art from different places shows Lakshmi with different features: in Cambodian art a single standing statue with a tiara and lotus bud, in Cham art always seated and able to hold a conch shell, and in Javanese art holding a grain of rice. Kamalamika, the "[red] lotus lady", is a tantric form of Lakshmi, and as Gaja-Lakshmi she is most often depicted being bathed by heavenly elephants.

cultural_context.id: Menurut keterangan koleksi museum, Lakshmi adalah perwujudan Hindu bagi segala hal yang membawa pertanda baik dan kelimpahan.
cultural_context.en: According to the museum catalog entry, Lakshmi is Hinduism's embodiment of all that is auspicious and abundant.

summary.en: In the Mahabharata, the gods and demons stir the primeval milky ocean. After Brahma and Vishnu intervene, Lakshmi appears clothed in white and then places herself under Vishnu's protection. In the Vishnu Purana she arises seated on a lotus and is bathed by an elephant.

summary.en: Lakshmi, fed up with her husband, takes refuge with the royal household of King Akasha Raja in southern India, calling herself Padmavati. A distraught Vishnu, in the guise of Shrinivas, finds her; Brahma and Shiva had conspired for them to meet, and the two marry again in a lavish ceremony.

claims.quote: Lakshmi (or Laksmi) is the Hindu goddess of wealth, good fortune, youth, and beauty.

statement.id: Lakshmi adalah dewi kekayaan, keberuntungan, kemudaan, dan kecantikan dalam Hindu.
statement.en: Lakshmi is the Hindu goddess of wealth, good fortune, youth, and beauty.

claims.quote: She is the wife of the great god Vishnu and the pair is often worshipped in tandem as Lakshmi-Narayana.

statement.id: Lakshmi adalah istri Vishnu dan keduanya kerap dipuja bersama.
statement.en: Lakshmi is Vishnu's wife and they are often worshipped together.

claims.quote: In the Mahabharata, Lakshmi was born from the stirring of the primeval milky ocean by the gods and demons.

statement.id: Dalam Mahabharata, Lakshmi lahir dari pengadukan samudra susu oleh dewa dan iblis.
statement.en: In the Mahabharata, Lakshmi is born from the churning of the milky ocean.

claims.quote: The goddess is particularly associated with the lotus flower and is sometimes referred to simply as the Lotus Goddess.

statement.id: Lakshmi berkaitan dengan bunga teratai dan disebut Dewi Teratai.
statement.en: Lakshmi is associated with the lotus and called the Lotus Goddess.

claims.quote: The goddess has no temples built in her name but she is particularly worshipped in one of Hinduism's most evocative celebrations, the annual Diwali or 'Festival of Lights', held every October-November.

statement.id: Lakshmi tidak memiliki kuil yang dibangun atas namanya, tetapi terutama dipuja dalam perayaan tahunan Diwali (Festival Cahaya).
statement.en: Lakshmi has no temples built in her name but is particularly worshipped during the annual Diwali festival, the Festival of Lights.

claims.quote: The beautiful and benign goddess Kamalamika, the “[red] lotus lady,” is a tantric form of Lakshmi, Hinduism’s embodiment of all that is auspicious and abundant.

statement.id: Kamalamika adalah bentuk tantra Lakshmi.
statement.en: Kamalamika is a tantric form of Lakshmi.

claims.quote: As the goddess of wealth and prosperity, Lakshmi is most often depicted being lustrated by heavenly elephants where she is known as Gaja-Lakshmi.

statement.id: Sebagai Gaja-Lakshmi, ia kerap digambarkan dimandikan gajah surgawi.
statement.en: As Gaja-Lakshmi she is often shown being bathed by heavenly elephants.

claims.quote: Lakshmi may also be called Lokamata, 'mother of the world' and Lola, meaning fickle, in reference to her seemingly haphazard dispensation of good fortune.

statement.id: Lakshmi juga disebut Lokamata ('ibu dunia') dan Lola ('berubah-ubah'), merujuk pada caranya membagikan keberuntungan yang tampak tak menentu.
statement.en: Lakshmi may also be called Lokamata, 'mother of the world', and Lola, meaning fickle, referring to her seemingly haphazard dispensation of good fortune.

claims.quote: Following the intervention of Brahma and Vishnu, Lakshmi miraculously appeared from this sea of clarified butter clothed all in white and radiating youth and beauty.

statement.id: Setelah campur tangan Brahma dan Vishnu, Lakshmi muncul secara ajaib dari lautan mentega murni itu, berbalut putih dan memancarkan kemudaan serta kecantikan.
statement.en: After the intervention of Brahma and Vishnu, Lakshmi miraculously appeared from the sea of clarified butter, clothed in white and radiating youth and beauty.

claims.quote: For this reason, the goddess is sometimes called Ksirabdhitanaya, 'daughter of the sea of milk'.

statement.id: Karena kelahiran itu, sang dewi kadang disebut Ksirabdhitanaya, 'putri lautan susu'.
statement.en: Because of this birth, the goddess is sometimes called Ksirabdhitanaya, 'daughter of the sea of milk'.

claims.quote: Lakshmi immediately gave herself to Vishnu's protection and for this reason, she is said to dwell on Vishnu's chest giving rise to one of the god's alternative names, Shrinivas meaning 'the dwelling place of Sri'.

statement.id: Lakshmi segera menyerahkan diri pada perlindungan Vishnu, sehingga dikatakan bersemayam di dada Vishnu; hal ini melahirkan salah satu nama lain sang dewa, Shrinivas, 'tempat tinggal Sri'.
statement.en: Lakshmi immediately placed herself under Vishnu's protection and is said to dwell on his chest, which gave rise to one of the god's other names, Shrinivas, 'the dwelling place of Sri'.

claims.quote: Sri (Shri) means prosperity and is another of Lakshmi's many names.

statement.id: Sri (Shri) berarti kemakmuran dan merupakan salah satu dari banyak nama Lakshmi.
statement.en: Sri (Shri) means prosperity and is another of Lakshmi's many names.

claims.quote: According to the Harivamsa Lakshmi is the mother of Kama, the god of love and so provides an interesting parallel to the Greek goddess Aphrodite and her son Eros, the former also born from a foaming sea.

statement.id: Menurut Harivamsa, Lakshmi adalah ibu Kama, dewa cinta; sumbernya membandingkannya dengan dewi Yunani Aphrodite dan putranya Eros.
statement.en: According to the Harivamsa, Lakshmi is the mother of Kama, the god of love; the source compares this with the Greek goddess Aphrodite and her son Eros.

claims.quote: In one myth Lakshmi got a little fed up with her husband and went to live with the royal family of King Akasha Raja in southern India. There, now calling herself Padmavati, she was eventually found by a distraught Vishnu, himself in the guise of Shrinivas.

statement.id: Dalam satu mitos, Lakshmi jengkel pada suaminya lalu tinggal bersama keluarga kerajaan Raja Akasha Raja di India selatan dan menyebut dirinya Padmavati; Vishnu yang cemas, dalam rupa Shrinivas, akhirnya menemukannya.
statement.en: In one myth, Lakshmi grew fed up with her husband and went to live with the royal family of King Akasha Raja in southern India, calling herself Padmavati; a distraught Vishnu, in the guise of Shrinivas, eventually found her.

claims.quote: Brahma and Shiva had actually conspired for the two to meet and they, of course, fell in love and married in a lavish ceremony (again) which is still commemorated today in the town of Tirupati in southern India.

statement.id: Brahma dan Shiva bersekongkol agar keduanya bertemu; mereka jatuh cinta dan menikah lagi dalam upacara megah yang hingga kini diperingati di kota Tirupati, India selatan.
statement.en: Brahma and Shiva conspired for the two to meet; they fell in love and married again in a lavish ceremony that is still commemorated today in the town of Tirupati in southern India.

claims.quote: In art, Lakshmi is often represented either standing or seated on a large lotus flower and holding a water pot and single lotus flower in her hands, always either blue or pink. With her other two hands she typically gives a sign of blessing and showers coins on her loyal followers.
claims.locator: How is Lakshmi Represented in Art?

statement.id: Dalam seni, Lakshmi sering digambarkan berdiri atau duduk di atas bunga teratai besar sambil memegang kendi air dan setangkai teratai; dengan dua tangan lainnya ia biasanya memberi isyarat restu dan menghujani pengikut setianya dengan koin.
statement.en: In art, Lakshmi is often shown standing or seated on a large lotus, holding a water pot and a single lotus flower; with her other two hands she typically makes a gesture of blessing and showers coins on her loyal followers.

claims.quote: In Cambodian art, Lakshmi is more typically portrayed as a single-figure statue, standing, wearing a tiara and holding a lotus bud. In Cham art the goddess is always seated and besides the lotus bud can also hold a conch shell.
claims.locator: How is Lakshmi Represented in Art?

statement.id: Dalam seni Kamboja, Lakshmi lazimnya berupa arca tunggal yang berdiri, bermahkota kecil, dan memegang kuncup teratai; dalam seni Cham ia selalu duduk dan selain kuncup teratai dapat memegang kerang.
statement.en: In Cambodian art Lakshmi is typically a single standing statue wearing a tiara and holding a lotus bud; in Cham art she is always seated and, besides the lotus bud, can also hold a conch shell.

claims.quote: Finally, in Javanese art Lakshmi holds a grain of rice as there she is regarded as the goddess of this important food.
claims.locator: How is Lakshmi Represented in Art?

statement.id: Dalam seni Jawa, Lakshmi memegang butir padi karena di sana ia dipandang sebagai dewi pangan penting itu.
statement.en: In Javanese art Lakshmi holds a grain of rice, because there she is regarded as the goddess of this important food.

claims.quote: In this guise, she is a member of the Buddhist pantheon too.

statement.id: Dalam wujud Dewi Teratai ini, ia juga termasuk dalam jajaran dewa-dewi Buddha.
statement.en: In this guise as the Lotus Goddess, she is a member of the Buddhist pantheon too.

claims.quote: Lakshmi regularly appears alongside her husband Vishnu in temple decorative sculpture, for example, massaging his feet with lotus flowers or riding his gigantic man-bird vehicle Garuda.
claims.locator: How is Lakshmi Represented in Art?

statement.id: Lakshmi kerap tampil di samping suaminya, Vishnu, pada pahatan hias candi, misalnya memijat kaki Vishnu dengan bunga teratai atau menunggang Garuda, kendaraan manusia-burung raksasa milik Vishnu.
statement.en: Lakshmi regularly appears beside her husband Vishnu in temple decorative sculpture, for example massaging his feet with lotus flowers or riding his gigantic man-bird vehicle Garuda.

claims.quote: then from the water arose the exalted Sri, endowed with excellent grace,—seated on a blown lotus, and carrying also a lotus in her hand.

statement.id: Dalam Vishnu Purana, dari air muncul Sri yang agung, berparas anggun, duduk di atas teratai mekar dan membawa setangkai teratai di tangannya.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, the exalted Sri arises from the water, endowed with excellent grace, seated on a blown lotus and carrying a lotus in her hand.

claims.quote: And an elephant of one of the cardinal points, taking water out of the golden vessels, bathed that goddess—the mighty Mistress of all the worlds.

statement.id: Dalam Vishnu Purana, seekor gajah penjuru mata angin mengambil air dari bejana emas dan memandikan sang dewi, Nyonya agung seluruh dunia.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, an elephant of one of the cardinal points takes water from golden vessels and bathes the goddess, the mighty Mistress of all the worlds.

claims.quote: In the days of yore, Sri was begot of Bhrigu on Khyati. And she again came out of the Ocean when it was churned by the celestials.

statement.id: Dalam Vishnu Purana, Sri dahulu dilahirkan oleh Bhrigu dan Khyati, lalu ia muncul lagi dari lautan ketika diaduk oleh para dewa.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, Sri was formerly born to Bhrigu and Khyati, and she came out of the Ocean again when it was churned by the celestials.

claims.quote: When Hari assumed the form of a dwarf, she took birth as a lotus, and when He descended on earth as Parasurāma, she appeared as the Earth. At time of the incarnation of Rāma, she became Sitā, and when He was born as Krishna, she became Rukhmini.

statement.id: Dalam Vishnu Purana, ketika Hari menjelma sebagai kurcaci, Sri lahir sebagai teratai; ketika Parasurama turun ke bumi, ia tampil sebagai Bumi; pada penjelmaan Rama ia menjadi Sita, dan ketika Krishna lahir ia menjadi Rukhmini.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, when Hari took the form of a dwarf she was born as a lotus; when he descended as Parasurama she appeared as the Earth; at the incarnation of Rama she became Sita, and when he was born as Krishna she became Rukhmini.

claims.quote: This eulogy of Lakshmi, the source of all wealth, came out of the mouth of the lord of celestials. Poverty can never infest those persons on earth, who chant this hymn every day

statement.id: Dalam Vishnu Purana, pujian untuk Lakshmi, sumber segala kekayaan, diucapkan oleh penguasa para dewa; kemiskinan tidak akan menimpa orang di bumi yang melantunkan himne ini setiap hari.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, this eulogy of Lakshmi, the source of all wealth, came from the mouth of the lord of the celestials; poverty can never beset those on earth who chant this hymn every day.

summary.id: Lakshmi lahir dari pengadukan samudra susu oleh para dewa dan iblis (Mahabharata).
summary.en: Lakshmi is born from the churning of the milky ocean by the gods and demons (the Mahabharata).

summary.id: Vishnu Purana menyebut Sri dahulu dilahirkan oleh Bhrigu dan Khyati, dan juga keluar lagi dari lautan ketika diaduk.
summary.en: The Vishnu Purana says Sri was formerly born to Bhrigu and Khyati, and also came out of the Ocean again when it was churned.

short_description.id: Neptune adalah dewa laut Romawi yang berpadanan dengan Poseidon Yunani. Ia bersaudara dengan Jupiter dan Pluto, memegang trisula yang dapat memunculkan gelombang dan badai, dan semula terkait air tawar.
short_description.en: Neptune is the Roman god of the sea and counterpart of Greek Poseidon. A brother of Jupiter and Pluto, he wields a trident that can raise waves and storms, and he was originally linked to fresh water.

long_description.id: Neptune adalah dewa laut Romawi dan padanan Poseidon dari Yunani. Menurut salah satu sumber, ia mulanya dewa air tawar yang sejak awal sejarah Romawi dikaitkan dengan Poseidon, dan sumber lain menyebut ia kemungkinan dikaitkan dengan mata air tawar sebelum laut. Ia putra Saturnus dan Ops, suami Salacia, dan dalam tradisi bernuansa Yunani saudara Jupiter dan Pluto. Ketiganya mengundi wilayah kekuasaan: Neptune mendapat laut, Pluto dunia bawah, dan Jupiter langit.
long_description.en: Neptune is the Roman god of the sea and the counterpart of Greek Poseidon. One source says he was originally a god of fresh water who was associated with Poseidon early in Roman history, and another says he was likely linked to freshwater springs before the sea. He is the son of Saturn and Ops, husband of Salacia, and in the Greek-inspired tradition a brother of Jupiter and Pluto. The three drew lots for their realms: Neptune received the sea, Pluto the underworld, and Jupiter the sky.

long_description.id: Neptune dikisahkan berdiam di istana emas di dasar laut dan menjadi penguasa bagi dewa-dewi laut, nimfa, dan segala makhluk laut. Sebuah arca perunggu Romawi di The Met semula menampilkannya bersandar pada trisula. Ia menunggang lumba-lumba atau kerang raksasa bersama istrinya, ditarik paus dan kuda laut serta dikawal putranya Triton. Trisulanya disebut mampu memecah batu, mengangkat gelombang, membentuk perairan baru, dan memanggil badai. Sumber lama berbeda soal perangainya: Ovidius menyebut wajahnya selalu muram, sedangkan Virgil menyebutnya berperangai lembut.
long_description.en: Neptune is said to dwell in a golden palace on the sea floor, ruling the gods, nymphs and creatures of the deep. A Roman bronze statue at The Met originally showed him leaning on a trident. He rode a dolphin or giant sea shell beside his wife, pulled by whales and seahorses and escorted by their son Triton. His trident is said to smash rocks, raise waves, create new bodies of water and call forth storms. Ancient authors differ on his demeanour: Ovid says he always looked sullen, while Virgil says he had a mild demeanour.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah-kisahnya Neptune menciptakan kuda pertama dengan trisulanya dalam perlombaan dengan Minerva, mengirim banjir ke Troya setelah Raja Laomedon menolak membayar, dan mengirim banteng indah kepada Minos lalu menghukumnya. Dalam Aeneid ia menenangkan laut untuk membantu Aeneas. Ia juga pernah bersekongkol menggulingkan Jupiter dan dihukum dengan diasingkan ke laut.
long_description.en: In his stories Neptune creates the first horse with his trident in a contest with Minerva, sends a flood against Troy after King Laomedon refuses payment, and sends Minos a splendid bull and then punishes him. In the Aeneid he calms the sea to help Aeneas. He also once conspired to overthrow Jupiter and was punished by banishment to the sea.

long_description.id: Dalam ibadah Romawi, Neptune hanya memiliki satu kuil di Roma, dekat Circus Flaminius, dan merupakan satu dari empat dewa yang layak diberi kurban banteng. Neptunalia diadakan setiap 23 Juli saat puncak musim panas; orang Romawi berkurban agar kekurangan air mereda. Ia juga disembah sebagai Neptunus equestris, dewa kuda dan pelindung balap kuda. Nama Etruria untuknya adalah Nethuns.
long_description.en: In Roman worship, Neptune had only one temple in Rome, near the Circus Flaminius, and was one of four gods considered fit recipients of a bull sacrifice. The Neptunalia was held every 23 July at the height of summer, when Romans offered sacrifices to ease water shortages. He was also worshipped as Neptunus equestris, god of horses and patron of horse-racing. His Etruscan name is Nethuns.

claims.quote: Neptune is the Roman god of the sea and the Roman equivalent of the Greek god Poseidon.

statement.id: Neptune adalah dewa laut Romawi yang berpadanan dengan Poseidon Yunani.

statement.id: Neptune semula dewa air tawar sebelum dikaitkan dengan Poseidon.

text.id: Tercatat dalam Theogony Hesiod (sekitar 700 SM)
text.en: Recorded in Hesiod's Theogony (around 700 BCE)

short_description.id: Uranus atau Ouranos adalah dewa purba dan personifikasi langit dalam mitologi Yunani. Menurut Hesiod ia ayah para Titan, Cyclopes, dan Hecatoncheires, hingga dikebiri oleh putranya Cronus.
short_description.en: Uranus or Ouranos is the primordial god and personification of the sky in Greek mythology. In Hesiod he fathers the Titans, Cyclopes and Hecatoncheires until his son Cronus castrates him.

long_description.id: Uranus adalah personifikasi langit dan salah satu dewa purba Yunani. Orang Yunani membayangkan langit sebagai kubah perunggu bertabur bintang, dan Ouranos adalah langit itu sendiri, sebagaimana Gaia adalah bumi. Menurut Hesiod, Gaia melahirkan Langit sebagai pasangan yang setara dengannya, lalu berbaring bersamanya dan melahirkan dua belas Titan, tiga Cyclopes, dan tiga Hecatoncheires.
long_description.en: Uranus personifies the sky and counts among the earliest Greek gods. The Greeks imagined the sky as a starry brass dome, and Ouranos was the literal sky just as Gaia was the earth. According to Hesiod, Gaia bore Heaven as an equal for herself, then lay with him and bore the twelve Titans, three Cyclopes and three Hecatoncheires.

long_description.id: Menurut satu sumber, Uranus dan Gaia memiliki dua belas putra dan enam putri. Uranus membenci anak-anaknya dan menyembunyikan mereka di dalam bumi. Gaia membuat sabit dari batu api dan menyuruh Cronus menyergap ayahnya; saat Uranus datang berbaring bersama Gaia, Cronus mengebirinya. Dari darah yang jatuh lahirlah Erinyes, para Raksasa, dan Meliae, sedangkan dari buih laut tempat bagian tubuhnya jatuh lahirlah Aphrodite. Dengan kesal Uranus menjuluki putra-putranya Titan dan berkata bahwa pembalasan akan datang.
long_description.en: One source says Uranus and Gaia had twelve sons and six daughters. Uranus hated his children and hid them within the earth. Gaia made a flint sickle and had Cronus ambush his father; when Uranus came to lie with Gaia, Cronus castrated him. From the blood that fell were born the Erinyes, the Giants and the Meliae, and from the sea foam around the severed parts Aphrodite was born. In reproach Uranus called his sons Titans and said that vengeance would come afterwards.

long_description.id: Setelah dikebiri, peran Uranus surut ke latar belakang, tetapi ia dan Gaia memperingatkan Cronus bahwa ia akan digulingkan putranya, membantu Rhea melarikan diri ke Kreta tempat Zeus lahir, dan memperingatkan Zeus tentang putra Metis. Uranus bersama Gaia dan Styx sering menjadi saksi sumpah para dewa. Menurut salah satu sumber, ia menubuatkan kejatuhan para Titan, yang digenapi ketika Zeus menggulingkan mereka.
long_description.en: After his castration Uranus recedes into the background, yet he and Gaia warned Cronus that his son would overthrow him, helped Rhea flee to Crete where Zeus was born, and warned Zeus about Metis's son. Gaia, Styx and Uranus were frequently called on to witness divine oaths. According to one source, he prophesied the fall of the Titans, fulfilled when Zeus deposed them.

long_description.id: Tidak ada kultus yang ditujukan langsung kepada Uranus yang bertahan hingga masa klasik, dan ia tidak termasuk tema lazim keramik lukis Yunani, meski ada satu himne Orfik untuknya. Ia diidentifikasi pada relief Gigantomachy di Altar Pergamon, berjenggot dan bersayap, serta pada masa Romawi sering digambarkan sebagai Aion. Menurut salah satu sumber, ia tidak muncul dalam seni Yunani awal, dan penggambaran Mesir tentang dewi langit Nut menunjukkan bagaimana ia dibayangkan. Caelus adalah padanan Uranus dalam tradisi Romawi.
long_description.en: No cult addressed directly to Uranus survived into classical times and he is not among the usual themes of Greek painted pottery, though one Orphic hymn is dedicated to him. He is identified on the Gigantomachy frieze of the Pergamon Altar, bearded and winged, and in the Roman era he was often depicted as Aion. According to one source, he does not appear in early Greek art, and Egyptian depictions of the sky-goddess Nut show how he was imagined. His Roman counterpart is Caelus.

literal_meaning.id: Kebanyakan ahli bahasa menelusuri nama ini ke bentuk Proto-Yunani *Worsanós dengan akar Indo-Eropa "menghujani"; ini menjadikan Ouranos "pembuat hujan" atau "penguasa hujan".
literal_meaning.en: Most linguists trace the name to a Proto-Greek form *Worsanós from an Indo-European root meaning "to rain", making Ouranos the "rain-maker" or "lord of rain".

who.id: Uranus adalah personifikasi langit dan dewa purba Yunani.
who.en: Uranus is the personification of the sky and a Greek primordial god.

origin.id: Ia berasal dari mitologi Yunani; menurut Hesiod ia lahir dari Gaia.
origin.en: He comes from Greek mythology; according to Hesiod he was born of Gaia.

role.id: Ia menjadi ayah para Titan, Cyclopes, dan Hecatoncheires bersama Gaia dan disingkirkan oleh Cronus.
role.en: He fathered the Titans, Cyclopes and Hecatoncheires with Gaia and was deposed by Cronus.

famous_for.id: Ia terkenal karena dikebiri oleh putranya Cronus dengan sabit.
famous_for.en: He is famous for being castrated with a sickle by his son Cronus.

did_you_know.id: Astronom Johann Elert Bode mengusulkan nama Uranus untuk planet yang ditemukan pada 1781 untuk menghormati dewa purba ini.
did_you_know.en: The astronomer Johann Elert Bode proposed the name Uranus, in honour of this primordial deity, for the planet discovered in 1781.

description.id: Ouranos menubuatkan kejatuhan para Titan, dan bersama Gaia memperingatkan Cronus serta Zeus bahwa putra mereka akan menggulingkan mereka.
description.en: Ouranos prophesied the fall of the Titans, and with Gaia warned Cronus and Zeus that their sons would overthrow them.

description.id: Dalam Orfisme, Nyx melahirkan Gaia dan Uranus bersama Phanes.
description.en: In Orphism, Nyx bore Gaia and Uranus with Phanes.

tradition.id: Versi yang dianggap versi Fenisia, dicatat oleh Herennius Philo
tradition.en: Version considered Phoenician, recorded by Herennius Philo

description.id: Epigeios, yang kemudian dinamai Uranus, menggantikan ayahnya sebagai raja dan menikahi saudarinya Ge; Cronus mengebirinya pada tahun ke-32 pemerintahannya.
description.en: Epigeios, later named Uranus, replaced his father as king and married his sister Ge; Cronus emasculated him in the 32nd year of his reign.

tradition.en: The epic War of the Titans

description.id: Menurut penulis War of the Titans, Ouranos adalah putra Aither.
description.en: According to the writer of the War of the Titans, Ouranos was the son of Aither.

role.id: Korban
role.en: Victim

summary.id: Uranus menyembunyikan anak-anaknya di dalam bumi; Gaia memberi Cronus sabit, dan Cronus mengebiri Uranus saat ia datang berbaring bersama Gaia.
summary.en: Uranus hid his children within the earth; Gaia gave Cronus a sickle, and Cronus castrated Uranus as he came to lie with Gaia.

role.id: Ayah dari makhluk-makhluk yang lahir dari darahnya
role.en: Father of beings born from his blood

summary.id: Darah Uranus melahirkan Erinyes, Raksasa, dan Meliae; buih di sekitar bagian tubuhnya di laut melahirkan Aphrodite.
summary.en: Uranus's blood bore the Erinyes, Giants and Meliae; the foam around his severed parts in the sea bore Aphrodite.

role.id: Pemberi peringatan
role.en: Giver of warnings

summary.id: Uranus dan Gaia memperingatkan Cronus akan digulingkan putranya, membantu Rhea ke Kreta, dan memberi tahu Zeus soal putra Metis.
summary.en: Uranus and Gaia warned Cronus he would be overthrown by his son, helped Rhea reach Crete, and told Zeus about Metis's son.

title.en: Witness to the oaths of the gods

role.id: Saksi
role.en: Witness

summary.id: Uranus bersama Gaia dan Styx sering menjadi saksi sumpah para dewa.
summary.en: Gaia, Styx and Uranus were frequently called on to witness divine oaths.

description.id: Wilayah neraka yang jaraknya dari Bumi sama dengan jarak Bumi dari langit (Uranus) menurut Theogony.
description.en: The infernal region, as far below Earth as the heavens (Uranus) are above it, according to the Theogony.

description.id: Tempat Aphrodite lahir dari buih di sekitar bagian tubuh Uranus dalam versi ini.
description.en: Where Aphrodite was born from the foam around Uranus's severed parts in this account.

description.id: Tempat Zeus lahir setelah Uranus dan Gaia membantu Rhea melarikan diri ke sana.
description.en: Where Zeus was born after Uranus and Gaia helped Rhea flee there.

description.id: Hesiod (700 SM) menulis bahwa Gaia melahirkan Uranus bersama Pontus dan Ourea.
description.en: Hesiod (700 BCE) writes that Gaia bore Uranus along with Pontus and Ourea.

description.id: Orfisme, yang menyebut Uranus lahir dari Nyx dan Phanes, menonjol pada abad ke-6 SM.
description.en: Orphism, which has Uranus born of Nyx and Phanes, rose to prominence in the 6th century BCE.

note.id: Pasangan Uranus dalam kisah Hesiod; juga ibunya.
note.en: Uranus's consort in Hesiod's story; also his mother.

note.id: Putra yang menggulingkan Uranus.
note.en: Son who overthrew Uranus.

note.id: Dua belas anak Uranus dan Gaia.
note.en: Twelve children of Uranus and Gaia.

note.id: Tiga Cyclopes, anak Uranus dan Gaia.
note.en: Three Cyclopes, children of Uranus and Gaia.

note.id: Tiga Hecatoncheires, anak Uranus dan Gaia.
note.en: Three Hecatoncheires, children of Uranus and Gaia.

note.id: Lahir dari darah Uranus yang jatuh ke Gaia.
note.en: Born from Uranus's blood falling on Gaia.

note.id: Dalam versi ini lahir dari buih di sekitar bagian tubuh Uranus.
note.en: In this account born from the foam around Uranus's severed parts.

note.id: Padanan Romawi Uranus.
note.en: Roman counterpart of Uranus.

note.id: Raja Langit dalam mitos Het yang dapat dikenali sebagai Uranus menurut World History Encyclopedia.
note.en: King of Heaven in the Hittite myth, who can be identified as Uranus according to World History Encyclopedia.

note.id: Uranus memperingatkannya tentang putra Metis; Zeus kemudian menggulingkan para Titan.
note.en: Uranus warned him about Metis's son; Zeus later deposed the Titans.

note.id: Ayah Ouranos menurut penulis War of the Titans.
note.en: Father of Ouranos according to the writer of the War of the Titans.

note.id: Ibu Uranus dalam Orfisme.
note.en: Mother of Uranus in Orphism.

sources.author: Hesiod (trans. Hugh G. Evelyn-White)

sources.title: Hesiod, Theogony, lines 139-172 (trans. Hugh G. Evelyn-White)
sources.author: Hesiod (trans. Hugh G. Evelyn-White)

claims.quote: Uranus (also spelt Ouranos) is the personification of heaven and the sky in Greek mythology.

statement.id: Uranus atau Ouranos adalah personifikasi langit dalam mitologi Yunani.
statement.en: Uranus or Ouranos is the personification of the sky in Greek mythology.

claims.quote: OURANOS (Uranus) was the primordial god (protogenos) of the sky.

statement.id: Uranus digolongkan sebagai dewa purba langit.
statement.en: Uranus is a primordial sky god.

claims.quote: Gaia (Earth) gave birth to Uranus and chose him to be her equal.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Gaia melahirkan Uranus dan menjadikannya pasangannya.
statement.en: Gaia gave birth to Uranus and chose him as her equal.

claims.quote: She lay with him, resulting in the birth of the twelve Titans, the three Cyclopes and the three Hecatoncheires.

statement.id: Gaia dan Uranus melahirkan para Titan, Cyclopes, dan Hecatoncheires.
statement.en: Gaia and Uranus parented the Titans, Cyclopes, and Hecatoncheires.

claims.quote: Uranus hated his and Gaia's children and hid them deep beneath the earth so that they would stay out of his sight.

statement.id: Uranus menyembunyikan anak-anaknya di dalam bumi.
statement.en: Uranus hid his children within the earth.

claims.quote: Gaia made a sickle out of grey adamant, gave it to Cronus, and hid him in her bed chamber.

statement.id: Gaia memberikan sabit kepada Cronus untuk melawan Uranus.
statement.en: Gaia gave Cronus a sickle to confront Uranus.

claims.quote: Cronus took his chance and struck out with the sickle, castrating Uranus' genitals.

statement.id: Cronus mengebiri Uranus dengan sabit.
statement.en: Cronus castrated Uranus with the sickle.

claims.quote: As the blood fell, it impregnated Gaia, who gave birth to the Erinyes (the Furies), the Giants and the Meliae (tree nymphs).

statement.id: Darah Uranus yang jatuh ke Gaia melahirkan Erinyes, para raksasa, dan Meliae.
statement.en: Uranus's blood falling on Gaia led to the birth of Erinyes, Giants, and Meliae.

claims.quote: White foam surrounded it, and from it, the goddess Aphrodite was born in Cythera (Kythira).

statement.id: Dalam kisah itu, Aphrodite lahir dari buih di laut.
statement.en: In this account, Aphrodite was born from sea foam.

claims.quote: His Roman counterpart is Caelus.

statement.id: Caelus adalah padanan Romawi Uranus.
statement.en: Caelus is Uranus's Roman counterpart.

claims.quote: The Greeks imagined the sky as a solid dome of brass, decorated with stars, whose edges descended to rest upon the outermost limits of the flat earth. Ouranos was the literal sky, just as his consort Gaia (Gaea) was the earth.

statement.id: Orang Yunani membayangkan langit sebagai kubah perunggu padat bertabur bintang yang tepinya bertumpu pada batas terjauh bumi yang datar; Ouranos adalah langit itu sendiri, sebagaimana pasangannya Gaia adalah bumi.
statement.en: The Greeks imagined the sky as a solid brass dome decorated with stars, its edges resting on the outermost limits of the flat earth; Ouranos was the literal sky, as his consort Gaia was the earth.

claims.quote: Ouranos and Gaia had twelve sons and six daughters. He locked the eldest of these--the giant Kyklopes (Cyclopes) and Hekatonkheires (Hecatoncheires)--away inside the belly of Earth.

statement.id: Ouranos dan Gaia memiliki dua belas putra dan enam putri; ia mengurung anak tertua, para Kyklopes dan Hekatonkheires yang raksasa, di dalam perut Bumi.
statement.en: Ouranos and Gaia had twelve sons and six daughters; he locked the eldest, the giant Cyclopes and Hecatoncheires, away inside the belly of Earth.

claims.quote: Four of these positioned themselves at the corners of the world, ready to grasp their father as he descended to lie with Earth, while the fifth, Kronos (Cronus), took his place in the centre and there castrated Ouranos with an adamantine sickle.

statement.id: Menurut uraian ini, empat dari anak-anak itu berjaga di sudut dunia untuk menangkap ayah mereka, sementara Kronos di tengah mengebiri Ouranos dengan sabit adamantin.
statement.en: In this account four of the children took positions at the corners of the world to seize their father while Kronos, in the centre, castrated Ouranos with an adamantine sickle.

claims.quote: Ouranos prophesied the fall of the Titanes and the punishments they would suffer for their crimes--a prophecy brought to fruition by Zeus who deposed the five brothers and cast them into the pit of Tartaros.

statement.id: Ouranos menubuatkan kejatuhan para Titan dan hukuman atas kejahatan mereka; Zeus menggenapi nubuat itu dengan menggulingkan lima bersaudara dan melemparkan mereka ke jurang Tartaros.
statement.en: Ouranos prophesied the fall of the Titans and their punishment for their crimes, a prophecy fulfilled when Zeus deposed the five brothers and cast them into the pit of Tartaros.

claims.quote: Ouranos does not appear in early Greek art but Egyptian depictions of their sky-goddess Nut demonstrate how he was imagined--as a gigantic, star-spangled man with long arms and legs, resting on all fours

statement.id: Ouranos tidak muncul dalam seni Yunani awal, tetapi penggambaran Mesir tentang dewi langit Nut menunjukkan bagaimana ia dibayangkan: pria raksasa bertabur bintang berlengan dan berkaki panjang yang bertumpu pada keempat anggota badan.
statement.en: Ouranos does not appear in early Greek art, but Egyptian depictions of the sky-goddess Nut show how he was imagined: a gigantic, star-spangled man with long limbs, resting on all fours.

claims.quote: In the Roman era he was often depicted as Aion, god of eternal time, in the form of a man holding the zodiac-wheel, standing above the reclining Gaia (Earth).

statement.id: Pada masa Romawi ia sering digambarkan sebagai Aion, dewa waktu abadi, berwujud pria yang memegang roda zodiak dan berdiri di atas Gaia yang berbaring.
statement.en: In the Roman era he was often depicted as Aion, god of eternal time, as a man holding the zodiac-wheel and standing above the reclining Gaia.

claims.quote: According to the writer of the War of the Titans Ouranos (Uranus) was the son of Aither (Aether).
claims.locator: Classical literature quotes: cosmogony of Eumelus

statement.id: Menurut penulis War of the Titans, Ouranos adalah putra Aither.
statement.en: According to the writer of the War of the Titans, Ouranos was the son of Aither.

claims.quote: In Orphism, the world began with Chronos (Time). ... Phanes gave birth to Nyx (Night), then Nyx bore Gaia and Uranus with Phanes.
claims.locator: The Creation of the World According to Orphism

statement.id: Dalam Orfisme, Phanes melahirkan Nyx (Malam), lalu Nyx melahirkan Gaia dan Uranus bersama Phanes.
statement.en: In Orphism, Phanes gave birth to Nyx (Night), and then Nyx bore Gaia and Uranus with Phanes.

claims.quote: Although there is barely any surviving evidence of worship to Uranus, he does have an Orphic hymn dedicated to him.

statement.id: Meski nyaris tidak ada bukti ibadah kepada Uranus yang bertahan, ia memiliki satu himne Orfik yang dipersembahkan untuknya.
statement.en: Although there is barely any surviving evidence of worship of Uranus, one Orphic hymn is dedicated to him.

claims.quote: Uranus, along with Gaia and Styx, was often the witness to the oaths of the gods.
claims.locator: Witness to the Oaths of the Gods

statement.id: Uranus bersama Gaia dan Styx sering menjadi saksi sumpah para dewa.
statement.en: Uranus, along with Gaia and Styx, was often the witness to the oaths of the gods.

claims.quote: According to the Theogony, there is an equal distance between Tartarus (the infernal regions), Earth (Gaia), and the heavens (Uranus). Therefore, an anvil falling from Uranus would take nine days and nights to reach Gaia

statement.id: Menurut Theogony, jarak antara Tartarus, Bumi (Gaia), dan langit (Uranus) sama; sebuah landasan yang jatuh dari Uranus butuh sembilan hari sembilan malam untuk mencapai Gaia.
statement.en: According to the Theogony, Tartarus, Earth and the heavens are equally far apart; an anvil falling from Uranus would take nine days and nights to reach Gaia.

claims.quote: Uranus lost power to Cronus but warned him that he, too, would face being overthrown by his son.

statement.id: Uranus kehilangan kekuasaan kepada Cronus tetapi memperingatkannya bahwa ia pun akan digulingkan oleh putranya.
statement.en: Uranus lost power to Cronus but warned him that he too would be overthrown by his son.

claims.quote: A desperate Rhea approached Uranus and Gaia for help, and they helped her run away to Crete, where Zeus was born.

statement.id: Rhea yang putus asa meminta bantuan Uranus dan Gaia, dan mereka membantunya melarikan diri ke Kreta, tempat Zeus lahir.
statement.en: A desperate Rhea asked Uranus and Gaia for help, and they helped her flee to Crete, where Zeus was born.

claims.quote: After Zeus married his first wife, Metis, Uranus and Gaia informed him that Metis would have a daughter who was strong and wise like her father and a son who would overthrow his father to become king of the gods and men.

statement.id: Uranus dan Gaia memberi tahu Zeus bahwa Metis akan melahirkan seorang putri yang kuat dan bijak serta seorang putra yang akan menggulingkan ayahnya menjadi raja para dewa dan manusia.
statement.en: Uranus and Gaia told Zeus that Metis would have a strong, wise daughter and a son who would overthrow his father to become king of gods and men.

claims.quote: The myth closely follows the Uranus-Cronus-Zeus succession myth found in Hesiod's Theogony. Anu, the king of Heaven, can clearly be identified as Uranus.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, mitos itu sangat mirip dengan mitos suksesi Uranus-Cronus-Zeus dalam Theogony Hesiod, dan Anu, raja Langit, dapat jelas dikenali sebagai Uranus.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, the myth closely follows the Uranus-Cronus-Zeus succession myth in Hesiod's Theogony, and Anu, king of Heaven, can clearly be identified as Uranus.

claims.quote: During the 20th-century excavations in the village of Boĝazköy (Turkey), a set of tablets were discovered that recounted the Hittite story of the storm god Teššub's rise to power and the attempts to overthrow him.

statement.id: Tablet yang ditemukan dalam penggalian di desa Boĝazköy menceritakan kisah Het tentang kebangkitan dewa badai Teššub dan upaya menggulingkannya.
statement.en: Tablets found in excavations at the village of Boĝazköy recount the Hittite story of the storm god Teššub's rise to power and the attempts to overthrow him.

claims.quote: What is considered a Phoenician version of the succession myth is recorded by Herennius Philo (aka Philo of Byblos, l. 1st or 2nd century CE).

statement.id: Versi mitos suksesi yang dianggap versi Fenisia dicatat oleh Herennius Philo (Philo dari Byblos, abad ke-1 atau ke-2 M).
statement.en: What is considered a Phoenician version of the succession myth is recorded by Herennius Philo (Philo of Byblos, 1st or 2nd century CE).

claims.quote: Together they have a son named Epigeios, who would later be named Uranus, and a daughter called Ge (Gaia). After his father's death, Epigeios (Uranus) replaced him as king and married his sister, Ge.

statement.id: Dalam versi suksesi ini, Epigeios, yang kemudian dinamai Uranus, menggantikan ayahnya sebagai raja dan menikahi saudarinya, Ge (Gaia).
statement.en: In this succession version, Epigeios, later named Uranus, replaced his father as king and married his sister Ge (Gaia).

claims.quote: During the 32nd year of his reign, Cronus emasculated Uranus.

statement.id: Dalam versi itu, pada tahun ke-32 pemerintahannya Cronus mengebiri Uranus.
statement.en: In that version, Cronus emasculated Uranus in the 32nd year of his reign.

claims.quote: it was fellow astronomer Johann Elert Bode (1747-1826) who suggested that it be called Uranus in honour of the primordial deity

statement.id: Astronom Johann Elert Bode mengusulkan agar planet itu dinamai Uranus untuk menghormati dewa purba tersebut.
statement.en: The astronomer Johann Elert Bode suggested that the planet be called Uranus in honour of the primordial deity.

claims.quote: Uranus is the seventh planet from the Sun and the third largest of the planets. It was discovered in 1781 by the British-German astronomer William Herschel (1738-1822)

statement.id: Planet Uranus ditemukan pada 1781 oleh astronom Inggris-Jerman William Herschel.
statement.en: The planet Uranus was discovered in 1781 by the British-German astronomer William Herschel.

claims.quote: In his Theogony, Hesiod (700 BCE) writes that Gaia, the personification of Earth, gave birth to Uranus (Heaven), along with Pontus (the Sea) and Ourea (the Mountains).

statement.id: Dalam Theogony-nya, Hesiod (700 SM) menulis bahwa Gaia melahirkan Uranus (Langit) bersama Pontus (Laut) dan Ourea (Pegunungan).
statement.en: In his Theogony, Hesiod (700 BCE) writes that Gaia bore Uranus (Heaven) along with Pontus (the Sea) and Ourea (the Mountains).

claims.quote: Orphism was a religious movement that rose to prominence during the 6th century BCE.
claims.locator: The Creation of the World According to Orphism

statement.id: Orfisme adalah gerakan keagamaan yang menonjol pada abad ke-6 SM.
statement.en: Orphism was a religious movement that rose to prominence during the 6th century BCE.

claims.quote: And Earth first bore starry Heaven, equal to herself, to cover her on every side, and to be an ever-sure abiding-place for the blessed gods.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi pertama-tama melahirkan Langit berbintang, setara dengannya, untuk menutupinya di semua sisi dan menjadi tempat tinggal yang selalu aman bagi para dewa yang diberkati.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, Earth first bore starry Heaven, equal to herself, to cover her on every side and be an ever-sure abiding place for the blessed gods.

claims.quote: But afterwards she lay with Heaven and bore deep-swirling Oceanus, Coeus and Crius and Hyperion and Iapetus, [135] Theia and Rhea, Themis and Mnemosyne and gold-crowned Phoebe and lovely Tethys.

statement.id: Hesiod menulis bahwa Gaia kemudian berbaring bersama Langit dan melahirkan Oceanus, Coeus, Crius, Hyperion, Iapetus, Theia, Rhea, Themis, Mnemosyne, Phoebe, dan Tethys.
statement.en: Hesiod writes that Earth afterwards lay with Heaven and bore Oceanus, Coeus, Crius, Hyperion, Iapetus, Theia, Rhea, Themis, Mnemosyne, Phoebe and Tethys.

claims.quote: For of all the children that were born of Earth and Heaven, [155] these were the most terrible, and they were hated by their own father from the first. And he used to hide them all away in a secret place of Earth so soon as each was born, and would not suffer them to come up into the light: and Heaven rejoiced in his evil doing.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, anak-anak terdahsyat Bumi dan Langit dibenci ayah mereka sejak awal; setiap kali seorang lahir ia menyembunyikannya di tempat rahasia di Bumi dan melarangnya naik ke terang, dan Langit bersukacita atas perbuatan jahatnya.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, the most terrible children of Earth and Heaven were hated by their father from the first; as each was born he hid it in a secret place of Earth and would not let it come up into the light, and Heaven rejoiced in his evil doing.

claims.quote: Forthwith she made the element of grey flint and shaped a great sickle, and told her plan to her dear sons.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi membentuk sabit besar dari unsur batu api kelabu dan menyampaikan rencananya kepada putra-putranya.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, Earth made the element of grey flint into a great sickle and told her plan to her sons.

claims.quote: And Heaven came, bringing on night and longing for love, and he lay about Earth spreading himself full upon her. ... Then the son from his ambush stretched forth his left hand and in his right took the great long sickle [180] with jagged teeth, and swiftly lopped off his own father's members and cast them away to fall behind him.

statement.id: Dalam Hesiod, Langit datang membawa malam dan merindukan cinta lalu merebahkan diri di atas Bumi; putranya dari penyergapan memotong anggota tubuh ayahnya dengan sabit panjang bergerigi dan melemparkannya ke belakang.
statement.en: In Hesiod, Heaven came bringing night and longing for love and spread himself upon Earth; his son from his ambush lopped off his father's members with the long jagged sickle and cast them behind him.

claims.quote: for all the bloody drops that gushed forth Earth received, and as the seasons moved round [185] she bore the strong Erinyes and the great Giants with gleaming armour, holding long spears in their hands and the Nymphs whom they call Meliae

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi menerima semua tetes darah itu dan seiring musim ia melahirkan Erinyes yang kuat, para Raksasa berbaju zirah gemerlap bertombak panjang, dan Nimfa yang disebut Meliae.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, Earth received all the bloody drops and as the seasons turned bore the strong Erinyes, the Giants in gleaming armour with long spears, and the Nymphs called Meliae.

claims.quote: But these sons whom he begot himself great Heaven used to call Titans (Strainers) in reproach, for he said that they strained and did presumptuously [210] a fearful deed, and that vengeance for it would come afterwards.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Langit yang agung menjuluki putra-putranya "Titan" (Para Penegang) sebagai celaan, karena mereka berbuat lancang suatu perbuatan mengerikan, dan ia berkata bahwa pembalasan akan datang kemudian.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, great Heaven called his sons Titans (Strainers) in reproach, saying they strained and did presumptuously a fearful deed, and that vengeance for it would come afterwards.

claims.quote: However, no cult addressed directly to Uranus survived into classical times, and Uranus does not appear among the usual themes of Greek painted pottery.

statement.id: Tidak ada kultus yang ditujukan langsung kepada Uranus yang bertahan hingga masa klasik, dan Uranus tidak termasuk tema lazim keramik lukis Yunani.
statement.en: No cult addressed directly to Uranus survived into classical times, and Uranus is not among the usual themes of Greek painted pottery.

claims.quote: is the personification of the sky and one of the Greek primordial deities. According to Hesiod, Uranus was the son and husband of Gaia (Earth), with whom he fathered the first generation of Titans.

statement.id: Uranus adalah personifikasi langit dan salah satu dewa purba Yunani; menurut Hesiod ia putra sekaligus suami Gaia, yang bersamanya menurunkan generasi pertama Titan.
statement.en: Uranus is the personification of the sky and one of the Greek primordial deities; according to Hesiod he was the son and husband of Gaia, with whom he fathered the first generation of Titans.

claims.quote: Most linguists trace the etymology of the name Οὐρανός to a Proto-Greek form *Worsanós

statement.id: Kebanyakan ahli bahasa menelusuri etimologi nama Οὐρανός ke bentuk Proto-Yunani *Worsanós.
statement.en: Most linguists trace the etymology of the name Οὐρανός to a Proto-Greek form *Worsanós.

short_description.id: Saraswati adalah dewi Hindu yang dikaitkan dengan ilmu, kebijaksanaan, musik, dan seni; ia juga dewi ujaran dan, pada awalnya, sungai suci.
short_description.en: Saraswati is a Hindu goddess associated with learning, wisdom, music, and the arts; she is also the goddess of speech and, originally, a sacred river.

long_description.id: Saraswati (juga ditulis Sarasvati) dikenal dalam tradisi Hindu sebagai dewi ilmu, kebijaksanaan, musik, dan estetika. Sebagai Vac, ia adalah dewi ujaran. Ia dikenal pula dengan nama seperti Bharati, Vedamata ("ibu para Veda"), dan Vagisvari. Ia juga pelindung seni dan ilmu pengetahuan, dan dipuja sebagai dewi ilmu dalam Jainisme serta oleh beberapa sekte Buddha.
long_description.en: In Hindu tradition Saraswati (also written Sarasvati) is the goddess of learning, wisdom, music, and aesthetics. As Vac she presides over speech. She also bears names such as Bharati, Vedamata ("mother of the Vedas"), and Vagisvari. She is a patron of the arts and sciences too, and is revered as a goddess of learning in Jainism and among some Buddhist sects.

long_description.id: Namanya pertama muncul dalam Rigveda, dan dalam teks keagamaan yang lebih belakangan ia disebut penemu bahasa Sanskerta serta pemberi pena dan tinta kepada Ganesha. Nama Saraswati berarti "anggun", "mengalir", dan "berair". Mula-mula ia dikaitkan dengan sungai kuno yang bernama sama, dan sungai itu kemudian berkembang menjadi dewi yang dipersonifikasikan. Seiring waktu ia semakin dirayakan sebagai dewi segala perairan.
long_description.en: Her earliest appearance is in the Rigveda, and later religious texts name her as the inventor of Sanskrit and the giver of pen and ink to Ganesha. Her name means "elegant", "flowing", and "watery". She was originally linked with an ancient river of the same name, which later developed into a personified deity. Over time she came to be celebrated as the goddess of all waters.

long_description.id: Himne Rigveda dalam terjemahan Griffith memuji Sarasvati sebagai sungai dahsyat yang menjebol punggung bukit dengan ombaknya dan menemukan sungai bagi suku-suku manusia. Ia juga digambarkan menjatuhkan mereka yang menghina para dewa, bersaudara tujuh, dan berasal dari tiga sumber.
long_description.en: A Rigveda hymn in Griffith's translation praises Sarasvati as a mighty river that bursts the ridges of the hills with her waves and discovers rivers for the tribes of men. She is also described as casting down those who scorned the gods, as seven-sistered, and as sprung from a threefold source.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Hindu, Saraswati adalah istri Brahma, tetapi sebagian tradisi menyebutnya mula-mula istri Vishnu. Menurut satu kisah, Brahma menunggu istrinya untuk memulai upacara penting lalu para dewa menciptakan istri baru baginya, Gayatri. Saraswati yang tiba kemudian mengutuk Brahma agar tidak dipuja manusia. Putranya adalah resi Sarasvata, yang selamat dari Kekeringan Besar sebagai penyimpan kitab Veda.
long_description.en: In Hindu mythology Saraswati is Brahma's wife, though some traditions call her first the wife of Vishnu. In one tale, Brahma waited for his wife to begin an important ceremony, so the gods created a new wife for him, Gayatri. When Saraswati arrived later, she cursed Brahma never to be worshipped by humanity. Her son is the rishi Sarasvata, who survived the Great Drought as a keeper of the Vedas.

long_description.id: Saraswati Puja dirayakan pada hari pertama musim semi: pemuja mengenakan pakaian kuning, arca sang dewi dibalut sutra kuning, dan anak-anak diajari menulis untuk pertama kalinya. Musisi berdoa kepadanya sebelum konser dan pelajar sebelum ujian. Ia juga dipuja dalam perayaan Navaratri.
long_description.en: The Saraswati Puja is held on the first day of spring: worshippers wear yellow, statues of the goddess are draped in yellow silk, and children are taught to write for the first time. Musicians pray to her before concerts and students before examinations. She is also worshipped at Navaratri.

long_description.id: Dalam seni Hindu ia biasanya digambarkan sebagai remaja anggun berkulit putih dengan sari putih bertepi biru, sering berlengan empat dengan manuskrip, teratai putih, dan vina, serta dapat menunggang angsa atau soang. Ia lazim ditemani angsa, meskipun sebuah cetakan menampilkan merak di sisinya.
long_description.en: In Hindu art she is usually shown as a graceful white-skinned youth in a white sari with a blue border, often four-armed with a manuscript, a white lotus, and a vina, and may ride a swan or goose. A swan conventionally accompanies her, though one print shows a peacock beside her.

cultural_context.id: Menurut keterangan koleksi museum, atribut Saraswati (vina, manuskrip seukuran telapak tangan, dan tasbih) menandai perannya sebagai dewi pengetahuan.
cultural_context.en: According to the museum catalog entry, Saraswati's attributes (the vina, a palm-sized manuscript, and a rosary) denote her role as a goddess of knowledge.

statement.en: As the patron of music she is frequently prayed to by musicians before concerts, and as a goddess of intellectual pursuits by students before examinations.

claims.quote: In Hindu mythology, Saraswati is the wife of the great god Brahma. However, according to some traditions, she was first the wife of Vishnu.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Hindu, Saraswati adalah istri dewa agung Brahma, tetapi menurut sebagian tradisi ia mula-mula istri Vishnu.
statement.en: In Hindu mythology Saraswati is the wife of the great god Brahma, but according to some traditions she was first the wife of Vishnu.

claims.quote: One day, when, awaiting his wife to begin an important religious ceremony and so unable to start the ritual punctually, Brahma asked the gods' advice. They responded by creating a new wife for him, Gayatri, so that the ceremony could go ahead at the precise time.

statement.id: Suatu hari, ketika menunggu istrinya untuk memulai upacara penting sehingga tak dapat memulai ritual tepat waktu, Brahma meminta nasihat para dewa; mereka menciptakan istri baru baginya, Gayatri, agar upacara berjalan pada waktunya.
statement.en: One day, while waiting for his wife to begin an important ceremony and unable to start the ritual on time, Brahma asked the gods' advice; they created a new wife for him, Gayatri, so that the ceremony could proceed at the proper time.

statement.en: When Saraswati finally arrived and saw her husband with another woman she was displeased and cursed Brahma never to be worshipped by humanity (although he is worshipped today in parts of South-east Asia).

claims.quote: More specifically, Saraswati's son is the rishi (sage) Sarasvata. He, nourished by the bountiful waters of his mother, was able to withstand the Great Drought of Hindu mythology and so survive as the definitive repository of the Vedas sacred texts.
